links.title: KV-Rescue: Recovering Reasoning Language Model KV Eviction Loss via Stepwise Interleaving

evidence: Abstract: 'recovers an average of 87% of the accuracy lost to eviction at eviction budget B=64' and 'reduces base-model token generation by 43% on average'
Introduction/Figure 1: 'an oracle choice between an evicted 7B model and a full-context 1.5B model recovers 79% of the accuracy gap to the full-KV 7B model'

Table 2 (Degeneration Analysis): cumulative ablation at budget 64 shows interleaving lifts accuracy 52.8→81.8%, cuts degeneration 13.4→2.8%, and early exit removes a further 20% of base tokens (7.9k→6.3k) at 8.0% early-exit rate

Appendix C (Implementation Details): R-KV with λ=0.1, window 128, budgets B∈{64,128,256,512}; detector thresholds τ_ent=7.0, τ_cmp=0.18, w_cmp=800; sampling temp 0.8, top-p 0.95, top-k 20, max context 4096; AIME/AMC averaged over five seeds, other benchmarks single seed
Appendix E Table 5: full 4×5 pass@1 grid (7B/72B × N=1,8 × 5 benchmarks) including full-KV and small full-KV references; e.g. 7B N=8 B=64 b2n 82.2 vs bon 52.8 vs full-KV 84.0 on MATH500
Appendix E (KV-Rescue with SnapKV): 'repeats the 7B study with R-KV replaced by SnapKV... the same pattern holds', supporting evictor-agnosticism
Table 3 (MATH500 wall-clock efficiency): at batch 64 KV-Rescue achieves 10.6 prob/min vs BoN 3.2 (3.3×), 5,460 72B tokens vs 18,371, while full-KV OOMs

Limitation evidence: 'Models' section uses only Qwen2.5-Math family; benchmarks are all math (MATH500, AIME24, AMC23, GSM8K, OlympiadBench); no code or artifact availability statement appears in the paper
Appendix D: derived and measured eviction-vs-full-KV compute crossover ℓ*≈2500 (α≈2.9) and helper overhead ρ≈24% (7B base) / 2.5% (72B base) at ℓ=4k
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-methodology paper: KV-cache eviction for reasoning LMs, PRM-guided test-time scaling, and inference efficiency (matches LLM, Reasoning/CoT, Long Context, Inference & Serving preferences). The information-gap vs capability-gap framing plus stepwise interleaving of an evicted base with a full-context helper is a genuinely new angle distinct from SmallKV-style eviction guidance, and the entropy/gzip online degeneration detector is simple but well-motivated. Rigor is solid: 5 math benchmarks, 7B/72B bases, two evictors (R-KV and SnapKV in Appendix E), cumulative ablation (Table 2) isolating interleaving vs early exit, oracle complementarity analysis, and a wall-clock throughput study (Table 3) with theoretical cost derivation (Appendix D). Main weaknesses: evaluation restricted to one model family (Qwen2.5-Math) and math tasks only, hand-tuned detector thresholds (τ_ent=7.0, τ_cmp=0.18) with no sensitivity analysis, comparison gives KV-Rescue 2N total candidates vs BoN's N (partially mitigated by the cost analysis), and no code release statement despite detailed hyperparameters. Quantitative claims (87% recovery, 43% token reduction, 3.3x throughput) are traceable to tables and internally consistent.

primary_link.title: KV-Rescue: Recovering Reasoning Language Model KV Eviction Loss via Stepwise Interleaving

papers.summary: KV-cache eviction caps the memory cost of long reasoning traces but is inherently lossy because the model decodes from a partial view of its history. Under aggressive budgets, this not only lowers accuracy but can also cause runaway degeneration, where the model produces incoherent or repetitive tokens until reaching the length limit. We characterize much of this loss as an information gapf caused by missing context, rather than a capability gap caused by limited model capacity. An evicted 7B mo
papers.summary_zh: KV 快取驅逐能限制長推理軌跡的記憶體成本，但本質上是有損的：模型只能從部分歷史解碼，在激進預算下不僅降低準確率，還可能引發失控退化，產生不連貫或重複迴圈的 token 直到長度上限。本文核心觀察是此損失主要源自資訊落差而非能力落差：被驅逐的 7B 模型與完整上下文的 1.5B 小模型會犯互補的錯誤，兩者答案間的 oracle 選擇可恢復 79% 的準確率差距。據此作者提出 KV-Rescue，一個免訓練的推論框架：在每個推理步驟同時自 KV 驅逐的基礎模型與輕量全上下文輔助模型取樣候選步驟，由 process reward model 選出最佳步驟提交至共享軌跡，並以熵與 gzip 可壓縮性構成的線上偵測器即時終止不連貫或重複迴圈的基礎模型候選。在五個數學基準與 Qwen2.5-Math 7B／72B 上，KV-Rescue 於驅逐預算 B=64 時平均恢復 87% 的準確率損失，並透過抑制失控退化減少 43% 的基礎模型 token 生成；在批次 64 時吞吐量為僅驅逐 best-of-N 的 3.3 倍，而完整 KV 此時會發生記憶體不足。消融顯示交錯與提前終止各自貢獻明確，輔助模型提供 17%–34% 的已提交步驟。此方法可與不同驅逐策略正交組合，展現互補上下文視角在嚴格記憶體限制下維持推理品質的價值。
papers.title: KV-Rescue: Recovering Reasoning Language Model KV Eviction Loss via Stepwise Interleaving
papers.title_zh: KV-Rescue：以步驟交錯恢復推理語言模型的 KV 驅逐損失

links.title: Cross-Entropy Risk Estimation for Language Models: Inconsistency Must Be Dense, and the Holdout Method Is No Exception

evidence: Abstract: states the per-token cross-entropy risk 'cannot be consistently estimated', that inconsistency is dense under restrictions, and identifies two 'ways out' (floored models via bounded context window; screened reporting below a pre-fixed threshold).
Section 1: motivates via practice — the quantity 'decides which checkpoint ships' and 'is the quantity scaling laws are fitted to' (Kaplan et al. 2020; Hoffmann et al. 2022).

Section 4.1: Theorem 1 (no estimator pointwise consistent on P_<∞×Q), Theorem 2 (survives bounding expected sequence length by L and restricting to full-support models Q_>0), Theorem 3 (failures are dense on P_<L×Q_>0 under total-variation metrization).

Appendix A: Lemma 1 reduces estimation to a finiteness test; Lemma 4 constructs 'witness' models with quadratic loss growth, dense in Q; Proposition 2 gives a budgeted vacillation construction proving every test is densely inconsistent on P_<L, using Lemma 2 (lower semicontinuity) for the limit argument.

Section 5.1: bounded context window ⇒ finitely many distinct next-token distributions ⇒ floor β>0 ⇒ linear loss growth ⇒ holdout consistency; candidly notes real β is 'on the order of e^{-30}', so the bound is 'finite and useless', and the finite-expected-length assumption it needs is untestable (Proposition 3).
Section 5.2: screened estimator ρ̂^r is consistent at every state except ρ=r exactly, requiring only the law of large numbers, and loses 'nothing that model selection needed'.

Section 6 + Appendix C: reformulates the result as eight jointly inconsistent conditions and surveys six further exits, including Appendix C.2's argument that locality plus strict propriety force an unbounded loss, and that sequence-level Brier risk of every model 'lies within a vanishing distance of 1'.

Section 7: closing honestly frames the result as 'no free lunch' — held-out evaluation rests on an untestable presupposition (finite expected sequence length) that the floor 'relocates rather than discharges'.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A rigorous mathematical-statistics paper whose object is genuinely the LLM pipeline: the held-out per-token cross-entropy risk that scaling laws (Kaplan, Hoffmann) are fitted to and that gates checkpoint selection. It proves an impossibility theorem — no estimator of per-token risk is pointwise consistent, the failure survives bounding expected sequence length and restricting to full-support (softmax) models, and is dense in that restricted state space — and offers two constructive exits: a bounded context window induces a probability floor giving a new statistical rationale for context windows, and a screened (threshold) estimand restores consistency for model selection. Preference relevance is solid but concentrated on the LLM/evaluation/scaling clusters; it does not touch the highest-weight applied clusters (agents, reasoning, Japanese LLMs). Novelty is high: the mutual denseness of finite/infinite risk and the reduction of estimation to an untestable finiteness hypothesis go beyond Antos–Kontoyiannis (whose consistency holds only on the finite-entropy class) and the conditional-independence hardness literature, and the LLM-specific framing (window floor, two-stage pretrain-then-sift procedure) is fresh. Rigor is excellent: complete, careful proofs in Appendix A (witness-model construction, coupling/Lipschitz lemma, budgeted vacillation construction with l.s.c. bookkeeping to stay inside P_<L). Evidence strength is high for a theory paper — all claims are theorem-backed, with no empirical validation needed or offered. Generalizability is moderate: results cover any local strictly proper (hence unbounded) loss on an infinite sequence space, and the (p,q)-state consistency refinement is portable, but the analysis is specific to sequence-model evaluation. Reproducibility is good: self-contained definitions and full proofs permit independent verification. Limitations are honestly flagged (floor quantitatively vacuous at β~e^{-30}, the finite-expected-length presupposition is relocated not discharged, non-uniformity in L).

primary_link.title: Cross-Entropy Risk Estimation for Language Models: Inconsistency Must Be Dense, and the Holdout Method Is No Exception

papers.summary: Language models are compared by their held-out per-token cross-entropy risk---the quantity scaling laws are fitted to. We show that it cannot be consistently estimated. Consistency, or convergence to the estimand, is defined relative to a \emph{possible state of the world}: a pair consisting of a data-generating distribution and a model we turn out to train. Quantifying over models as well as data-generating mechanisms is essential, because what decides whether a model's risk is estimable is a t
papers.summary_zh: 語言模型常以保留樣本的 per-token cross-entropy 風險互相比較,scaling law 也以此為擬合對象。本文證明該風險無法被一致地估計:序列空間可數無限,而 softmax 模型對每條序列都給正機率,風險可能發散為無窮;在總變差拓撲下,有限與無限風險兩類狀態互為稠密。作者將一致性定義於「世界狀態」(資料分布 p 與已訓練模型 q 的配對),並證得三個定理:不存在任何估計量能在風險有定義的所有狀態上收斂;即使限制期望序列長度有界且模型具完整支撐,失敗仍存在;且不一致的狀態在該空間中稠密,任何局部假設都救不回一致性。證明思路是將估計化約為「風險是否有限」的檢定問題,而此檢定不可解。文中提出兩條出路:一是有限 context window 使 next-token 機率有下限,此時風險恰在期望序列長度有限時為有限,為 context window 提供統計上的新理由;二是只在風險低於預設門檻時回報數值,即可恢復一致性,且足以支援模型選擇。兩者皆有代價:前者把無法檢定的假設轉移到資料生成端,後者放棄了解被拒模型究竟有多壞。此結果凸顯保留集評估隱含期望長度有限的預設,也指出預訓練學習理論必須正視風險估計。
papers.title: Cross-Entropy Risk Estimation for Language Models: Inconsistency Must Be Dense, and the Holdout Method Is No Exception
papers.title_zh: 語言模型的交叉熵風險估計:不一致性必然稠密,保留集方法也不例外

links.title: TRACE: Trajectory Aware Reasoning for Multi-Turn Adversarial Conversation Evaluation

evidence: Section 6 / Table 2: Trace-GRPO attains average ASR 14.5% across seven multi-turn attacks vs 31.4% for best baseline STAIR and 74.9% for the undefended target, including OOD attacks FITD (20.0%) and AMA (19.2%)

Section 6.2 / Table 2: Trace-GRPO recovers near-base full-compliance on over-refusal benchmarks (PHTest 93.0%, XSTest 93.6%) while STAIR degrades to 44.1%/62.0%; Table 3 shows general capability preserved (e.g., GSM-8K 79.6 vs base 81.1)

Appendix K / Table 8: ablation replacing the three-axis judge and removing harm-adjacent data yields lower ASR (0.8% X-Teaming) but PHTest refusal rises from 7.0% to 36.7%, confirming the safety-helpfulness design is load-bearing
Appendix G / Table 7: human-LLM annotation agreement quadratic-weighted kappa 0.81-0.86 on scores/action and cue Jaccard 0.69-0.74, validating the Claude-Sonnet-4.5 labeling pipeline

Limitations section: evaluation restricted to English-only attacks on a single target (Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct), text-only trajectories, and the explicit State block is acknowledged as a potential prompt-injection attack surface

Appendix L / Tables 9-10: full SFT/GRPO hyperparameters and model IDs with licenses are listed, but the dataset is only promised for release under a gated research-only license (Ethical Considerations) with no code release stated
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core in-scope LLM-safety paper: multi-turn jailbreak defense with trajectory-aware structured reasoning, cue taxonomy, dual-hypothesis scoring, SFT+GRPO training on Llama-3.1-8B, directly matching LLM, AI Safety, Red Teaming, Reasoning, and Alignment preferences. Novelty is solid but incremental over STAIR/GuardReasoner-style reasoning defenses, distinguished mainly by trajectory-level reasoning and the DRI effort metric. Rigor is strong: seven attack benchmarks, six baselines including reasoning-based STAIR, OOD attacks (FITD, AMA), human annotation validation (Appendix G, quadratic-weighted kappa 0.81-0.92), and an informative ablation (Appendix K Table 8) showing the three-axis judge and harm-adjacent data are load-bearing. Evidence is quantitatively detailed but judge-based (GPT-5.2, per-attack native judges) with no variance/significance reporting and single-target evaluation. Generalizability is limited by English-only, single target model, and text-only attacks, as the authors acknowledge. Reproducibility is moderate: hyperparameters, attack configs, and model IDs are fully specified, but the dataset is only promised under a gated license and no code release is stated.

primary_link.title: TRACE: Trajectory Aware Reasoning for Multi-Turn Adversarial Conversation Evaluation

papers.summary: Multi-turn jailbreak attacks have emerged as a critical safety threat to LLMs, as harmful objectives are decomposed across a sequence of apparently benign turns to bypass guardrails. Existing defenses lack the reasoning capacity to identify evolving manipulation patterns, often trading helpfulness for safety by over-refusing benign requests related to sensitive topics. We introduce Trace, a multi-turn defense with trajectory-aware structured reasoning. Before generating each response, the model
papers.summary_zh: 多輪越獄攻擊把有害意圖拆散到看似無害的對話輪次,現有防禦缺乏對對話軌跡的推理,且常過度拒答敏感但無害的請求。TRACE 提出軌跡感知的結構化推理:回答每輪之前,模型先自軌跡辨識 11 種操縱線索(分四大類),並對使用者意圖同時建立良性與對抗兩種假設、各自評分,再彙整為 1–5 的越獄風險分數,決定 Allow、Caution 或 Decline。資料上,作者以五種攻擊框架針對 300 個有害行為產生 4 千筆多輪對話,搭配 2.4 千筆良性對話與 6 百筆敏感但無害的對話,以 Claude-Sonnet-4.5 標註推理軌跡,對 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 先做 SFT,再以結合分數準確度、線索偵測與行為一致性的多成分獎勵進行 GRPO(GDPO)訓練。在七個多輪攻擊基準上,TRACE-GRPO 平均 ASR 為 14.5%,遠低於最強基線 STAIR 的 31.4% 與未防禦目標的 74.9%,同時在過度拒答基準維持 93.3% 的完全配合率;攻擊成本指標 DRI 最高提升逾百倍,顯示軌跡級推理能同時兼顧安全與可用性。限制包括僅評估英文、單一目標模型與純文字攻擊,State 區塊可能成為新的攻擊面,線索分類亦需持續擴充。

links.title: PLSQLBench: Benchmarking LLM Systems for Executable Procedural Database Programming

evidence: Abstract: PLSQLBench contains 2,865 instances (2,594 single-turn tasks, 271 multi-turn conversations spanning 978 turns); experiments with eight LLMs; code released at github.com/oracle-samples/plsqlbench.

Section 4.3: GPT-5.4 achieves highest test Mean Test Pass@1 at 64.96%; Codex DB Agent improves Spider2 test Mean Test Pass@1 by 6.9-9.8 points (GPT-5.4-Mini) and 12.0-14.5 points (GPT-5.6-Sol); best model below 65% indicating headroom.

Appendix B.5: rule-based MBPP conversion validated by Oracle-backed replay (806/823 MBPP, 308/323 MBPP+ retained) and Python-PL/SQL behavioral cross-checks agreeing on 96.8% of MBPP and 89.7% of MBPP+ output-comparable records.

Section 4.4 / Appendix E.2: error taxonomy over execution logs attributes 11,015 failures (82.5%) to wrong procedure logic, 1,777 (13.3%) to invalid artifacts, and 566 (4.2%) to interface/schema grounding, with representative examples using Oracle diagnostics (PLS-00201, ORA-00900).

Appendix G: temperature 0.0, max 8192 output tokens, Oracle Autonomous Database 23ai serverless; Section 4.1 uses database-disjoint private test splits; Limitations notes read-only tasks, test-coverage bounds, and no benchmark-specific training set.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly on-preference: an LLM code-generation/agent benchmark (Code 2.0, Agents 2.5, LLMs 2.5, Evaluation 1.8, Reasoning 2.5) evaluating eight LLMs and Codex-based tool-augmented agents on executable procedural PL/SQL. Novelty is solid but primarily as a new benchmark niche (first procedural-SQL execution benchmark per Related Work), largely by adapting Spider, Spider 2.0, and MBPP/MBPP+ rather than introducing new methods. Rigor is good: database-disjoint held-out splits, multi-stage quality control, multiple strict/partial-credit metrics, and replay/behavioral validation of the rule-based MBPP conversion; weaknesses are single-sample Pass@1 at temperature 0.0 with no variance or significance testing and brittle string-comparison for Spider-PLSQL. Evidence is detailed (per-model tables, quantified agent gains, error taxonomy with counts), though self-reported by an industry team. Generalizability is limited by Oracle/PL/SQL-only scope and read-only restriction. Reproducibility is aided by released code, prompts, and hyperparameters, but private test splits constrain independent re-scoring.

primary_link.title: PLSQLBench: Benchmarking LLM Systems for Executable Procedural Database Programming

papers.summary: We present PLSQLBench, to our knowledge the first benchmark for evaluating whether LLMs can write executable PL/SQL programs, with correctness measured through execution-based tests. Existing LLM evaluations largely target general-purpose code generation or declarative text-to-SQL, leaving procedural database programming underexplored. PLSQLBench contains 2,865 instances: 2,594 single-turn tasks and 271 multi-turn conversations spanning 978 turns. The benchmark combines complex schema-grounded t
papers.summary_zh: 現有程式碼生成與 text-to-SQL 基準多聚焦宣告式查詢或一般程式設計,程序性資料庫程式設計(如 PL/SQL)長期未被系統性評估。PLSQLBench 是首個以執行為本的 PL/SQL 基準,含 2,865 個實例:2,594 個單輪任務與 271 段跨 978 輪的多輪對話,涵蓋企業級 Spider 2.0 資料庫、Spider 1.0 與 MBPP 衍生的程序題;任務皆為唯讀,以利重現。評估在 Oracle Autonomous Database 上實際執行,提供 Mean Test Pass@1(部分給分)、Suite Pass@1(全部測試通過)與多輪 Episode Pass@1。八個模型中,GPT-5.4 以 64.96% 的測試平均最高,Claude-Opus-4.8 與開源 Gemma-4-31B 緊隨其後;工具增強的 Codex DB Agent 可再將 Spider2 成績提升 6.9 至 14.5 個百分點,但嚴格指標下最佳多輪 Episode Pass@1 僅 41.27%,顯示錯誤會跨輪累積。錯誤分析顯示 82.5% 的失敗為程序邏輯或輸出錯誤,13.3% 為無效或不完整的 PL/SQL,4.2% 為介面或 schema 對接錯誤,後者九成集中於多輪情境。限制:僅涵蓋唯讀工作流程,正確性受測試覆蓋率限制,且未附訓練集,結果應視為泛化能力指標。

links.title: Q-First: Most of Attention Needs Only the Query in Disaggregated LLM Decoding

evidence: Section 1 ('What this paper does not claim'): 'No speedup is measured... what it buys needs two devices and a decode loop'; overlap demonstrated only via Appendix D simulation whose finish-time number 'is not a speedup this paper claims'.
Section 2: protocol verified end to end on a trained checkpoint to 4.2e-3 relative, runs on stock flash-attention kernel returning log-sum-exp; no custom operator or changed tensor shape.
Section 5: mergeable-aggregate identity verified with 200 random four-way cache splits agreeing to 1.4e-7.

Section 7: family A arms within 0.0011 bits/byte of control vs measured 3-seed resolution 0.0117; same runs resolve sub-layer exchange at 56x and shared-query arm at 91x; shared-query +0.1003 exceeds pre-registered +0.05 refutation threshold at every seed.

Section 6: converting a trained checkpoint fine-tunes W_q only (9.5%/9.1%), residual +0.0142 (Qwen3-0.6B) and +0.0088 (Qwen3-4B), reproduced across 2 seeds to 0.0003; stated as an upper bound since 'equal steps is not equal difficulty'.
Section 10: all figures are validation with checkpoint and learning rate selected on it; held-out test split moves gaps <=0.0094 (<=0.0020 in family A); 24 runs = 51 GPU-hours, each run 2.0-2.7h.
Section 12 Limitations: one model family, one scale, one corpus, 3 seeds at 3% compute-optimal; arrangement 'is verified, not built'; family gap -0.0623 reported but unexplained.

Reproducibility statement: all numbers generated from run records by script (unmeasured numbers raise build errors), pre-registrations under protocols/ with stated verdict thresholds; code at github.com/fan-wenjie/qfirst.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM inference-efficiency paper: a decode protocol for disaggregated serving in which the cache-side device receives only the query, enabling KV-sweep/feed-forward overlap without changing the graph. Strongly matches LLM, Inference & Serving, Scaling & Efficiency, and Transformer Architecture preferences. The observation is framed with an exact re-bracketing identity (conjugation of shifted vs ordinary stacks, verified bit-identical), which is a genuinely neat reframing distinct from parallel blocks (GPT-J/PaLM) and from prior query-routing work it cites. Rigor is unusually high for a systems-adjacent paper: 8 arms x 3 seeds with all seeds printed, pre-registered refutation gates (+0.05 threshold exceeded at every seed by the shared-query arm), paired-difference statistics with a measured resolution band (0.0117), held-out test-split and overlapping-window checks, and identical measured parameter counts/arithmetic. However, the decisive practical claim is untested: no speedup, latency, or throughput is measured anywhere ('What this paper does not claim', Section 1; Section 12), overlap is only illustrated via a hand-checked 12-request simulation (Appendix D) that explicitly disclaims a speedup. Training evidence is one model family (Qwen3-0.6B from scratch), one corpus (WikiText-103, 372M tokens), 3% of compute-optimal; the null result 'moving the read point is free' is carefully bounded but is a null at small budget, and the conversion residual (+0.0142) is an upper bound at one budget on one corpus. Generalizability is limited accordingly, though the core identity is architecture-agnostic and forward-only probes on hybrid checkpoints are included. Reproducibility is strong: code released, every number generated from run records by script, pre-registrations under protocols/, cheap 51 GPU-hour campaign. Net: a methodologically honest, well-verified decomposition whose deployment value remains unmeasured.

primary_link.title: Q-First: Most of Attention Needs Only the Query in Disaggregated LLM Decoding

The usual repair costs one resident KV cache per extra sequence in flight, which is what motivated separating the devices at all. We remove the dependency i
papers.summary_zh: 解耦式解碼把 KV cache 掃描放在記憶體最佳化硬體,把投影與前饋網路放在算力最佳化硬體,但解碼器區塊內注意力先行,導致單一序列內兩側互相等待,通常只能靠增加並行序列掩蓋。本文觀察:上下文長度為 j 時已有 j-1 個位置快取,注意力的掃描其實只需要 query;只要讓前饋層先執行、query 提早存在,兩側即可並行,當前 key/value 之後再寫入,無人等待。作者以代數證明此重排等同於把層邊界畫在半個子層之外,是經建構性驗證的恆等變換;裝置回傳可合併的 softmax 統計量,cache 可任意切分、任序合併,兩張普通加速器即可依權重種類分工。訓練實驗以 Qwen3-0.6B 從頭訓練三個種子:提早讀取 query 等改動與對照組差異在 0.0011 bits per byte 內,遠低於種子解析度 0.0117;但自網路輸入投影所有層的 query 會增加 0.1003,超過預先註冊的否證門檻,顯示自由度僅限一個前饋層範圍。既有 checkpoint 僅微調 Wq(約 9.5% 參數)即可遷移,殘餘成本上界為 +0.0142 bits per byte。限制:未量測加速比,僅單一模型家族、規模與語料,收斂結果為上界而非實測;此分解為解耦式推論提供了近乎零成本的排程自由度。
papers.title: Q-First: Most of Attention Needs Only the Query in Disaggregated LLM Decoding
papers.title_zh: Q-First:解耦式 LLM 解碼中,注意力大多只需要 query

links.title: Bounded Agents: Delegation Security for Multi-Agent AI Systems

evidence: Abstract: 'AgentDojo exfiltration fell from 75-100% to 0% across all four domains; APC blocked all 544 InjecAgent data-stealing cases' and 'utility was 8.6 and 13.9 percentage points lower in the two settings'.
Sec. 6.2, Table 4: 'Complete X reduces data stealing from 100% to 0%. Direct harm drops to 60.4%: the remaining cases are single-action attacks within scope that require parameter-level validation.'

Sec. 6.4, Table 7: 'Pair-weighted aggregate deltas across the 949 task-injection pairs are -13.9 pp under the strict condition and -8.6 pp under the interactive condition' (3 runs, std devs reported).
Sec. 7.4 Limitations: 'all benchmarks are synthetic, and no production-deployment data is presented' and 'the theorems are not machine-checked; mechanized proofs are future work.'
Sec. 6.4: compromised-model evaluation 'appends the ground-truth attack tool call after the first legitimate tool call, simulating full model compromise' - a simulation, not live model compromise.
Sec. 6.4 matched-protocol comparison: Progent 'reported here without a corresponding artifact in our repository, since redistributing it is outside our control.'
Appendix I: 'available at https://github.com/xmuruaga/bounded-agents' (implementation, evaluation harnesses, domain configurations).

Appendix D: latency measured on 'Intel Core i5-1245U ... mobile-class processor' with disclosed load sensitivity ('0.083-0.091 ms p50 ... 0.345-0.427 ms p99' under load), 0.24 ms p99 under no-load protocol.

Sec. 6.5: 'We design twenty-three attacks by an adversary with full knowledge of the model' - self-designed adaptive attacks, 23/24 attack variants blocked, session splitting admitted as documented limitation.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core agentic-AI security contribution squarely matching priority topics (agents & tool use, AI safety, evaluation/red-teaming): a session-scoped authorization model (APC) with composition closure enforced outside the LLM runtime, targeting prompt-injection-driven tool misuse. Novelty is solid but not maximal: composition restriction is a coarse-grained action-type variant of information-flow control and separation-of-duty (acknowledged in Sec. 8), and adjacent systems (CaMeL, Progent, SEAgent) are credited; the per-hop blast-radius monotonicity and compromised-model evaluation methodology are the most original elements. Rigor is above average: explicit threat model (Sec. 3), conditionally-stated theorems with assumptions (Thm. 4.6, 4.8, Prop. 4.9), residual-failure taxonomy (Table 9), matched-protocol Progent comparison with an equivalence threshold, and candid limitation analysis (Sec. 7.4: synthetic benchmarks only, self-designed adaptive attacks, unmechanized proofs). Evidence is multi-benchmark (3,154 instances: InjecAgent 1,054; ASB 400; AgentDojo 949 utility / 609 compromised; 99 chain scenarios) with baselines and reported utility cost (-8.6 pp interactive, Table 7), though the 'compromise' condition is simulated ground-truth call injection rather than real model compromise, and the Progent-side figures lack a committed artifact. Reproducibility is strong: code, harnesses, domain configs, and latency run files are released (Appendix I, Appendix D) with model versions pinned. Score reflects high topical fit with real but bounded novelty and synthetic-only external validation.

primary_link.title: Bounded Agents: Delegation Security for Multi-Agent AI Systems

papers.summary: LLM-based agents can act on behalf of a user to access cloud services, call tools, or invoke agents. At session start, the agent's permissions are set but remain static, and each request is evaluated independently, without considering prior actions. Within its permissions, an agent may act contrary to the delegated task, combine individually permitted actions into a prohibited outcome, or delegate authority to a sub-agent without limiting it. A prompt injection poses a risk only if the agent has
papers.summary_zh: 本文主張提示注入的安全性後果本質上是授權架構問題，而非單純的模型穩健性問題。LLM 代理人會代使用者呼叫工具、存取雲端服務或委派子代理人，但傳統存取控制以個別請求獨立評估，無法防範代理人在權限內組合多個被允許的動作以達成禁止的結果（如先讀取機密文件再外寄郵件外洩資料）。作者提出 Agentic Principal Chain（APC）模型：以工作階段為範圍的授權狀態，隨委派鏈傳遞並逐跳縮減範圍與預算，由模型外部的 PDP/PEP 基礎設施以六項授權條件強制執行，核心原語為組合封閉（禁止特定動作類型組合）與意圖綁定。論文證明爆炸半徑單調性與組合健全性兩項形式性質。在涵蓋 InjecAgent、AgentDojo、ASB 共 3,154 個評測實例中，受損模型評測下所有四個 AgentDojo 網域的資料外洩攻擊成功率從 75–100% 降為 0%，544 個 InjecAgent 資料竊取案例全數被阻擋，互動式設定的效用代價為 −8.6 個百分點。限制在於範圍內單一動作誤用與參數層攻擊仍需互補機制，且組合狀態不跨工作階段。此研究顯示授權架構可在模型行為之外提供可證明的安全保證。
papers.title: Bounded Agents: Delegation Security for Multi-Agent AI Systems
papers.title_zh: 有界代理人：多代理人 AI 系統的委派安全

links.title: Admission Without Answers: Label-Free Certification and Experience Learning for LLM-Based Optimization Modeling

evidence: Abstract: 'AdmitOR raises admission precision to 0.927, against 0.871 for majority vote and 0.726 for execution success'; 8x fewer poisoned admissions than execution success.
Section 4.2 / Table 2: AdmitOR macro accuracy 58.35 vs 54.82 majority vote and 53.89 ground truth; paired bootstrap gain +3.53 [+0.87,+6.75], +3.49 after removing 85 anomalous items.
Section 4.3: preregistered K3 fails; realized FDR 15.9% (22/138), 95% upper bound 22.0%, threshold sweep flat at 14.7-16.5%.
Appendix B: preregistered criteria K1-K4 fixed before unblinding; panel pinned to DeepSeek-V3.2, GPT-5.4, Claude Sonnet 4.6 with Pyomo/HiGHS and gurobipy stacks.
Appendix C / Table 4: audit of all 22 disagreements attributes 15 to text missing decisive data, 5 to truncated precision, 2 to label errors, 0 to gate defects; audit is authors' own (Section 4.3).
Section 4.1 / Appendix C Table 6: host reproduction within 2.6 macro points; ComplexOR instance labeled 200 re-verified as 250, retained as error under preregistered protocol.
Section 5: acknowledged limitations - shared extractor E=1 invisible to consensus, coverage loss (recall 0.601), conditional guarantee on Assumption 1, single host backbone.
Abstract: 'Code and data are available at https://github.com/junbolian/AdmitOR'; Appendix C reports run ledger, call-level logs, and released case packets.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant to LLM-agent methodology: a label-free admission gate for experience-learning skill libraries built from LLM-generated code across three model families (DeepSeek-V3.2, GPT-5.4, Claude Sonnet 4.6 per Appendix B), touching agents, reasoning consensus, and evaluation. Although instantiated on operations-research modeling, the core contribution is language-model methodology (cross-family behavioral consensus over resampled value-function traces plus finite-sample FDR calibration), not a pure domain application. Rigor is strong: preregistered criteria K1-K4 (Appendix B), collect-once/replay-many judge isolation, paired stratified bootstrap, sealed-vault labels, proofs for Propositions 1-2, and honest reporting of the failed transfer criterion (realized FDR 15.9% vs 10% budget, Section 4.3). Evidence is concrete (precision 0.927 vs 0.871/0.726, Abstract; macro 58.35 vs 54.82 with CI [+0.87,+6.75], Table 2) but gains are modest, ComplexOR has n=18, the 22-case audit is authors' own, and the calibration set is 150 synthetic instances. Generalizability is limited by reliance on solver-exact candidates and value functions, single extractor E=1, single host backbone, and a demonstrated transfer failure. Reproducibility is good: public code/data, verbatim prompts, model pins, run ledger, and released audit packets. Novelty is solid as the first FDR-calibrated label-free admission mechanism, though it composes known conformal selection and self-consistency ideas.

primary_link.title: Admission Without Answers: Label-Free Certification and Experience Learning for LLM-Based Optimization Modeling

papers.summary: Experience-learning agents for optimization modeling improve by storing verified skills, but existing learners admit knowledge by checking against known answers, which real ticket streams do not provide. The natural label-free alternatives are unreliable: on a 300-problem label-blind stream, admitting every executable model poisons roughly one admission in four, while single-instance agreement accepts models that match at one value but differ elsewhere. We propose AdmitOR, an admission gate buil
papers.summary_zh: 經驗學習型代理人透過儲存已驗證技能來改進 LLM 最佳化建模，但真實工單串流不提供標準答案，而放行所有可執行模型會污染知識庫——在 300 題無標籤串流上約四分之一准入有毒。作者提出 AdmitOR 准入閘門：由三個模型家族在不同提示策略與求解器堆疊下產生候選，於從萃取參數域重取樣的多個實例上執行，以跨家族最大團彙整值函數軌跡的一致性，再以校準閾值回傳接受、棄權或上報，目標為名目 5% 的錯誤發現率並附有限樣本認證預算 2α。採用「一次性收集、多次重放」協定，四種評審重放相同日誌：AdmitOR 將准入精確率提升至 0.927（多數決 0.871、執行成功 0.726），並以最小的知識庫在五個公開基準上取得最高宏觀準確率 58.4，增益經配對自助法驗證。關鍵負面結果是校準的轉移假設在野外串流失效：實測錯誤發現率為 15.9%，審計將多數失敗歸因於基準題目文字未完整編碼其標註實例（如列印資料缺漏或精度不足），至少 10.9% 的准入題目無法由文字作答，並提出資料層冗餘作為必要條件。此研究首次以明確校準的錯誤發現率為目標設計無標籤准入機制，並劃定其適用邊界。
papers.title: Admission Without Answers: Label-Free Certification and Experience Learning for LLM-Based Optimization Modeling

links.title: ARENA: Automated Red-Teaming for Large Audio Language Models

evidence: Abstract: ARENA achieves FDR/PSR of 87.9/100.0%, 71.5/96.3%, 68.1/100.0%, and 75.4/98.5% on Audio Flamingo 3, Qwen2-Audio, MiMo-Audio, and GPT-Audio over 520 held-out AdvBench objectives.
Sec. 3.1: final scoring uses two independent Llama Guard 3 calls; MD-Judge is reserved for reward labeling and search feedback and its labels never enter the reported metric.
Sec. 3.6: two-stage controller training with reward-weighted SFT (Eqs. 6-7) followed by DPO (Eqs. 8-10) on reward-labeled preference pairs.

Sec. 3.3 / Sec. 4.1: 2,000 training specifications are disjoint from AdvBench; evaluation uses 520 held-out AdvBench objectives with no overlap in SFT, DPO, checkpoint selection, or reward-weight tuning.
Sec. 4.4 (Refinement Budget): ASR is 23-30% at K=0 and reaches 88%, 74%, and 68% at K=30 on AF3, Qwen2-Audio, and MiMo-Audio, with most gains in the first ten rounds.
Sec. 4.4 (Sound Variants): increasing TangoFlux variants from M=1 to M=16 raises ASR from 70% to 95% (AF3), 59% to 96% (Qwen2-Audio), and 49% to 85% (MiMo-Audio).
Sec. 4.3 (Table 3): off-diagonal transfer ASR of 37.1-67.5%, e.g., AF3-found cases transfer to GPT-Audio at 50.4% without refinement.
Sec. 4.1: only two static baselines (AJailBench, JALMBench) are compared; no automated text-based red-teaming baseline is adapted; code availability is claimed via a GitHub link.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM-safety/red-teaming methodology paper (not pure audio): an LLM controller (LoRA-tuned Qwen3-32B) is trained with reward-weighted SFT and DPO (Sec. 3.6) to generate text-safe queries plus audio prompts that jailbreak audio-language models, directly matching the high-weight AI Safety, Red Teaming & Evaluation, and Alignment/DPO preferences, with LLM judges (MD-Judge for search, Llama Guard 3 for final labels). Novelty is moderate: the audio-grounded, two-sided safety setting is new and the train/judge separation is good hygiene, but the pipeline closely adapts established text/vision automated red-teaming (TRUST-VLM-style feedback loops, DPO). Rigor is solid on design (disjoint 2,000-spec training pool vs. 520 held-out AdvBench objectives, ablations on refinement budget, temperature, top-p, sound variants, transfer matrix) but limited by only two static baselines, judge-only scoring with no human validation, and reward hyperparameters 'searched' without a fully specified tuning protocol (Sec. 4.1). Evidence is quantitatively consistent (FDR=PSR×ASR; diagonals 87.9/74.2/68.1/76.5 match Table 1) yet entirely judge-derived. Generalizability is decent (four targets including an API model, cross-model transfer 37-67%) but the framework is audio-renderer-specific. Reproducibility is supported by stated code availability, public judges, and detailed implementation settings (Sec. 4.1).

primary_link.title: ARENA: Automated Red-Teaming for Large Audio Language Models

papers.summary: Large audio-language models (LALMs) make it possible to interact with language models through speech, music, and environmental sound, but they also introduce a safety surface that is difficult to expose with text-only red-teaming. We study automated audio-grounded red-teaming, where a text query must remain safe in isolation while the joint text-audio input induces harmful target behavior. We propose ARENA, a closed-loop framework that trains a controller on an independent 2,000case text-audio d
papers.summary_zh: 大型音訊語言模型（LALM）可處理語音、音樂與環境音，但純文字紅隊測試難以揭露音訊通道的安全弱點。ARENA 研究音訊奠基的攻擊：文字查詢單獨檢視時必須安全，但文字與音訊的組合輸入會誘發有害回應。此封閉迴圈框架訓練控制器 LLM，利用 2,000 個與評測集不相交的文字—音訊規格，同時產生安全文字查詢與音訊提示，並在語音合成與環境音合成間選擇模態；MD-Judge 提供訓練獎勵與自適應搜尋回饋，最終標籤則由獨立且不自適應的 Llama Guard 3 單獨判定，避免直接對最終評審進行最佳化。在 520 個留出的 AdvBench 目標上，ARENA 於 Audio Flamingo 3、Qwen2-Audio、MiMo-Audio 與 GPT-Audio 分別達成 87.9/100.0%、71.5/96.3%、68.1/100.0% 與 75.4/98.5% 的 FDR/PSR，大幅超越靜態音訊越獄基準 AJailBench 與 JALMBench，且成功案例具跨模型可轉移性。消融顯示回饋式精修與音訊變體搜尋是關鍵：精修預算從 0 增至 30 可將 ASR 由 23–30% 提升至最高 88%，目標端取樣溫度過高則降低成功率。此工作說明安全評估應測試完整的生成與執行迴路，而非僅以固定提示評測。

links.title: The Price of Thinking: Reasoning Effort as a Model-Specific API Contract

evidence: Abstract: 'Mean delivered cost was $0.01031 per call higher under the explicit-high contract than under the omitted contract [+$0.00204, +$0.01974]' with accuracy contrast '+0.0133 [-0.0267, +0.0467]' and no detected accuracy difference.

Methods (Statistical plan): item-clustered percentile bootstrap with '10,000 draws, analysis seed 20260713', where 'each draw samples 30 items with replacement and carries every call' — repeated calls are not treated as independent problems.

Methods (Contracts and registered cells): fixed non-randomized dispatch — 'within all 150 Sonnet item/repeat pairs, the high call preceded the omitted call in the queue' — and Limitations concedes the design 'cannot separate request-form differences from systematic dispatch-position or short-run service effects'.

Results (Table 2): Sonnet omitted accuracy 0.913 (137/150) [0.813, 0.987] at mean cost $0.06998 vs Sonnet high 0.927 (139/150) [0.833, 1.000] at $0.08029; Terra omitted 28/30 correct at $0.02319; Fable omitted 30/30 at $0.21582.

Results (Exhibit 1, Dated omission and thinking-control evidence): omission semantics differ across exact model IDs including within one provider (e.g., Claude Opus 4.8 omitted thinking 'off' vs Sonnet 5 'adaptive'), with asymmetric evidence grades where absence of thinking structure 'could not distinguish adaptive-zero from disabled thinking'.

Results (Rail utilization): 'No main-grid call ended in no_answer_rail, and none of the 360 calls reached 99% rail utilization', resolving the preregistered conservative gate; zero-event intervals are explicitly flagged as 'not informative population upper bounds'.

Data, code, and spend disclosure: total spend $33.043144 reconciled against provider dashboards at cent granularity; release includes release_rows.l, paired_contrasts., SHA-256 pins (artifact_hashes.), plot scripts, and pinned MathArena dataset revision, but no AIME problem text (CC BY-NC-SA).

Limitations: 'The main cohort also contains only 30 curated items from one competition-mathematics task family' and 'every main-cell estimate is conditional on that session', bounding generalizability to the studied model, task, and collection date.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A measurement/economics study of LLM inference: a preregistered within-model contrast of explicit-high vs omitted reasoning-effort on the same API contract, directly relevant to LLM, reasoning, and inference/serving preferences. Methodological discipline is unusually strong (frozen parser, taxonomy, and statistical plan; item-clustered bootstrap respecting 30 independent items; evidence grading of documentation vs raw-response probes; dashboard spend reconciliation), and claims are carefully bounded. However, the contribution is intentionally narrow: the headline result (higher cost, no detectable accuracy gain) is a single-model, single-task, single-session descriptive contrast with a confounded fixed dispatch order, the cross-model cells are single-pass, and generalizability is explicitly minimal. Novelty is moderate since the paper positions itself as filling a narrow gap left by Chen et al. (2026) rather than establishing new phenomena. Reproducibility of the analysis is excellent given pinned artifacts, seeds, and released row-level data.

primary_link.title: The Price of Thinking: Reasoning Effort as a Model-Specific API Contract

papers.summary: API buyers purchase a dated contract, not a model name alone: the contract includes the requested and served model, reasoning-effort term or its omission, output rail, service product, prompt, and price schedule. We study the reasoning-effort term through a registered paired contrast of Sonnet 5 with explicit high effort against the same model with effort omitted, using 30 AIME 2026 items and five calls per item. Every paid attempt was assigned one frozen terminal category, and inference resampl
papers.summary_zh: API 買方購買的是有日期的契約，而非僅是模型名稱；契約包含所請求與實際服務的模型、推理努力參數或其省略、輸出軌道、服務產品、提示與價格表。本文以預註冊的配對對比設計，比較 Sonnet 5 顯式設定高努力與省略努力參數兩種契約，在 30 題 AIME 2026、每題 5 次呼叫下測量。每個付費嘗試依凍結的優先序規則被指派一個終端類別（正確、錯誤、軌道耗盡無答案、其他無答案、供應商失敗），推論以題目為獨立單位並保留重複呼叫進行叢集自助法。結果顯示顯式高努力契約每次呼叫的平均交付成本高出 0.01031 美元 [+0.00204, +0.01974]，而準確率對比為 +0.0133 [−0.0267, +0.0467]，未偵測到顯著差異；每答對一題的成本分別為 0.08665 與 0.07662 美元。有日期的契約普查與預註冊的原始回應探針進一步記錄省略語義因模型而異，甚至同供應商內部亦然；當原始結構無法判定時，主張僅維持在文件等級。限制包括僅 30 題單一任務、單一會話日期、非隨機派發順序與非同時期的五題橋接比較。此研究將努力標籤轉化為可稽核的契約比較，強調省略語義必須在精確的模型契約層級記錄。

links.title: Kozuchi Agent: A Language-Agnostic Open-Weight Agent for Software Repair

evidence: Abstract: 'With locally hosted Qwen3.5-27B, no fine-tuning, and TTS@8, Kozuchi resolves 374/500 SWE-bench Verified instances on the official evaluator' and 41/128 on Multi-SWE-bench Java

Section 2: 'the individual harness mechanisms—phased workflows, persistent state, runtime tools, CI orchestration—draw on established practice. The originality of this work lies in the cross-agent selector formulation'
Table 1 (Evidence map): 'Phase graph, handover state, formatter, tool sandbox, CI reuse — Operational signatures; not ablated'; 'Engineer-minute saving — Derived order-of-magnitude estimate'
Table 7 (TTS@8 ablation): K=1 mean 338.6/67.7%, K=8 order baseline 362/72.4%, self-tests-only 346/69.2%, cross-agent selector 376/75.2%, oracle 408/81.6%
RQ1 (S8.1): 374/500 with Wilson 95% CI [70.82%, 78.41%] and repository-clustered bootstrap CI [67.0%, 79.8%]
RQ2 (S8.2): paired McNemar with Holm-Bonferroni and BH-FDR; 'significantly outperforms 16 of 17 curated open-weight peers'; ranks 12/135, highest-ranked open-weight
RQ4 (S8.4, Table 6): 91.3% of 126 unresolved instances are WRONG_FIX; PATCH_DID_NOT_APPLY and EMPTY_PATCH are 0; 494/495 patches apply cleanly
RQ5 (S8.5): GPU cost is 'an upper bound because the vLLM servers batch many concurrent instances... Accounted GPU-hours would require cluster-side telemetry we did not collect'
RQ6 (S8.6): Java 41/128 (32.03%, Wilson CI [24.57, 40.54]), ranks 4/42, first strict open-weight; 'We therefore claim language-agnostic harness transfer, not equal language fluency'
Section 9: 'the about-70-engineer-minute-per-cycle figure is an estimate... not a measured before/after from a controlled developer pilot'
Data Availability Statement: GitHub artifact (github.com/marscod/kozuchi-agent-artifact) and Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.19941649 with trajectories, selector bundle, and scripts to regenerate RQ1-RQ6
llm_evaluation.rationale: An in-scope LLM-agent systems paper directly hitting the highest-weighted preferences: agentic software repair with tool use, test-time selection, and an open-weight local LLM (Qwen3.5-27B), evaluated on SWE-bench Verified (374/500 official evaluator) and Multi-SWE-bench Java (41/128). Rigor is above average: Wilson CIs plus a repository-clustered bootstrap (RQ1), paired McNemar tests with Holm/BH-FDR multiplicity control against 24 peers (RQ2), and an artifact-based ablation isolating candidate count and selector design (Table 7: mean pass@1 338.6, order baseline 362, self-tests-only 346, cross-agent 376, oracle 408). The paper is unusually candid about its evidence boundary (Table 1 marks phase graph, formatter, tool sandbox, and CI reuse as 'operational signatures; not ablated'), which lowers novelty (cross-agent selector is the main increment; phased workflows, persistent state, and CI orchestration are acknowledged established practice) and caps mechanism-level evidence. Operational impact figures (engineer-minutes, GPU-hours) are disclosed estimates rather than measurements. Generalizability is moderate: the harness transfers unchanged to Java, but the 43pp score gap and language-specific failure profile lead the authors themselves to 'claim language-agnostic harness transfer, not equal language fluency' (RQ6), and only one backbone is reported. Reproducibility is strong: Zenodo DOI with 495 trajectories, selector bundles, pinned seeds/manifests, and scripts regenerating RQ1-RQ6, though internal pipeline source sits outside the release boundary and full replication costs thousands of GPU-hours.

primary_link.title: Kozuchi Agent: A Language-Agnostic Open-Weight Agent for Software Repair

papers.summary: Industrial software-engineering teams increasingly need LLM agents that turn bug reports into correct patches, yet benchmark-scale operation adds long horizons, tool-use discipline, context persistence, heterogeneous clusters, and evaluation reuse. We present Kozuchi Agent, a language-agnostic open-weight repair agent and CI-operated evaluation pipeline. Explicit phases, persistent state, deterministic tools, a model-independent action interface, and cross-agent test-time selection make runs aud
papers.summary_zh: 產業團隊需要 LLM 代理人將錯誤報告轉為能通過測試的修補程式，但基準規模運作面臨長時程執行、模型家族間工具語法漂移、異質叢集與高評估成本等挑戰。Kozuchi Agent 以 mini-swe-agent 為基礎，採八階段相位驅動工作流、持久共享狀態、確定性工具沙盒（動態行追蹤、呼叫者探索、受保護編輯）、模型無關的動作介面，以及以跨代理人測試為核心的測試期選擇層：K=8 次獨立推論各自產生修補與測試，選擇器僅交叉套用封存的測試，不使用隱藏基準測試或學習式驗證器。CI 管線將九個階段中六個標記為可重用，將操作者接觸點從五個降至一個。以本地部署的 Qwen3.5-27B、無微調、TTS@8，官方評估器解析 374/500 個 SWE-bench Verified 實例（74.80%，Wilson 95% CI [70.82, 78.41]）；不變的代理人在 Multi-SWE-bench Java 解析 41/128（32.03%），在嚴格開放權重提交中排名第一、42 個系統中第四。未解實例中 91.3% 是修補可套用但未翻轉隱藏測試的語義錯誤，編輯格式失敗為 0%。限制在於相位、格式器等機制僅有操作簽章支持而非移除式消融，Java 端另有語言特定測試架構問題。此經驗報告展示了可稽核、可重複的代理人修復工作流如何取代人工流程。

llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM research: a process benchmark (WSE-bench) evaluating LLM storytelling across 12 models and 12 agent architectures (multi-agent Character Agents, world-model planning WMOD, structured memory WMEM), with LLM-judge evaluation, Pareto analysis, and scaling analysis. Strong preference match to LLMs, Agents & Tool Use, Evaluation/LLM-as-judge, and Long Context & Memory. Novelty is solid: decomposing narrative evaluation into sustained generation (coverage), canonical coherence (Kaplan-Meier survival with right-censoring), and meaningful development is a genuine methodological increment over completed-story benchmarks, and the non-concave Pareto frontier with supported/unsupported cells (Appendix B.3) is an interesting analysis. Rigor is above average: 6,048 trajectories over 144 cells (Section 5.3), paired within-episode contrasts with hierarchical bootstrap CIs, censoring-aware dual consistency summaries, leave-one-play-out and full-horizon sensitivities, and honest acknowledgment that intervals are not multiple-comparison adjusted (Appendix C.1). primary_link.title: When Stories Evolve: Benchmarking LLM Storytelling Across Agent Architectures in Open-Ended World Simulations

papers.summary: Large language models can write fluent stories, but open-ended storytelling requires more than local fluency. In evolving world simulations and AI-native games, models must preserve facts, relationships, causal dependencies, and character states as the world changes. We introduce WSE-bench, a process benchmark that separately evaluates sustained generation, canonical coherence, and meaningful development in dynamic LLM storytelling. Generation Coverage records the proportion of planned narrative
papers.summary_zh: 開放式敘事要求模型在演進的世界模擬中持續生成、維持正典一致性，並有意義地發展劇情。WSE-bench 是一項過程基準，將故事視為軌跡並以三項指標分開評估：生成覆蓋率衡量計畫敘事步驟的實際產出比例；一致性以 Kaplan–Meier 曲線追蹤正典何時首次被違反；豐富度衡量分支與玩家塑造軌跡的有意義發展。實驗橫跨 12 個模型、42 個共享劇集種子與 12 種架構（三種角色決策拓撲，搭配敘事前規劃模組 WMOD 與敘事後記憶模組 WMEM），共 6,048 條軌跡，並輔以盲測人類驗證。主要發現：一致性與豐富度並非平滑權衡——前沿模型的經驗 Pareto 前沿呈非凹形，四個中間組態為非受支持點，任何正向線性加權都無法選出；增加結構可豐富軌跡，但不會一致地改善一致性，甚至可能縮短故事（WMEM 使兩組生成覆蓋率下降約 14 至 18 個百分點）；模型規模主要提升持續生成（密集 Qwen 檢查點參數倍增約提升 19.3 個百分點覆蓋率），對一致性與豐富度無可靠增益；源自熟悉劇作的 DraCor 世界並未比模擬原生世界更易矛盾，否證了先驗正典干擾假說。此基準顯示三項能力各自獨立且時而競爭，應分開衡量而非壓縮為單一分數。

links.title: THESIS-MoE: Trainable Hierarchical Extraction and SteerIng of Sycophancy in Mixture-of-Experts

evidence: Abstract: 'Our conditional interventions removed up to 90% of the belief-induced sycophancy'; Section 6.4 reports the learned gate removing 90% of push on OLMoE, supporting the 'up to' claim.

Section 6.4: gate removes 90%/63%/32% (OLMoE/Qwen/Granite) with GSM8K at 115%/111%/115%, while conditional subtraction removes 77%/87%/60% with GSM8K at 100%/92%/103% - the text's 'strongest method on the behavioral axis' for the gate is contradicted on Qwen and Granite removal.

Section 5.1: causal test 'swap[s] activations between matched nudged and no-nudge examples' to test necessity and sufficiency, with selection requiring both tests plus no retention harm - a genuine causal (not merely correlational) localization procedure.
Section 3.2 / Table 2: 8234 matched items balanced 4117/4117, identifier-disjoint train/dev/test splits 'verified to have zero leakage', with answer-label balance to prevent position artifacts.
Section 5.7: three open-weight MoE models (OLMoE, Granite, Qwen1.5-MoE) spanning two routing regimes, three seeds per model resampling fitting data and reinitializing gates.

Section 5.8: 'every intervention is applied at that same token and no other'; perplexity is 'a structural control rather than a test of open-ended generation', bounding all behavioral evidence to decision-token multiple-choice tasks.
Section 7 and Section 6.4: admits MMLU at 80-89% of baseline under conditional subtraction, possible overshoot to negative belief push, and untested open-ended generation.
Section 5.5: loss weights (lambda_anchor, lambda_know, lambda_gen) and gate training details are given symbolically only; no code or artifact availability statement appears anywhere in the paper.
Section 6.3: baselines are real comparators - prompting increases push by 29%/8%/24% and the FARE routing baseline removes 39%/23%/41% of push while dropping GSM8K to 68%/83%/85% of baseline.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM interpretability/alignment work: localizes and steers sycophancy in three open-weight MoE LLMs (OLMoE, Granite, Qwen1.5-MoE), matching high-weight preferences (LLMs, AI Safety/Alignment, Interpretability, MoE architecture, evaluation). Methodologically careful: matched nudge/no-nudge condition-contrast direction with answer-label balancing and identifier-disjoint splits (Sec 3.2/Table 2), causal necessity/sufficiency tests via activation swapping (Sec 5.1), nine component-set and strength sweeps, a 72-run gate architecture sweep, dev/test operating-point selection, and 3 seeds per model. Main concerns: the analytic 'conditional subtraction' is essentially projection-based directional ablation, a known technique; evidence is restricted to decision-token multiple-choice edits with perplexity admitted to be a non-firing structural control (Sec 5.8); MMLU declines at selected operating points (80-89% of baseline, Sec 6.4) despite retention framing; the claim that the learned gate is 'the strongest method on the behavioral axis' (Sec 6.4) conflicts with its own reported removal numbers (63% Qwen, 32% Granite) versus conditional subtraction (87%, 60%), and Figure 4's caption ('remove most of the push') overstates the Granite gate result; no code release, and loss weights/gate training hyperparameters (Sec 5.5) are unspecified, limiting reproducibility. Generalizability is bounded: one behavior, multiple-choice only, open-ended generation explicitly left to future work (Sec 7).

Existing activation steering methods typically apply a single contrastive direction uniformly throughout the model, which is an unconditional intervention that alters activations even when no sycophantic behavior is present, trading knowledge retention for behavioral correction. In Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models, prior work further suggests that behavior is encoded w
papers.summary_zh: 諂媚（sycophancy）指語言模型因使用者陳述信念而改變答案，是常見的對齊失敗。現有激活引導方法將單一對比方向施加於所有 token，屬無條件干預，即使諂媚未出現也改變激活，以知識保留換取行為矯正。作者以配對的有／無信念提示建構共享對比訊號，定義連續帶正負號的 belief-push 指標，將定位形式化為跨越 MoE 區塊、專家、注意力區塊與頭的粒度階梯之因果搜尋，並比較無條件減法、解析式條件減法與學習式逐 token 閘門三種干預。在三個開放權重 MoE 模型（OLMoE、Granite、Qwen1.5-MoE）上，因果搜尋顯示信念位移集中在少數中後層元件；路由基線 FARE 僅移除部分諂媚且損害保留，無條件減法則持續出現移除—保留權衡（GSM8K 掉至基準的 65–75%）。條件式方法最多移除 90% 的信念誘發諂媚，同時 GSM8K 維持在基準或以上（閘門達 111–115%），證明諂媚居住於可辨識的計算子電路，且可在凍結權重下選擇性引導。限制包括強減法可能過度矯正為負向推力，評估限於選擇題的決策 token，開放式生成尚待延伸。此工作為對齊行為的精準編輯提供條件式引導的新架構。

links.title: Hallucination Span Detection with Input-Side Evidence Alignment

evidence: Abstract: introduces 'hallucination span detection with input-side evidence alignment', jointly identifying hallucinated spans and aligning output tokens with input evidence via masked-token prediction confidence.
Section 5, Table 3: proposed method F1 54.8 (QA) / 40.3 (Summary) vs LettuceDetect 64.4 and Llama-SFT 47.6; proposed has best recall (82.7 QA, 38.0 Summary), precision 40.9/42.8.
Section 4.2: base model ModernBERT-large 0.4B, 5 epochs, lr 1.0e-5, γ_f=1.4, γ_h=0.8, w=2.0, threshold λ_h=0.68 tuned on Dev(λ); 35,578 faithful vs 13,269 hallucinated masked spans.
Section 6.1 footnote 1: human evaluation of 700 words 'one of the authors inspected top-k predictions'; no inter-annotator agreement or independent annotators reported.
Section 7.1, Table 8: recall for baseless hallucinations 87.6/91.2 (QA) and 50.1/37.7 (Sum) vs conflict 14.0/18.3 (QA) and 16.6/18.3 (Sum).

Limitations: 'inference cost that grows linearly with the output length' from per-token re-encoding; 'experiments are limited to question answering and news summarization using the RAGTruth benchmark'; other tasks, domains, languages, LLM families untested.
Section 1: 'Our code is available at https://github.com/miyu-y/HalluSpan_EviAlign'; dataset RAGTruth (Section 4.1) with official character-level P/R/F1 metrics.
Section 6.2, Table 5: alignment avg scores for proposed method 1.97 (faithful top-1) to 2.21 (faithful top-3) vs OTAlign 1.65-1.78, assessed only on faithful tokens for OTAlign.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly on-topic: joint hallucination span detection with input-side evidence alignment for LLM outputs sits squarely in RAG factuality/grounding/LLM-evaluation preferences, with a fine-tuned Llama-3.1-8B baseline and RAGTruth (LLM-generated outputs). Novelty is solid: the joint detect+align task formulation and distant-supervision adaptation of non-parametric masked LM confidence (NPM-inspired) go beyond span-only detectors (LettuceDetect) and alignment-only methods (OTAlign), though the core mechanism is an incremental reuse of masked-token retrieval. Rigor is mixed: clean split design with separate threshold-tuning set, same-base (ModernBERT-large) encoder comparison, type- and task-level analysis; but no component ablations (SRL segmentation, loss terms, masking strategy), no significance testing, and the human evaluation (700 words) was performed by 'one of the authors' with a single annotator and no inter-annotator agreement. Evidence strength is tempered by the headline detection numbers: the proposed method trails LettuceDetect (F1 64.4 vs 54.8 on QA) and Llama-SFT (47.6 vs 40.3 on Summary) in Table 3, winning only on recall, so 'effectively detects hallucinated spans' is only partially supported; alignment quality claims (avg ~1.97-2.21) are supported by Table 5 but only against OTAlign and via author annotation. The paper is candid that conflict hallucinations fail (recall 14.0-18.3, Table 8). Generalizability is limited: single benchmark (RAGTruth QA+summarization), English only, one encoder, and linearly-scaling per-token inference cost acknowledged in Limitations. Reproducibility is good: public code URL, public dataset, full hyperparameters (γ_f=1.4, γ_h=0.8, w=2.0, λ_h=0.68, lr 1e-5, 5 epochs), and specified SRL tooling.

papers.summary: Hallucinations remain a major obstacle to the reliable use of large language models (LLMs) in conditional text generation. Existing methods primarily assess the factuality of an entire generated text, providing limited insight into which output spans are hallucinated or how they relate to the input. We introduce the task of hallucination span detection with input-side evidence alignment, which jointly identifies hallucinated spans and aligns output tokens with the corresponding input evidence. O
papers.summary_zh: 現有幻覺偵測多著重整段輸出的事實性評估，無法定位幻覺片段或指出對應的輸入證據。本文提出「具輸入端證據對齊的幻覺片段偵測」任務，同時辨識輸出中的幻覺片段並將輸出 token 對齊至輸入證據。方法基於觀察：忠實的輸出 token 可從輸入預測，幻覺 token 則否。作者以遠距監督訓練編碼器模型（ModernBERT-large）執行輸入奠基的遮罩 token 預測：遮罩輸出片段後僅以輸入表示預測，以餘弦相似度的最大信心值區分忠實與幻覺 token，檢索到的輸入 token 自然形成證據對齊，無需人工對齊標註，且推論遠較大型解碼器 LLM 輕量。在 RAGTruth 的問答與新聞摘要任務上，本方法在兩項任務皆取得最佳召回率（QA 82.7%、摘要 38.0%），優於 Llama-3.1-8B 微調與 LettuceDetect；人類評估確認對齊品質，忠實詞與無根據幻覺的平均評分約 2（相關證據等級）。限制在於衝突型幻覺因輸入存在高度相似文字而難以偵測（召回率僅 15.8–18.3%），且逐 token 推論成本隨輸出長度線性成長。此框架為可解釋的細粒度幻覺稽核提供輕量且高效的途徑，對長文件的事實查核尤其有價值。

links.title: SubZero+: Efficient Zeroth-Order LLM Fine-Tuning via Large Learning Rates

evidence: Abstract and §1 contributions: multi-query estimation in layer-specific low-rank subspaces, subspace Adam, and QR sign correction for Haar-distributed projections.
§5.1: models OPT-1.3B/13B/30B, LLaMA3.1-8B, Qwen2.5-32B; matched 40K forward-pass budget (SubZero+ 400 steps × 100 forwards vs 2×20K for baselines).
Table 1 (§5.2.1): OPT-1.3B avg 66.3 (SubZero+) vs 65.5 (SubZero) vs 64.6 (MeZO); OPT-13B 73.0 vs 70.3 vs 69.9.
Table 3 (§5.2.3): Qwen2.5-32B avg 87.4 vs SubZero 85.1; caption states 'SubZero+ scores are oracle best values from task-specific optimal hyperparameter configurations' over only 5 tasks.
§5.2.4: LR-robustness sweep only on Qwen3-0.6B with LoRA on SST-2; MeZO drops >31 points when LR doubles from 1e-4 to 2e-4, SubZero+ drops 0.5 points at 3e-2.
Table 5 (§5.3): fixed 30K-forward budget; SST-2 accuracy rises 50.9→92.2 from K=1→100, MultiRC only 52.3–61.1, showing strong task dependence.
Table 4 (§5.2.5): Haar correction gains +0.7 (Adam) and +0.3 (SGD) on average; RTE shows +4.6 under Adam but −3.2 under SGD.
Table 6 (§5.4): peak GPU memory overhead ~1% under FT and 0% under LoRA on OPT-13B.
§2 and §5.1: baselines limited to MeZO and SubZero; cited methods LOZO, TeZO, Sparse MeZO, FZOO, ZO-Muon are not empirically compared.
Appendix A.2: hyperparameter grids (Tables 7–8), single H200/RTX 4090 hardware, PyTorch 2.1.0/CUDA 12.1; no code or artifact availability claim appears anywhere in the document.
§6 Limitations: data-independent random subspaces may discard important gradient directions; subspace regenerated every F steps rather than adapted.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Methodology paper on backpropagation-free (zeroth-order) fine-tuning of LLMs, squarely matching high-weight preferences for LLMs, training/optimization, and scaling/efficiency, with SuperGLUE evaluation anchoring NLP relevance. Novelty is incremental: SubZero+ extends the authors' own SubZero via (i) multi-query estimation in a fixed low-rank subspace to sidestep the multi-query paradox, (ii) Adam restricted to r×r buffers, and (iii) a known QR sign-correction (Mezzadri 2007) whose measured effect is small (+0.7/+0.3 avg, Table 4, with inconsistent task-level signs, e.g., RTE +4.6 Adam vs −3.2 SGD). Rigor is solid on budget-matched comparisons (40K forwards, §5.1), ablations over K and rank, and memory accounting (Table 6, ~1% FT overhead), but baselines are limited to MeZO/SubZero while cited competitors (LOZO, TeZO, Sparse MeZO, FZOO, ZO-Muon) are not compared; no seeds/variance or significance testing are reported; the central learning-rate-robustness claim is validated on only one small model and one task (§5.2.4, Qwen3-0.6B LoRA SST-2). Evidence is mostly credible and quantitative, but Table 3 uses oracle-best, task-specific hyperparameters on only 5 tasks, and some table inconsistencies (e.g., Table 4 vs Table 1 Adam numbers) reduce confidence. Generalizability benefits from three model families (1.3B–32B) and FT/LoRA schemes; the K-ablation (Table 5) shows strong task dependence. Reproducibility is aided by pseudocode, hyperparameter grids (Tables 7–8), and hardware details, but there is no code-release statement anywhere in the document.

We propose SubZero+, an improved SubZero framework that improves stability in three complementary ways: (i) multi-query gradient estimation within layer-specific low-rank subspaces to reduce variance without exhibiting the multi-query paradox; (ii) a subspace Ada
papers.summary_zh: 零階最佳化讓 LLM 無需反向傳播即可微調,大幅節省激活記憶體,但其梯度估計變異數隨參數維度成長,導致收斂不穩且對學習率極為敏感。本文提出 SubZero+,從三方面改善既有 SubZero 框架:(1)在各層專屬低秩子空間內進行多次查詢梯度估計,在不落入多重查詢悖論的前提下降低變異數;(2)於子空間內執行 Adam,以多次查詢的梯度範數等統計量設定各層自適應步長,狀態僅佔 O(r²) 記憶體;(3)對 QR 分解建構的投影矩陣施加正負號校正,使其服從 Haar 分布,消除實作相依的方向偏誤。證據方面,在 1.3B 至 32B 模型與 SuperGLUE 九項任務上,無論全參數微調或 LoRA,SubZero+ 均超越 MeZO 與 SubZero;Qwen2.5-32B 平均達 87.4%,領先 SubZero 2.3 個百分點。消融顯示 K=100 時 SST-2 提升 41.3 分,Haar 校正在 Adam 下平均提升 0.7%。學習率穩健性實驗證實其穩定範圍遠大於 MeZO,額外 GPU 記憶體僅約 0.6GB。限制在於隨機子空間為資料獨立,可能捨棄重要梯度方向,且每 F 步重新生成而非依最佳化歷史調整。其意義在於證明在壓縮子空間內結合多重查詢與自適應最佳化器,能以近推論等級記憶體成本縮小與一階方法的差距。

links.title: Topological collapse of higher-order interactions bottlenecks collective intelligence in AI agent societies

evidence: Abstract: identifies 'topological collapse' across a platform of 1.6M registered agents and claims code is 'publicly available at this link' (placeholder URL, no explicit repository).
Section 2.1/Table 1: Moltbook HIS 0.413 vs SocioPatterns 0.691 with bootstrap 95% CI for delta-HIS [0.204, 0.363]; Moltbook Gini 0.863, overlap 0.117.
Section 2.3/Table 2: condition C jumps from rho=0.016 to 0.966 between seed proportions 5%-15%; permutation test max-delta 0.907 at p=1e-5; Hartigan's dip p=6.85e-4.
Section 2.4: 22 LLMs from 10 vendors; random-pairs HIS=0.000 for all models (cross-model s.d.=0.000); norm adoption ranges ~0.00 (GLM-5) to ~1.00 (GPT-5.4) under identical conditions.
Section 4.9: AgentPanel grid of 4 conditions x 3 sizes x 3 temperatures x 3 rho0 x 3 seeds x 22 models (up to 7,128 configurations), structured [SUPPORT: X] parsing, seeds 42/137/256.

Section 4.4/Table 3: 66.1% of agents flagged as puppets via four signals; precision 94% from 200 manually inspected accounts; recall explicitly not estimated; conclusions robust across >=1/2/3-signal thresholds.

Discussion (Limitations): single-platform confound (human baselines differ in substrate and mechanism), n<=100-to-10^6 extrapolation 'a well-supported hypothesis rather than an established scaling law', and readout is norm adoption rather than task-level collective intelligence.

Section 2.1 vs Methods Table 3: inconsistent post-removal statistics (Gini 0.781 and mean hyperedge size 5.54 in Section 2.1 vs Gini 0.855 and reference size 5.21/Gini 0.926 in Table 3); Table 1 node count 23,840 unexplained against 174,458 active agents.

Section 4.6: Phi=c*(1+alpha J)*(1+CV^2)*HIS with alpha=2.0 fitted from SocioPatterns calibration; LHS robustness over 500 parameter combinations gives mean amplification ratio 2.01, 95% CI [1.70, 2.25], but bistability agreement holds in only 31% of samples.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A million-scale study of collective behavior in LLM agent societies (Moltbook) plus controlled experiments with 22 frontier LLMs, squarely matching the Agents & Tool Use and LLM preferences, though the methodology is network science rather than language-model methodology. Novelty is high: 'topological collapse' in an AI social platform, a hypergraph contagion framework (HIS, amplification factor Phi), and a natural experiment at 10^6-agent scale are genuinely new. Rigor is solid but dented by internal numeric inconsistencies (Section 2.1 reports post-removal Gini 0.781 and mean hyperedge size 5.54, while Methods Table 3 reports 0.855 and a no-removal reference of 5.21/0.926) and by an unexplained node-count discrepancy (Table 1: 23,840 nodes vs 174,458 active agents in the abstract). Evidence is strong for the ABM phase transition and for the trivially-by-construction cross-model HIS invariance, but weaker for the key LLM-specific claim that topology gates real LLM collective outcomes, since adoption results across topological conditions are only shown per-model in figures without textual summary; the n<=100 to 10^6 extrapolation and single-platform confound are honestly flagged in Limitations. Reproducibility benefits from public HuggingFace data, seeds, and full parameter grids, but the code link is a placeholder.

papers.summary: Current paradigms in artificial intelligence concentrate on scaling the capabilities of individual models, yet the collective behaviour of interacting agents is shaped by the topology of their interactions rather than by individual cognition alone. Here we show that the binding constraint on collective behaviour in agent societies is topological. Analysing a macroscopic AI social platform of 1.6 million registered agents (174,458 active in the interaction record), we identify a phenomenon we ter
papers.summary_zh: 集體行為的湧現取決於個體能力還是互動結構?本文分析擁有 160 萬註冊代理的 AI 社交平台 Moltbook,發現 93.5% 的貼文無人回覆,呈現平行獨白現象。作者建構時間超圖,提出超邊不可約分數(HIS)量化群組內參與平等性,並推導拓撲放大因子 Φ 將可測量的網路結構連結到社會傳染動力學,再以 1,040 次受控代理人模擬與來自十家廠商的 22 個前沿 LLM 實驗驗證因果關係。證據顯示:Moltbook 的 HIS 僅 0.413,遠低於人類面對面基線的 0.691;樞紐支配、低三角閉合等指標在配置模型隨機化下均顯著偏離;Shapley 分解指出 HIS 貢獻 Φ 差距的 81.6%。關鍵發現是結構不變而行為分歧:固定互動協定下,22 個模型的 HIS 完全相同(成對條件標準差為 0.000),但規範採納率卻從近 0 到近 1 不等,證明拓撲而非模型能力決定集體行為是否可及;三階超邊條件在模擬中展現明確的不連續相變。限制包括僅分析單一 AI 平台、HIS 差距測量至 n≤100,且行為讀數為規範採納而非任務級集體智慧。其意義在於主張集體 AI 的設計應從增強個體模型轉向工程化互動拓撲,並提出限制樞紐支配、促成多方同步協商與播種超過 10% 臨界質量的具體準則。

links.title: Large Discovery Models: Empirically-grounded Model-Based Open-Ended Search

evidence: Abstract: LDM couples a generative model with a Bayesian non-parametric surrogate; reports 2.4x validation-BPB reduction, 18.2% binding-energy decrease, >60% molecular multi-objective gains; code claimed at https://github.com/yzailab/Large-Discovery-Models
§3.1 Proposition 1: optimal search distribution is acquisition-tilted p*exp(eta*a_t) via Gibbs variational principle, with finite-pool softmax/deterministic approximations in §3.3
§5 Theorem 1: average regret decomposed into discovery gap, GP-UCB optimization term, and LDM sampling shortfall depending on reservoir near-UCB mass kappa_t; proofs in Appendix B
§6.2.1 Figure 11: test-time scaling ablation — N8H8 beats N4H4, EI/UCB beat posterior-mean-only, and removing the discovery mechanism converges to a worse plateau

§6.3.1: LDM reduces val_bpb by 0.0727 vs 0.0301 for the LLM-only baseline from a shared 1.0069 start (single-run trajectories, Fig. 7); B200 leaderboard run reaches 0.902291 in 59 runs vs forge 0.9264

§6.1.2: antibody CDRH3 design on Absolut! oracle across five PDB targets, 200 evaluations, four LDM variants; policy-mode comparable to AntBO while Direct variants marginally beat standalone LLMs (§6.3.2)
§6.4.3 Figure 17: reasoning-augmented fine-tuned Qwen3.5-9B reaches HV 26.660±2.608 vs base 16.489±5.867 and DeepSeek V4 Flash teacher 24.548±3.589, with overlapping intervals noted
§6.4.4 / Appendix E.6: task-level OOD model fine-tuned only on nanoGPT and molecule trajectories matches in-distribution on 4/5 antigens; failure case 1H0D_C attributed to de novo motif design
Appendix E.7 Table 8: GP-hidden reasoning augmentation matches or beats GP-in-prompt (avg -106.9 vs -104.7), with only 1.3% of traces citing surrogate numbers
§8 Limitations: cubic GP scaling, surrogate misspecification/reward exploitation risk, manual kernel customization per domain, dependence on LLM prior coverage
llm_evaluation.rationale: A clearly in-scope LLM methodology paper: it couples an LLM proposal distribution with a GP surrogate via a KL-regularized acquisition-tilted policy, applies inference-time search scaling, and distills acquisition-guided behavior into the LLM via reasoning-augmented SFT — directly engaging LLM, reasoning/CoT, agent, RL/bandit, and scientific-AI preferences. Rigor is solid: formal framework, closed-form tilted policy (Prop. 1), a regret decomposition (Thm. 1) with proofs in Appendix B, plus ablations on test-time budget, discovery mechanism, acquisition functions, and hyperparameters across three domains. Novelty is moderate: the core machinery (Gibbs variational principle, GP-UCB, Gumbel-top-k, SFT) is standard, and the paper itself positions against OPRO/LLAMBO/dLLM; the distinctive parts are the reservoir-view regret decomposition and acquisition-reweighted distillation with hidden GP values. Evidence is mixed: multi-seed results with std for antibody and molecule fine-tuning (HV 26.660±2.608 vs base 16.489±5.867, §6.4.3), but the headline AutoResearch 2.4× claim rests on single-run trajectories and a leaderboard comparison (§6.3.1), and some fine-tuning intervals overlap (acknowledged). Generalizability is credibly demonstrated via cross-target and task-level OOD transfer (§6.4.4, App. E.6), with honest limitations (cubic GP cost, manual kernel design, weak LLM priors in antibody domain, §8). Reproducibility is supported by code/benchmark release, algorithm boxes, and GP details, though key LLM choices in the main runs are under-specified.

primary_link.title: Large Discovery Models: Empirically-grounded Model-Based Open-Ended Search

papers.summary: Scientific discovery often involves optimising expensive-to-evaluate objectives over vast, structured, and open-ended hypothesis spaces, such as molecules, protein sequences, and computer programs. Generative models such as large language models (LLMs) provide expressive priors over such spaces, but their likelihoods and self-assessments are unreliable proxies for the objectives and calibrated epistemic uncertainty, especially for novel candidates outside the observed data distribution. We intro
papers.summary_zh: 科學發現需在龐大、開放的假設空間中最佳化昂貴的評估目標;LLM 的似然與自我評估無法可靠代理真實目標與校準後的不確定性,而傳統貝葉斯最佳化又難以在組合式空間提出有效候選。本文提出大型發現模型(LDM),以 KL 正則化的變分目標將 LLM 生成先驗與高斯過程代理模型的獲取函數耦合,導出封閉形式的獲取傾斜搜尋分布;透過推論期搜尋(有限候選池重加權、Gumbel-top-b 抽樣)近似該分布,並將高預算測試期搜尋經驗經推理增強的監督微調蒸餾回模型權重,理論上給出將遺憾分解為發現間隙、GP-UCB 最佳化誤差與抽樣短差的界限。證據:在 AutoResearch 上驗證 BPB 降幅為純 LLM 反思基線的 2.4 倍;抗體 CDRH3 設計結合能較 LLM 基線降低 18.2%;KRAS G12D 分子多目標任務的 Pareto 前沿超體積較 LLM 與傳統 BO 分別提升 62.4% 與 63.1%。消融證實搜尋預算、兼顧探索與開發的獲取函數及發現機制皆屬必要;微調後模型更能跨任務、跨目標遷移。限制為高斯過程計算隨觀測數呈三次方成長、核函數仍需人工調校、測試期搜尋開銷可觀。其意義在於將推論期擴展從廉價驗證器情境延伸至昂貴實證回饋的科學設計,確立開發、探索、發現三元搜尋框架。

links.title: Assessing Attack Surfaces in Generative Search Engines through Publisher Attributes: A Case Study in Political Domains

evidence: Section 5.1: experiments use OpenAI GPT-5, Claude Sonnet 4, and Gemini Flash 2.5 with web search enabled; 33 question templates, 13 parties, 3 user profiles, 3,861 answers; artifacts released at github.com/mzhkz/QL_Research_CIKM26_Artifacts

Section 4.2: content-injection barrier classifier maps citations to primary/opponent/low/medium/high categories via LLM-as-a-judge (two GSE models) with manual fallback on disagreement; no classifier accuracy or inter-annotator agreement is reported
Section 5.2: model-level citation distribution differences reported (U.S. chi2(8)=568.94, p<.001, V=0.328; Japan V=0.250) and user-profile null results (all V<=0.06, chi2 tests non-significant)
Section 5.2: grounding thresholds calibrated separately per language using STS-B (0.80/0.90) and JSTS (0.70/0.85), citing Shibayama & Shinnou 2021 for lower Japanese SBERT similarity

Section 6: authors acknowledge limitations — closed-ended political questions only, two countries, coarse publisher categories ignoring per-page processes (e.g., peer review vs. preprint), and undisclosed underlying search engines approximated by Brave Search API

Section 5.2 (Table 1): ruling-vs-opposition asymmetry with Pearson correlations and MAE between primary-source shares in web results and citations; the Green Party hit-count counterexample is honestly discussed as limiting the web-volume explanation
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM-centric security measurement study squarely within scope: it audits citation behavior of three production LLM search systems (GPT-5, Claude Sonnet 4, Gemini Flash 2.5) against poisoning attacks, touching RAG, LLM safety/evaluation, and a Japanese-language experimental arm (Japanese parties, JSTS-calibrated thresholds, JGLUE lineage). The proposed 'content-injection barrier' metric — classifying citations by publisher authority rather than content alone — is a genuinely new evaluation axis vs. prior faithfulness/domination metrics. Rigor is solid but not airtight: 3,861 answers, chi-square/Cramér's V with effect sizes, and SBERT threshold calibration on STS-B/JSTS are careful, but the barrier taxonomy mapping (low/medium/high) is hand-crafted, the LLM-as-a-judge classifier with manual fallback lacks reported inter-annotator agreement or validation accuracy, and Brave Search is used as a proxy for undisclosed underlying search engines. Evidence for model- and party-group-dependent citation distributions and the personalization null result is quantitatively supported, though the causal claim that 'query generation shapes the attack surface' is inferential from correlation analysis (Table 1). Generalizability is bounded by the political domain, two countries, closed-ended questions, and closed-weight models; reproducibility is partially supported by a released artifact repository but depends on non-deterministic commercial APIs and a manual classification step.

links.title: FluxBin: Flexible LUT-based Ultra-low-bit LLM Inference by Algorithm-Kernel Synergy

evidence: Abstract: claims up to 5.92x speedup, 10.19x energy savings, and 70B deployment on one A100 with 4x memory reduction; code link provided (https://github.com/nicyyyy/FluxBin).

Table 1 (Sec 4.2): LLaMA-2-7B FluxBin-2b-s16-g128 (2.75 bits) avg 59.15 vs QuIP# 59.41 at 2.02 bits and AQLM 58.64; 70B: FluxBin 70.95 vs QuIP# 71.17 at 2.01 bits — accuracy parity claim holds only at ~0.7 extra bits.

Sec 4.3/Table 2: ablations show saliency search removal collapses Wiki PPL to 26.02, hybrid-base removal raises PPL to 13.71, and disabling VCM costs 18% speed and 33% memory (250.87→205.68 tok/s; 3475→4640 MB).

Definition 3.4 (Sec 3.1): Hessian-based column saliency score is stated as 'Following SLiM-LLM', and Appendix B integrates into the GPTQ framework — algorithmic components largely derived from prior work.
Appendix E.1/Table 8: 13B total energy 579.23J (FluxBin-2b-g128) vs 5908.03J FP16, avg power ~115W vs 225W, supporting the 10.19x claim.
Table 12 (Appendix E.4): isolated kernel latency 41µs vs QuIP# 112µs and AQLM 79µs at 4096x4096, with official implementations of baselines.
Appendix D.2/Table 4: LLaMA-3.1-70B FluxBin-2b-s16 avg 67.81 vs AQLM 50.27 and GPTQ-3bit 69.75, at 2.75 vs 3.125 bits.
Limitations section: admits SRAM footprint scales as 2^μ (μ=8 needs 136KB at BS=8, near A100's 164KB limit) and a residual accuracy gap vs fine-tuning-based methods.
Minor inconsistency: Table 7 default Ncal=256 for 2b-s8-g128 reports Wiki 8.63 / Avg 58.77, while Table 1 reports 8.76 / 58.09 for the same configuration.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM efficiency paper (weight-only ultra-low-bit PTQ plus custom CUDA LUT kernel) directly matching high-weight LLM and inference/serving preferences. Strongest evidence is systems-level: extensive quantitative tables across LLaMA-2/3.1 and Qwen3 (7B-70B), ablations, energy profiling, and per-kernel latency comparisons. Algorithmic novelty is moderate: multi-binary bases follow QBB/DB-LLM, Hessian column saliency is explicitly adopted from SLiM-LLM (Def 3.4), and the LUT kernel builds on LUT-GEMM; the genuinely new pieces are the row-column outer-product scaling, scale fusion, and Virtual Columnar Mapping. Main caveats: accuracy is 'comparable' only at higher effective bits (2.63-2.75) than 2.0-2.02-bit baselines that slightly outperform it on 7B/13B/70B (Table 1), all hardware results are A100-only, a small Table 1 vs Table 7 inconsistency exists for 2b-s8-g128, and AutoAWQ is cited as a compared baseline in Sec 4.1 without numbers.

primary_link.title: FluxBin: Flexible LUT-based Ultra-low-bit LLM Inference by Algorithm-Kernel Synergy

papers.summary: While binary quantization theoretically promises extreme compression and acceleration for Large Language Models (LLMs), existing research often overlooks the necessity of specialized hardware kernels, thus failing to unleash the full acceleration potential due to persistent reliance on expensive floating-point arithmetic or runtime dequantization overheads. To bridge this gap, we propose FluxBin (\textbf{F}lexible \textbf{L}UT-based \textbf{U}ltra-low-bit e\textbf{X}ecution with \textbf{Bin}ary
papers.summary_zh: 二值化量化理論上可極致壓縮 LLM,但既有方法多依賴反量化至 FP16 或昂貴浮點運算,未發揮位元運算潛力,且精細的顯著性保護常與硬體效率衝突。本文提出演算法—核心協同設計 FluxBin:演算法層包含解耦行列二值基底分解(同時引入列與欄縮放向量捕捉異向性分布)與 Hessian 引導的顯著性感知混合基底,純以 PTQ 完成、不需微調;核心層設計基於查找表的 CUDA 核心,以尺度融合建表(LUT-BSF)消除欄縮放的浮點運算,並以虛擬欄式映射(VCM)將稀疏顯著欄轉為稠密執行,繞過反量化開銷。證據:在 A100 上,LLaMA-2-7B 端對端達 254.39 tokens/s,較 FP16 加速 5.92 倍,能耗節省最高 10.19 倍;70B 模型得以在單張 A100 上以約 4 倍記憶體縮減執行。零樣本準確率與經大量微調的 QuIP#、AQLM 相當(7B 上 59.15%),並在 LLaMA-3.1-70B 上領先 AQLM 達 17.5 分;消融證實欄縮放、顯著性搜尋與 VCM 各自不可或缺。限制為 LUT 儲存隨子向量長度指數成長而受限於共享記憶體,且純 PTQ 與重度微調方法仍有些微差距。其意義在於證明透過演算法與核心共同設計,可將二值量化的理論效益轉化為實際端對端加速與能源節省。
