links.title: UI-Mate: Advancing Open-Weight Foundation GUI Agents with In-Context Demonstrations

evidence: Abstract & §7.2.1 Table 1 / §7.2.2 Table 3: UI-Mate-27B reports 77.0% OSWorld-Verified and 66.2% WindowsAgentArena, claimed strongest among open-weight systems compared (closed models Claude Opus 4.8 at 83.4% and GPT-5.5 at 78.7% remain higher).

§7.3.4 Table 5: paired self-demo gains under identical instructions, initialized environments, budgets, and evaluators — OSWorkerBench-Subset33 progress 67.85%→81.14% and success 17.17%→35.35%; OSWorld-Subset30 40.27%→65.75%; per-task tables show improvement on 28/33 and 18/30 tasks with negative transfer on 4 OSWorld tasks.

§7.4.2: authors state adaptive curriculum sampling and PCM 'do not consistently improve final task success' and mainly speed convergence; historical reasoning during RL causes entropy-collapse signatures — candidly reported limited/negative results.

§7.4.1: the +15.5 pp Multi-App gain from capability-aware sampling is admitted as 'correlational rather than a controlled isolation'; the evaluator audit finding ~18% misaligned rewards is quantitative but self-reported without external validation.

§6.4 and §10: systematic evaluation of the 45-task variant-demo collection is explicitly 'left to future work'; only a 10-task pilot is summarized, so the procedural-transfer claim is not yet substantiated.
§5.3 Limitations: workflow placement at context start invalidates shared prefixes and prevents KV-cache reuse — an acknowledged deployment limitation.

§6.4: 'We plan to release the task specifications, the 33 self-demo and 45 variant-demo pairings, taxonomy metadata, and evaluators' — release is planned, not confirmed; no released training code or full hyperparameter specification is documented, limiting reproducibility.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A comprehensive GUI/computer-use agent technical report squarely within preference scope: a VLM-based (Qwen3.6-27B) agentic system trained with SFT + GRPO-style online RL, in-context demonstration learning (DemoCUA), and a new paired-protocol benchmark (OSWorkerBench). Preference relevance is high (agents/tool use, reasoning/process credit, RLVR, ICL, multimodal, evaluation), and it is not out-of-scope pure CV. Novelty is moderate: RL components (IcePop, SeqClip, GRPO, adaptive curriculum) are adapted from prior work, while the subtask-workflow demo formulation, self/variant-demo distinction, capability-tree data rebalancing, and evaluator hard-negative/alternative-positive probes are genuine but incremental contributions building on UI-TARS/ScaleCUA/EvoCUA/CUA-Gym. Rigor is solid: controlled paired demo/no-demo comparisons with identical budgets/evaluators, 3-5 runs per task on demo experiments, honest negative findings (PCM/curriculum improve efficiency not final performance; historical reasoning harms RL exploration), and acknowledged correlational evidence. Evidence is strong for headline numbers but has gaps: no variance reported for main benchmark tables, baselines largely cited not reproduced, one rollout per task for trajectory analysis, and the variant-demo (procedural transfer) claim is deferred with only a 10-task pilot. Reproducibility is limited: benchmark resources are only 'planned' for release, model weights release is asserted but not documented, and training scale/hyperparameters are unspecified with internal infrastructure.

primary_link.title: UI-Mate: Advancing Open-Weight Foundation GUI Agents with In-Context Demonstrations

papers.summary: Foundation GUI agents can automate complex digital tasks, but deployment is hindered by scarce and biased training data, ambiguous prompts, and unreliable execution. Routine workflows rely on user-specific tools and tacit conventions, so unstated instructions can produce arbitrary variations across runs. We present UI-Mate, a foundation GUI agent that integrates an environment-grounded training stack with in-context demonstration learning. UI-Mate makes three contributions: A Scalable Environmen
papers.summary_zh: 基礎 GUI 代理面臨訓練瓶頸(可執行環境與驗證器稀缺、資料分布偏斜)與互動瓶頸(指令未明說使用者慣用程序,導致同一任務時而成功時而失敗)。本文提出 UI-Mate,整合三大元件:(1)環境紮根的閉環資料引擎,自動生成任務、建構可執行環境、蒐集並過濾軌跡,以階層能力樹診斷覆蓋缺口,支撐 SFT 與線上 RL(含決策回合中心化與過程信用模型);(2)DemoCUA 情境內示範學習,將人類或強代理的螢幕錄影轉為子任務層級工作流,以活體截圖為最終依據,遵循、跳過或改寫示範步驟;(3)OSWorkerBench,含 100 項橫跨 41 個應用的長時程辦公任務,並區分同任務自示範與相關任務變異示範兩種配對設定。證據:UI-Mate-27B 在 OSWorld-Verified 達 77.0%、WindowsAgentArena 達 66.2%,為開放權重最佳;OSWorkerBench 嚴格成功率 41.0%、進度 76.9%;在 33 任務自示範子集中,單一示範使嚴格成功率由 17.2% 升至 35.4%、進度由 67.9% 升至 81.1%。限制為工作流置於上下文開頭阻礙 KV 快取重用,變異示範的跨任務遷移尚未穩定。其意義在於證明示範不僅提升平均完成率,更提升代理實現未充分指定意圖的一致性,強化長時程可靠性。

links.title: VARM-Bench: Benchmarking Verifiable Structured Reasoning in Chinese Abusive Speech Moderation

evidence: Abstract: 'deterministic protocol evaluates field correctness, target alignment, output validity, complete-record agreement, and hidden record errors... without relying on an LLM judge'
Table 1 (Main Results): GPT-5.5 zero-shot Label Macro-F1 97.6, Category 85.7, JREM 55.4, HER-C 38.1; CoT-SFT raises JREM to 56.0-59.5 across open models
Benchmark Construction: '8,000 records split into 5,600 training, 800 development, and 1,600 test instances' with RapidFuzz >=95% pairs 'confined to a single split'
Annotation Quality Control: Krippendorff's alpha of 0.943 (Label), 0.935 (Category), 0.914 (Stance), 0.797 (Target Type), 0.671 (Target Explicitness), target pairwise char-F1 0.775
Experimental Setup: 'CoT-SFT uses 5,600 training and 800 development instances with prompt-masked LoRA... The test set is excluded from adaptation and model selection'

Q3 (Main Results): 'Shapley decomposition... attributes 76.6-80.6% of the Parse Success-JREM gap to the Referent group'; Q3 also concedes 'reasonable readers do not always choose the same normalized target... as the frozen reference'
Q4 (Main Results): 600 CoTs audited with three blinded GPT-5.5 passes plus human recheck; CoT-SFT Adequacy 99.7% vs Zero-Shot 22.8%
Title page footer: Code at github.com/NUAA-MMMI/VARM-Bench and dataset at huggingface.co/datasets/NUAA-MMMI/VARM-Bench; Appendix 'documents prompts, hyperparameters, hardware'
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly aligned with curator preferences: an LLM benchmark (Qwen2.5/Llama-3.1/InternLM3 plus three API models) centering field-anchored chain-of-thought rationales, verifiable structured reasoning, and toxicity/harm evaluation without LLM-judge scoring. Not a pure domain application, since the deterministic anchor-parse-verify protocol is general LLM evaluation methodology, though the Japanese-LLM preference is unmatched (Chinese content only). Quality is solid: 8,000 human-verified records with reported Krippendorff's alpha, dedup leakage control, end-to-end metric denominators, Shapley error attribution, and CoT-SFT with test excluded. Novelty is moderate-incremental: it combines known ingredients (rationales, structured extraction, process metrics) into a new verifiable-record representation for moderation. Evidence is quantitative and internally consistent (e.g., GPT-5.5 Label 97.6 vs JREM 55.4, HER-C 38.1), though no significance testing, some key analyses appear only as figures, and HER/JREM depend on a frozen single-answer reference convention the authors themselves flag. Generalizability is limited by language/domain specificity; reproducibility is good with released code/data and documented prompts and hyperparameters. API model versions (GPT-5.5, Qwen3.7-Max, DeepSeek-V4-Pro) are unverifiable from the document.

primary_link.title: VARM-Bench: Benchmarking Verifiable Structured Reasoning in Chinese Abusive Speech Moderation

papers.summary: The widespread circulation of abusive online content has increased the need for reliable moderation of Chinese social-media text. Existing Chinese benchmarks support label classification, fine-grained toxicity categorization, and target-aware extraction, but do not provide a unified representation for deterministically verifying the stated basis of a moderation decision. We introduce VARM-Bench, a benchmark for field-anchored chain-of-thought rationales in Chinese abusive-speech moderation. Each
papers.summary_zh: 中文社群媒體的仇恨言論審核評估多止於最終標籤,但正確標籤可能掩蓋錯誤的判決依據,例如認錯指涉對象、把引用或反駁誤判為作者立場。本文提出 VARM-Bench,收錄 8,000 則中文社群評論(含 1,440 例引用、反駁、中性提及等誘導性非有害案例),要求模型產出含六個錨點的自然語言思維鏈:目標、目標類型、目標明確性、作者立場、有害標籤與細類別;確定性解析器將其重建為完整審核紀錄,在不使用 LLM 評審下進行欄位正確性、紀錄有效性與完整紀錄一致(JREM)等多層級評分,並經人工校驗與一致性審計。證據:GPT-5.5 標籤 Macro-F1 達 97.6%,但 JREM 僅 55.4%,類別正確輸出中仍有 38.1% 含紀錄錯誤;CoT-SFT 將開源模型的 JREM 提升至 56.0–59.5% 並降低隱藏錯誤;Shapley 分解顯示 76.6–80.6% 的差距來自目標定位;詞彙線索挑戰集顯示引用、反駁等非有害用法特別困難,有害與非有害案例的 JREM 中位差達 26 分。限制為凍結參考答案使目標與明確性評分部分反映單一慣例而非純語義錯誤,且暫限中文有害言論領域。其意義在於提供可稽核、可重現的基準,揭示標籤級表現掩蓋紀錄級錯誤的風險。

links.title: LLMs Get Smarter from Targeted Synthetic Multilingual Data

evidence: Abstract: claims 6.2% average ID improvement, 3.7% OOD-task and 7.1% OOD-language reduction in forgetting; 'We will release code upon acceptance.'
Section 4.3 Takeaway 1: 4.3% improvement over base model on Nemotron tasks (5.5% Qwen 7B, 3.1% Qwen 14B, 4.4% Llama 8B); Table 2 average +6.2 across baselines.
Table 5 (Section 4.3): Format/+LAI/+LSI rows individually near base (e.g., Qwen 7B Nemotron 52.0/50.9/50.8 vs base 52.3) but '+LAI + LSI' jumps to 57.8 — combination effect unexplained.
Appendix C Table 10: includes an undescribed 'mCOT' baseline row; Distillation (32B) scores (e.g., Qwen 7B Nemotron 49.6) show most gains come from trained question generation, not label quality.
Section 4.4/Discussion: cost of 0.96 min/training-data sample, ~8 GPU-hours one-time on 6 A100 GPUs for GRPO generator training.
Section 6 Limitations: high-resource languages only, verifiable tasks only, relies on Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct labels since student self-labeling failed.
Appendix B Tables 6-9: min/max standard deviations across 3 runs reported per model/method; Section 4.2 states all results averaged across 3 runs.
Table 4: cross-lingual spread Std 9.4 (HOTFIXR) vs 9.6 (Base); text concedes 'no SOTA data curation method for ensuring multilingual consistency.'
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM methodology paper (multilingual synthetic-data generation for Qwen/Llama instruct models) with GRPO-trained question generator, student-feedback rewards, and SFT — strong overlap with LLM, training, reasoning, and RL preferences. Novelty is moderate: the framework extends AcquisitionSynthesis (same-group prior work); the hidden-state cross-lingual divergence (LSI) reward is the freshest element. Rigor is solid — three model families, seven baselines including DataEnvGym, three-run averages with per-task std devs, reward ablations, distillation and continual-learning appendices — but the individual reward components show near-zero effect and only the combination works (Table 5) without mechanistic explanation, one Appendix C baseline (mCOT) is never described, and thresholds like ROUGE>=0.8 are ad hoc. Quantitative claims are internally consistent (e.g., +4.3% ID over base and -0.9% OOD verified from Table 10), though the abstract's '6.2%' is an average over baselines rather than vs. base. Generalizability is decent across models/tasks/languages but limited to high-resource languages and verifiable tasks (Limitations). Code only promised 'upon acceptance'; prompts and cost details (0.96 min/sample, 6 A100s) are given but SFT hyperparameters are missing.

In other words, a language model outputs different (and potentially incorrect) responses to the same semantic query when prompted in different languages. Prior work attributes this to an internal misalignment of semantic representation across languages. Currently, there are two main approaches to address LSC in the literature: (1) routing all queries throug
papers.summary_zh: 語言特定能力(LSC)指 LLM 對同一語義查詢在不同提示語言下表現各異,主因是英語主導的預訓練造成跨語言表徵錯位;現有對策如全部經英語路由會犧牲語言表達力,語言均衡訓練又壓低整體效能。本文提出 HOTFIXR,一種以學生模型回饋訊號訓練問題生成器的合成資料框架,其語言赤字獲取函數同時衡量兩種弱點:語言不可知無能(以英語推理時的模型不確定度)與語言特定無能(擷取英語與目標語言推理的最後隱藏狀態並計算餘弦距離),再以 GRPO 最佳化生成器,使其聚焦於揭露學生弱點的難題。證據:在 Qwen2.5-7B/14B 與 Llama-3.1-8B 上,相較七種基線,HOTFIXR 平均提升分布內效能 6.2%,並將微調引發的災難性遺忘降至最低——分布外任務僅損失 0.9%(較其他訓練式基線好 5.6%),未見語言(德、日、俄、中)僅損失 1.4%(好 7.1%);消融顯示兩種訊號需合併才有效,獎勵駭客問題則透過限制訓練樣本數緩解。限制為僅涵蓋高資源語言、仰賴 Qwen-32B 產生可靠標籤,且無法保證推廣至不可驗證領域。其意義在於展示資料中心的標靶式合成可在不犧牲通用能力下,同時強化多語言效能與一致性。

links.title: Not All Attention Is Equal: A Quantitative Survey of the EEI Trade-off

evidence: Abstract and Section 2 ('Score Consistency and Limitations'): single-rater EEI scores with assumed +/-1 perturbation; 200,000-sample Monte Carlo (NumPy PCG64, seed 42) reports 67-70% mean fraction of samples where a method's rank changes by more than one position, and a rank-matched null model reproduces the stability profile, supporting only coarse tier-level comparisons.

Section 2 ('Exploratory Quantitative Analysis'): Ex-LRA Spearman rho=0.54 (p=0.21, n=7; rho=0.45, p=0.27, n=8 with RWKV) is positive but non-significant; no inferential correlation is reported for the Efficiency axis because speedups span kernel-, model-, and serving-level scopes with different baselines and hardware.

Survey Methodology and Figure 2: PRISMA-inspired flow uses author-maintained reconstructed counts; the text states raw exports, query strings, and screening logs 'were not retained,' making it explicitly 'not an independently reproducible systematic-review record' (approx. 1,265 retrieved, 63 included).

Table 4 and Appendix A: 21-method EEI panel with per-axis numeric justifications; Table 15 (reproducibility audit, verified 7 Aug 2026) records that Focus 'code not located' and DashAttention has 'no independent reproduction located,' with both flagged as unverified mid-2026 preprints.

Section 2 ('EEI Frontier Pattern'): authors state the pattern 'is a descriptive characterization of how the EEI rubric was defined and applied, not an independently verified empirical law,' conceding the observation partially confirms rubric construction rather than testing an external hypothesis.

Section 7.8 ('Threats to Validity'): acknowledges publication bias, preprint-heavy frontier, cross-paper benchmark inconsistency, and that Efficiency scores are 'implicitly NVIDIA-centric' and should not be generalized to non-NVIDIA hardware without independent validation.

Code and Data Availability section: claims all analysis scripts, scoring records, and manuscript source at github.com/Nixon-H/not-all-attention-is-equal; sensitivity protocol specifies integer weights, average-rank tie handling, and clipping to [1,10], with alternative tie conventions reported to shift mean instability figures materially (65.5/64.8/65.9% min-rank vs 45.8/50.9/50.8% dense-rank).
llm_evaluation.rationale: A quantitative survey of attention mechanisms framed by an Efficiency-Expressiveness-Interpretability (EEI) rubric. Preference relevance is high: the core subject matter is Transformer/attention architecture, LLM inference efficiency (GQA/MQA KV-cache sharing, FlashAttention, PagedAttention/vLLM, Mamba/SSM, 128K+ contexts, RoPE/YaRN context extension), and mechanistic interpretability, all heavily weighted preferences; the vision section is one part of a broader language-centric treatment, so no out-of-scope cap applies. Rigor is unusually strong for a survey: seed-fixed Monte Carlo perturbation analysis with a rank-matched null model, explicit circularity disclosures, and extensive threat-to-validity discussion. However, the substantive quantitative content is thin: scores are single-rater ordinal judgments, the Ex-LRA correlation is non-significant at n=7-8, no original experiments are run, and the central 'EEI Frontier Pattern' is admitted by the authors to be a rubric-internal consistency check rather than an empirical finding. Evidence strength is moderate: benchmark synthesis is appropriately caveated as cross-study incomparable, and the frontier adaptive methods (Focus, DashAttention) rest on unverified preprints. Generalizability is decent but bounded by NVIDIA-centric efficiency scores and a purposive 21-method panel. Reproducibility of the computational artifacts (pinned seeds, scripts, scoring worksheet, per-method justifications) is good, though the literature search itself is admittedly non-reproducible.
topics: Efficient attention: FlashAttention, sparse/linear attention, Mamba/SSM
LLM inference efficiency: KV cache, GQA/MQA, PagedAttention, long context
Mechanistic interpretability: induction heads, superposition, sparse autoencoders
Quantitative survey methodology and evaluation rubrics

primary_link.title: Not All Attention Is Equal: A Quantitative Survey of the EEI Trade-off

papers.summary: Attention mechanisms have driven machine learning for a decade, from neural machine translation to language models that do general-purpose reasoning. This survey covers four connected threads: their formulation for sequence-to-sequence tasks, adaptation to computer vision, efficiency innovations that address the quadratic bottleneck, and advances in interpretability. We define three criteria: efficiency, expressiveness, and interpretability, and compare twenty-one methods using an EEI scoring fr
papers.summary_zh: 本調查回顧注意力機制十年演進：從 Bahdanau–Luong 對齊到 Transformer 的縮放點積形式，再經視覺轉換（ViT、DETR、Swin）、效率創新（稀疏模式、線性注意力、FlashAttention、Mamba 等狀態空間模型）到可解釋性發現。論文提出效率—表達力—可解釋性（EEI）框架，以評分量表為 21 種方法在三軸賦分，並主張沒有任何方法在三軸同時達到最強觀察水準，研究進展即是擴張 EEI 前沿。為檢驗分數穩健性，作者以固定亂數種子執行二十萬次蒙地卡羅擾動：在假設 ±1 分擾動下，方法名次變動超過一位的樣本比例達 67–70%，且名次配對的虛無模型重現同樣的穩定度輪廓，顯示分數僅支持粗略層級比較，不宜解讀為精細排名。作者亦貢獻七大類、21 子類的方法分類法、跨研究基準資料綜整、五大開放問題與 2015–2026 演進時間軸。限制包括單一評分者的主觀性、可解釋性軸缺乏標準化基準，以及權重設定改變時排名隨之變動。其價值在於提供設計空間的結構化詞彙與誠實的不確定性揭露，協助實務者在證據強度明確的前提下選擇注意力方法。

evidence: Section 1 & Abstract: IDSS is a training-free framework maintaining an explicit situation state with fact layer (provenance-aware entities) and state layer (intents, variables, constraints) for user-centric multi-turn agents
Section 4.1/Appendix A.1: evaluation on τ-bench, VitaBench, UserBench across eight LLMs with GPT-4.1 as user simulator and four independent trials (Avg@4, pass^4)
Table 1 (Section 4.2): GPT-4.1 IDSS Airline 59.0 Avg@4 vs U-Fold 57.5; per-model deltas average to the claimed +1.5 Avg@4/+2.0 pass^4 Airline gains
Table 2 (Section 4.3): ablations run on GPT-4.1 only; w/o Fact Layer drops τ-bench Avg@4 67.0→64.8; w/o State Layer drops UserBench Score 0.382→0.350
Section 4.4: annotated error analysis reports fact omission decreasing 14%→8% and missing-information errors 8%→5%; constraint violation changes only 5%→8%
Section 4.5: claims zero extra LLM calls, highest average performance 50.5%, and fewest turns (7.8)
Section 3.2.1: fact layer updated via deterministic Parse(o_t) operations (ADD/UPDATE/DELETE/MERGE); implementation details and code release are not provided

Appendix A.1: VitaBench scored 0-100 via GPT-4.1 rubric judge (LLM-as-judge dependency)
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly on-preference: a training-free context-management framework for LLM multi-turn tool-using agents (Agents & Tool Use w2.5, LLMs w2.5, memory/long-context w1.8), not a domain-application paper. Novelty is moderate: explicit fact/state layer separation with constraint propagation refines DST, StateAct chain-of-states, and U-Fold/PABU-style context folding rather than introducing a new paradigm, though deterministic zero-extra-call parsing and intent-blocking propagation are practical contributions. Rigor is solid in breadth (3 benchmarks, 8 LLMs, 5 baselines, ablations, error and efficiency analysis; Table 1/2 numbers are internally consistent with the claimed +1.5 Avg@4/+2.0 pass^4 Airline and +1.7/+2.1 VitaBench OTA/Cross gains), but weakened by no significance testing or variance reporting, ablations on GPT-4.1 only, dramatic ReSum/IterResearch degradation (e.g., 52.0 vs 77.5 Retail) suggesting baseline-tuning concerns, GPT-4.1 as sole user simulator and VitaBench rubric judge. Evidence strength benefits from detailed case studies (Appendix C) and consistent arithmetic (Table 2 Full 67.0 = mean of Retail 75.0/Airline 59.0; UserBench relative gains match text), but rests on simulated users and LLM-judge scoring. Generalizability is decent across model scales and three task families, yet limited to text-parsable tool returns per the Limitations section. Reproducibility is weak: Appendix B gives prompt/state formats, but no code release, no parser implementation details, and unspecified residual-history compression parameters.

primary_link.title: Intent-Driven Situation Tracking for User-Centric Multi-Turn Agents

papers.summary: User-centric multi-turn agents must act on an evolving task situation shaped by changing user intents, accumulated tool-grounded facts, missing information, and execution constraints. Existing context-management methods improve the use of past interaction history, but rarely maintain an explicit situation state that separates grounded facts from task-state judgments. As a result, agents often need to infer fine-grained attributes, task dependencies, and constraint satisfaction implicitly from di
papers.summary_zh: 以使用者為中心的代理在多輪互動中須持續追蹤演變的使用者意圖、工具回傳的事實、缺失資訊與執行約束，但既有外部記憶或上下文壓縮方法鮮少將工具落地事實與任務狀態判斷分開維護。本文提出免訓練的 IDSS 框架：事實層以確定性解析器將工具回傳轉為具來源標記的實體與屬性；狀態層在生成回應時同步維護意圖、必要變數與約束的狀態；跨層約束傳播則在新事實出現時重新評估約束，封鎖不可行意圖並啟動替代路徑，全程不需額外 LLM 呼叫。作者在 τ-bench、VitaBench 與 UserBench 三項互動基準、八個 LLM 上實測，IDSS 在任務完成、偏好引導與互動效率上優於 ReAct 與 U-Fold 等基準，航空與跨域等需多實體協調、約束動態演變的場景增益最明顯；消融實驗顯示事實層對 τ-bench 助益最大，狀態層對 UserBench 關鍵，錯誤分析中事實遺漏由 14% 降至 8%。限制在於假設工具回傳含可解析的文字欄位，且實驗採模擬使用者。此研究展示了顯式情境狀態可作為以歷史為中心的上下文管理之外的有效替代方案。

links.title: Navigation-Informed Embeddings: Dense-Retriever Adaptation from Agent Search Traces

evidence: Abstract: support Recall@20 improves from 72.2 to 78.0 overall and long-path from 46.7 (unadapted BGE) to 55.4 (NIE-Path); shuffled-order control loses 3.2 points.

Section 5.3 (Ablation Study): 10,000-sample paired bootstrap CIs for long-path gains (NIE-Stop +5.6, CI [2.1,9.0]; NIE-Path vs matched no-order +2.6, CI [0.5,4.8]; observed vs shuffled order +3.2, CI [0.9,5.6]); three-seed std 55.4±0.4 vs 52.8±0.5 for no-order control.

Section 5.2 (Matched Trace-Adaptation Baselines): ANN self-training (51.9 long-path), all-viewed-positive, retained tool-query pairs, and matched no-order control (52.8) all start from the same BGE initializer with identical training budget, separating generic trace adaptation from stopping/path-structure signal.

Section 4 (audit) and Section 5.5 (Robustness to Behavioral Noise): four annotators judged 1,000 sampled terminal documents; 26% wrong under a three-of-four rule, with no filtering of these sessions before training.

Section 5.7 (Standard Public-Benchmark Transfer): frozen checkpoints give +1.9 nDCG@10 and +1.5 Recall@100 over BGE-base on standard BEIR HotpotQA, with paired query-bootstrap CI [0.8,3.0] for the nDCG@10 gain.

Section 4 (Dataset size / Target workflow benchmark): internal target corpus of 47,109 documents and 542 held-out queries with human supporting-evidence judgments; no public code or data availability statement appears anywhere in the paper, limiting independent verification.

Section 7 (Limitations): method requires retained agent traces, uses a soft monotonic relevance prior that fails under premature stopping or evidence accumulation, and notes cold-start/low-traffic settings need complementary supervision.

Section 5.6 (Transfer to HotpotQA): pooled-corpus transfer improves both-support Recall@20 from 61.3 to 64.7, but the paper itself flags duplicate-competition sensitivity, making it a secondary diagnostic rather than a standard retrieval result.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Sits squarely in the agentic-RAG preference space: adapting a dense retriever (BGE-base) from LLM agent navigation traces (stopping events, path order) without new labels. Methodologically strong for its type: matched trace-adaptation baselines under identical budget (Sec 5.2), order-perturbation ablations isolating chronology signal (Sec 5.3), paired bootstrap CIs and three-seed variance, a four-annotator audit showing 26% noisy terminal positives, and two external transfer checks (pooled and standard BEIR HotpotQA). Novelty is moderate: the supervision source (agent trajectories as soft relevance gradients) is fresh, but the machinery is a sensible combination of contrastive learning, hard negatives, and learning-to-rank from implicit feedback. Main weaknesses: primary results are on a single proprietary workflow benchmark (47,109 docs, 542 queries) with no code or data release, the LLM agent is fixed so policy dependence is untested across agents, and public-benchmark gains are modest (+1.9 nDCG@10). Evidence is internally consistent and statistically supported but not independently verifiable on the primary benchmark; generalizability beyond one workflow family and gradual-drift regimes is acknowledged but unproven.

primary_link.title: Navigation-Informed Embeddings: Dense-Retriever Adaptation from Agent Search Traces

papers.summary: Agentic retrieval workflows produce query, retrieval, and stopping traces as a byproduct of answering questions. We study how these traces can adapt a deployed dense retriever to changing workflow distributions without new relevance labels, synthetic queries, or LLM judgments. We introduce Navigation-Informed Embeddings (NIE), a family of trace-derived objectives. NIE-Stop turns the stopping document into a soft positive; NIE-Path additionally uses preceding path documents as hard comparisons an
papers.summary_zh: 代理式檢索工作流程會自然留下查詢、檢索與停止的軌跡。本文探討能否用這些軌跡在沒有新標註、合成查詢或 LLM 評判的情況下調適已部署的密集檢索器。所提 NIE 家族中，NIE-Stop 將代理停止時的終端文件視為軟性正例；NIE-Path 進一步把路徑上較早文件當作難比較樣本，加上相鄰排序損失與幾何衰減權重。訓練僅用保留的來源軌跡，評估則在獨立目標基準、以人工支援證據標註計分：整體支援 Recall@20 從 72.2 提升至 78.0，長路徑查詢從 46.7 升至 55.4，其中僅用終端文件的 NIE-Stop 已達 76.9。打亂路徑順序的對照組損失 3.2 點，證實觀測到的時間序確實帶有訊號；四位標註者的稽核顯示 26% 終端文件有誤，但整體增益仍在，代表雜訊監督在聚合層面有用。同一 adapter 在標準 BEIR HotpotQA 上也提升 nDCG@10 約 1.9 點。限制包括單調相關性先驗僅為軟性假設、軌跡保留須符合隱私與政策、低流量場景訊號不足，且實驗僅評估單次離線更新。其意義在於當軌跡已被保留時，提供零標註成本的檢索器持續調適通道。
papers.title: Navigation-Informed Embeddings: Dense-Retriever Adaptation from Agent Search Traces

links.title: Why Summaries Turn Neutral: Policy Attribution for Sentiment Drift in Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback

evidence: Abstract: 'RLHF summaries get higher rewards but show 30–40% lower sentiment variance'; cross-lingual analysis across eight languages; 'Code and toolkit will be public' (future tense, not released).

Section 3.3 / Table 5: Policy Attribution decomposes the policy gradient into reward, KL, and clipping components; KL penalty shows 0.82 negative attribution mass vs 0.58 (reward) and 0.75 (PPO clipping).
Section 4.2: base models Llama-3-8B and Mistral-7B-v0.1, TRL library, β ∈ {0.05, 0.1, 0.2}, hyperparameters in Table 1 (LR 1e-5, batch 64, 4 PPO epochs).
Table 7 (Section 5.4): SA-KL (γ=0.3) SV 0.158 vs RLHF 0.121, drift reduction 18.2%; SA-KL (γ=0.5) 21.7% reduction, ROUGE-L 36.5/36.3 vs 36.8 baseline.
Section 5.5: human evaluation limited to 50 pairs and 3 annotators; RLHF neutrality mean 2.1 vs SFT 3.4 vs SA-KL 2.9, Fleiss' κ = 0.62.

Limitations (items 1-5): single-document summarization only; static unnamed pretrained sentiment classifiers; 'lack of explicit correlation analysis between JSD and human judgments'; attribution requires 50 integration steps per token (computational cost).

Section 2.2: paper itself concedes prior work documented reward over-optimization behaviors (verbosity bias, stylistic flattening), positioning its contribution as mechanistic diagnosis rather than discovery of the phenomenon.

Section 4.4: sentiment-bearing tokens identified 'via a multilingual sentiment lexicon and classifier confidence threshold (p>0.8)' using Captum; specific classifier models for the eight languages are not named anywhere in the paper.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Directly on-topic for the preference profile: it studies RLHF/DPO alignment of LLMs (Llama-3-8B, Mistral-7B-v0.1, Section 4.2) and proposes an interpretability-style 'Policy Attribution' framework decomposing policy gradients into reward, KL, and PPO-clipping components (Section 3.3), evaluated on standard summarization benchmarks. Novelty is moderate: sentiment drift overlaps known reward over-optimization findings (Section 2.2 cites Gao et al.), and the cross-lingual evaluation builds heavily on the authors' own prior work (citation [6], Sections 3.2/5.1/6.3); the token-level attribution-to-loss-component framing and the sentiment-aware KL relaxation (Eq. 7) are the main new contributions. Rigor is fair but uneven: controlled β sweeps for PPO and DPO (Tables 4, 6), consistent numbers across tables, and a limitations section are strengths, but the attribution aggregation scheme behind the headline 'KL ≈ 82% of negative attribution' claim (Section 1.3, Table 5) is under-specified, sentiment classifiers for eight languages are unnamed, no statistical significance or multi-seed variance is reported, and the 'causal driver' claim rests on correlational attribution evidence. Evidence is moderately supported by quantitative tables (e.g., Table 7: drift reduction 18.2%/21.7% with ROUGE-L within 0.3-0.5 of baseline) and a small human study (50 pairs, 3 annotators, Fleiss κ=0.62, Section 5.5), but lacks significance testing and external validation of classifier-based drift against human judgments (admitted in Limitations item 2). Generalizability is decent across datasets, two alignment methods, and eight languages, but confined to single-document summarization (Limitations item 4). Reproducibility is weak: code and the attribution toolkit are only promised ('will be public', Abstract; Section 6.6), not released, and key implementation details (classifier identities, attribution normalization) are missing. Not penalized by the out-of-scope caps, as this is core LLM alignment/interpretability/NLP methodology.

primary_link.title: Why Summaries Turn Neutral: Policy Attribution for Sentiment Drift in Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback

papers.summary: Reinforcement learning with human feedback (RLHF) aligns LLMs with human preferences, improving summarization fluency and safety, but causes sentiment drift: overly neutral summaries stripped of emotional nuance. We diagnose why RL acts as a sentiment neutralizer and present Policy Attribution, a framework using gradient and logit decomposition to trace drift to reward model (RM) signals and KL (Kullback-Leibler) penalty. Sentiment drift reflects a strategic bias toward "low-risk" tokens maximiz
papers.summary_zh: RLHF 雖提升摘要的流暢與安全，卻帶來情感漂移：輸出趨於過度中立，情感強度與變異被系統性壓低。本文提出 Policy Attribution 框架，把策略梯度分解到獎勵、KL 懲罰與 PPO 裁剪三個目標組成，並以整合梯度在情感詞元上歸因。在 Reddit TL;DR 與 CNN/DailyMail 上，RLHF 摘要獎勵更高但情感變異下降 30–40%；歸因顯示 KL 正則項占情感詞元負向歸因約 82%，是主要驅動力，印證模型在偏好不確定下偏向低風險詞元的策略性偏誤。跨八種語言的分析顯示漂移與語言無關，但芬蘭語、匈牙利語等形態豐富語言受抑更強；延伸至 DPO 的實驗顯示抑制同樣存在（25–30%），代表此為偏好最佳化的普遍後果。作者據此提出情感感知 KL 正則化，放寬情感詞元的 KL 懲罰，在不損害 ROUGE-L 的前提下將漂移減少 18–22%。限制包括僅涵蓋單文件摘要、依賴靜態情感分類器、人工評估規模小（50 對），且逐詞元歸因計算成本高。此研究對需要情感保真的下游應用與情感感知對齊設計具直接啟示。
papers.title: Why Summaries Turn Neutral: Policy Attribution for Sentiment Drift in Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback
papers.title_zh: 摘要為何變得中立：RLHF 情感漂移的策略歸因

links.title: Dense Expands, Sparse Anchors: Channel-Asymmetric Query Expansion for Hybrid Retrieval

evidence: Abstract: DESA improves macro nDCG@10/Recall@20 over the unexpanded query by 3.82%/2.38% across seven BEIR datasets while reducing dense and sparse access depths by 36.90%/36.56%.

Section 3.3: Orthogonal residual expansion projects out the component of averaged query-reference vectors parallel to the original query (45-degree bound derived in Appendix B.1); score-product anchoring s_A(d)=s_o(d)s_r(d) preserves the original sparse support since supp(s_o) ⊆ supp(s_r).

Section 2.2 and 3.4: The complete-list fusion and bound-based replay stopping-depth evaluation protocol is adopted from Zhang (2026), arXiv:2608.07152 — a self-citation supplying the core evaluation methodology.

Section 5.2/Table 5b: All four improvements vs Original significant after Holm correction (p_Holm=.0004); vs Shared expansion only nDCG is significant (p_Holm=.0012) while Recall and both depth differences are nonsignificant.

Table 3/Table 7: QuDAR-simple RRF attains 0.4761 nDCG vs DESA's 0.4747 with paired differences not significant (p_Holm=.3966/.1668); DESA uses 64.16% fewer fusion-side rank entries (1402.1 vs 3911.5).
Section 5.1/Figure 3: A fixed L=50 cutoff changes 6.95% of nDCG and 18.84% of Recall query-level judgments vs complete-list fusion, with 3.07%/3.06% strict gain-loss reversals.

Table 2/Table 4: Sparse anchoring contributes most effectiveness gain (Sparse-only +3.11% nDCG vs Dense-only +1.08%); DESA retains original sparse support exactly on six of seven datasets, with Touché-2020 at 99.9999% due to 25 omitted tail documents.

Appendix A: Full prompts, model revision hashes (Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct fe11104..., Mistral-7B c170c70...), decoding parameters, XGrammar validation, Pyserini 2.3.0 with BM25 k1=0.9/b=0.4, seed derivation, uv.lock, and hash-manifest artifact traceability.
Section 5.5/Appendix C.1: Contriever on Touché-2020 raises depths by 14.29%/4.34% — the only observed failure case; Mistral generator and nested TREC-COVID corpora retain gains.

Limitations: evaluation covers seven English BEIR datasets, two generators, BM25 only, equal-weight RRF; score-product anchoring assumes a non-negative additive scorer; replay depth is not wall-clock latency.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A methodologically careful hybrid-retrieval paper squarely within the RAG/retrieval preference: LLM-generated reference passages (Qwen2.5-7B, Mistral-7B) are integrated asymmetrically — orthogonal residual expansion for the dense channel and support-preserving score-product anchoring for BM25. Novelty is moderate: multi-reference LLM expansion exists (HyDE, Query2doc, MuGI), and the complete-list fusion plus replay-depth evaluation protocol is adopted from the author's own prior work (Zhang 2026, cited in Sections 2.2/3.4); the genuinely new elements are the channel-asymmetric integration rules and the cutoff-sensitivity analysis. Rigor is strong: matched-reference controls, 2x2 operator ablations, stratified sign-flip tests with Holm correction, bootstrap CIs, and honest reporting of nulls (Recall vs Shared p_Holm=.2736; no significant effectiveness gap vs QuDAR-simple, Table 7). Evidence is consistent with claims, per-dataset tables included, and failure boundaries documented (Contriever on Touché-2020 depth increases, Section 5.5/Appendix C.1). Generalizability is limited to English BEIR, BM25, and equal-weight RRF per the Limitations section, and the depth metric is a proxy rather than latency. Reproducibility is exceptional: verbatim prompts, model revision hashes, decoding settings, Pyserini/BM25 parameters, seed derivation, and hash-manifest artifact traceability in Appendix A. Solid but incremental contribution yielding a mid-to-good overall score.

primary_link.title: Dense Expands, Sparse Anchors: Channel-Asymmetric Query Expansion for Hybrid Retrieval

papers.summary: LLM-based query expansion improves retrieval by generating document-like passages. In hybrid retrieval, however, most evaluations fuse fixed top-$L$ dense and sparse rankings. Because the cutoff controls both which cross-channel contributions enter fusion and how much of each ranking is accessed, gains measured at one $L$ can change or reverse at another. We separate these effects by evaluating retrieval effectiveness under complete-list fusion and recording the policy-specific per-channel repla
papers.summary_zh: LLM 查詢擴增在混合檢索中常於固定 top-L 截斷下評估，但截斷同時決定跨通道融合的貢獻與讀取深度，單一截斷的結論可能隨深度改變甚至反轉。本文提出通道非對稱方法 DESA：由 LLM 生成互補參考段落，密集通道採正交殘差擴增，保留原查詢方向、只加入新語義分量（與原向量的夾角理論上限 45°）；稀疏通道採分數乘積錨定，將原查詢與擴增查詢的分數相乘，使生成詞彙只在原詞彙支援範圍內重排文件、不擴大支援集合。評估改採完整清單融合，並以重播程序記錄決定 top-K 所需的各通道讀取深度：在七個 BEIR 資料集上，nDCG@10 與 Recall@20 相較未擴增查詢分別提升 3.82% 與 2.38%，密集與稀疏存取深度分別減少 36.90% 與 36.56%，63.31% 查詢兩通道皆變淺。實驗亦證實固定截斷會改變 6.95% 的 nDCG 判斷與 18.84% 的 Recall 判斷，並有約 3% 嚴格反轉。機制分析顯示稀疏錨定貢獻主要效能增益，密集殘差則進一步降低所需深度；Contriever 在 Touché-2020 上為唯一失效案例。限制涵蓋僅測英文 BEIR 資料集、BM25 與等權 RRF 融合，以及稀疏評分函數須為非負的假設。

links.title: Adversarial Review: Structured Disagreement for Grounded Agentic Code Review

evidence: Section 3.5 & Table 1: AR scores 87% pass-rate (43/57 hard) on LCB, +5pp over MARS (82%) with 2 reviewing roles vs MARS's 4.
Section 4.2 & Table 2: naive AR is lowest of four methods on SWE-PRBench (F1=0.457); AR with text constraint reaches F1=0.533 vs Two-reviewers 0.503, MARS 0.501, Single-reviewer 0.495 (N=100).
Section 4.4: the fix is a three-verdict critic output (AGREE / DISAGREE_EVIDENCE with code citation / DISAGREE_CONCERN) plus per-verdict reviewer response rules; only prompts change, not structure.
Section 4.1: SWE-PRBench uses a GPT-5.2 judge matching agent comments to human reviewer comments, Cohen's kappa = 0.75.
Section 5.2 & Table 3: SWE-bench Verified N=500: AR 75.2% vs MARS 72.6% vs Zero-shot 71.6%, with AR at ~4.5x Zero-shot tokens; evaluation via Claude Code reading a SKILL.md protocol.
Section 4.3 case studies: 'C yields to R' (F1 0.286 for AR vs 0.667 for MARS on the same bug) documents the false-consensus mechanism qualitatively.
Section 6 & Figure 2: Pareto-frontier claims; paper notes LCB token medians are 'estimated from per-method call counts' while other benchmarks use per-task logs.
Section 7: authors state claims are 'empirical, not formal', acknowledge no broad model coverage, judge-design limits, scope-creep failure (Case 2, astropy-14182), and token-cost trade-offs.

Appendix A: all reviewer/critic/MARS prompts dumped verbatim per benchmark; preamble states prompts 'will be released alongside the implementation upon acceptance' — code availability is conditional, not confirmed.

Section 5.1: only three methods evaluated on SWE-bench Verified because full runs 'estimate over 300 hours per method'; MARS row uses the authors' re-implementation (A.3.3), not necessarily the official MARS system.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core agentic-LLM coding paper: a minimal reviewer-critic (Adversarial Review) protocol positioned between subagent-as-tool and large multi-agent teams, evaluated on LiveCodeBench, SWE-PRBench, and SWE-bench Verified, with a documented 'false consensus' failure mode and a prompt-level fix (three-verdict evidence-grounded disagreement). Strong match to Agents/Code/LLM preferences. Novelty is modest: reviewer-critic loops, multi-agent debate, MARS, and Self-Refine are known, and the contribution is a compact recombination plus an explicit disagreement taxonomy. Rigor is decent (step-by-step construction as ablation, matched model claude-sonnet-4-5 across all agents, token accounting) but weakened by small LCB samples (105/57 tasks), no significance tests or repeated-run variance, a single LLM judge (GPT-5.2, kappa 0.75), and only two anecdotal case studies. Evidence is concrete (tables with N, token medians, concrete patches) but mostly single-run with cherry-picked cases; the Pareto-frontier claim in Section 6 relies on estimated LCB token medians. Generalizability is limited to one model family and Python-centric benchmarks, though two execution modes (Python orchestrator vs. SKILL.md on Claude Code) help. Reproducibility is good: full prompts dumped verbatim in Appendix A, model version pinned, official Docker harness, but code is only promised 'upon acceptance'. Solidly in-scope, above-average empirical work with honest limitations, not a top-tier contribution.

primary_link.title: Adversarial Review: Structured Disagreement for Grounded Agentic Code Review

papers.summary: Early multi-agent LLM systems often used role-separated teams, yet scaling agent count yields diminishing returns on repository-level coding tasks. Recent alternatives treat agents as passive tools (subagents), yet this removes the benefits of agent interaction entirely. We study whether a subagent paradigm can support a middle ground: minimal agentic cooperation without the overhead of large multi-agent teams. We introduce Adversarial Review (AR), a minimal cooperative code-review protocol in w
papers.summary_zh: 早期的角色分工多代理系統隨代理數增加而出現報酬遞減，把代理當被動工具的子代理範式則失去互動好處。本文提出的 Adversarial Review（AR）居於兩者之間：主代理撰寫程式碼，審查者 R 評估成品，批評者 C 以結構化分歧審計 R 的審查；內迴圈只交換審查文字、成品凍結，收斂後才由外迴圈編輯。在 LiveCodeBench 上，AR 以 87% 解題成功率領先六種方法，僅用三個代理即超越五代理的 MARS；在 SWE-bench Verified 上達 75.2%，優於 Zero-shot 的 71.6% 與 MARS 的 72.6%，但耗用約 4.5 倍 token。關鍵發現是錯誤共識：在 SWE-PRBench 上，原始 AR 因批評者傾向順從審查者而墊底（F1 0.457）；僅加入一次提示迭代，強制批評者在同意、有證據反對與疑慮反對三類判決中擇一，並要求引用程式碼證據，F1 即升至最高的 0.533。個案分析顯示此迴圈能引導找到根因，也可能放大推測性顧慮造成範圍蔓延。限制包括基準與 LLM 評判設計、token 成本，以及結論屬實證觀察而非形式保證。其教訓在於代理合作須讓分歧明確、有據且可審計。

links.title: KV-Pipe: On the Relation Between KV Sharing and Pipeline Parallel Efficiency in LLMs

evidence: Abstract: claims 'up to 9.2% higher training MFU and up to a 9.8% reduction in iteration time' with larger gains at higher pipeline-parallel degrees.
Section 3.2, Table 3(c): PP=8, S=8K — MFU 56.32→61.49 (9.17%), iteration time 263.3→237.5s (9.80%), FIR 1.1194→1.0004 on 8x Ascend 910B with LLaMA2-7B.
Section 3.3, Table 4: 8x V100 results for LLaMA2-7B/13B, LLaMA3-8B, Qwen2.5-14B at S=4K/8K/16K and PP=2/4/8; KV-Pipe beats 1F1B and Seq1F1B, e.g., LLaMA2-13B 16K PP=8: MFU 39.5→52.0, time 960→750s.
Appendix A.2, Table 8: KV-Pipe optimal at PP=8/S=8K (SKV=4, layers 29–32) yields Val PPL 5.49 and downstream avg 52.2 vs full-attention baseline 5.47/52.2; quality checked only for LLaMA2-7B.
Appendix A.4, Table 9: ablations show Architecture-Balanced (+9.17% MFU) beats Uniform (+6.40%) and Symmetric Bipolar (+7.10%) at SKV=4; FIR-guided (+9.17%) vs max-stage-time-guided (+8.90%).
Appendix A.5, Table 10: Seq1F1B+KV-Pipe reaches 50.0% MFU / 248s vs Seq1F1B alone 47.0% / 265s (LLaMA2-7B, PP=8, 8K), supporting composability.
Appendix A.6.1, Table 11: in vPipe/DawnPiper setting on 8x A100, KV-Pipe achieves 1.20x (GPT-2 770M) and 1.41x (T5 780M) speedup vs vPipe-AS, with reduced stage-imbalance ratios.
Appendix A.8, Table 13: GQA decoding throughput 665 vs 620 tok/s (LLaMA3-8B, 32K) and 184 vs 170 tok/s (Qwen2.5-14B, 128K).
Limitations and Future Work: quality results scoped to LLaMA2-7B dense models; PP degrees up to 8; greedy heuristic not claimed globally optimal; no MoE/hybrid-architecture quality claims.

Section 2.6, Algorithm 1: offline tail-first greedy conversion with FIR retargeting, requiring only PP partition and per-layer FLOPs estimates; no code or artifact availability statement anywhere in the document.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM systems/efficiency paper (no disqualifying domain-application content): it couples cross-layer KV sharing with pipeline-parallel partitioning, framing KV layout as a stage-balancing control knob with a simple FLOPs Imbalance Ratio (FIR). The core idea is a genuine but incremental combination of known techniques (MLKV/HShare-style KV reuse, 1F1B/Seq1F1B scheduling), with a useful new observation that MFU is non-monotonic in the shared-KV budget due to over-correction. Evaluation is reasonably broad: 8x Ascend 910B at PP=2/4/8 (Table 3), 8x V100 across four dense LLMs (Table 4), ablations over placement, stopping tolerance, and FIR-vs-timing guidance (Table 9), composability with Seq1F1B (Table 10), external comparison to vPipe/DawnPiper (Table 11), and GQA inference validation (Table 13), plus PPL/downstream quality checks (Table 8). Limitations: quality preservation validated only on LLaMA2-7B, PP up to 8, dense models only, single-run results without variance, GPU Table 4 numbers appear rounded, inference case study run 'under identical execution assumptions' without a serving-stack description, and no code release. Relevance is solid for LLM/efficiency preferences but does not touch the highest-weight methodological topics (reasoning, agents, Japanese LLM/NLP, alignment).

primary_link.title: KV-Pipe: On the Relation Between KV Sharing and Pipeline Parallel Efficiency in LLMs

papers.summary: Pipeline parallelism (PP) is widely used to scale large language model (LLM) training, but its efficiency is often limited by stage imbalance and pipeline bubbles. Meanwhile, cross-layer KV sharing has primarily been studied as a mechanism for reducing KV-cache costs during inference, without examining how KV reuse reshapes pipeline workloads. We present \textbf{KV-Pipe}, a stage-aware KV-sharing mechanism that turns KV reuse into a pipeline-balancing control knob. KV-Pipe starts from the tail s
papers.summary_zh: 管線平行（PP）訓練常受階段不均衡與氣泡拖累，而跨層 KV 共享過去只被視為推論端節省 KV 快取的手段。KV-Pipe 將 KV 重用提升為管線層級的控制旋鈕：從尾段開始，以尾段優先順序把選定的注意力層轉為跨層 KV 共享，並迭代重新定位當前瓶頸，以自提的 FLOPs 不均衡比（FIR）趨近 1 為目標。整個流程離線執行，只需管線切分與每層 FLOPs 估計，開銷可忽略。在 8×Ascend 910B 上，KV-Pipe 於 PP=2/4/8 分別帶來 3.1%、4.3%、9.2% 的 MFU 提升與 4.9%–9.8% 的迭代時間縮減，增益隨管線深度擴大；V100 實驗與和 Seq1F1B 的可組合性實驗證實趨勢可外推。研究也揭示共享 KV 量與 MFU 呈非單調關係：過度共享會矯枉過正、把瓶頸移到較早階段。推論端同一機制降低 KV 快取成長與重複投影，使長上下文解碼吞吐提升，且在 GQA 模型上仍有效。品質面以 LLaMA2-7B 的困惑度與下游任務驗證，所选層皆位於網路後半。限制包括品質驗證僅涵蓋 LLaMA2-7B、PP 上限為 8，貪婪式配置不保證全域最佳。
papers.title: KV-Pipe: On the Relation Between KV Sharing and Pipeline Parallel Efficiency in LLMs
papers.title_zh: KV-Pipe：KV 共享與 LLM 管線平行效率的關聯

links.title: RLCascadeRouter: Quality-Estimator-Free Cascade Routing via Reinforcement Learning

evidence: Abstract/Section 1: proposes quality-estimator-free cascade routing formulated as an MDP with stop and model-selection actions, evaluated on ten LLMRouterBench benchmarks with thirteen LLMs
Section 3.1 Proposition 1: two-action construction showing lower squared prediction loss (4δ²) can reverse ordering while higher loss (2K²) preserves the optimal decision

Table 1 (Section 5.1): RLCascadeRouter macro-average 68.81 at cost 180.22, above Avengers-Pro 67.84/135.65 and GPT-5 65.12/124.81, but cost is higher than all baselines; HybridLLM/FrugalGPT/GraphRouter/Avengers-Pro rows duplicate GPT-5 scores on most benchmarks (e.g., AIME 83.33, LMB 78.38, GPQA 88.33), indicating possibly degenerate baselines
Section 5.2: Pareto points 59.11% @ cost 10.64 vs Avengers-Pro 59.10% @ 16.12 (34.0% cost reduction) and 67.29% @ 85.41 vs 67.22% @ 107.88 (20.8% reduction)
Table 2/Section 5.3: Setting B on replacement pool retains 53.97% (90.99% of initial-pool 59.32%) without retraining, with replacement models invoked on 98.18% of queries

Table 3/Section 5.4: ablations Full 68.81/180.22 vs w/o CE 68.30/152.60 and w/o VAS 67.43/191.56 at α=1.0; authors note w/o VAS is 0.60 better at α=0.2 and QE Stop reduces performance by 1.11 at α=1.0

Section 4 Implementation Details: PPO 100 iterations, 2048 episodes/iteration, 6-layer Transformer encoder (hidden 256, 8 heads), AdamW lr 3e-5, seed 42, single NVIDIA RTX 50-series 16GB GPU; no code or data availability statement appears
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-methodology paper on quality-estimator-free cascade routing via an MDP policy trained with PPO, directly matching LLM/inference-efficiency/reinforcement-learning preferences. Novelty is moderate: it extends Dekoninck et al.'s cascade routing (removing quality estimators) and RL routers like TREACLE/Router-R1, with a simple but clear Prediction-Decision Mismatch argument. Rigor concerns: in Table 1 several routing baselines (HybridLLM, FrugalGPT, GraphRouter, Avengers-Pro) report scores essentially identical to GPT-5, suggesting degenerate baseline routing or transcription issues; no variance or significance testing; headline α=1.0 result costs 180.22 vs GPT-5's 124.81, deferring the efficiency claim to the Pareto sweep. Evidence is concrete (Table 2 unseen-model retention of 90.99%, Table 3 ablations, specific Pareto points) but single-seed. No code/data release is stated, though hyperparameters, seeds, and model descriptions are documented.

primary_link.title: RLCascadeRouter: Quality-Estimator-Free Cascade Routing via Reinforcement Learning

papers.summary: The growing ecosystem of large language models (LLMs) offers huge potential to optimize performance-cost trade-offs. However, their heterogeneous capabilities and inference costs make efficiently routing queries a significant challenge. Existing paradigms are inflexible: one-shot routers commit before observing responses, whereas conventional cascades stop adaptively but follow a fixed model order. Cascade routing removes both restrictions by reconsidering whether to stop or invoke another model
papers.summary_zh: LLM 生態系中模型能力與成本異質，一次性路由在看到回應前就承諾選擇，固定順序的級聯又無法按查詢跳過或重排。級聯路由允許每步在停止與再呼叫之間重新決策，但既有方法先預測回應品質再最佳化，存在預測—決策不一致：小的跨門檻誤差即可翻轉停止或選模決策。RLCascadeRouter 免用品質估計器，將級聯路由建成馬可夫決策過程，動作空間含「停止」與所有未選模型，直接以軌跡報酬最佳化效能—成本目標。其級聯策略網路由兩模組組成：互補性編碼器以自我注意力建模剩餘模型間的互補與競合，價值感知停止器比較當前狀態與剩餘動作的價值。在 LLMRouterBench 十項基準、十三個 LLM 上，宏平均 68.81% 優於最強基準 Avengers-Pro 0.97 點、最佳單模型 GPT-5 3.69 點；Pareto 前緣顯示近 59% 效能時成本省 34%，近 67% 時省 20.8%。以文字描述即可納入未見模型且免重訓，保留 90.99% 效能。消融實驗驗證兩模組皆屬必要。限制為高效能端成本仍偏高，未來需擴及動態模型池與線上環境。
papers.title: RLCascadeRouter: Quality-Estimator-Free Cascade Routing via Reinforcement Learning
papers.title_zh: RLCascadeRouter：免品質估計器的強化學習級聯路由

links.title: HyMem: Hierarchical Context Management for Long-Horizon Agents via Information Isolation

evidence: Abstract: 'Experiments on GAIA and Browsecomp-plus show that, with DeepSeek-V4, HyMem achieves average Pass@1 scores of 66.7% and 61.3%, outperforming the strongest baseline by 6.1 and 4.7 percentage points' — matches Table 1 (ReSum 60.6 GAIA, ReAct 56.6 Browsecomp-plus).

Section 4.1: 'However, on Browsecomp-plus, Qwen3-32B with HyMem does not outperform the ReAct baseline... We therefore treat cross-backbone robustness as promising but not uniform' — honest negative result.

Section 4.3 / Table 2: 'Removing isolated reasoning causes the large performance drop, reducing Pass@1 by 5.0 percentage points on Browsecomp-plus and 18.6 percentage points on GAIA'; removing memory management drops 9.0 and 18.6 pp — but Table 2 Full values (0.6300, 0.3200) do not match Table 1 averages (61.3, 33.0), an unexplained inconsistency.

Section 4 (Benchmark): 'we randomly sampled 150 questions with a balanced difficulty distribution from Browsecomp-plus' and 'the evaluation is restricted to text-based queries' — small, filtered evaluation sets.
Appendix A.1: 'All experimental results are reported as the mean value derived from at least three independent trials' — but no variance or significance tests are reported.

Section 3.1/Figure 1: context dilution 'empirically measures this phenomenon by tracking task-critical information across reasoning steps' — no definition of how task-critical information is quantified.

Appendix C, Tables 4-7: complete prompt templates for Planner, Executor, Isolated Reasoning, and Memory Management modules provided; Appendix A.2 gives hyperparameters (planner_turns=12, execute_turns=10, etc.) — no code or artifact availability claim anywhere in the paper.
Appendix B: case study content 'has been selectively curated and condensed' — weakens evidentiary value of the qualitative trace.
Section 5 Conclusion/Limitations: 'Its effectiveness depends on the model's ability to follow typed control instructions... gains are not uniform across all backbone and benchmark combinations.'
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strong preference match: a training-free LLM agent framework targeting long-horizon context management, directly hitting Agents & Tool Use, Long Context & Memory, and LLM/Reasoning preferences. Methodologically, hierarchical 'typed context isolation' (planner/executor/isolated-reasoning/memory) is a sensible but incremental synthesis of known ideas (ReSum, THREAD recursive spawning, context folding, A-MEM), so novelty is moderate. Evaluation is reasonably careful: two public benchmarks, two backbones, five baselines, ablations of both components, resource/consumption analysis, and honest reporting that Qwen3-32B+HyMem fails to beat ReAct on Browsecomp-plus (Sec 4.1). Weaknesses: only 150 sampled Browsecomp-plus tasks and text-only GAIA, no significance testing, unexplained numeric inconsistency between Table 2 (HyMem Full Pass@1 0.6300 on Browsecomp-plus) and Table 1 (61.3), and the 'context dilution' metric in Figure 1 is asserted as empirical but never defined. Evidence is supported by tables but diluted by the curated/condensed case study (Appendix B) and undefined metrics. Generalizability is limited by dependence on strong instruction-following backbones (acknowledged in Conclusion/Limitations). Reproducibility is aided by full prompt templates (Appendix C) and hyperparameters (Appendix A.2), but no code release or availability claim is made.

primary_link.title: HyMem: Hierarchical Context Management for Long-Horizon Agents via Information Isolation

papers.summary: Large language model (LLM) agents often perform poorly on complex, long-horizon tasks because their context becomes increasingly cluttered over time. As interactions accumulate, detailed execution traces and intermediate outputs dominate the context, making it difficult for the model to retain and use high-level planning information. Most existing methods address this issue through compression or retrieval applied to a single, flat context, which does not clearly separate different types of cont
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型代理在長程任務中常因脈絡稀釋而表現不佳:隨著互動累積,詳盡的執行軌跡與中間輸出會淹沒稀疏的高階規劃訊號,而現有的壓縮或檢索方法多在單一扁平脈絡上運作,難以區分規劃訊號與執行雜訊。本文提出 HyMem,一個免訓練的推論時階層式脈絡管理框架,核心原則為型別化脈絡隔離:將規劃層、執行層、隔離推理模組與記憶管理模組置於各自獨立的脈絡空間,僅允許符合綱要的結構化訊息跨越邊界。規劃層負責任務分解與迭代規劃;執行層在隔離空間進行工具呼叫並蒸餾觀察結果;隔離推理模組處理多跳分析而不污染規劃脈絡;記憶管理模組將歷史壓縮為事件、工作與工具三種記憶,透過非對稱注入保留任務連續性。在 GAIA 與 Browsecomp-plus 上,搭配 DeepSeek-V4 達到平均 Pass@1 分別為 66.7% 與 61.3%,超越最強基線 6.1 與 4.7 個百分點,困難題組由 14.0% 升至 30.0%,且 token 消耗與工具呼叫次數與基線相當。消融實驗證實隔離推理與結構化記憶缺一不可。限制在於效益依賴骨幹模型遵循型別化指令的能力,Qwen3-32B 在 Browsecomp-plus 上便未勝過 ReAct。此研究將脈絡管理從事後壓縮轉為源頭隔離,對長程代理設計具重要參考價值。
papers.title: HyMem: Hierarchical Context Management for Long-Horizon Agents via Information Isolation
papers.title_zh: HyMem:透過資訊隔離為長程代理進行階層式脈絡管理

links.title: HxAgent: Iterative Agent Planning for End-to-End Web Application Testing

evidence: Abstract: reports 97.4% Exact-Match on MiniWoB++, 83.8%/91.8% Exact/Prefix-Match on a 350-task real-world dataset, and 77.3% test-script success on OnlineMind2Web.
Section 5.4, Table 6: ablations show w/o (SAM + experience) drops Exact-Match to 47%, w/o iterative planning to 75%, w/o experience to 88% vs. 97% full system.

Section 4 (Baselines): only Li et al., SeeAct, and WALT compared on all datasets because they emit executable replayable action sequences; demonstration-dependent baselines (WebNT5, HTML-T5, WebGUM, CC-Net, Synapse, etc.) restricted to MiniWoB++ (Table 8/Table 9).
Section 5.5 / Appendix F.5: average 80k input and 22k output tokens per task; HxAgent uses about one-third of WALT's total tokens and 8.9% of its output tokens.

Inconsistencies: Abstract claims 4.6% improvement over WALT on OnlineMind2Web but Table 2 shows 50.7% vs 37.5% Exact-Match (13.2 points) and WALT leads Prefix-Match (69.0 vs 62.4); Section 5.1 text states '97% vs. 94%' vs Li et al. while Table 3 reports Li at 91.7%.
Limitations section: evaluation is web-specific over DOM/Selenium with no empirical mobile/desktop transfer; temperature set to zero to mitigate LLM output nondeterminism.
Data Availability and Appendix D: code/data at anonymous.4open.science/r/hxagent; main prompt, memory section, and experience prompt templates shown in Figures 6-8.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly on-topic LLM-agent paper: iterative ReAct-style planning with short-term state-action memory and long-term rule-based experience for executable web test-script generation, matching high-weight preferences (Agents & Tool Use, LLMs, Reasoning, Code/Software Engineering, Multimodal). Novelty is incremental: ReAct, Reflexion, and trajectory-memory ideas are recombined; the main new angles are per-step proactive state evaluation and replayable (non-coordinate) action sequences for regression testing. Rigor and evidence are solid in structure (three datasets, component ablations, token/cost analysis, threats-to-validity discussion) but weakened by abstract/intro claims that do not match tabulated numbers (e.g., claimed 4.6% OnlineMind2Web gain over WALT vs. 13.2 points in Table 2, where WALT actually leads on Prefix-Match 69.0 vs 62.4; text cites Li et al. at 94% while Table 3 reports 91.7%), a single backbone LLM (GPT-4o), unclear separation between experience-training instances and evaluation instances on MiniWoB++, and only three primary baselines on the main datasets. Generalizability is limited to web/DOM with no empirical cross-platform validation despite architectural claims. Reproducibility is aided by an anonymous code link, public benchmarks, and published prompts in Appendix D.

primary_link.title: HxAgent: Iterative Agent Planning for End-to-End Web Application Testing

papers.summary: In automated web testing, generating test cases and performing testing using functionality descriptions in natural-language is crucial for improving efficacy. These tasks require such a testing agent to carry out tasks on the target application and generating tests autonomously. We introduce HxAgent, an iterative LLM-based planning agent with a proactive correction strategy. After each step, HxAgent reassesses the web state to determine the next action using (1) current observations, (2) short-t
papers.summary_zh: 在網路應用程式測試中,依自然語言描述自動產生可執行、可重放的動作序列(測試腳本)至關重要,但現有 UI 代理多有不足:或專注於完成任務而非產生可執行序列,或以絕對螢幕座標表示動作而在介面變動時失效,或依賴大量人工示範,或採事後反應式的自我反思而陷入盲目試錯。本文提出 HxAgent,一個以 LLM 為基礎的迭代式規劃代理,核心是「主動式修正」:每執行一步即重新評估網頁狀態,綜合四項輸入決定下一步動作——當前頁面文字與截圖、可互動元素、短期記憶(過去狀態—動作對的序列動作記憶),以及長期經驗(從過去成敗軌跡萃取的行為規則);當文字觀察不足以區分候選動作時,再運用視覺能力以截圖消歧。以 GPT-4o 實驗:HxAgent 在 MiniWoB++ 達 97.4% 完全匹配率,無需人工示範即媲美最佳基線,超越 WALT 10.5%;在 350 個真實網站任務上達 83.8%,超越 WALT 13.4%;OnlineMind2Web 上再提升 4.6%;測試腳本生成成功率介於 77.3% 至 100%,token 消耗僅約 WALT 三分之一。消融實驗顯示短期記憶貢獻最大。限制包括對日期選擇器與高度動態網站仍易失敗,且實證驗證僅限網頁環境,然架構上具平台無關性。此工作串連測試生成與自主代理,對軟體測試自動化具實務價值。
papers.title: HxAgent: Iterative Agent Planning for End-to-End Web Application Testing
papers.title_zh: HxAgent:以迭代式代理規劃實現端對端網路應用測試

links.title: PL-Guard: Probabilistic Logic Reasoning for LLM Guardrails

evidence: Abstract: PL-Guard reduces unsafe compliance from 22.0% (base) to 0.5% and below the 6.0% of an LLM-as-a-judge baseline on XSTest, at higher over-refusal (14.4% vs 5.2%)
Section 2.2: predicates grounded via renormalized True/False token probabilities (Eq. 3), then ProbLog performs rule inference with safety-prioritized action selection at threshold 0.5
Section 3: all methods use the same Phi-3 14B backend with temperature 0.0; Qwen/Qwen3.5-35B-A3B is an offline semantic evaluator, explicitly 'treated as semantic estimates rather than ground truth'
Section 4.1 Table 2: granularity ablation shows over-refusal 16.4%→14.4% and unsafe compliance 2.0%→0.5% from minimal to detailed policy, with plateau at very detailed (24 predicates)
Section 4.2 Table 3: failure trace on privacy prompt shows grounding probabilities (harmful request 0.060, harmful response 0.107) causing unsafe compliance, localized to the grounding layer
Section 5 Limitations: restricted to XSTest, one generator family, one evaluator; True/False scores 'are not calibrated'; repair step not evaluated separately from diagnosis
Appendices C and D: full prompt templates and complete ProbLog programs/predicate inventories for minimal, moderate, detailed, and very detailed policies are provided
llm_evaluation.rationale: A clearly in-scope LLM-safety paper (guardrails, LLM-as-a-judge, safety evaluation, interpretability) that proposes a neurosymbolic architecture separating neural predicate grounding (renormalized True/False token probabilities) from ProbLog policy inference. The decomposition idea is sensible and moderately novel, though it builds directly on ProbLog shields from safe RL and existing neurosymbolic-LLM work. Rigor is limited: a single benchmark (XSTest, 450 prompts), a single generator family (Phi-3), and one LLM-based offline evaluator whose reliability is not validated against human labels; no significance testing, and the regex evaluator disagrees sharply with the LLM evaluator (e.g., LLM-as-a-judge unsafe compliance 38.5% vs 6.0%), indicating label noise. The granularity ablation is a genuine strength, and the paper is honest about tradeoffs (PL-Guard does not dominate baselines) and about uncalibrated grounding scores causing a documented failure case. Generalizability is constrained by the single-benchmark, single-model design. Reproducibility is decent: all four policy variants, predicate inventories, ProbLog programs, and prompt templates are included in appendices, and decoding/hardware details are given, but no code or data release is claimed.

primary_link.title: PL-Guard: Probabilistic Logic Reasoning for LLM Guardrails

papers.summary: Large language model guardrails can be viewed as policy-consistency problems: a system must determine which policy-relevant facts hold in a prompt-response pair and what those facts imply under a given policy. Common approaches, including policy prompting and LLM-as-a-judge pipelines, often overlap the tasks of semantic grounding and policy reasoning: the model both interprets the prompt-response pair and reasons about whether a policy has been violated. This can lead to unsafe compliance with h
papers.summary_zh: LLM 防護欄本質上是政策一致性檢查:系統須判定提示與回應中哪些政策相關事實成立,並據此推論是否符合政策。常見做法如政策提示或 LLM-as-a-judge 管線,將語意 grounding 與政策推理混於同一模型,易導致對有害請求的不安全順從,或對良性請求的過度拒絕。本文提出 PL-Guard,一個神經符號混合架構:離線階段以生成模型將自然語言政策轉換為 ProbLog 述詞與規則;前向階段中,基礎 LLM 先產生初始回應,本地 LLM 依重新正規化的 True/False token 機率為各政策述詞賦予機率值,ProbLog 求解器再進行顯式的機率規則推論,並以安全優先的規則層級門檻產生行動建議(拒絕或改寫、有幫助回答、保留原回應),最後引導最終回應生成。在 XSTest 上以 Phi-3 為骨幹、Qwen 為外部語意評估者:PL-Guard 將不安全順從從基線的 22.0% 降至 0.5%,低於 LLM-as-a-judge 的 6.0%,代價是過度拒絕較高(14.4% 對 5.2%);執行時間與 LLM-as-a-judge 相當。政策粒度消融顯示適度細化可同時改善兩項指標,過度細化則收益遞減;案例分析展示如何依可稽核的推理軌跡將錯誤定位至 grounding 或政策覆蓋面。限制包括僅驗證單一基準與模型家族、token 機率未校準、政策須人工設計,且修訂步驟未必遵循建議。其價值在於將安全—有用性權衡透明化,使防護決策可審計、可編輯。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-agent methodology paper squarely matching top-weighted agent/tool-use preferences (ReAct-style tool calling, agent framework, workflow orchestration) plus graph-RAG and text-to-SQL. Rigor is above average: a controlled three-way comparison (GRA vs graph-free RSA vs full-context SQA) sharing the same execution loop and prompts, answer-first question generation with SQL executed before question writing, deterministic scoring instead of an LLM judge (Section 4), a seven-configuration model grid with paired-bootstrap CIs (Section 5, Table 3), a tool-call budget ablation (Section 6.4), and a reliability analysis (Table 4). Novelty is modest: mapping code-agent primitives (ls/cat/grep) onto knowledge graphs is an incremental transfer of SWE-agent/ReAct ideas, acknowledged via the related work. Evidence supports the headline 5.1pp gain (88.4 vs 83.3, DeepSeek V4-Pro-Think, Table 3) and the token savings (29-33% of SQA unique input, Section 6.3), but the honest finding that the graph itself contributes little (+0.3 to +1.9pp over RSA, Section 7) undercuts the title's central claim, and SQA wins on Qwen3-Coder-Flash and GPT-5 Nano. Generalizability is limited: one synthetic, self-built industrial benchmark; the regime where navigation should matter most (corpus exceeding the context window) is explicitly untested (Section 7). No code, harness, or benchmark release is stated anywhere, limiting reproducibility despite detailed procedure descriptions. Score reflects strong preference fit and careful experimental hygiene against narrow scope and a weakly-supported headline framing.

papers.summary: Tool-calling LLM agents navigate unfamiliar codebases with a handful of generic primitives for listing, reading and searching files (ls, cat, grep). A knowledge graph admits the same interface: listing neighbours, reading node content and searching descriptions are the same operations on a different substrate. Building on this correspondence, we present GRA, a Graph Reasoning Agent that explores hybrid knowledge graphs, whose nodes are either textual concepts or relational tables, with seven gen
papers.summary_zh: 工具呼叫型 LLM 代理能以少數通用原語(如 ls、cat、grep)在陌生程式碼庫中導航。本文將此對應推廣至混合知識圖譜——其節點可為文字概念或關聯式資料表——提出 GRA,一個綱要無關的圖形推理代理,僅憑七個通用工具(ls、cat、grep、sems 語意搜尋、唯讀 SQL query、think、answer)於執行時期探索圖譜,不預載任何領域特定資訊。研究在自建的 UFK-M 產業基準上評估:虛構自行車組裝工廠的混合圖譜,其 xlarge 層級含 258 道分析題,標準答案來自實際執行並驗證的 SQL 程式,並以確定性匹配器計分。比較三種系統:GRA(圖形導航)、RSA(移除圖形、僅平面檢索的同構代理)與 SQA(將全文與完整綱要約 17k token 序列化至提示的全上下文代理)。結果顯示:搭配 DeepSeek V4-Pro-Think,GRA 達 88.4%,勝過 SQA 的 83.3%(提升 5.1 個百分點),且僅讀取其約三成的唯一輸入 token;但 GRA 相對 RSA 僅高出 0.3 至 1.9 個百分點,顯示增益主要來自選擇性代理式存取而非圖形拓撲本身。工具呼叫可靠度是關鍵瓶頸:GPT-5 Nano 有 10.2% 呼叫失敗,此時全上下文的 SQA 反而較佳;約 30 次工具呼叫的預算即可涵蓋幾乎所有增益。限制在於語料尚小、全上下文仍可容納於提示,且圖形結構貢獻尚不明確。此工作說明「看得少反而答得好」,對大型結構化知識源的代理式存取設計深具啟發,並展示結合作業研究求解的部署迴圈。

Section 5: preregistered patches on three models — injected A flips '3.1–4.0% of greedy tokens, 40–45% of the context reference' while 'matched-norm noise reproduces 58–74% of that flip rate'; B-side premium over random is 5.6–80x.

Section 7 'Limits of the evidence': 'The seven open-weight checkpoints form an opportunistic, family-correlated sample rather than a factorial architecture sweep' and behaviors are 'next-token quantities, not task-level generation quality'.
Section 7: merged-expert Beyonder-4x7B-v3 breaks the range in the unexpected direction (r_A/blk 0.014/0.011), reported as 'A boundary that fails in the informative direction'.
Appendix D: Moonlight-16B-A3B preregistered intervention excluded after a stop gate fired when exposure 'turned over at full removal on both domains'.

Reproducibility statement: 'Code and captures underlying the reported figures and tables are available at https://github.com/CedricCaruzzo/routing-divergence-moe' with fixed seeds and frozen captures.
Appendix C: tokenwise-ratio aggregation inflates exposure by 20–38% relative to the preregistered per-layer-first reduction; a held-out MBPP screen is reported but not used to define the range.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope analysis paper on MoE routing in open-weight LLMs: an exact A/B decomposition separates routing-mismatch (A) from content-shift (B) terms, and residual 'exposure' is proposed as the downstream quantity, with the corrective finding that router divergence alone does not indicate behavioral influence. Preference relevance is moderate-to-good: strong match to MoE/Transformer architecture and interpretability, moderate LLM match (Mixtral, Qwen3, DeepSeek-V2, OLMoE are the studied checkpoints), with GSM8K/PubMedQA serving as probes rather than the paper being a reasoning-methods contribution; no match to the highest-weight Japanese-LLM/agents clusters. Novelty is solid but bounded: the decomposition is an acknowledged algebraic identity (Section 2), with value in the measurement program and causal patches. Rigor is a strength: reconstruction gate (<0.02, Appendix C, with a quantized checkpoint excluded at error 1.06), prompt-level bootstrap CIs (Appendix B), preregistered patches, matched-norm and frozen-numerator controls, dose-response tables (Appendix D), an honestly reported failed prediction on the merged-expert checkpoint, and a preregistered stopped extension (Moonlight). Evidence is strong for the narrow single-step, same-weight claims but behavioral measures are next-token flip rates on only three checkpoints, and the checkpoint sample is admittedly 'opportunistic, family-correlated' (Section 7). Generalizability is deliberately delimited: no coverage of weight-induced mismatch, RL trajectories, or accumulated drift, and the observed block-level range is explicitly not universal (Qwen3-235B breaks it upward, Beyonder breaks it downward). Reproducibility is supported by a stated code/captures release, fixed seeds, and preregistered protocols, though the repository contents cannot be verified from the text.

We study this mismatch in its single-step form, with frozen weights rather than as a proxy for a full training trajectory. papers.summary_zh: 混合專家模型中，兩次前向傳遞可共用所有權重，卻把同一個 token 路由到不同專家，這使同權重自我蒸餾存在潛在盲點：由示範條件化的教師監督僅查詢的學生。論文提出精確的分塊分解，將路由項（內容固定、閘門改變）與類稠密的內容項（閘門固定、內容改變）分開，並以殘差流暴露度作為下游關注量。在七個開放權重檢查點與兩個領域上，路由項佔區塊輸出的比例僅變動 1.6 倍，其暴露度卻變動 3.2 倍，且暴露度由被路由區塊佔殘差流的比例排序。在兩個確認模型上縮放常開骨幹會單調推高暴露度；共同模式控制支持質量與一致性機制，而非單純的分母稀釋。預註冊的 PubMedQA 因果補丁顯示，注入完整路由項對輸出的改變不到自然上下文效應的一半，且大半可由匹配範數的雜訊重現；內容項則具強烈方向特異性。尺度與合併專家探針顯示區塊層級的窄範圍並非普適。結論：路由器移動本身不是行為影響的證據；應先測量暴露度，當決策要緊時再執行行為介入。

Fig. 2 caption: 'Both panels are model predictions under the stated parameters, not measurements'

llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly on-topic: a systematization of LLM-driven agentic security pipelines covering tool orchestration, prompt injection, red-team verdict cascades, context saturation, and budget enforcement — squarely aligned with the Agents & Tool Use, AI Safety, Red Teaming & Evaluation, and LLM preferences, and not an excluded pure-domain paper since the design laws target any agentic LLM pipeline. The closed-form results (retention fidelity Eq. 2, cascade likelihood-ratio multiplication Eq. 5, unscoreable-collapse bias Eq. 6, knapsack routing Eq. 7-8, cap β*=αv/c Eq. 9) are mathematically sound but are standard tools (Bayes, renewal theory, bin packing, Pareto tails) applied to a new setting, limiting novelty. The critical weakness is evidence: the paper concedes 'Every quantitative claim here is analytic' (Section X), all figures are 'model predictions, not measurements' (Fig. 2/4/5 captions), scorer operating points (η≈0.9, φ≈0.3) are asserted not measured, the IFI is 'an ordinal instrument scored by the authors' (Section X), and no precision/recall for the Inspectra platform is reported because 'no labelled ground truth exists'. Honesty is high (shipped/partial/planned labelling in Section IX-B, explicit limitations), which supports rigor, but no code, benchmarks, or datasets are released, capping reproducibility. Generalizability is above average because the artifacts-passing, mediator-enforcement, and cascade-independence lessons transfer beyond penetration testing.

We systematize these failures through a hands-on evaluation of ten widely used static, dynamic, cloud, orchestration, and AI red-teaming tools for unattended pipelines. We introduce a four-dimensional Integration Friction Index that separates one-time engineering c
papers.summary_zh: 代理式安全指以 LLM 代理規劃、派發並解讀安全工具，短短兩年已從展示走向產品，但新進人員總以相同順序重蹈相同失敗。本文從實作評估系統化此領域：作者整合十種靜態、動態、雲端、編排與 AI 紅隊工具，以四維整合摩擦指數分離一次性工程成本與重複的組織、法務及維護成本，並歸納反覆出現的失敗模式。將系統建模為由確定性中介層包覆的隨機 LLM 策略後，論文以封閉形式推導多項定量規律：長命會話以與階段數成反比的速率喪失常駐證據，拆成短命子代理可使可用視野延長恰好等於原始證據對摘要的壓縮比；兩階段判定級聯相乘兩評分器的概似比，是紅隊評分器雜訊唯一經濟的解方，但評分器錯誤相關時失效；把無法評分的結果記為「攻擊失敗」會偏差所有下游數字，且集中在最隱匿、最嚴重的回應上；規劃層與工作者層間的模型路由是背包問題；重尾工具的最佳執行上限為 β*=αv/c。作者論證範圍與預算執行不能委託給系統提示詞，因為提示不過濾實際執行的內容，LLM 因此在結構上被排除於可信運算基礎之外。自建平台 Inspectra 全程作為工作實例，每個機制皆標註已上線、部分完成或規劃中，包括未奏效之處。

Section 6.2 / Figure 2a: 'Of the 372 questions tied at k=3, 70 become negative, 122 remain tied, and 180 become positive at k=10', and Jaccard similarity of routing sets across budgets is 0.569.

Section 6.4: 'its observed yield remains within each random control's 95% range' — the authors concede the routing advantage over matched-random (yield 7.62 vs 5.09-5.30 per 100) is not statistically decisive.
Section 6.4 / Table 3: 'tied questions account for 65.9% of the policy's total improvement', showing the k=3 gain depends on the inclusive threshold admitting the tie block.
Section 6.3 / Table 2: ROC-AUC for temporal coverage is 0.532 [0.499, 0.566], 'close to chance', honestly reported as weak construct validity.
Table 4: CARVE +3.26 accuracy points on LVBench (CI [+1.23, +5.28]) but Random deferral achieves +2.18 [+0.95, +3.42], narrowing the marginal advantage.

Section 4 / Appendix A: Lemma 4 derives the exact finite-replay law, E[Delta-hat]=delta_d - delta_s and Var = (delta_d(1-delta_d)+delta_s(1-delta_s))/k, with the empirical tie excess (+0.062 at k=3, Table A2) showing the homogeneous model is only approximate.

Appendix G: code URL given, fixed configuration, replay seeds retained, vLLM 0.8.4 / PyTorch 2.6.0 / RTX 4090 documented; but Section 5 states 'Total GPU-hours could not be reconstructed reliably' and Limitations notes per-invocation token telemetry is missing.

Limitations: 'Broader conclusions require additional agents, rendering pipelines, intervention operators, and video benchmarks' — one VideoExplorer-style agent and one primary benchmark limit generalizability; Appendix D.2 transfer gains are positive but asymmetric (+2.17 vs +3.52 depending on direction).
llm_evaluation.rationale: A methodologically careful black-box audit for tool-using video agents: matched SHAM/DESTROY counterfactual replays with a finite-replay binomial theory (Lemma 4), three independent seeds, multiple baselines, and an unusually candid limitations section. It sits at the intersection of agents & tool use and evaluation methodology rather than core LLM/language methodology, so preference relevance is moderate; the video-QA domain is a lower-weight area but the agentic probe is clearly in scope (no out-of-scope cap applies). The aggregate intervention effect is strongly evidenced and reproducible, and the resolution-vs-routing-utility dissociation (deeper replays weaken the fixed threshold) is a genuinely novel and useful finding. However, the headline routing gain is partially an artifact of the inclusive threshold at k=3 (ties contribute 65.9% of net repairs), the advantage over matched random deferral is admitted to be non-decisive, construct validity is near chance (ROC-AUC 0.532), and generalization is limited to one agent scaffold and one primary benchmark with asymmetric two-backbone transfer.

primary_link.title: Counterfactual Sensitivity Is Not Repairability: Auditing Replay Probes for Video Evidence

papers.summary: Tool-using video agents retrieve visual evidence before answering, but the final answer is not forced to depend on what was retrieved. The natural black box test is counterfactual: destroy the semantic content of the frames the agent retrieved and check whether the answer changes, against a matched sham that re-executes the identical pipeline on those same frames. We introduce CARVE, a black-box counterfactual probe that compares answer changes under matched SHAM and DESTROY replays. Across thre
papers.summary_zh: 工具型影片代理回答前會擷取視覺證據，但最終答案未必真正依賴所擷取內容。本文提出 CARVE，一個黑箱反事實探針：對代理擷取的畫格施加傅立葉相位隨機化（DESTROY），並與在相同畫格上重跑同一管線、保留原始內容的對照組（SHAM）比較，以兩者答案改變率之差 Δ 衡量答案對證據的依賴，無需標註或評審模型。在凍結的 VideoExplorer 風格代理上進行三次獨立 k=3 重播，DESTROY 使答案改變率平均高出 29.3 個百分點，聚合效應大且可重現。但問題層級分數較不穩定：理論分析證明 Δ 估計量是兩個二項比例之差，其變異數、離散支撐與平手機率皆由重播預算 k 決定。將 k 從 3 增至 10 可解決多數低預算平手並穩定連續分數，卻反而削弱原本的零門檻路由政策，因為政策效用取決於可修復案例在決策邊界附近的分布，顯示更精確的測量未必造就更好的控制器。在 k=3 時，CARVE 從 1,258 個 LVBench 問題選出 538 個，準確率提升 3.26 點，淨修復產率高於多數匹配隨機子集。分數與標註時間覆蓋僅呈微弱關聯，故 CARVE 宜視為路由訊號而非直接的接地分類器。限制包括分數非正確性標籤、相位隨機化非完美介入、結果綁定特定門檻與代理、成本遙測不完整。
