Section 5.5: 128-token rollouts give max output relative errors 0.00303 (GDN), 0.00450 (KDA), 0.00376 (RWKV6) and state errors up to 4.61e-4, supporting only a 'tolerance-equivalent' rather than bit-exact claim.

Section 3.2, Eq. 7 plus 'Closure under the recurrence': the base-plus-log invariant is shown closed under append and merge, establishing algebraic equivalence to eager dense decoding in exact arithmetic.

Section 5.4, Figure 10: U-shaped merge-interval sweep at B=128 with best FLA-relative settings GDN M=8 (1.57x), KDA M=4 (1.34x), RWKV6 M=4 (1.60x), confirming the write-amortization vs replay trade-off.

Section 6 (Discussion and Limitations): gains are confined to large-batch, large-state decode regimes; serving evaluation covers only GDN and KDA paths under a graph-mode prototype, and no code availability statement appears anywhere in the paper.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A GPU systems paper on LLM decode efficiency for recurrent linear attention (GDN, KDA, RWKV6), matching LLM/Transformer-architecture/scaling-efficiency/inference-serving preferences but not the higher-weighted topical areas (agents, reasoning, Japanese LLM). Novelty is moderate: deferred write-back via a base-plus-bounded-log is a classic systems technique, applied here sensibly and, per the related-work discussion (Section 7), not previously applied to dense recurrent-state write-back in one-token decoding. Rigor is solid: a formal traffic model (Section 3.2, Eqs. 7-11), a closure proof of algebraic equivalence, DRAM-counter mechanism validation, merge-interval and state-size sweeps, split-replay ablation, and mixed-precision error analysis. Evidence strength is good at kernel level but end-to-end validation is narrow: H200 only, two models, 128 decode tokens, modest 1.05-1.20x serving gains, and no head-to-head against alternative approaches (e.g., the cited KVBuffer or FPGA persistent-state designs). Limitations are candidly stated. No code or artifact release is mentioned, limiting reproducibility despite detailed configuration tables.

primary_link.title: DeltaLog: Deferred Materialization of Recurrent States for Linear Attention Decoding

papers.summary: Linear attention models eliminate the quadratic prefix computation and context-growing KV cache of softmax attention by replacing pairwise token interactions with recurrent state updates. However, existing decoding implementations often materialize and write back the full recurrent state after every generated token, making state maintenance a major source of memory traffic, especially for models with large states and many heads. This paper presents DeltaLog, a recurrent-state decoding scheme tha
papers.summary_zh: 線性注意力模型以固定大小的遞迴狀態取代二次方前綴計算與持續成長的 KV cache，但現有解碼實作常在每生成一個 token 後就完整具現化並寫回遞迴狀態，使狀態維護成為記憶體流量主因，對大狀態、多頭模型尤甚。本文將此「狀態更新稅」歸因於具現化策略而非遞迴本身，提出 DeltaLog：把遞迴狀態表示為稠密基底狀態加上有界的近期緊湊更新日誌。多數解碼步驟僅附加緊湊更新因子，週期性合併步驟才把累積更新摺回稠密基底；模型觀察到的邏輯狀態與即時稠密具現化解碼完全一致，不改變模型語義與權重。作者為 GDN、KDA、RWKV6 實作 DeltaLog，沿值維度切分狀態以獲得值磚並行，共享鍵側中繼資料僅寫一次，並整合進以 vLLM 為基礎的服務原型。實驗顯示：單 token 解碼核心相較經最佳化的稠密基線 FLA，在 H200 與 RTX 4090 上加速 1.19–1.86 倍，剖析證實遞迴狀態寫入流量最高減少 7.83 倍，端到端服務在 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 與 Kimi-Linear-48B-A3B-Instruct 上獲得 1.05–1.20 倍加速。限制：端到端增益受 Amdahl 定律約束，服務評估僅涵蓋 GDN 與 KDA 路徑；小批次或小狀態的工作負載收益有限；混合精度引入需容忍的浮點誤差。
papers.title: DeltaLog: Deferred Materialization of Recurrent States for Linear Attention Decoding
papers.title_zh: DeltaLog：線性注意力解碼中遞迴狀態的延遲具現化

links.title: GraniKV: Asymmetric Granularity KV-Cache Paging for Multi-Agent Systems with Long Shared Prefix

evidence: Abstract: reports 2.16x/1.98x/1.57x output-token throughput over the production baseline at L_p=16K on Llama-3.1-8B/TP=1, Qwen-2.5-14B/TP=2, Qwen-2.5-32B/TP=4.
Sec 4.3: SGLang-Cascade is explicitly positioned as the ablation of the storage-layer contribution, since it is 'exactly GraniKV without the asymmetric-granularity storage layer'.
Sec 4.5 Table 3: GraniKV 2943 vs SGL 1362 tok/s (2.16x) at L_p=16K Llama-8B/TP=1; storage layer alone adds 1.05-1.15x over cascade at single-prefix saturation.

Appendix B.8b Table 21: under heterogeneous multi-prefix load GraniKV reaches 1.95x while SGLang-Cascade collapses to 0.99x, supporting the claim that the storage layer carries the win in this regime.

Limitations: admits up to 30% regression (0.70x SGLang default) at L_p=512/B=512 on Qwen-2.5-14B, a static HOT/COLD pool fraction, and a hardware-specific M_sat=1024 threshold that must be re-fitted on other GPUs.

Appendix B.11 Table 23: ncu counters show paged-side DRAM bytes match the byte model within 0.24% and tensor-core pipe activity is near-identical across layouts (24.7% vs 25.9%), isolating the layout effect; paged kernel has <=1.27x tuning headroom.
Sec 4.4: evaluation uses deterministic synthetic shared prefixes paired with 500 ShareGPT-V3 user turns under Poisson arrivals, not measured multi-agent production traces.
Appendix A: full source, kernel microbench, sweep drivers, raw per-cell results (results/, ncu_reports/), and REPRODUCE.md in an anonymized repository; public checkpoints and ShareGPT V3 used.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A solid LLM-serving systems paper: asymmetric KV-cache paging (contiguous HOT pool for shared prefixes, token-level COLD pool for suffixes) plus per-step dense/cascade backend dispatch inside SGLang, motivated by multi-agent workloads. Preference relevance is moderate-to-good: it directly hits Inference & Serving (KV cache, vLLM/SGLang), Scaling & Efficiency, and multi-agent serving, but it is infrastructure below the highest-weighted LLM/agent methodology preferences and contributes no LLM-capability method. Novelty is incremental systems novelty: the constituent kernels (Hydragen-style fat GEMM, FlashInfer Cascade, RadixAttention) are prior work; the contribution is their asymmetric-storage integration in a production engine. Rigor is strong: an appropriate storage-layer ablation (SGLang-Cascade, §4.3), full synthetic and ShareGPT sweeps (Tables 6-11), dispatch-trace and threshold-fit analyses (B.4/B.4b), Amdahl residual decomposition (B.9), and ncu roofline validation (B.11), with candid negative results (0.70x regression at L_p=512/B=512, Limitations; k=64 collapse, B.8). Evidence strength is high: internally consistent numbers (Table 3 matches Tables 9-11), mechanism-level hardware-counter support, though main tables give 3-rep means without variance and workloads are synthetic shared prefixes over ShareGPT turns rather than real agent traces (§4.4). Generalizability is limited by a hardware-specific dispatch threshold, single A100 host, dense 8B-32B models only, one engine, and a regime envelope where benefits vanish (B.7). Reproducibility is excellent: anonymized repo with patched fork, sweep drivers, raw results, and REPRODUCE.md (Appendix A).

primary_link.title: GraniKV: Asymmetric Granularity KV-Cache Paging for Multi-Agent Systems with Long Shared Prefix

papers.summary:
Production paged-serving engines apply uniform paging granularity to the KV cache, even though the two regions of a multi-agent workload have opposite storage requirements: a long shared prefix demands contiguity, while the per-request suffix demands fine-grained allocation.
  We present \textbf{GraniKV}, a KV-cache layer that allocates the shared prefix in a contiguous HOT pool and the suffix in a token-level COLD pool, combined with a per-step dispatcher which selects the appropriate backend a
papers.summary_zh: GraniKV 針對多代理 LLM 服務的 KV cache 管理問題：共享前綴需要連續儲存以利批次 GEMM 與單次讀取，而每個請求的後綴需要細粒度分配，但現有分頁式服務引擎（如 SGLang、vLLM）對兩者使用統一分頁粒度。作者提出非對稱粒度分頁層：將 KV 池分為連續的 HOT 池（存放共享前綴）與 token 級的 COLD 池（存放後綴），搭配每步派發器，依運算、記憶體或通訊瓶頸在稠密後端與 cascade 後端間動態選擇，並整合於 SGLang。實驗在 4×A100 上以 ShareGPT 搭配 Poisson 到達流量評估三種組態，於 L_p=16K 時分別達 2.16×、1.98×、1.57× 輸出吞吐量；異質多前綴情境下儲存層獨自撐起 1.95× 優勢，而批次全域 cascade 退化至持平。核心微基準顯示 HOT 連續佈局帶來 15.6× 核心加速，roofline 分析佐證瓶頸來自儲存佈局本身。限制包括：短前綴高批次角落最多 30% 回歸、HOT/COLD 比例為開機時靜態設定、飽和門檻 M_sat=1024 為 A100 專屬需在其他硬體重新擬合、未涵蓋 MoE 與更大模型。此研究證明儲存層設計是批次 GEMM 前綴注意力在生產引擎中可行的先決條件，對長系統提示詞的多代理部署具直接價值。
papers.title: GraniKV: Asymmetric Granularity KV-Cache Paging for Multi-Agent Systems with Long Shared Prefix
papers.title_zh: GraniKV：針對長共享前綴多代理系統的非對稱粒度 KV-Cache 分頁

links.title: Where Accountability Lives: Mapping Human Responsibility to Workflow Artifacts in Agentic Software Development

evidence: Section 1.5 (Contribution 1): 'The framework organising the reading is not claimed as novel; the correspondence it measures has not previously been measured' — novelty honestly scoped to the empirical two-layer reading.

Section 3.4: absence claims re-tested against a doubled page set; 'Six were testable; six survived' with exact binomial interval 0.54 to 1.00; a spurious refutation from the unanchored pattern 'approve protected-path' is reported and corrected.

Section 7 (Threats to Validity): 'A single coder, with no reliability estimate... This is the most serious limitation of the study' — all Table 2 cell assignments made once with no agreement statistic.

Section 4.2, Table 2: two-axis verification grid; Cursor documented as occupying the agent-performed/compelled cell via 'Maximum Risk Threshold sets the highest risk level the agent may approve' (CURSOR-DOC-08).

Data Availability: Zenodo deposit DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21965182 with 121 manifest items, byte-exact bodies, SHA-256 hashes, extraction records, absence record, and retrieval/extraction/consistency scripts; Section 3.2 states 'No language model sat in the retrieval path at any point'.

Section 8.1: 'We have not shown a dispute that turned on a missing artifact...' — the paper explicitly does not establish that the documented gap harms anyone, and Section 7 bounds cross-tool comparison by a residual 2.3-to-1 coverage spread (GitHub 21, Devin 14, Cursor 32, Claude Code 19 pages).
llm_evaluation.rationale: A document-analysis study of accountability in agentic software development, mapping platform controls against provider terms across four coding agents (Copilot cloud agent, Devin, Cursor, Claude Code) and eighteen policy documents. Topically it sits squarely in the Agents & Tool Use / Code & Programming preferences (coding agents, agent approval of PRs, human oversight), though it is a governance/policy empirical reading rather than a language-model methodology contribution. Novelty is moderate and honestly framed: the authors state the framework is not novel but claim the two-layer correspondence measurement is new, plus a modest conceptual contribution (the compelled-vs-performer verification grid) and a first attempt at quantifying absence-claim reliability. Rigor is above average for qualitative document work: an equalized page-selection rule, absence claims re-tested against a doubled page set with a correctly computed exact binomial interval (6/6, CI 0.54-1.00), and candid reporting of a corrected erroneous absence and a spurious lexical refutation. The single-coder design with no inter-rater reliability is disclosed as the most serious limitation. Evidence strength is high for the claims actually made: verbatim quotations with archive item identifiers throughout Appendix A, quantitative term-count tables, and disciplined refusal to over-claim (no harm or legal-obligation assertions). Generalizability is bounded: four tools, seven providers, one retrieval date, unequal documentation coverage (2.3:1 spread), and vendors restructuring docs mid-study. Reproducibility is excellent: a Zenodo archive with byte-exact bodies, SHA-256 hashes, extraction/absence/consistency scripts, and no model in the retrieval path.

primary_link.title: Where Accountability Lives: Mapping Human Responsibility to Workflow Artifacts in Agentic Software Development

papers.summary:
Coding agents author commits, open pull requests, and push code in production repositories. Who is accountable is settled in two places that do not refer to each other: the platform controls that gate what an agent may do, and the provider terms that allocate responsibility for what it produces.
  We read both against the workflow events that leave artifacts, across four agentic coding tools and eighteen governing policy documents from seven providers, recording at each event who holds authority
papers.summary_zh: 當編碼代理自行 commit、開 pull request 時，誰該負責？本文指出答案分別寫在互不引用的兩層：平台控制（分支保護、必要審核、工作流程閘門等）決定代理能做什麼，供應商條款決定後果歸屬。作者針對四款代理編碼工具（GitHub Copilot 雲端代理、Devin、Cursor、Claude Code）與七家供應商的十八份政策文件，建立 Accountability Event Map，將責任對應到九個工作流程事件，沿權威、執行、驗證、後果、紀錄五個維度編碼，並以雙倍頁面重測所有文件缺席主張（六項全數存活）。主要發現為三種重複模式：責任被主張卻無產出紀錄、執行與後果分離且中間無核准事件、強制機制預設關閉或可繞過。Cursor 的文件記載代理可在設定風險門檻下佔據核准事件，產出與人類審查無法區分的核准紀錄；各供應商署名方向相互矛盾；GitHub 企業條款的驗證詞彙密度為零，對照 Sourcegraph 同類文件的 10.82 次／千字。限制：僅分析文件而非實務、單一編碼者無信度估計、未證明缺口造成實害。本文的價值在於具體定位一個現象：十年前已量測的審核紀錄薄弱問題，已被代理工具從個人習慣轉為產品設計屬性。
papers.title: Where Accountability Lives: Mapping Human Responsibility to Workflow Artifacts in Agentic Software Development
papers.title_zh: 問責歸於何處：將人類責任對應至代理式軟體開發的工作流程產物

links.title: Token Distribution versus Data Volume: Domain Balancing in Multi-Domain Meeting Summarisation

evidence: Section 3.2: balanced, natural, and example-level allocation schemes are constructed at matched token budgets (2-32M) so that token distribution is isolated from data volume

Table 2 (Section 5.1): at 32M balanced leads minority domains on ROUGE-Lsum (AMI +0.102, ICSI +0.164, ELITR +0.163) while macro favours balanced (0.500 vs 0.421) and micro favours natural (0.637 vs 0.615)
Appendix E.1 / Table 25: 3-seed replication at 2M/8M/32M reproduces the per-domain crossover, with minority-domain gaps exceeding seed standard deviations (<0.07) at 8M and 32M
Table 5 (Section 5.5): the sign of the balanced-minus-natural gap agrees between Mistral-7B and Llama-3.2-3B on every dataset and both metrics
Appendix L / Table 18: judge validated on 741 facts; human-human kappa=0.79-0.84, judge kappa=0.57-0.76, and the judge over-accepts in 87-94% of disagreements, so absolute scores are upper bounds

Limitations section: 16,384-token window truncation confounds EuroParlMin training targets, all experiments are English-only, and findings are established only up to 7B parameters under low-rank adaptation
Appendix I / Table 16: complete QLoRA configuration (r=32, alpha=16, lr 1e-4, seeds 42/1/2/15) is reported, but the paper states no code or artifact release
llm_evaluation.rationale: This is an LLM fine-tuning data-mixture methodology study (QLoRA SFT of Mistral-7B/Llama-3.2-3B with controlled token-budget mixtures), not a pure domain application, so the 0.20 cap does not apply; it matches LLM, Training & Optimization, Data & Datasets, and NLP preferences but nothing on Japanese LLM, agents, reasoning, or RAG. Novelty is moderate: balanced-vs-proportional allocation is well studied at pretraining scale, and the closest SFT work (ADAPT) learns mixtures, so the fixed-mixture matched-budget probe is a clean but incremental contribution. Rigor is strong: a 2x2x5 grid with multi-seed replication (Appendix E.1), an example-level control (RQ4), a cross-family smaller-model control (RQ5), bootstrap CIs, and human validation of both the pruner (500 lines, kappa=0.67, Appendix B) and the LLM judge (741 facts, Table 18). Evidence is internally consistent across budgets, seeds, and model families, though the main grid is single-seed (seed 42) and the primary 'pruned' condition uses a pruner that both annotators agreed misfires on EuroParlMin (4% ratification, Appendix B). Generalizability is limited to English meeting summarisation at <=7B under LoRA, with transfer to other tasks explicitly left open (Limitations). Reproducibility is good on paper (full hyperparameters Table 16, verbatim prompts Appendix N, seeds, compute and cost reporting) but no code or artifact release is stated.

primary_link.title: Token Distribution versus Data Volume: Domain Balancing in Multi-Domain Meeting Summarisation

papers.summary: Jointly fine-tuning an LLM on meeting-summarisation corpora of widely varying size raises a question that prior work leaves confounded: when a domain-balanced training mixture helps, is the gain due to the distribution of tokens across domains, or merely to the volume of data seen? We disentangle these factors by constructing balanced and natural (native-proportional) token mixtures at matched token budgets (2-32M) over five English meeting corpora, fine-tuning Mistral-7B with QLoRA, and evaluat
papers.summary_zh: 將多個規模懸殊的會議摘要語料合併微調 LLM 時，資料量龐大的領域會壓過小語料。域平衡混合是否有效，過往研究混淆了兩個因素：token 在領域間的分布與資料總量。本文以控制實驗分離兩者：在五個英文會議語料（AMI、ICSI、ELITR、MeetingBank、EuroParlMin）上，於 2–32M token 等量預算下建構平衡與自然（比例）兩種混合，以 QLoRA 微調 Mistral-7B，並用 ROUGE、BERTScore 與經雙標註員驗證（741 個事實）的事實級 LLM 評審逐域評估。結果顯示平衡是重新分配品質而非整體提升：三個小語料域在 ROUGE-Lsum 上大幅領先（如 ICSI +0.164），多數域則付出代價；比例分配將小域份額固定於 1–2%，即使加大預算到 32M 也追不上平衡。另發現以 Gemma-3-27B-it 剪除對話填充句可從會話語料移除約 15% token（整體 6.8%）而品質不損；以例數而非 token 平衡會因轉錄長度差異造成意外加權；結論在 Llama-3.2-3B 上重現。限制包含 16K 上下文截斷使 EuroParlMin 訓練目標缺乏輸入支撐、LLM 評審傾向過度接受事實、僅驗證至 7B 與 LoRA、限英文語料。此研究為多域部署提供何時平衡、以何單位平衡的實務準則。

links.title: Dynamic Multi-Byte Prediction With Hierarchical Language Models

evidence: Abstract/Section 1: introduces multi-byte prediction for hierarchical byte LMs with variable-length segment-aligned prediction windows and an attention-masking scheme (LCA) enabling parallel byte prediction without violating causality; code promised at github.com/skai-research/lca-multibyte.
Section 4.1: five parameter-matched baselines (LlamaByte, SpaceByte, FlexiTokens, MLP-MBP, Eff-FxT); authors note parameter matching increases FLOPs of flat models.
Section 4.3: 373M-parameter model pretrained on 50B bytes of FineWeb-edu, batch size 1048576 bytes, trained on 4 NVIDIA B200 GPUs.

Section 5/Figure 3: LCA lies on the Pareto front in three of four tasks (IfEval, CoQA, CNN/DailyMail); on Spanish-English translation FxT/Eff-FxT achieve slightly higher COMET at much lower throughput.

Table 1: acceptance rates show MLP-MBP 61.91/63.45/58.08/62.67/65.01 vs LCA-MBP 45.95/46.62/48.89/51.68/49.74 across five tasks; authors attribute MLP's high acceptance but worse quality to conditional independence of heads.

Table 4 (Appendix B): under speculative decoding acceptance at n=3, LCA-MBP performance is below MLP-MBP on es-en (0.8147 vs 0.8178), fr-en (0.7977 vs 0.8064), and IfEval (44.97 vs 46.54), complicating the Section 6.2 claim that LCA overtakes MLP-MBP on all three tasks.
Section 6.3/Figure 8: LCA used as drafter with external FxT verifier matches FxT downstream performance while achieving 2.1-2.3x speedup with n=7, with acceptance rates in Table 5 (47.97-52.04%).
Limitations section: single model scale (373M) and training corpus, English-centric/English-paired evaluation only, task-dependent speculative horizon n under threshold acceptance.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope core LLM methodology paper: byte-level hierarchical language modeling with a transformer attention-mask innovation (Latent Causal Attention) for parallel multi-byte prediction and inference acceleration. Strong matches to LLM, Transformer Architecture, Inference & Serving, Scaling & Efficiency, and NLP preferences, though it touches none of the top-weighted reasoning/agents/Japanese topics. Novelty is moderate and incremental: it combines known MTP/speculative-decoding ideas with learned segment units from FlexiTokens, with concurrent related work (FastBLT, Grivas et al. probabilistic-circuit MBP) noted in Section 7. Rigor is solid: five parameter-matched baselines (Section 4.1), four downstream tasks, ablations over acceptance threshold tau (Section 6.1) and candidate count n with two acceptance schemes (Section 6.2), plus an external-verification experiment (Section 6.3). Weaknesses: single 373M scale on 50B bytes, headline Pareto results shown only as figures without tabulated values or variance/significance, and Table 4 shows LCA below MLP-MBP on es-en (0.8147 vs 0.8178) and fr-en (0.7977 vs 0.8064) under self-verification, tempering the Section 6.2 claim that LCA 'overtakes the MLP-MBP baseline on all three tasks'. Generalization to other hierarchical LMs (BLT, HNet) and larger scales is asserted but untested (Limitations). Detailed hyperparameters (Section 4.3, Appendix A, Table 2), public datasets, and promised code support reproducibility, though no seeds or released code are verified.

primary_link.title: Dynamic Multi-Byte Prediction With Hierarchical Language Models

papers.summary: Byte-level hierarchical language models (LMs) have recently emerged as a robust alternative to their popular counterparts that use subword tokenization. However, generating one byte at a time remains a bottleneck for inference speed. To address this, we introduce multi-byte prediction (MBP), which generates multiple bytes in parallel, speeding up inference with minimal performance impact and no additional parameters. MBP builds on the popular multi-token prediction (MTP) paradigm with two crucia
papers.summary_zh: 位元組階層式語言模型避開了子詞分詞的偏誤，但一次生成一個 byte 使推論緩慢；既有 multi-token prediction（MTP）方法為每個未來 token 增設預測頭，且固定偏移無法適應文本局部結構。本文提出 LCA（Latent Causal Attention）：利用 FlexiTokens 式階層模型學得的分段（latent token）作為多 byte 生成單元，以單一多 byte 頭搭配邊界感知因果遮罩，讓段內各 byte 平行預測、僅條件於前一個分段，兼顧因果性與平行性，且不新增參數。作者訓練 373M 參數模型（50B bytes FineWeb-edu、4×B200），於 IFEval、CoQA、CNN/DailyMail 摘要與西英翻譯等四項任務評估。LCA 在其中三項位於效能—吞吐 Pareto 前緣；以推測式解碼驗證時，候選數 n 從 3 增至 7 可得 +29–37% 吞吐而品質不變；作為 drafter 搭配 FxT 驗證器可在匹配 FxT 品質下加速 2.1–2.3×。消融顯示接受門檻 τ 與候選數 n 可逐任務調校；MLP-MBP 雖接受率高但預測常錯，證實條件獨立假設的缺陷。限制：僅單一模型規模與英文中心任務、門檻接受策略下 n 需逐任務調整。此方法證明階層模型已學得的潛在 token 可直接重用為平行生成單元，是位元組模型推論加速的低成本途徑。
papers.title: Dynamic Multi-Byte Prediction With Hierarchical Language Models

links.title: The Little Scientist: LLM Agent-Driven Discovery via the Scientific Method

evidence: Abstract: claims Delta V ranks first on ProteinGym DMS Substitutions Zero-Shot (+0.033 over VenusREM) and DALE beats STREME 0.842 vs 0.803 AUROC (Wilcoxon p<1e-6), 11x faster
§3.6/Table 1: full compute accounting, 229M tokens motif + 475M tokens ProteinGym (~$493 total) on a single 2-core VM with no GPUs
§5.5 'The data expansion transition': discontinuous jump 0.445→0.578 on Aug 4 was a human intervention adding pre-computed predictions from five SOTA models, after which the agent built an ensemble

Table 3 vs §3.6/§4.4: proto-DALE 0.843 exceeds DALE 0.842 on shuffled negatives; text reports best 0.846 (run #50), best 0.843 (run 52), and final algorithm (run #118) — internally inconsistent run reporting
§7.4 item 6: authors concede components were changed sequentially, not a controlled factorial design, and the contribution of each infrastructure component remains uncertain
§3.9.5/§4.6.5: statistical protocol specified (Wilcoxon signed-rank, bootstrap 95% CI seed=42, McNemar, Cliff's δ, Cohen's d) with per-test values reported
Code availability: Apache 2.0 repositories for DALE, Delta V, and framework with benchmark scripts, Jupyter notebook, and archived search history (history.l)
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core contribution is an LLM-agent methodology (Scientist/Kuhn agents, hypothesis-forced prompting, structured per-instance diagnostics) directly matching high-weight preferences for agents, LLMs, reasoning, and code generation; the bioinformatics domains are testbeds rather than pure domain application, so no out-of-scope cap applies. Novelty is moderate: hypothesis-driven search with causal diagnostics and a paradigm-shift agent is a genuine variation on FunSearch/AlphaEvolve/Karpathy-style loops but builds on a well-populated line. Rigor is mixed: careful statistics (Wilcoxon, bootstrap CIs, McNemar, effect sizes in §3.9.5/§4.6.5) and honest limitation discussion (§7.4 item 6 admits no controlled ablation), but sequential confounded infrastructure changes, no evolutionary baseline on the same task, and internal number inconsistencies (proto-DALE 0.843 vs DALE 0.842 in Table 3; best score reported as 0.846 at run #50 and 0.843 at run 52; final algorithm at run #118; differing Scientist run/acceptance counts between Table 7 and Figure 10) weaken it. Evidence strength is reduced because the headline ProteinGym result was enabled by human injection of pre-computed predictions from five SOTA models (§5.5 data expansion transition, 0.445→0.578 jump), making the 'beats the leaderboard' claim largely an ensemble-of-top-models gain, and sample-efficiency comparisons vs FunSearch are admitted to be indirect. Generalizability is limited to two benchmarkable bioinformatics tasks with cheap evaluation, as the authors themselves note. Reproducibility is good on paper: Apache 2.0 repos, benchmark scripts, notebook, history.l, token logs, seeds, and hardware specs, though the stochastic discovery process itself is not repeatable.

We approach automated algorithm design through the lens of the scientific method, where an LLM-based agent goes through each step of the process in an ordered, iterative fashion.

papers.summary_zh: 「小科學家」框架讓 LLM 代理像科學家一樣工作：先提出假說、寫下數值預測，再修改程式碼並在評測環境中驗證，最後與預測對照，逐步累積對基準的因果理解；評測環境提供逐實例的結構化診斷，而非只是單一分數。當代理陷入局部最佳時，Kuhn 代理會注入「典範轉移」猜想並搭配跨領域靈感，迫使搜尋轉向模型潛在空間的不同區域。論文以兩個領域展示成效：在蛋白質適應度預測，代理發展出 Delta V 集成校準策略，於 ProteinGym DMS Substitutions Zero-Shot 排行榜以 0.551 Spearman 在五項官方指標全數奪冠，領先第二名 VenusREM 達 0.033；在 DNA 基序發現，代理從零寫出 DALE 演算法，於 132 個 ENCODE 轉錄因子上平均 AUROC 0.842 優於 STREME 的 0.803（Wilcoxon p<10^-6），且快 11 倍。整個研究計畫僅在一台無 GPU 的虛擬機上耗用 7.04 億 tokens，總成本約 493 美元。相較 FunSearch、AlphaEvolve 等演化式搜尋，假說驅動搜尋樣本效率更高，但本質上是序列化流程。限制包括僅兩個案例、缺乏控制變因的消融實驗、依賴現成基準，且 ProteinGym 的關鍵躍升來自人類中途提供現成的模型預測。此研究顯示，以人類科學流程組織代理架構，可產出可稽核且具競爭力的新演算法。

links.title: Logos: Certified Order-Sensitive SQL Rewrites with Mechanized Semantics and LLM Guidance

evidence: Abstract: 'Logos solves 86.9% of them, compared with 64.0% for SQLSolver, the strongest baseline.'

Section 5.2 (RQ1): 'On the order-sensitive subset, it solves 76 (73.1%), whereas SQLSolver solves 43 (41.3%), QED 35 (33.7%), and Cosette 5 (4.8%).'; 'Logos solves 72 cases that no other evaluated verifier solves.'

Section 5.1 (Environment): 'Logos uses the gpt-5.6-sol proof agent at medium reasoning effort and permits at most three counterexample rounds.' — single closed-model configuration, no ablation on agent choice.

Section 5.3 (RQ2): 'Logos is substantially slower: its median is 3,632 seconds (60.5 minutes), and its 338 solved cases accumulate 396.3 hours'; '493.2 hours (87.6%) occur outside diagnostic Rocq invocations.'
Section 5.4 (Threats to Validity): 'the transpiler cannot guarantee semantic preservation across dialects' and 'Agent-guided proof search is also not fully deterministic.'

Section 3.3, Theorem 9 (Bag-to-list lifting): 'E1 ≡out E2 ⟺ Bags(O1) = Bags(O2) ∧ Errs(E1) = Errs(E2)' under bag-closure conditions, with proof provided; Theorem 10 gives a syntactic closure certificate.

Section 4 (Implementation): FormalSQL repo at https://github.com/WindOctober/FormalSQL, Logos at https://github.com/WindOctober/Logos, 'library contains over 2,000 verified lemmas'; every certificate 'checked in isolation by the Rocq kernel.'
Section 5.1 (Benchmarks): R-Bot TPC-H/DSB targets 'generate[d]... reproducibly by applying a single rewrite with a pinned version of R-Bot's Calcite rewrite engine' — author-curated pairs, disclosed.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A database/formal-methods paper whose LLM component is an off-the-shelf proof agent (gpt-5.6-sol) inside an agentic tool-use loop with kernel-checked Rocq certificates; this gives genuine, above-baseline relevance to agentic tool use and formal reasoning preferences, but the core contribution is mechanized SQL semantics, not LLM methodology, and there is no ablation isolating the LLM's contribution. Novelty is solid: closure-based bag-to-list lifting over all legal ordered lists (Theorem 9, Sec. 3.3) plus LLM-guided proof synthesis with certified countermodels is a credible new combination, though LLM theorem-proving agents (LeanDojo, Thor) and SQL verifiers (Cosette, SQLSolver, QED, VeriEQL) exist separately. Rigor and evidence are strong: 389 pairs across six benchmark families, three baselines with original implementations, 86.9% vs 64.0% overall and 73.1% vs 41.3% on the 104 order-sensitive pairs (Sec. 5.2), detailed runtime diagnostics (median 3,632 s; 87.6% of agent time outside Rocq compilation, Sec. 5.3), and an honest threats-to-validity section on SQLGlot dialect transpilation and agent nondeterminism (Sec. 5.4). Weaknesses: single LLM config with no model/effort ablation, author-curated R-Bot pairs, slow runtime (396.3 h total), and a closed-source black-box agent limit generalizability and reproducibility despite public FormalSQL/Logos repos and a 2,000+ lemma library (Sec. 4).

papers.summary_zh: 資料庫查詢改寫驗證必須處理重複資料列、可觀察的列順序與型別化值語意，但現有驗證器多停留在 bag 語意，對 ORDER BY、LIMIT 與視窗函式等順序敏感運算元只有語法導向的侷限支援，或僅能給出有界保證。論文在 Rocq 證明助理中機械化 FormalSQL 語意：對帶型別的 SQL 核心給出組合式邏輯語意，將每個查詢對映為「所有合法有序結果清單加上可觀察 SQL 錯誤」的集合，並證明關鍵的封閉性提升定理——在 bag 封閉的邊界上，可能 bag 的相等即可推出有序清單等價，讓 bag 層次推理能安全地局部重用。系統 Logos 以 LLM 代理引導證明搜尋：預測等價時，代理利用逾兩千條已驗證引理建構查詢專屬的 Rocq 證明；預測不等價時，須對完整結果關係建立反例模型，所有憑證皆由 Rocq 核心獨立檢核。在來自 Apache Calcite、TPC-H、TPC-DS 與 WeTune 的 389 組查詢對上，Logos 解出 86.9%，較最強基線 SQLSolver 的 64.0% 提升 22.9 個百分點；在順序敏感子集上為 73.1% 對 41.3%。代價是速度：解出案例的中位數耗時約 60.5 分鐘，代理時間近九成花在模型推理而非 Rocq 編譯，證明合成仍是瓶頸。在查詢最佳化器混用人工規則與 LLM 生成改寫的趨勢下，此首次將巢狀、平手敏感的 top-k 語意與認證式驗證結合的工作極具實務價值。

Recent efforts toward finer-grained supervision primarily rely on textual descriptions or localized visual regions as evidence proxies. However, such supervision signals may either overlook complex visual structures or provide incomplete and inaccurate rep
papers.summary_zh: 視覺文件檢索要在文件頁面影像中找出與查詢相關的頁面，但現有檢索器多採頁面級對比學習，只提供粗粒度的相關訊號；細粒度方法則以文字描述或局部視覺區域作證據代理，前者難以忠實表達圖表、版面等複雜視覺結構，後者又缺乏全域語境。ConceptFormer 提出潛在概念表示學習框架：訓練時由強大的視覺語言模型（Qwen3.6-Plus）定位查詢相關區域，並將其投影到檢索器的視覺 token 網格，動態分配潛在概念 token 數量——證據越分散複雜，概念容量越大。檢索器自身在查詢條件下生成連續潛在概念，以 KL 散度對齊概念誘導的排序分布與查詢誘導的排序分布（權重 λ=0.2），再與標準 InfoNCE 共同訓練；推論時完全不需生成潛在概念。在 InfoVQA、ChartQA、SlideVQA、TQA、OWID Charts 與 Wikimedia Maps 六個基準上，平均 NDCG@10 相較最強視覺檢索基線相對提升 16.7%，相較最強 OCR 文字檢索基線提升 22.1%，且在 Phi3V 與 Qwen2.5-VL 兩種骨幹上一致有效。消融實驗顯示潛在概念優於文字與視覺代理、自適應長度優於固定長度；概念長度中位數為 50 個 token 並呈長尾分布。此方法為多模態檢索提供了跳脫文字中介的細粒度對齊監督途徑。

links.title: FlashQuant: Sparse-Dense Fusion for Memory-Efficient Outlier-Aware LLM Inference

evidence: Abstract: claims '2.74x-4.18x speedup over cuBLAS BF16 and up to 1.53x speedup over the strongest unfused outlier-aware baseline' for fused W4A16 decoding.
Section 5.1 Setup: evaluation on RTX 3090/4090/5090 with '340 INT4+BF16 outlier-aware operator configurations' from LLaMA, Qwen, DeepSeek, OPT shapes and outlier ratios 1.0%-3.0%.

Section 5.1 Baselines: 'To the best of our knowledge, prior systems do not provide a fused operator for the mixed dense-sparse computation pattern', so baselines combine Marlin with Sputnik or cuSPARSE.
Section 5.4 Ablation Study: sparse-dense tiling alone gives 6%-16% speedup over Sputnik+Marlin, extra warps add 2%-4%, reordering adds 4%-9%; memory traffic reduced 'by up to 45.4%'.
Table 3 (Section 5.5): WikiText2 PPL for LLaMA3-8B drops from 6.896 (GPTQ) to 5.925-5.979 (SpQR thresholds 5%-20%) with modest memory increase.
Table 4 (Section 5.5): end-to-end vLLM decoding throughput 114.4 tokens/s (FlashQuant) vs 56.9 (BF16) at batch 8 on LLaMA3; Qwen2.5 OOMs under BF16 but runs quantized.
Section 5.2 / Figure 9 discussion: 'For batch sizes below 8, however, FlashQuant pads inputs to a minimum size of 8... its advantage diminishes for very small batches, such as 1 and 2.'
Section 7 Conclusion: 'Currently, FlashQuant targets INT4 weight-only quantization with BF16 outliers' — scope limitation; no code/artifact availability statement appears anywhere in the paper.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A GPU systems paper that fuses low-bit dense GEMM with high-precision sparse SpMM into one kernel for outlier-aware W4A16 LLM decoding. It is squarely in-scope LLM inference-efficiency work (LLM workload, quantization, vLLM serving), though its methodology is CUDA kernel engineering rather than language-model methodology, capping preference relevance. The content-sharing fusion of heterogeneous dense/sparse paths over a shared tile space and the Tile-COO format are genuinely new operator-level contributions built from known primitives (Stream-K, COO, swizzling, double buffering). Rigor is solid for a systems paper: three GPU generations, 340 operator configurations, unfused Marlin+Sputnik/cuSPARSE baselines, an incremental ablation (SD 6-16%, EW 2-4%, RE 4-9%), and end-to-end perplexity and vLLM throughput tables; but evaluation is limited to consumer GeForce GPUs, no variance reporting, and the strongest fused-competitor claim is unverifiable since none exists. Evidence strings are concrete and internally consistent. Generalizability is moderate: three model families and GPU generations, but restricted to INT4 weight-only/BF16 outliers, degraded below batch 8 due to padding, and untested on data-center hardware. No code or artifact release is stated anywhere, substantially hurting reproducibility for a kernel paper.

However, high-magnitude outlier weights can induce substantial quantization errors and degrade model accuracy. Outlier-aware quantization addresses this issue by retaining outliers in high precision while quantizing the remaining weights, resulting in a low-bit dense GEMM path and a high-precision sparse SpMM path. Existing implementations execute these paths in separate GPU kernels,
papers.summary_zh: 低位元數的 weight-only 量化能大幅降低大型語言模型推論的記憶體與頻寬成本，但高量值的異常值權重會造成嚴重量化誤差。異常值感知量化將少量異常值以高精度保留，其餘以 INT4 量化，形成低精度稠密 GEMM 加高精度稀疏 SpMM 的混合執行模式；既有系統以兩個獨立 GPU kernel 分別執行，兩者共用相同的啟動值與輸出，卻重複載入與寫回，在記憶體受限的解碼階段造成可觀延遲。FlashQuant 提出內容共用融合：將兩條異質計算路徑合併進單一 kernel，在晶片上重用啟動值與輸出 tile。三項關鍵技術包括：稀疏—稠密分塊，將異常值處理對齊 GEMM 的 CTA/warp/thread 階層並以 Stream-K 改善負載平衡；Tile-COO 異常值編碼，以 tile 與 bucket 為單位打包索引與數值，支援向量化解碼並降低共享記憶體 bank 衝突；以及管線化排程，以雙緩衝重疊資料搬移與計算。在 RTX 3090/4090/5090 上，相較 cuBLAS BF16 加速 2.74 至 4.18 倍，較最強未融合基線 Marlin+Sputnik 最高加速 1.53 倍；在 vLLM 端到端解碼較 BF16 快 2.01 倍，消融顯示分塊、額外 warp 與重排各貢獻 6–16%、2–4% 與 4–9%。限制是僅支援 INT4 weight-only、需離線前處理，速度仍不及不處理異常值的 Marlin，極小批次下優勢也會縮減。此工作讓異常值感知量化的精度優勢不再以效能為代價。

llm_evaluation.rationale: A genuine LLM mechanistic-interpretability study (Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, activation patching, causal abstraction) squarely within preferred topics (LLM, interpretability, algorithmic reasoning), though on toy synthetic domains. Methodological rigor is exceptionally high: frozen 36-candidate pre-specification, isolated construction/confirmation splits, wrong-operation/norm-matched-random/no-op controls, IUT with Holm correction, exact sign-flip tests, and a cross-backend (PyVene/NNsight) replication. Novelty is modest and honestly disclaimed: the paper itself states (Abstract, §2.6, §2.7) that all ingredients (steering, controls, isomorphic transfer, preregistration) are precedented, with the contribution only the joint restriction. Evidence supports only the narrow claim; the NNsight replication reproduces the same data's effect object rather than independent samples (§5.4, §7.1), and the shuffled-operation control retains ~0.287 recovery, so operation-specificity is partial (§7.3). Generalizability is explicitly minimal: one route, one candidate, one model revision, one layer interval, no cross-model or backend-independence claims. Reproducibility is strong on environment/artifact detail (frozen hashes, seeds, §A.3) but the preregistration is private and no public code release is promised (§6, §10).

primary_link.title: A Pre-Specified Construction-Confirmation Test of Operation-Level Causal Transfer Across Finite Isomorphic Symbolic Domains

papers.summary: Behavioral accuracy, linear decodability, and successful activation interventions do not by themselves show that a model carries an operation-level structure from one symbolic domain to another. We ask a narrower question in finite isomorphic state spaces: if the hidden-state difference between two operations is estimated separately for each source input, does adding that difference to a mapped recipient input move the model toward the corresponding recipient answer? The design compares this inp
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文探討可解釋性研究中一個狹窄的問題:在有限同構的符號狀態空間中,若針對每個來源輸入個別估計兩種操作之間的隱藏狀態差異,將該差異加到映射後的接收輸入上,能否使模型趨向對應的接收答案?作者在凍結的 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 模型第 20–21 層上,以 PyVene 與 NNsight 兩套介入實作,測試 36 個預先指定的候選(兩種提示路徑、三個領域對、六種有序操作遷移),並與錯誤操作、範數匹配隨機方向及四種 no-op 對照比較。建構與確認分割獨立計算行為資格並分別裁決後取交集,僅一個候選 transparent|integer_mod16–letters16|successor→predecessor 在兩個分割皆通過,確認交集—聯集 p 值為 0.000198,36 族 Holm 校正後為 0.0069;後續 NNsight 複製實驗在數值上重現全部 12 個效應估計、信賴區間與精確符號翻轉 p 值。結論嚴格受限於單一提示路徑、單一候選、單一模型版本與層區間,不宣稱跨模型泛化、後端獨立、領域通用遷移或代數不變性。此研究的價值在於示範預先指定、分割隔離與多重性校正的嚴謹設計,為操作層級因果遷移提供有界但可稽核的證據。

links.title: Conjunctive Poisoning in AI Supply-Chain Applications

evidence: Abstract: attack pairs 'a benign-looking wrapper with crafted metadata to deterministically alter post-generation behavior without modifying model weights', evaluated across fifteen LLM/VLM deployments with TIF-BAH defense.
Section 4.1 / Eq. 2: gate activates only when HMAC-keyed marker check (C1) AND canonical SHA-256 wrapper hash (C2) both hold.

Section 6 / Table 2: pre-defense payload success 0.91-1.00; post-defense 0.68-0.82, with caption noting values 'reflect task-specific rendering, output parsing, or defense-specific filtering, rather than stochastic failure of the gate'.
Section 6.1 / Table 3: task utility changes are small (e.g., GSM8K 0.1367->0.1338; COCO F1 1.0000->0.8931, returning to 1.0000 after payload stripping).
Section 6.4 / Table 5: mean latency overhead 0.29-0.46%, p95 under 6 ms across provider classes.

Limitations: 'This work does not claim that conditional execution, HMAC authentication, or hash-based integrity checks are novel by themselves'; TIF-BAH depends on canonicalization N(.) and requires a trusted reference not always available.
Appendix H.2: HF Spaces deployment case study reports '100% attack accuracy rate without any security trigger'.
Appendix J / Table 8: full-bundle SigStore signing and TIF-BAH block the gate 'by construction', while partial signing and prompt-level defenses do not.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM/VLM deployment-security paper squarely within preferred topics (LLM supply chain, AI safety, prompt-layer attacks, agent-adjacent metadata manipulation), with a clear threat model, 15-model evaluation, defense ablations, latency analysis, and released code. However, the core mechanism is admittedly not novel (Limitations concede HMAC/conditional execution/hash checks are standard), gate correctness of 1.00 is tautological since the predicate is attacker-authored wrapper code independent of the model, and the defense metric in Table 2 is interpretively muddled: post-defense ASR of 0.68-0.82 is attributed to 'rendering, parsing, or filtering' rather than defense efficacy, leaving unclear what partial SigStore/PromptShield numbers actually demonstrate. Task baselines are weak (GSM8K 0.1367), no production scanning tools are benchmarked, and TIF-BAH reduces to standard file-integrity checking that the authors note is subsumed by full-bundle signing. Solid systems-security observation with candid limitations, but incremental novelty and metric confusion cap the score.

primary_link.title: Conjunctive Poisoning in AI Supply-Chain Applications

papers.summary: Large Language and Vision-Language Models are increasingly deployed through inference pipelines that include prompt wrappers (e.g., templates and post-processing scripts) and configuration metadata (e.g., JSON/YAML files) that together shape model outputs. While model weights and binaries are routinely verified, these textual deployment artifacts remain weakly protected despite directly influencing runtime behavior. We show that a malicious developer can pair a benign-looking wrapper with crafte
papers.summary_zh: 本研究指出大型語言模型與視覺語言模型部署中的範本層——提示包裝器與組態中繼資料——是一個缺乏保護的執行層。惡意開發者可在不修改模型權重、訓練資料或推論後端的情況下,將看似無害的包裝器與精心構造的中繼資料配對,確定性地改變生成後行為。作者實作合取閘門作為受控實例:僅當包裝器內嵌的隱藏標記透過 HMAC 以外部祕密金鑰驗證,且包裝器規範化後的 SHA-256 雜湊與中繼資料中發布的摘要相符時,惡意分支才啟動;任一檢查失敗即失敗關閉,使單一構件的靜態檢查難以察覺。研究在 15 個開源與閉源 LLM/VLM 部署、75 個組態上評估,顯示閘門判定正確率為 1.00、延遲開銷低於 0.5%,而靜態中繼資料檢查、包裝器掃描器、PromptShield 與僅涵蓋權重的部分 SigStore 簽署都只能部分降低可見攻擊效果;唯有完整簽署封裝或作者提出的 TIF-BAH 中介軟體防禦(驗證包裝器完整性並記錄行為證明標頭)才能建構性地阻擋。實驗使用良性代理酬載(橫幅、免責聲明、排序偏移)以符合倫理,並未涵蓋所有前緣平台與更強酬載。此研究的意義在於提醒 ML 供應鏈安全應將範本構件視為完整性關鍵資產,而非可任意編輯的輔助檔案。
papers.title: Conjunctive Poisoning in AI Supply-Chain Applications
papers.title_zh: AI 供應鏈應用中的合取式毒化

links.title: AutoSQL: Extracting SQL Templates from Imperative ORM Code in Large-Scale Repositories

evidence: Abstract/§1: AutoSQL achieves 68.04%-72.18% recall on a benchmark of 579 test-covered entry points and 1,186 runtime-traced SQL statements from five Go repositories, exceeding the static reachability baseline by 11.80-15.94 points and existing agents by 8.52-21.50 points.

§4.2 Evaluation Scope: ground truth is runtime SQL logs from instrumented integration/regression tests; entry points not exercised by tests are excluded from quantitative evaluation; AutoSQL's pipeline covers 2,332 candidate entry points but metrics are scoped to the runtime-traced subset.

§4.4 Metrics: precision is estimated by sampling 20 unmatched predictions per method/repository pair (1,200 samples total), labeled false positive vs possible positive; match correctness uses LLM-assisted evaluation followed by expert review.

§4.3: Static Reachability baseline reflects the 'practical capability boundary of DBridge-style approaches' with statically-reachable paths marked during the labeling process - an author-defined baseline; proprietary coding agents excluded for non-transparent retrieval policies.

§5.3/Table 7: ablation with kimi-k2 shows AutoSQL (68.04 avg recall) vs Bash-Only (61.89), Vector-RAG (60.71), Multi-Agent (60.71); the 2.35-37.93 point range over Bash-Only checks out across per-repository and both-model numbers.

§5.4/Table 8: depth D sensitivity is non-monotonic per project (Grafana peaks at D=2 with 88.13% and drops to 84.02% at D=4; Go-Admin jumps 1.18%->62.35% from D=0 to D=2), indicating the D=4 default is not universally optimal.

§6 Threats: ground truth covers only tested paths so exact precision is unmeasurable; data contamination acknowledged; adapting to a new ORM requires updating framework-specific knowledge in the system prompt; results should not be generalized to untested entry points.

Data Availability: artifacts and data at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21872535; §4.4 specifies kimi-k2-0905 and Claude Sonnet 4.5 at temperature 0.1 and the ABCoder indexer, though verbatim prompts are not provided.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM code-agent paper (ReAct agent with Code Index graph navigation plus on-demand pattern search) for SQL template extraction from Go ORM code. It squarely matches high-weight preferences (Agents & Tool Use, Code & Programming, LLMs, Reasoning/CoT) via its agent design, tool use, and CoT synthesis, though the LLM is an off-the-shelf component and the contribution is system-level rather than LLM methodology. Novelty is moderate: RepoGraph-style graph navigation and ReAct scaffolds exist; the hybrid retrieval strategy and the imperative-ORM SQL reconstruction task are the fresher elements. Rigor is solid: runtime-instrumented ground truth (579 test-covered entry points, 1,186 SQL statements, §4.2), baselines spanning static reachability, iCodeReviewer, RepoAudit, Bash-Only, Vector-RAG, and Multi-Agent (§4.3, Table 7), two models, depth sensitivity (Table 8), and a threats section. Deductions: match judgments are LLM-assisted then expert-reviewed (§4.4), precision only estimated by sampling 20 unmatched predictions per pair, the 'Static Reachability' baseline recall derives from author labels made during dataset construction (§4.3), and no significance testing. Reported numbers are internally consistent (e.g., 56.24+11.80=68.04; 44.8x-62.0x token ratios in §5.2 match Tables 5-6). Generalizability is limited to Go, two ORM frameworks plus one custom builder, and test-covered entry points; new ORMs require prompt updates (§6). Reproducibility is aided by a Zenodo artifact DOI and model/temperature/config details, but full prompts are not shown and results depend on proprietary APIs.
topics: agent tool use and retrieval (hybrid graph + pattern search)

primary_link.title: AutoSQL: Extracting SQL Templates from Imperative ORM Code in Large-Scale Repositories

papers.summary: Suboptimal SQL queries can significantly degrade the performance of cloud systems, motivating the extraction and auditing of SQL statements before deployment. However, Go ORM frameworks construct SQL imperatively through scattered method-call sequences, making it difficult to statically recover the resulting SQL templates. We present AutoSQL, a system that reconstructs SQL templates from Go ORM code. AutoSQL constructs a Code Index, a directed graph that captures structural dependencies between
papers.summary_zh: 現代 Go 應用多以命令式 ORM 動態組裝 SQL,語句由分散的方法呼叫對狀態建構器逐步累積而成,執行前難以審計效能風險;既有靜態工具只支援 Java 宣告式框架。本文提出 AutoSQL,一個 LLM 代理系統,分三階段還原 SQL 範本:先建構 Code Index,以有向圖擷取函式、型別與全域變數間的結構依賴;再從 ORM 終端呼叫點向上追蹤呼叫鏈,界定與資料庫互動的進入點;最後代理以混合式上下文檢索收集語境——主要在圖上進行結構導航,當圖無法解析檢索目標時,依需求從檢索目標合成正規表示式進行模式搜尋,例如定位全域組態中特定鍵的賦值——並結合 ORM 隱含行為分析(結構標籤與 BeforeUpdate 等生命週期鉤子)與控制流枚舉,合成完整 SQL 範本。評估基於五個大規模 Go 儲存庫、579 個有測試覆蓋的進入點與 1,186 條執行期追蹤 SQL,其中 43.76% 依賴反射鉤子、執行期綱要解析等動態特性,純靜態可達性召回率僅 56.24%。AutoSQL 達 68.04%–72.18% 召回率,超出靜態基線 11.80–15.94 個百分點,並勝過 iCodeReviewer 與 RepoAudit 8.52–21.50 個百分點;消融實驗證實圖導航與模式搜尋皆不可省略。代價是每進入點約 94–136K 輸入 token 與更多工具呼叫,且量化評估僅限測試覆蓋的進入點。此方法對部署前的 SQL 效能審計具實用價值。

links.title: Dear Algo: A Precision-First Agentic Intent Layer for Unified Search and Recommendation

evidence: Abstract: strict categorical LLM-as-a-judge gate achieved 94.4% exact-Relevant precision [88.8%, 98.9%]; reranker-on path -1.97 points judge-Irrelevant share [-3.02, -0.94] and +2.24 Exact-Relevant [0.08, 4.41].
Section 4.2: 'The production prompt, model version, decoding configuration, and service details are proprietary and are not disclosed.'

Section 5.1: 'The precision-first estimand and threshold were clarified after label inspection. Initial human reliability was also weak: pairwise exact agreement was 0.677 and quadratic weighted kappa was 0.250 before the final-label rule.'
Section 4.3: the 0.8 judge score cutoff 'was a pre-existing internal product-review quality bar... retained... post hoc as the qualification gate', not tuned to the contrast but not human-derived.

Section 2.3: 'Agentic recommenders commonly place an LLM control plane over conventional retrieval and ranking tools (62, 74, 19). Dear Algo follows this pattern rather than replacing the serving data plane.'
Table 3 / Section 5.2: full configuration 7.73 vs 6.61 qualified candidates@20, C–B +1.11 [0.12, 2.12] over 72 clusters; sensitivity with malformed responses assigned zero yield still excludes zero.

Section 7 (Limitations): behavioral analysis is observational with self-selection and proxy sessions; 'recall or pre-reranking rank movement cannot be estimated'; judgment coverage and candidate composition differ by arm.
Section 5.4 / Table 5: +4.15% to +8.61% relative usage lift across cohorts, but 'every two-sided interval includes zero' for report-rate changes and no non-inferiority claim is licensed.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An industrial LLM-agent system paper with strong topical alignment to the Agents & Tool Use, LLM, RAG/grounding, and LLM-as-a-judge preferences: an agentic intent layer compiles natural-language requests into a grounded typed DSL (STQL) driving retrieval and optional LLM reranking. Rigor is unusually careful for a production paper—stratified blinded human calibration with inverse selection weights, Dawid-Skene sensitivity, paired offline and candidate-randomized serving studies with bootstrap CIs and MNAR bounds—and estimands are kept deliberately separate. However, the design pattern (LLM control plane over conventional retrieval, Section 2.3) is acknowledged as established; headline effects are modest and barely exclude zero (C–B yield +1.11 [0.12, 2.12]; Exact-Relevant +2.24 [0.08, 4.41]); all outcomes are scored by the same proprietary LLM judge that anchors the system, creating unresolved circularity/self-preference risk; the 0.8 threshold and precision-first estimand were retained post hoc and initial inter-rater reliability was weak (kappa 0.250, Section 5.1); the behavioral study is observational without a control. Everything is proprietary—no prompt, model version, code, or data are released—so reproducibility is minimal, and results are Threads/SilverTorch-specific, limiting generalizability despite transferable evaluation-methodology lessons.

primary_link.title: Dear Algo: A Precision-First Agentic Intent Layer for Unified Search and Recommendation

papers.summary: Search and recommendation serve a shared discovery objective but encode intent differently. We study this boundary through Dear Algo on Threads, a deployed product where open-ended requests such as \emph{more NBA news} or \emph{less politics} steer subsequent feed recommendations rather than return a one-shot result list. Its agentic intent layer compiles explicit, inferred, negative, and compound intent into a grounded executable plan, then invokes conventional retrieval and optional semantic o
papers.summary_zh: Threads 部署的 Dear Algo 讓使用者以自然語言(如「多看 NBA 新聞」、「少看政治」)持續引導動態消息推薦,而非僅回傳一次性結果清單。系統的代理式意圖層將明確、推斷、負向與複合意圖解讀為帶型別的語意特徵,透過受控詞彙表落地到實際項目識別碼,編譯成可檢視的 STQL 執行計畫,再呼叫既有候選檢索與選擇性語意或多模態重排序;意圖屬於控制面,檢索屬於延遲敏感的資料面,兩者分離,使搜尋式與推薦式模式可共享意圖—檢索合約而不必共用模型或服務路徑。評估採精準優先框架:在 300 對(296 對可評)公開請求—項目的盲測稽核中,嚴格類別 LLM 評審閘門達 94.4% 完全相關精確率;72 個標準化請求叢集的配對離線研究顯示完整組態每 20 個名額產出 7.73 個評審合格候選,高於 LLM 衍生查詢基線的 6.61(+1.11);在前 72 小時交付窗口內的候選隨機化服務路徑研究中,重排序開啟時評審判定不相關比例降低 1.97 個百分點、完全相關比例提高 2.24 個百分點;跨三個群組的觀察性研究顯示提出明確請求後每使用者代理工作階段數提升 4.15%–8.61%,而檢舉率區間皆含零。作者明確區分各研究的估計目標,並強調結果支持表徵層級統一,尚不證明跨模式因果遷移;行為研究缺乏處置控制,評審校準亦屬事後釐清。

links.title: L3Cube-IndicQuest v2: A Large-Scale Multilingual Benchmark for Evaluating Factual Knowledge of Large Language Models Across Indic Languages

evidence: Abstract and Section 1: benchmark of 3,471 English QA pairs across nine domains, translated to 19 Indic languages for 69,420 total pairs, evaluating six LLMs under three protocols.
Section 3.7: 'Any pair flagged by one reviewer was removed after discussion. This cut 20-25% of the set' - human review removes pairs that passed both automated gates.
Section 5.2 and Table 5: judge and two lexical criteria produce near-identical rankings; lexical scores are 17-25 pp lower, with the shortfall largest for Indic-word answers with spelling variants.

Limitations: Gemini 2.5 Flash is both Agent 1/2 backbone and the top evaluated model ('familiarity bias we cannot fully control for'); single judge model (Gemma 3 12B); no inter-annotator agreement statistic; multilingual evaluation covers only 9 of 19 languages and 2 of 6 models under the judge protocol only.
Table 6: Gemma4 31B weighted accuracy 56.9-66.9% vs Sarvam 30B 33.2-48.7% across ten languages, supporting the claim that Indic-native pre-training does not guarantee an advantage.
Appendix C: agent and judge prompts reproduced but explicitly abridged ('rule bodies, worked examples, and JSON schemas are abridged'); footnote 1 gives public release at l3cube-pune/IndicQuest-v2.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A squarely in-scope LLM evaluation benchmark: closed-book factual QA over six LLMs with an LLM-as-judge protocol plus two deterministic lexical criteria (Sections 4.2-4.3), touching high-weight preferences (LLMs, evaluation/LLM-judge, factual knowledge/hallucination, QA). Not Japanese-focused, and the 'agents' are data-generation pipeline workers, not agentic-systems research, so relevance is good but not top-tier. Novelty is moderate: it is a v2 extension of IndicQuest v1 (Table 1), with the main new contributions being scale, a hybrid agent-human construction pipeline, and the observation that 20-25% of auto-validated pairs fail expert review (Section 3.7). Rigor is solid but weakened by acknowledged confounds: the judge (Gemma 3 12B) is a single unvalidated small model with no human-agreement study, Gemini 2.5 Flash is both dataset generator and top evaluated model (Limitations), GPT-5.4 Mini is both translator and evaluated model, and no significance testing or inter-annotator agreement is reported. Evidence strength is decent: extensive domain/language/protocol tables (Tables 4-7) that are internally consistent, and claims like the Gemma4-vs-Sarvam gap (13.5 pp English, 17.4-28.3 pp multilingual, Table 6) are directly supported, though the pre-training-strategy conclusion is properly hedged. Generalizability is limited to Indic/India-specific factual recall and only 9 of 19 languages and 2 of 6 models were evaluated multilingually (Limitations). Reproducibility benefits from a public dataset release (footnote 1) and deterministic lexical metrics, but prompts are abridged in Appendix C and dedup thresholds/annotator guidelines are underspecified.

primary_link.title: L3Cube-IndicQuest v2: A Large-Scale Multilingual Benchmark for Evaluating Factual Knowledge of Large Language Models Across Indic Languages

papers.summary: We present L3Cube-IndicQuest v2, a large-scale gold-standard multilingual question-answering benchmark for evaluating the India-specific factual knowledge of Large Language Models (LLMs). The benchmark comprises 3,471 curriculum-grounded English question--answer pairs spanning nine domains, curated from educational curricula, competitive examination materials, and domain-specific reference books. We introduce a practical hybrid construction strategy that combines context-grounded LLM-based quest
papers.summary_zh: 本文發表 L3Cube-IndicQuest v2,一個評估大型語言模型印度特定事實知識與幻覺的多語言基準。資料集包含 3,471 對課綱為本的英文問答,橫跨九個領域(文化、歷史、地理、法律、政治、科學、體育、藝術、商業),譯成 19 種印度語系語言後共 69,420 對、20 種語言。建構採混合管線:Gemini 2.5 Flash 驅動的兩個代理分別負責生成與嚴格驗證,再以句子嵌入相似度進行語意去重,最後由三名標註者審核;人類審核移除了 20–25% 已通過自動檢查的配對,凸顯自動驗證的極限。評估涵蓋六個模型,採三種協定:Gemma 3 12B 擔任的 LLM 評審、精確子字串匹配與詞彙重疊匹配;三種協定給出幾乎相同的模型排序,顯示結果不依賴評審選擇。Gemini 2.5 Flash 以 86.9% 遙遙領先;開源權重模型 Gemma4 31B 以 62.2% 勝過印度語系特化模型 Sarvam 30B 的 48.7%,且在每種受測印度語言皆領先,差距擴大至 17.4–28.3 個百分點,挑戰「本土語料預訓練必然佔優」的假設。體育與法律是普遍弱點。限制包括多語言評估僅完成部分語言與模型、生成與評估模型重疊可能引入熟悉度偏誤,以及機器翻譯可能影響非英文子集的分數。此基準對區域知識評估與標註品質監督具參考價值。

links.title: Do Assessment Instruments Measure the Same Thing for Humans and LLMs? A Latent Structure Analysis

evidence: Abstract: 'we find systematic differences between human and LLM factor structures, showing evidence that the analyzed assessments may not measure the same constructs for humans and LLMs'
Section 4.3 / Table 2: Quantitative Reasoning k=4 mean congruence L-H 0.438 vs H-H 0.543, Cohen's d 1.80***; Chemistry k=4 L-H 0.476 vs H-H 0.620, d 2.14***, all p<.001

Section 3.3: 'For each model and instrument, we collected 20 independent response sets, yielding 120 total responses across the six models per instrument', 'collected through the models' online user interfaces'
Section 3.5.1: 'seven items were removed from the chemistry item set: Items 1, 8-10, 12, 17, and 20' after sparse tetrachoric contingency diagnostics
Section 3.2: 'we opted to use a non-public dataset. While this choice limits reproducibility, it was necessary to ensure data quality'
Limitations: 'the LLMs dataset is relatively small compared to the human sample (120 responses)' and 'results are based on a small number of instruments and specific GenAI tools'
Section 3.1: 'The full code, sample data and prompts to reproduce the analyses in the paper can be found in the GitHub repository'
llm_evaluation.rationale: A methodologically careful psychometric critique of LLM benchmarking practice: the paper applies EFA, factor congruence with Hungarian matching, and a human-human resampling baseline (Section 3.6) to two instruments, finding consistent LH<HH congruence gaps (Table 2, Cohen's d 0.87-2.14, p<.001). It is squarely about LLM evaluation validity, giving solid preference relevance, but it does not advance core language-model methodology (no new modeling, prompting, or alignment technique) and prior work cited in Section 2.2 (Petrov 2024, Sauberli 2025, Liu 2025, Muncker 2025) already establishes human-LLM response divergence, so novelty is incremental. Rigor is undermined by pooling six heterogeneous proprietary LLMs into one population from only 120 web-UI-collected responses (Section 3.3, Limitations), post-hoc removal of 7/22 chemistry items (Section 3.5.1), and single-sided tests with only two case-study instruments. Generalizability is explicitly limited by the case-study design and specific models (Limitations). Code and prompts are released but the human data are non-public (Section 3.2) and web-interface collection is non-deterministic, capping reproducibility.

primary_link.title: Do Assessment Instruments Measure the Same Thing for Humans and LLMs? A Latent Structure Analysis

papers.summary: The rapid development and growing deployment of large language models (LLMs) have made it increasingly important to understand their capabilities. A common approach is to evaluate LLMs using assessment instruments originally designed to measure skills and competencies in humans, such as standardized exams, and to use performance on these instruments as evidence for generalizable claims about LLMs' underlying abilities on the same skills the assessments are intended to measure in humans. However,
papers.summary_zh: 用標準化測驗評估大型語言模型的常見做法,隱含一個假設:為人類設計的評量工具,其分數與底層能力的關聯對 LLM 同樣成立。本文以效度觀點檢驗此假設的必要條件——兩個群體在測驗上的潛在結構是否相似。作者選用兩份 STEM 評量:一份高中化學診斷測驗(931 名學生、22 題)與一份大學入學考量化推理測驗(4,800 餘名應試者、20 題),並讓六個多模態 LLM(GPT-4o、GPT-5.2、Gemini 1.5 Pro、Gemini 3 Pro、Claude 3.5 Sonnet、Claude 4.5)各產生 20 份獨立作答,合併為 120 份回應。分析流程包含四分相關矩陣的前處理、以 Kaiser 準則與平行分析估計保留因子數、分別對人類與 LLM 擬合探索性因素分析,再以因子諧合度搭配 Hungarian 演算法匹配因子,並進行 100 次重複重抽樣,以人類—人類比較為基線。結果顯示:無論因子數如何選擇,LLM—人類的因子結構持續低於人類—人類基線,差異在所有檢定中顯著;平行分析下兩群保留的因子數也不同。這表示這些測驗對人類與 LLM 可能測量不同的構念,高分不保證相同的能力解讀。作者提醒研究僅涵蓋兩份工具與特定模型、使用非公開資料,且將私有試題上傳至商業模型有污染風險。此發現對 LLM 基準設計與教育應用具有警醒意義。

links.title: CLARA: Clip-Level Multimodal Alignment with VLM-Derived Rationales for Hateful Video Detection

evidence: Section 4.1 (Implementation Details): 5-fold cross-validation with 7:1:2 split, AdamW lr 3e-5, batch 32, 8 experts with top-3 routing, lambda_CL=0.3, lambda_LB=0.01, 2x NVIDIA L40 GPUs.

Table 2 (Overall Results): CLARA reports 0.879 Acc / 0.872 M-F1 on HateMM, 0.779/0.734 on MHC_CN, 0.763/0.727 on MHC_EN, 0.735/0.659 on DeHate, vs second-best baselines (e.g., MM-HSD 0.839 on HateMM, HVGuard 0.754 on MHC_CN).
Appendix C (Table 9): paired t-tests vs MoRE, HVGuard, MM-HSD across Acc/M-F1/M-Pre/M-Rec on all four dataset subsets, all p-values below 0.05.
Table 3 (Ablation): removing rationale drops HateMM M-F1 from 0.872 to 0.803; w/o Transformer drops MHC_CN Acc from 0.779 to 0.672; every ablated variant underperforms the full model.

Section 3.4 and Appendix B.3 (Table 8): VLM rationale generation uses Qwen3VL-8B-Instruct with a two-step prompt, and the rationale explicitly includes a VLM 'Final decision' with hate/non-hate label, explicitness, and confidence.
Appendix G (Table 12): utterance-aligned segmentation beats fixed 10-second clips on all datasets (e.g., MHC_CN M-F1 0.734 vs 0.655).
Appendix H (Table 13): CLARA has 44.95M params and higher inference cost (3.720 ms/video, 2765 MB peak training memory) than MM-HSD/HVGuard, comparable to MoRE.
Abstract footnote 1: code claimed available at https://github.com/yuchenzhang-1/CLARA.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Applied multimodal content-moderation paper (hateful video detection) that does involve language methodology, so the pure-domain cap does not apply: it uses VLM (Qwen3VL-8B) two-step prompted rationale generation, BERT text encoding, MoE clip encoding, and a gated Transformer. Topic relevance is moderately high via AI Safety (hate/harmful content), Multimodal AI, Reasoning/Prompting, and Transformer preferences, but it studies no LLM/foundation-model question itself and merely consumes VLM rationales. Novelty is incremental: each ingredient is established (MoE routing with Shazeer/Fedus-style load balancing, local-global contrastive learning directly echoing Wang et al. 2022 long-short temporal contrast, FiLM-inspired gating, VLM rationales already used by HVGuard baseline); the main new element is utterance-aligned clip-level alignment. Rigor and evidence are solid: 5-fold CV (Section 4.1), paired t-tests vs three strong baselines with all p<0.05 (Appendix C, Table 9), extensive ablations (Table 3), sensitivity analyses on three datasets (Figs 3, 5-7; Appendices D-E), segmentation and encoder swaps (Appendix G, Table 12; Table 10-11), and a cost comparison (Appendix H, Table 13). Caveats: the rationale schema embeds the VLM's own hate/non-hate decision and confidence (Appendix B.3, Table 8), so part of the gain is distillation of an already-strong VLM predictor (Qwen3VL direct prompting: 0.738 Acc on HateMM, Table 2); no cross-dataset transfer; reported default 8-expert/top-3 differs from the observed 10-expert/top-2 optimum. Generalizability is limited to the hate-detection task though tested across two languages and four platform-sourced subsets. Code link is claimed (Abstract footnote 1) and hyperparameters/prompts are documented, aiding reproducibility.

papers.summary_zh: 仇恨言論在影片中的意義常由語音、音訊與視覺線索的跨時間交互累積而成,單一畫格或語句難以揭示;現有方法多採粗粒度的影片層級表示,容易稀釋短暫而關鍵的仇恨訊號。本文提出 CLARA,將影片依語句邊界(以 Whisper 取得轉錄與時間戳)切分為片段作為基本建模單位:片段層級上以混合專家(MoE)編碼器自適應融合文字、音訊與視覺特徵;引入局部—全域片段對比學習,使短片段與同影片較長語境保持一致並與其他影片區隔;再由 Qwen3-VL 產生影片層級推理依據,經閘控 Transformer 與片段表示整合,提供高層語意引導後進行分類。在三個公開資料集 HateMM、MultiHateClip(中、英子集)與 DeHate 上,CLARA 於準確率與巨觀 F1 等指標全面超越 MoRE、HVGuard、MM-HSD 等最新方法,準確率提升 2.4%–5.3%,配對 t 檢定顯著。消融實驗證實各模態、MoE 融合、對比學習、推理依據與時間建模皆有必要;參數分析找出 8–10 個專家、top-2/3 路由與適中對比權重為最佳區間,語句對齊切分亦優於固定長度切分。代價是推論成本高於輕量特徵級融合方法。此工作對內容審核中的隱式、語境依賴仇恨偵測具實務價值。

links.title: Pricing the Risk of Runtime Compression: Anytime-Valid Admission and a Served-Output Law for Compressed Serving State

evidence: Abstract: anytime-valid ledger bound holds at every one of 352,333 admission calls on live traffic; pre-registered held-out round halves exact-fallback rate 0.30 to 0.14 at matched risk.

Table 2 (Sec. 4): union budget exhausts on 100% of long requests; at budget 2x10^4 the cumulative arm's fallback rate 0.339 is worse than union's 0.315 and that arm's adjudication is reported INVALID rather than quoted as a win.

Table 3 (Sec. 5): five routes to the step budget; global Lipschitz envelope gives 10^221 and local operator norm sigma_max ~ 16.0 are rejected; betting-style confidence sequence yields E[TV] <= 0.0322 (0.0552 on deployed rounding, 160 distinct draws).

Sec. 6: 80 histories drawn without replacement from a constructed 148-candidate pool; 16/16 held-out histories certify; conformal bound 0.0254 marginal vs 0.0933 training-conditional; the paper states the population is a constructed pool, not runtime traffic (eq. 22).

Sec. 7 (eqs. 19-20): the 1064x witness-to-served gap is decomposed as 1.50x (query envelope) times 0.89x (measured ellipsoid, buys nothing) times ~700x (gate operating point), localizing the gap to the operating point.

Sec. 10 Limitations: propagation constants, a_q, and w_thr are measured on one run/model, not bounded; the witness is a local K/V band-norm, not served TV; the routing-predicate vacuity is reported as the most transferable finding.
Abstract and Sec. 2: 228 Lean 4 exported theorems with no sorry and pre-registered gates with artifact-traceable numbers; however, the document contains no public repository or artifact-release URL.

Table 5 (Sec. 8): five-arm RULER-style replication, all arms score 1.000 under the provably-clean caliber; union gate burns 99.4% of request budget with 59.3% fallback vs 56.3% for the cumulative gate; disclosed c4-tier sparse-read defect under mixed concurrent workloads.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A systems-plus-statistics paper on certified runtime quantization of LLM serving state (KV-write precision in MoE stacks). In scope for LLM serving/efficiency preferences (quantization, serving, KV cache, MoE), but it does not engage the highest-weight preference areas (reasoning, agents, alignment, Japanese LLM/NLP), so relevance is moderate. Methodological novelty is real: anytime-valid e-process admission driving precision decisions, a Lean 4 machine-checked chain from per-step moment budgets to request-level served-TV tails, a tanh gate law, and order-statistic conformal extrapolation across histories; the companion-adjudicated rejection of routing certification is a distinctive negative result. Rigor is unusually high for self-accounting (pre-registered gates with committed verdict branches, INVALID arms reported, four self-retractions), but key quantitative support rests on small samples (8 captured requests, 80 histories, 16 held-out, single confirmatory replication) and the decisive constants are measured, not bounded. Evidence is real-stack measurement (352,333 admission calls, five-arm RULER replication) but single-lab with no external baselines and internally unverifiable artifacts. Generalizability is limited by a constructed 148-history population explicitly not equal to runtime traffic and model-specific numerics. Reproducibility claims (frozen commits, provenance stamps, 228 theorems no sorry) are strong in wording, yet no public code/data/artifact release is stated.

primary_link.title: Pricing the Risk of Runtime Compression: Anytime-Valid Admission and a Served-Output Law for Compressed Serving State

papers.summary: Runtime compression of serving state trades quality for capacity with no priced guarantee: systems adapt precision on load signals with no soundness statement, and certified approaches budget request-level risk by a union bound over a pre-declared event count. We show the union budget exhausts on every long request in a production serving stack (100% of requests), and replace it with an anytime-valid, physically accounted ledger whose bound holds at every one of 352,333 admission calls on live t
papers.summary_zh: 大型模型伺服系統日益在執行期依負載動態調整量化精度,卻缺乏合理的風險保證;既有認證方法以聯集界限預先分配請求層級風險,在長請求上必然耗盡。本文建立一條以 Lean 4 機器檢驗(228 個定理、無 sorry)的風險會計鏈。第一環以累積實現損失的任意時刻有效准入帳本取代聯集界限:在生產伺服堆疊的 352,333 次准入呼叫中界線從未被跨越,預先註冊的留出確認輪中精確回退率從 0.30 減半至 0.14,判斷成本約 +3.8%。第二環證明從每步變異預算到請求層級服務輸出總變差尾界(定理 1),並以服務輸出定律 TV≤tanh(a_q·w_thr) 將服務目標換算成閘門門檻;三層稽核(查詢包絡 1.5 倍、測量橢球無增益、閘門操作點約 700 倍)把認證見證與實際服務輸出間整個 1064 倍差距定位到操作點。第三環是量化器:對 80 個可交換服務歷史做順序統計量外推,以 0.0933 的訓練條件失效界取代二元共形預測的空洞證書。作者亦簡述並拒絕認證 MoE 專家路由——路由閘門約束在 94–100% 生產流量上且翻轉與損害不相關。主要限制:歷史母體是自建的 148 候選池而非線上流量、傳播常數被測量而非被界定、見證僅為 KV 局部量。此論文示範如何在系統中做出可稽核、可花費的風險決策。

links.title: Beyond Single Object: Learning 3D Relations with Large Language Models

evidence: Abstract/Introduction: 'zero-shot single-object classification improves from 50.7% to 54.2%, indicating positive transfer without forgetting' — supports the positive-transfer claim quantitatively.

Table 1 (Sec. 5.1): Multi-3DLLM scores 56.3 Positional M, 33.8 Comparative M, 81.7 Holistic B vs best baseline ShapeLLM 22.6/11.2/49.8, and 37.1 SM Selection vs all baselines below the 25% chance level.
Table 10 (Appendix C.1): text-only Vicuna-7B with GT captions reaches 52.0 Positional and 70.5 Holistic B, and Ours still exceeds it (56.3/81.7) — a credible language-prior control.
Table 11 (Appendix C.2): Object-Level (Max) and Micro-Token (M=32) drop to 23.9 and 24.5 SM Selection vs 37.1 with PIT, directly supporting the 'interaction granularity matters' claim.
Appendix B.4: leakage-free splitting via connected components over a co-occurrence graph of 3D assets, preventing cross-split leakage.

Sec. 'Evaluation Metrics' and Appendix E.1: LLM judge (gpt-4o-mini) validated by 300-response human audit at 91.0% unanimous agreement; dataset audit of 500 QA pairs at 81.0% unanimous agreement (Sec. 3 'Dataset Statistics and Quality Control').
Table 12 (Appendix D.2): zero-shot real-scan transfer of 36.3% (OmniObject3D) rising to 62.0% after 5K-sample fine-tuning, while LLaVA-7B stays at ~25% chance.
Appendix A Table 5: full hyperparameters (batch sizes, LRs, epochs, 8x H200, Phase 1 70 min / Phase 2 12h), but no repository or data-release URL is provided anywhere in the document.
Table 13 (Appendix C.3): 1-Stage PIT reaches 66.6 SM Selection but drops MO3D Positional from 56.3 to 47.6 — an honest trade-off analysis of training strategy.

Appendix C.4: zero-shot 4-5 object scaling falls to 32%/14% naively but a training-free coarse-to-fine filtering recovers 50%/51%, with limitations (token budget, point density, caption bias) explicitly acknowledged in Sec. 6.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM-centric 3D multimodal paper: instruction-tunes a Vicuna-7B-based 3D-LLM (PointLLM) for multi-object relational/geometric reasoning, builds an LLM-generated instruction dataset (MO3D, ~70k QA), and evaluates with an LLM-judge, aligning well with LLM, reasoning, and multimodal preferences (it is not pure CV despite the point-cloud modality). Novelty is moderate: the multi-object relational gap is a genuine, well-argued contribution and the gated Patch-Interaction Transformer is a clean minimal extension, but the architecture itself is a shallow self-attention block and the dataset pipeline (CLIP grouping + GPT-4 QA generation) is methodologically standard. Rigor is strong: comprehensive baselines (3D-LLMs, 2D-VLMs, scene-level models, and a text-only language-prior control), multiple ablations (interaction granularity, pooling, 1-stage vs 2-stage training), human audits of dataset (81.0% unanimous) and judge metrics (91.0%), and leakage-free graph-based splits. Evidence for the core claim (patch-level interaction is needed for geometric tasks) is convincing (PIT 37.1 vs object-level variants ~24-25 Selection on Shape Mating), though results are single-seed without variance and rely on GPT-4o-mini judging. Generalizability is partially demonstrated via real-scan transfer and 4-5 object test-time scaling, but only on one backbone and mostly synthetic data. Reproducibility is aided by full hyperparameters, prompts, and templates, yet no code/data release URL is stated.

primary_link.title: Beyond Single Object: Learning 3D Relations with Large Language Models

papers.summary: We address a fundamental gap in 3D-LLMs: existing models focus on single-object/scene description, struggling with detailed, inter-object comparison. We propose a framework for detailed object-level reasoning across multiple objects with three components: (1) MO3D (Multi-Object in 3D), an instruction dataset requiring fine-grained multi-object comparison; (2) Multi-3DLLM, using a minimal Patch-Interaction Transformer (PIT) that models inter-/intra-object relationships while preserving local geom
papers.summary_zh: 現有 3D-LLM 多聚焦於單一物件或場景層級的描述，缺乏跨物件的細緻幾何比較能力。本文提出多物件 3D 理解框架，包含三項貢獻：其一，MO3D 資料集，基於 Objaverse-Cap3D 以 CLIP 嵌入取樣語意相關物件群組，再以 GPT-4 結合多視角渲染產生約 7 萬筆位置、比較與整體判斷型問答對，並透過平衡取樣抑制語言先驗；其二，Multi-3DLLM，在 PointLLM 骨幹上加入輕量級 Patch-Interaction Transformer（PIT），以 scalar-gated 殘差在 patch 層級建模跨物件關係，保留局部幾何細節；其三，Shape Mating 與 Change Captioning 兩個應用導向基準。實驗顯示，現有 3D-LLM 與 2D-VLM 在這些任務上普遍失準，而 Multi-3DLLM 在 MO3D 各項指標大幅超越基線，Shape Mating 選擇率達 37.1%（高於 25% 隨機水準），且零樣本單物件分類由 50.7% 提升至 54.2%，顯示正向遷移而無災難性遺忘。注意力分析亦顯示多任務訓練使注意力更稀疏集中。限制包括依賴既有描述的偏誤、物件數增加時的 token 預算取捨，以及真實掃描的點密度落差。此工作將 3D-LLM 擴展至多物件關係推理，對機器人與擴增實境等應用具實用價值。
