links.title: Beyond Visual CoT: Internalized Visual Thinking for Proactive Video Reasoning

evidence: Abstract: 'Compared with Visual CoT, IVT achieves comparable or better performance and reduces end-to-end latency by more than 5x'

Section 3.8, Tables 3-5: 'IVT improves all four metrics across all six settings' vs Answer-Only SFT; IVT beats Visual CoT in 4 of 6 settings but 'exceeding IVT by 1.3 ROUGE-L points on Ego4D and 1.2 points on EPIC-KITCHENS-100' in early-event prediction, and 'still trailing the larger Qwen3-VL-8B model'

Section 3.2, Table 1: Visual CoT mean latency 6.56s vs Answer-Only SFT 1.07s (6.2x); oracle-frame conditioning yields ROUGE-L +21.6% on early-event prediction, diagnosing generated-frame fidelity as the bottleneck
Section 3.6, Table 2: Joint Training ROUGE-L 34.5 vs Two-Stage 28.6 and Answer-Only SFT 30.6 on Ego-Exo4D early-event prediction
Section 3.3-3.7: controlled ablations over target representations (Flux-VAE/DINOv2/SigLIP2), 1:1 vs 3:1 vs 5:1 mixtures, regression vs flow matching, Dense vs MoE decoders, horizons H=1-4
Appendix D.1, Table 7: out-of-domain Charades accuracy IVT Dense 73.2% vs Answer-Only SFT 71.7% and Visual-CoT 58.2%
Appendix D.2, Table 9: per-benchmark mean latency IVT 0.81-2.07s vs Visual CoT 3.72-8.24s on a single B200 GPU

Section 3.1: 'ablations use a randomly sampled subset of 200 Ego-Exo4D validation examples'; 'Long-horizon anticipation ... is therefore left for future work'; no code or model release is stated anywhere in the document
llm_evaluation.rationale: A multimodal-LLM post-training paper (BAGEL-7B backbone) that internalizes visual chain-of-thought as a training-time next-embedding prediction objective for proactive video reasoning, eliminating inference-time image generation. Relevant to high-weight preferences (Reasoning & CoT, LLMs, Multimodal, Training/Inference), though the task domain is egocentric action anticipation rather than core LLM/NLP methodology. Novelty is moderate: the idea synthesizes JEPA-style latent prediction, latent visual reasoning, and unified understanding-generation models into an MLLM post-training recipe; the systematic design-space study adds value. Rigor is solid: matched backbones, one-factor-at-a-time ablations over target representation, mixture ratio, objective, curriculum, and architecture/horizon (Tables 1-2, Figs. 2-5), plus OOD transfer to Charades. Evidence is quantitative and the headline claims verify: IVT beats Answer-Only SFT on all six dataset-task settings and Visual CoT on 4 of 6 (Tables 3-5), with ~5.4x mean latency reduction (Table 9). Caveats: ablations use only 200 sampled validation examples, no significance testing or seed variance, no code/checkpoint release stated, gains over Visual CoT on Ego4D/EPIC next-event are marginal, and the method trails Qwen3-VL-8B. Generalizability is limited by evaluation restricted to egocentric anticipation (long-horizon explicitly deferred) with one OOD set.

primary_link.title: Beyond Visual CoT: Internalized Visual Thinking for Proactive Video Reasoning

papers.summary: Multimodal large language models increasingly use visual chain-of-thought (Visual CoT) to reason about spatial, temporal, and embodied environments. By generating intermediate reasoning images, Visual CoT provides an intuitive mechanism for visual foresight but introduces substantial inference overhead, which is particularly problematic for proactive video reasoning. We ask whether models can learn to think visually during training while reasoning directly at inference. We introduce Internalized
papers.summary_zh: 視覺思維鏈（Visual CoT）讓多模態大型語言模型先生成中間圖像再作答，雖提供視覺前瞻能力，卻在推論階段引入龐大運算負擔，延遲約增加 5 至 6 倍。本文提出內化視覺思考（Internalized Visual Thinking, IVT），一種後訓練框架：在訓練時以未標註影片聯合最佳化文字預測與次嵌入預測（next-embedding prediction），要求模型從已觀察的影片前綴預測未來影格的潛在表示與目標文字答案；推論時則直接生成答案，不需合成或重新編碼未來影格。作者在 Ego-Exo4D、Ego4D 與 EPIC-KITCHENS-100 的早期事件預測與次事件預測上進行系統性消融，發現 Flux-VAE 目標表示、1:1 的理解對預測資料混合、聯合訓練課程，以及短預測視界下的 Dense 解碼器最為關鍵。在六個資料集—任務設定中，IVT 全面優於純文字後訓練，並在其中四項超越 Visual CoT，同時平均端對端延遲降低逾 5 倍；次事件預測的平均 ROUGE-L 由 45.9 提升至 49.7。研究也指出目標表示、架構、視界、資料配比與課程等設計選擇缺一不可。此結果顯示顯式像素生成未必是主動式影片推理的必要條件，預測式世界建模可在訓練階段內化，對延遲敏感的應用深具意義。
papers.title: Beyond Visual CoT: Internalized Visual Thinking for Proactive Video Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 超越視覺思維鏈：以內化視覺思考進行主動式影片推理

links.title: Measuring Structured Predictability in Neural Training Dynamics: A Cross-Regime Study

evidence: Section 3 defines three graded probe families (displacement-direction ESA/VCS, subspace-residual FRR/LRGF, predictor-based inertia/linear/DMD) with explicit equations, causal history-only construction, and a DMD-in-span headroom bound cos_DMD <= sqrt(1-FRR^2).

Section 4.1: within-family agreement - 28/30 vision cells follow the parameter-free ESA-VCS curve; out-of-window vs in-window FRR median per-cell Spearman rho=0.83; DMD vs linear-trend SESA rho=0.89; cross-family anticorrelations rho=-0.74 (ESA-FRR) and rho=-0.75 (FRR-DMD cosine).

Section 4.2 / Fig. 3-4: auxiliary tensors exceed bulk in 29/32 trajectory-level comparisons under ESA and 32/32 under the DMD direction cosine, holding at all 246 Pythia model-checkpoint snapshots; predictable pockets are ~6% of pooled group-anchor observations.

Section 4.3 / Appendix E: ESA correlates with movement directedness at rho=0.978 and with a loss-side gradient-coherence estimate (no parameter-direction information) at rho=0.804 over the transfer-family grid, both registered as retrospective correspondences.

Appendix A: corpus of 139 training runs plus one frozen checkpoint; Pythia protocol of 123 anchors spanning steps 7,000-129,000 at all sizes; documents the upstream step116000 checkpoint defect in Pythia-1B with explicit masking windows, and Pythia-1B exclusion from cross-scale readings on three independent grounds (Appendix F, Table 11c).

Appendix G.4: rank correlation between anchor-averaged bulk ESA and final test accuracy is negative at every architecture (median -0.71, range -0.89 to -0.20, cell counts 4-7), and the weight-decay ladder shows predictability and final accuracy moving in opposite directions, supporting the caution that predictability is not an optimizer ranking.

Appendix H / Table 12: online auxiliary-only eligibility yields +0.94pp (ViT-tiny) and +0.87pp (ViT-mid) mean accuracy gain over three seeds while accepting 0.80%/0.32% of parameters, with explicit caveats that the mask, not role restriction, is the operative safeguard and no wall-clock accounting is attempted.

Section 5: limitations state that probes capture a restricted class of dynamics, readings depend on checkpoint spacing/horizon/grouping convention, measurements are retrospective rather than online signals, and coverage does not establish generality across larger models or other learning paradigms.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A methodologically careful measurement study of short-horizon predictability in training trajectories, applied to multi-pass CIFAR vision training and one-pass Pythia LLM pretraining (70M-1.4B). Preference relevance is moderate: the substantial Pythia cross-scale, segment-resolved (qkv/attn_out/MLP) analysis partially matches the LLM (2.5), scaling (1.3) and training/optimization (1.5) preferences, but the core contribution is an optimization-dynamics measurement framework, not an LLM/NLP/agent/reasoning method, and the paper explicitly disclaims circuit/behavior interpretability claims. Novelty is solid: a multiscale, convention-aware, null-calibrated probe framework for temporal redundancy of updates is a genuine gap relative to trajectory-geometry (Singh et al. 2025) and weight-nowcasting work. Rigor is exceptionally high: null calibration, grouping-sensitivity audits, within/cross-family coherence checks, blind audit, seed replicates, documented Pythia-1B defect masking, and unusually honest limitations and reporting-discipline rules. Evidence is strong within scope (paired orderings, correlations, dose ladders, multi-seed online check) but largely descriptive/retrospective, single-run per Pythia size, with no code-release claim, and generality is limited to two regimes.

primary_link.title: Measuring Structured Predictability in Neural Training Dynamics: A Cross-Regime Study

papers.summary: Modern deep networks are trained through long update trajectories, yet their temporal organization remains less systematically characterized than architectures, losses, or optimizers. We study short-horizon predictability as a measure of temporal redundancy: where, when, and under which training conditions recent updates contain information about near-future parameter motion. We combine three complementary probe families, displacement-direction, subspace-residual, and predictor-based probes, wit
papers.summary_zh: 深度網路的訓練軌跡雖漫長，其時間組織卻缺乏系統性刻劃。本文以短期可預測性作為時間冗餘的量度，探討在何處、何時及何種訓練條件下，近期的參數更新包含近未來位移的資訊。作者提出三族互補探針：位移方向（ESA、VCS）、子空間殘差（FRR、LRGF）與預測器式（慣性、線性趨勢、DMD），並搭配慣例感知、虛無假設校準的群組層級讀值，應用於 CIFAR 多趟視覺訓練（30 個模型—最佳化器組合）與 Pythia 公開預訓練檢查點。主要發現包括：輔助型向量參數（正規化參數與偏差）的短期動態比矩陣型主體權重簡單；主體權重整體難以預測，但含約 6% 局部且隨時間變動的「可預測口袋」；ESA 與實際移動方向性（ρ=0.978）及損失側梯度一致性（ρ=0.804）高度相關。Pythia-70M 案例呈現角色、深度與規模相依的事件序列，如主體 ESA 跌破隨機水準及 qkv 口袋的湧現與遷移。受控實驗亦顯示架構與訓練配方會系統性調變此結構，且可預測性不等於最佳化器好壞。限制在於探針屬回顧性量測，讀值依賴檢查點間距、視界與分組慣例。此框架為訓練動力學提供了參數層級的回顧式診斷工具。
papers.title: Measuring Structured Predictability in Neural Training Dynamics: A Cross-Regime Study
papers.title_zh: 衡量神經訓練動力學中的結構化可預測性：跨訓練範式研究

links.title: When Entropy Is Not Enough: Reclaiming Lost Semantics in LLM Output Length Prediction

evidence: Abstract: ESTP combines entropy with attention-based importance from self-attention weights during prefill, outperforming baselines on ForeLen and improving throughput/padding in end-to-end tests.

Preliminaries, Table 1 and Motivation: 120 manually annotated instances from Reasoning/RL scenarios, ~80% of high-attention tokens judged semantically important; Figure 2 reports attention-importance correlation r=0.424.
Method, Eq. 3-5: final pooling weight T_i = λ1*S_i + λ2*H_i with temperature-softmax over hidden-state weighted sum; prediction head and joint CE+MSE loss adopted from EGTP (Eq. 6-8).
Experiments, Table 2: ESTP achieves lowest average MAE on all four backbones (e.g., Qwen2.5-3B avg 96.74 vs EGTP 112.45) but loses to EGTP on Qwen2.5-7B LongSeq (85.34 vs 81.72).
Ablation Analysis, Table 4: text claims ESTP 'achieves the best results in each of the three scenarios', but Semantic Pooling reports 100.10 on LongSeq vs ESTP 96.85, contradicting the claim.

End-to-End System Performance, Table 5: on Llama3.2-3B, Reasoning padding ratio drops from EGTP's 1.18 to 0.37 and LongSeq throughput rises from 30.74 to 48.45; the sub-1.0 padding ratio is not explained in the provided text (details deferred to appendix).
Conclusion: authors acknowledge the attention-based proxy is 'correlational, not causal' and closed-source applicability is limited by inaccessible activations.

Reproducibility Checklist 2.3-2.4 answers 'yes' to formal theorem statements and proofs, yet the paper contains no theorems or proofs; Experimental Settings reports seed 42 and a λ1:λ2 sweep from 1:9 to 9:1.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM serving/efficiency paper: predicts LLM output lengths by fusing token entropy with prefill attention-based semantic weights, then feeds a length-aware scheduler on vLLM. It squarely matches LLM (weight 2.5) and Inference & Serving (1.5) preferences, with secondary matches to Scaling & Efficiency, Long Context, and interpretability-adjacent attention analysis; it is not about reasoning, agents, or Japanese NLP methodology, so relevance is solid but not top-tier. Novelty is incremental: the soft-label head and entropy pooling are adopted from EGTP, and attention-as-importance is a well-worn proxy; the entropy-semantics misalignment diagnostic is the main new element. Rigor is mixed: four backbones, six baselines, ablations, hyperparameter sweeps, and a significance test are present, but the Ablation Analysis text claims 'best results in each of the three scenarios' while Table 4 shows semantic-only pooling beating ESTP on LongSeq (100.10 vs 96.85), Table 2 shows EGTP winning Qwen2.5-7B LongSeq, and the Reasoning padding ratio of 0.37 (<1) is unexplained in the provided text. The checklist asserts formal claims and proofs exist, but none appear in the paper. Evidence strength is moderate: consistent MAE gains (e.g., Qwen2.5-3B avg 96.74 vs EGTP 112.45, RL gains >20 points) and end-to-end throughput improvements, but small manual-annotation samples (120 instances), correlational validation (r=0.424), and appendix-deferred results limit confidence. Generalizability is decent across open models but the authors concede the attention proxy is correlational and closed-source models are inaccessible. Reproducibility is supported by fixed seed, public datasets, swept hyperparameters, and code-release claims.

primary_link.title: When Entropy Is Not Enough: Reclaiming Lost Semantics in LLM Output Length Prediction

papers.summary: Efficient LLM serving is often bottlenecked by the need to pad sequences to a fixed maximum length, and this wastes compute and degrades throughput. Predicting output lengths in advance makes it possible to adopt length-aware scheduling, and this reduces the overhead. This advantage is especially pronounced in long-context reasoning and reinforcement learning applications. Existing approaches, such as entropy-guided token pooling, use token-wise entropy as their primary signal, but they tend to
papers.summary_zh: LLM 服務常因批次內需填充至固定最大長度而浪費運算，預先準確預測輸出長度可支援長度感知排程。現有最佳方法 EGTP 僅以 token 熵作為池化權重，但熵反映生成不確定性而非語意重要性，導致關鍵實體與指令等低熵 token 被低估、無資訊的過渡 token 被過度放大。本文透過對 512 筆 RL 樣本的診斷證實此錯位：逾 20% 的高熵 token 語意不重要，而逾 20% 的低熵 token 卻語意關鍵。作者提出 ESTP（Entropy-and-Semantic Token Pooling），於 prefill 階段重用自我注意力權重計算語意重要性，與熵線性融合後經溫度縮放 softmax 產生池化權重，並沿用軟標籤分布回歸頭（交叉熵加 MSE）處理長度分布的重尾特性；因直接重用 prefill 激活值，額外記憶體與延遲開銷極小。在 ForeLen 基準的四個骨幹模型上，ESTP 平均 MAE 均最低（如 Qwen2.5-3B 由 EGTP 的 112.45 降至 96.74），RL 場景改善逾 20 點；與 vLLM 上的 SJF 排程器整合後，Reasoning 場景填充比例由 1.18 降至 0.37，吞吐量與 JCT 亦顯著改善。限制包括注意力代理屬相關性而非因果證據，且閉源模型因無法存取內部激活值而難以適用。此工作為長度感知 LLM 服務系統提供了輕量而實用的構件。
papers.title: When Entropy Is Not Enough: Reclaiming Lost Semantics in LLM Output Length Prediction
papers.title_zh: 當熵不夠用時：在 LLM 輸出長度預測中重拾遺失的語意

links.title: Breaking and Defending LLM-Powered Social Media Bot Detection Systems

evidence: Abstract: claims attacks achieve 'up to a 48% reduction in detection accuracy' and LSABRE maintains '86% detection accuracy'; code/dataset released at https://github.com/runi-cyber-ai/LSABRE
Table I (Section IV-C1): Llama baseline Acc 0.908, TPR 0.993, FPR 0.177; Mistral near-chance Acc 0.5195 with TPR 0.045; 6-month re-test shows declines (Gemma 0.8925→0.7945)
Table XVIII (Section IV-C2): Llama drops to 0.473 (reasoning), 0.5685 (safety), 0.421 (out-of-service) under injections, consistent with the ~48% claim; Gemma similarly 0.4605-0.4705
Table XVI (Section V, footnote 4): Ensemble Results Acc 0.8623, TPR 0.855, FPR 0.13033; detection averages explicitly exclude Mistral, an ad hoc choice
Section IV-A: experiments on 2,000 TwiBot20 users (1,000 bots, 1,000 humans), three 7-8B open models, temperature 0.0, Apple M3/36GB without GPU

Section III-C: defines Rewrite (zero-shot, few-shot, classifier-guidance, feature-engineered guidance) and Prompt Injection (reasoning, safety-alignment, out-of-service) attack families with formal success criterion (Eq. 1)
Section VI-A (Future Work): defenses evaluated only against zero-shot rewrites; few-shot/classifier/feature-guided rewrites and other platforms deferred, limiting demonstrated generalizability

Section IV-C3 and Tables VII-X: no single defense restores clean performance across all models/attacks; Known Answer defense for Llama reaches 0.9825 against safety injection, exceeding clean baseline, indicating defense-specific idiosyncrasies
llm_evaluation.rationale: A black-box study of inference-time attacks (content rewrites, prompt injections) and prompt-based defenses on LLM classifiers for Twitter bot detection. It matches core preference areas (LLMs, AI Safety/adversarial robustness, red teaming, prompting/ICL) rather than being a shallow domain application, though it is not about reasoning, Japanese NLP, or agents. Novelty is moderate: the rewrite and injection attacks largely adapt known techniques (building on 'What Does the Bot Say?' and the prompt-injection defense benchmark), the Feature-engineered Guidance Rewrite is an incremental twist, self-examination defenses are prompt-engineering variants, and LSABRE is a straightforward model-diversity ensemble. Rigor is mixed: systematic 3-model factorial evaluation with accuracy/TPR/FPR, temperature 0.0, and a 6-month re-test, but no significance testing or variance estimates, a near-chance Mistral baseline distorts averaged 'prediction scores', the ensemble evaluation excludes Mistral from detection averages (footnote 4), and no ablation isolates ensemble components or compares against a simple majority-vote/hardened-single-model baseline. Evidence: headline numbers are traceable to tables (Llama 0.908 baseline; 0.421-0.473 under injections supports ~48% degradation; Table XVI reports ensemble Acc 0.8623, FPR 0.13033), but the 'adaptive adversarial attacks' framing is not demonstrated (attacks were not iterated against the defense), and LSABRE's 86% under attack lacks a like-for-like baseline comparison. Generalizability is limited to one dataset (2,000 TwiBot20 users) and one classification task; broader claims (phishing, fraud, other platforms) are asserted in the abstract but untested, and defense evaluation is restricted to zero-shot rewrites (Section VI-A). Reproducibility benefits from a public GitHub release, detailed prompt templates (Appendix VII-A), named 7-8B models, hardware, and cost/latency formulas (Appendix VII-C), though no seed/variance protocol is given.

primary_link.title: Breaking and Defending LLM-Powered Social Media Bot Detection Systems

papers.summary: The rise of social media bots poses a persistent threat, enabling misinformation, opinion manipulation, and the erosion of trust in online platforms. To combat this, machine learning systems have been developed to detect and limit bot activity, but attackers continuously adapt through techniques such as adversarial learning and behavior imitation, fueling an ongoing arms race between bots and detection tools. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have significantly improved bot detecti
papers.summary_zh: 社群媒體機器人長期散布假訊息並操弄輿論,近期防護逐漸轉向以大型語言模型(LLM)為核心的偵測系統,但此類系統同時帶來新的攻擊面。本文以 Twitter 機器人偵測為例,系統性研究 LLM 安全應用的攻擊與防禦。作者建立威脅模型與攻擊分類,區分內容操弄(Content Manipulation)與 LLM 操弄(LLM Manipulation)兩大類,並提出新攻擊方法 Feature-engineered Guidance Rewrite,利用情感、主題等特徵引導改寫貼文以規避偵測;另設計推理注入、安全對齊注入與癱瘓服務等提示注入攻擊。實驗採用 Mistral-7B、Llama-3-8B 與 Gemma-7B,在 TwiBot20 的 2,000 個帳號上評估,顯示攻擊最多可降低 48% 偵測準確率,其中推理式注入最有效,Mistral 是最強攻擊者,Llama 則最穩健。防禦方面,作者比較自檢(self-examination)、ICL、特徵引導、分隔符與 Known Answer 等策略,發現沒有任何單一方法能同時抵擋所有攻擊,因此提出多模型集成架構 LSABRE,結合偵測層、防護層與分類層,在適應性攻擊下仍維持約 86% 準確率與約 13% 誤報率。研究限制包括僅考量黑箱單輪推論情境、防禦評估聚焦零樣本改寫,且未使用 GPU 加速。此成果可延伸至釣魚偵測、垃圾郵件分類與詐騙分析等 LLM 安全應用,對產業部署具重要參考價值。

links.title: When Less Is Enough: Context Selection and Prompting Strategies for Bengali News Headline Generation

evidence: Abstract/Section 3: study uses Gemini-2.0-Flash, Llama-3.3-70B, GPT-4o to examine context selection, BNaP vs XLP prompting, MultiGen enrichment, and zero- to three-shot ICL on Bengali headline generation.

Section 4.1.2, Table 2: Gemini best with paragraph_1 (BERTScore 0.727, CI 0.722-0.732) vs full article 0.719, paired improvement 0.0078 (p=0.0011); Llama best with paragraph_1→3 (0.755 vs 0.754 full, p=0.82, not significant).
Section 4.1.2, Table 3: first-three-paragraph conditioning cuts mean input tokens from 1011.60 to 479.35 (52.6% reduction; 65.1% for articles with >3 paragraphs) on the BeliN test set.
Section 4.2.1, Table 4: Gemini BERTScore rises 0.720→0.760 zero-shot to three-shot (p<0.001), most gain from one demonstration; Llama one-shot gain over zero-shot not significant (Δ=0.0056, p=0.252).
Section 4.3.1, Table 5: XLP+MultiGen gives significant BERTScore gains over BNaP+MultiGen for Llama (Δ=0.012, p=0.0038) and Gemini (Δ=0.011, p=0.003); GPT-4o shows the opposite trend.

Section 4.4, Table 6: Gemini XLP+MultiGen 3-shot reaches BERTScore 0.769/ROUGE-L 0.292/METEOR 0.244 vs best fine-tuned BanglaT5 0.751/0.242/0.167 reproduced from Osama et al. (2025); authors note scale and pretraining confounds.
Section 4.5, Table 7: on Shironaam (n=15,012), Gemini BERTScore 0.810 vs fine-tuned BERT2BERT 0.831, but Gemini higher BLEU (0.373 vs 0.318).

Section 4.6 Limitations: authors acknowledge no large-scale human assessment, sensitivity to demonstration selection/ordering and run-to-run variation, and no repeated-run ablations; no code or output release is mentioned anywhere in the document.
Section 3.6: fixed decoding (temperature 0.7, top-p 0.9, max 50 tokens), shared random demonstrations across models, o200k_base tokenizer for input-length analysis.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A systematic empirical study of context selection, prompt language, contextual enrichment, and few-shot ICL for Bengali headline generation using Gemini-2.0-Flash, Llama-3.3-70B, and GPT-4o. Strong preference alignment with LLM (2.5), prompting/ICL (1.5), NLP (1.5), and long-context (1.8) preferences, though no Japanese-language relevance. The methodology is language-focused (prompting and context utilization), so it stays in scope. Rigor is above average: fixed decoding settings, Wilcoxon signed-rank tests with BCa bootstrap CIs over 10,000 resamples (Section 3.6), and a second-benchmark transfer test (Section 4.5). However, novelty is limited: the lead-paragraph/inverted-pyramid effect and lost-in-the-middle context degradation are established findings (Sections 2.3, 4.1.2), and the contribution is a characterization of known phenomena in a low-resource setting. Effect sizes are small (e.g., Llama full-context vs 3-paragraph difference not significant, p=0.82, Section 4.1.2), the fine-tuned-baseline comparison is confounded by model scale (Section 4.4), there is no human evaluation, no repeated-run ablation, and no code release. Reproducibility is moderate: public datasets (BeliN, Shironaam), full prompt templates (Appendix B), and disclosed hyperparameters, but reliance on proprietary model versions with single stochastic runs.

primary_link.title: When Less Is Enough: Context Selection and Prompting Strategies for Bengali News Headline Generation

papers.summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong performance in text generation tasks, yet their effectiveness on headline generation remains sensitive to how input context is selected and presented. In this work, we investigate Bengali news headline generation as a document-level generation task that requires effective selection and presentation of salient contextual information from long-form articles. Using Gemini-2.0-Flash, Llama-3.3-70B, and GPT-4o, we systematically study the effects of cont
papers.summary_zh: 以 LLM 為低資源語言生成新聞標題時,輸入脈絡的選擇與提示設計往往比加大篇幅更關鍵。本文聚焦孟加拉文新聞標題生成,探討選擇性脈絡條件化與提示策略的影響。作者先用 banBERT 句向量計算標題與各段落的餘弦相似度,發現 56.48% 文章的首段與參考標題語意最對齊,前三段累積涵蓋約 76%,據此提出只餵入文章前 k 段的策略。研究比較孟加拉語原生提示(BNaP)與跨語言提示(XLP,英文指令搭配孟加拉文內容),並在 Baseline 與加入情感、類別、面向等輔助資訊的 MultiGen 模板下,測試 Gemini-2.0-Flash、Llama-3.3-70B 與 GPT-4o 於零樣本至三樣本設定的表現。結果顯示:Gemini 僅用首段最佳(BERTScore 0.727),Llama 以前三段最佳(0.755),輸入長度可減少約 52.6% 而效能不減;少樣本示範對 Gemini 助益明顯,一次示範即獲取大部分增益,Llama 則變化有限;XLP 通常優於 BNaP,XLP+MultiGen 讓 Gemini 達 0.769,超越先前以 fine-tuning 訓練的 BanglaT5。但在 Shironaam 資料集上,經監督式 fine-tuning 的 BERT2BERT 仍略勝一籌,僅 BLEU 落後。限制包括模型數量有限、僅採自動指標、示範選取為隨機抽樣。此研究為多語言與低資源 LLM 應用提供務實指引:應重視脈絡相關性與提示設計,而非單純增加輸入長度。
papers.title: When Less Is Enough: Context Selection and Prompting Strategies for Bengali News Headline Generation

links.title: Ask to Be Sure: Informative Interactions for Confident Multi-Turn LLM Recommendation

evidence: Sec. 3.1-3.2 (Eqs. 1-9): Shannon and log-decay weighted entropy over n=5 sampled top-m=5 lists; turn-level and conversation-level entropy reduction defined as information gain
Sec. 4.2: same generated preference pairs relabeled for each reward variant; matched SFT data budget (top 801 INSPIRED / 8631 ReDial conversations) isolates reward effect
Table 1: DPO (Turn Entropy) best INSPIRED Hit@1 3.32±0.12% vs DPO (CollabLLM) 3.15±0.34%; DPO (Conv Entropy) best ReDial simulated hit 32.83±0.31% with fewest turns 2.74
Sec. 4.1: RL-based CRS methods (Deng et al. 2021; Du et al. 2025) not compared, justified by incompatible action spaces and metrics
Sec. 4.6 Limitations: automatic metrics plus LLM user simulator only, no human evaluation; fixed m=n=5; assumes base LLM can name candidate items without retrieval
Sec. 3.3/Fig. 2: mean recommendation entropy decreases over 300 INSPIRED conversations with weighted trend of -0.040 bits per turn
Sec. 4.2: all experiments use Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct with LoRA, assistant temperature 0.1, averaged over three runs; user simulator is Claude Sonnet 4 role-playing from reference conversations
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM-centric methodology paper: it defines entropy over sampled top-m recommendation lists as an uncertainty estimate (Sec. 3.1, Eqs. 1-7) and uses its turn/conversation-level reduction as a ground-truth-free reward to select SFT data and relabel DPO pairs (Sec. 3.4, Sec. 4.2). This is squarely within LLM training/alignment preferences (SFT, DPO, reward design, multi-turn dialogue). Novelty is incremental: the entropy estimator is adapted from Kweon et al. (2025) and the data-generation pipeline is borrowed from CollabLLM (Wu et al., 2025); the new element is the entropy-reduction reward replacing LLM-judge interactivity. Rigor is moderate: comparisons are well controlled (same generated preference pairs relabeled per reward, matched SFT budget, LoRA, 3 runs with std), and a 300-conversation entropy-trend analysis motivates the method (Fig. 2), but absolute gains are small (INSPIRED Hit@1 3.32 vs 3.15; simulated hit 27.94 vs 26.60), no significance tests, small test sets (228/3552 partial conversations), one 1B model, and RL-based CRS baselines are excluded (Sec. 4.1). Limitations are honestly stated (Sec. 4.6): LLM user simulator only, no human eval, fixed m=n=5, assumption that the base LLM can name catalog items. Reproducibility is hampered by no explicit code release and dependence on a commercial simulator (Claude Sonnet 4), though datasets, prompts, and Algorithm 1 are described in enough detail to attempt replication.

primary_link.title: Ask to Be Sure: Informative Interactions for Confident Multi-Turn LLM Recommendation

papers.summary: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have enabled their use as conversational recommender systems (CRS), demonstrating strong recommendation accuracy and natural dialogue. However, guiding multi-turn interactions to elicit user preferences effectively remains challenging. Existing approaches either use separate reinforcement learning agents with templated interactions or optimize for interactivity judged by another LLM, without measuring how much useful information is actually gained.
papers.summary_zh: 對話式推薦系統(CRS)近年改以大型語言模型直接擔任推薦者,但如何引導多輪互動、有效引出使用者偏好仍是難題。既有做法多以強化學習代理搭配制式化選項提問,或以另一個 LLM 評分互動性,卻未衡量互動實際帶來多少有用資訊。本文提出以不確定性的下降來量化每次互動的成效:對固定對話重複取樣前 m 個推薦清單,計算依排名位置以對數衰減加權的熵,並定義輪次級與對話級熵減作為獎勵,無需依賴真實答案標註。該獎勵用於篩選 SFT 訓練範例,或為 DPO 標註偏好配對。實驗在 INSPIRED 與 ReDial 電影對話推薦資料集上,以 Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct 進行 LoRA fine-tuning,並用 Claude Sonnet 4 模擬使用者,與 vanilla、SFT(Raw)及 CollabLLM 獎勵比較。結果顯示,300 段對話的平均推薦熵隨輪次遞減;DPO(Turn Entropy)在 INSPIRED 上取得最佳 Hit@1(3.32%)、Hit@5(5.21%)與模擬對話命中率(27.94%),同時減少觸及目標電影所需輪次。限制在於僅採自動指標與 LLM 模擬使用者、取樣參數固定為 m=n=5,且假設模型能直接說出候選片名,動態目錄情境需結合檢索。此方法將對話策略與資訊增益對齊,為缺乏標註資料的實務情境提供可行方案。

links.title: Propaganda Forensics: Recovering the Generation Pipeline of an AI-Driven Influence Campaign

evidence: Section 5.1: prompt instruction leaks detected on '50 out of the 84 PROPAGIA websites', including a verbatim ten-point editorial checklist (Figure 5) directing condemnation of Macron/Zelensky and positive Putin framing.

Section 6.1: mixed ANOVA shows corpus main effect F(1,5013)=111.30 and corpus x model interaction F(6,30078)=165.57; the RAIDAR asymmetry holds for 5 of 7 models including non-suspected Mistral and Zephyr, which the authors note 'suggests a shared signal... rather than unique family identification'.
Section 5.2 and Table 1: ~10% of PROPAGIA vs 2.5% of SIPA articles share >50% sentences with another article; mean quotation score .11 (PROPAGIA) vs .32 (SIPA).

Section 3.1: PROPAGIA (2,646 articles, 84 impersonating sites) is released at github.com/lip6-trustednews/propagia, while the 2,385-article SIPA comparison corpus is 'restricted for copyright reasons'.

Limitations: leak detection relies on a single model (Qwen3.6-35B-Thinking) 'not benchmarked against human-annotated ground truth', and the SIPA-PROPAGIA contrast 'varies along several dimensions at once' (authorship, intent, 12 vs 84 sources).
Appendix G: RAIDAR attribution required a mean of 95.5 GPU hours per candidate rewriting model, bounding how many families could be tested.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An NLP forensics study squarely within LLM scope: detection and black-box attribution of LLM-generated propaganda, leaked-prompt analysis, and manipulation/persuasion markers map onto the LLM, AI Safety, NLP, and Prompting preferences, though it touches no Japanese NLP, agents, code, or reasoning methodology. Novelty is moderate: the real-campaign PROPAGIA corpus and the instruction-to-corpus-evidence matching are new, but the pipeline assembles existing tools (VAGO, BERTopic, RAIDAR) without new detection methodology. Rigor is decent (large samples, ANOVA/Welch tests with Bonferroni, multi-model sentiment triangulation) but weakened by confounded SIPA-vs-PROPAGIA comparison, a single unvalidated leak-detection model, and a low-quality topic model (silhouette 0.2281). Evidence is strong that texts are LLM-generated (verbatim 10-point instruction checklist, leaks on 50/84 sites, redundancy 10% vs 2.5%) but weak for attribution: the RAIDAR signature holds for 5/7 models including non-suspected Mistral and Zephyr, so the method cannot uniquely identify the family, as the authors concede. Analyses are partly French-language-bound; PROPAGIA and prompts are released while SIPA is restricted, supporting moderate reproducibility.

For comparison, we rely on SIPA, a corpus of human-written French mainstream press from the same period. Using topic modeling, vagueness and sentiment analysis, we first isolate persuasion techniques characteristic of propaganda, with PROPAGI
papers.summary_zh: 本文針對 AI 驅動的影響力操作進行「宣傳鑑識」,目標有三:辨識宣傳新聞的語言標記、證明文本由 LLM 生成,並在黑箱情境下推斷生成模型家族。作者建立 PROPAGIA 語料庫,收錄 VIGINUM 與 INSIKT GROUP 揭露之 Storm-1516/CopyCop 行動的 2,646 篇法語文章,並與 SIPA Ouest-France 提供、經人工撰寫的 2,385 篇主流報導對照。分析方法涵蓋 BERTopic 主題建模、VAGO 模糊與主觀性評分、引用比例計算、多模型情感分析、跨文章冗餘度,以及運用 Qwen3.6-35B-thinking 的提示洩漏偵測。結果顯示 PROPAGIA 顯著更模糊、更主觀、更負面且引用來源更少;在 84 個假冒網站中,有 50 個偵測到提示指令洩漏,包括一份逐字的十點編輯規格清單(譴責馬克宏與澤倫斯基、正面描述普丁等),約 10% 文章與其他文章有逾半句子重疊。進一步以 RAIDAR 改寫法比對七個模型,支持 INSIKT 對 Llama 3 家族(含 dolphin、Lexi 等 uncensored fine-tuning 版本)的歸因,但也出現 Mistral 家族訊號,顯示可辨識的是模型家族層級而非單一模型。限制包括人寫與生成來源等多重混淆變數、主題輪廓係數偏低、洩漏偵測僅用單一模型,且 RAIDAR 每個模型平均需約 95.5 GPU 小時。作者公開 PROPAGIA 語料庫,對偵測生成式 AI 宣傳與媒體鑑識研究極具價值。

links.title: Can Retrievers Find the Same Paper from Different Aspects? A Multi-Aspect Full-Paper Scientific Retrieval Benchmark

evidence: Abstract and Table 5: strongest model GritLM-7B reaches 98.1% AnyAspect@20 but only 15.7% AllAspect@20, the paper's central multi-aspect consistency gap.
Table 3: benchmark scale of 2,095 queries, 210 positive ICLR 2026 papers, and 73,973-paper corpus (23,739 hard negatives, 50,024 normal negatives).
Section 3.3.1 and Table 4: blinded pairwise realism comparison shows 78.0% ties vs human-written queries with Cohen's kappa of only 0.24; kappa 0.78 vs fully LLM-generated queries.
Section 3.3.1 and Appendix D.2: 96.7% of 150 sampled query-paper pairs judged relevant by experts, with five-annotator pool described in Appendix D.
Table 6 (Section 5.1.1): GritLM-7B achieves 60.0 R@20 on MAPLE-1Q single-query setting vs 15.7 AllAspect@20 on full MAPLE, isolating the multi-aspect difficulty.
Section 5.2 and Figure 3: experiment-referenced and table-referenced queries are hardest across retrievers; more semantic constraints do not monotonically hurt dense retrievers.
Table 13 (Section 5.3): PDF screenshots with top-3 average pooling raise AllAspect@20 to 24.76 and Experiment/Result R@20 to 66.91 for the evaluated multimodal setup.
Reproducibility section: data released at huggingface.co/datasets/kai-02/MAPLE and evaluation code at github.com/Ggballs/MAPLE, with prompts in Appendix C and retriever checkpoints in Table 10.
Limitations and Future Work: scope restricted to ICLR 2026 ML/computer-science papers and a small human-written exemplar pool, limiting domain and language generalization.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A retrieval/IR benchmark paper squarely within NLP and retrieval (RAG-adjacent) scope, not in the excluded pure-CV/domain-application categories. It matches mid-weight preferences (retrieval/dense embeddings, benchmark/evaluation, datasets, retrieval-based ICL, partial multimodal and long-context coverage) and uses LLMs (GPT-5, DeepSeek-V4) as generation/validation tools, but substantively misses the highest-weighted preferences (LLM methodology, Japanese NLP, reasoning, agents). Novelty is genuine but incremental: the many-queries-per-paper consistency framing (AllAspect/AnyAspect) and OpenReview-grounded retrieval-ICL query synthesis extend rather than replace existing single-query benchmarks like LitSearch and aspect-based DORIS-MAE. Rigor is solid: 9 retrievers across 4 families, paper- and query-level metrics, representation ablations (chunking/pooling/OCR/screenshots), blinded expert realism checks with kappa, and failure analysis by evidence source and constraint count. Evidence supports the central gap claim, though the benchmark rests on synthetic LLM-generated queries validated on only 150 sampled pairs with low inter-annotator agreement, and LLM-validated hard negatives risk noise. Generalizability is limited to ICLR 2026 ML/CS papers per the stated limitations. Reproducibility is strong with public data, code, prompts, and checkpoints.

primary_link.title: Can Retrievers Find the Same Paper from Different Aspects? A Multi-Aspect Full-Paper Scientific Retrieval Benchmark

To bridge this gap, we introduce MAPLE, an expert-validated benchmark for multi-aspect, full-paper retrieval that evaluates whether retrievers can consistently recover the same paper from queries targeting its motivation, method, and experimental findings. MAPLE contains 2,095
papers.summary_zh: 科學論文檢索基準大多假設每篇論文僅對應單一查詢,但研究者實際上會從研究動機、方法設計、實驗結果等不同面向搜尋同一篇論文。本文提出MAPLE,首個經專家驗證的多面向全文科學檢索基準,包含2,095則針對210篇ICLR 2026機器學習論文的細粒度查詢,語料庫達73,973篇論文,並涵蓋文字與多模態(表格、圖表)證據。為規模化產生擬真查詢,作者設計MAPLE-Synth管線:先將OpenReview審稿討論摘要為面向要點,再以檢索式in-context學習引用人類撰寫的查詢範例引導LLM生成,並透過去脈絡化過濾剔除與標題摘要高度重疊的查詢。專家評估顯示96.7%樣本查詢與論文相關,擬真度與人類查詢相當。實驗涵蓋詞彙、科學領域、通用文本與多模態檢索器:最強的GritLM-7B達98.1% AnyAspect@20,卻僅15.7% AllAspect@20,顯示檢索器常能從單一面向命中論文,卻無法在所有面向一致找回同一篇論文;實驗結果類與表格引用類查詢特別困難。以top-3平均池化的多區塊聚合可改善表現,但失敗仍明顯。限制在於僅涵蓋機器學習與電腦科學論文,人類查詢範例庫規模偏小。此基準揭露了現有單查詢評估無法察覺的跨面向失敗模式,是發展更全面科學檢索器的重要測試平台。

links.title: Large Models for Small Devices: Recent Advances and Empirical Analysis of Edge AI Deployment

evidence: Abstract: Qwen3.5 0.8B reaches 93.85 SQuAD F1 and 92 EM under Q5_K_M quantization, while structured pruning at the same precision costs 16 F1 at a 1% ratio; segmentation ranking reverses with pruning cutting size ~80% at near-constant mIoU.

Section 4.2.2: every recovery run uses rank-8 LoRA adapters (alpha=16, dropout 0.05) on gate/up/down projections, 100 optimizer steps at lr 2e-4 on WikiText-2, with only 0.35-0.50% of parameters trainable.

Section 5.1.4 (Table 4): quality is non-monotone in bit width on 100 fixed-prompt items - TinyLlama and Gemma baselines score best at Q4_K_M (quality means 46.44 and 47.35), while Qwen peaks at Q5_K_M (59.68).

Section 6.3 (Table 9): token-weighted per-token decode time rises in all 18 matched baseline-versus-pruned pairs (Gemma +168.5% tokens vs +6.1-6.2% per token; TinyLlama +24.7-25.7% per token), and pruned Q4_K_M weights grow from 507.85 to 612.06 MB (+21%) due to 24 of 320 tensors falling back to higher precision.

Section 6.2 (Table 7): a Qwen2.5 1.5B +LoRA (1% pruning) configuration holds 71% strict BoolQ accuracy while predicting yes on 97/100 samples at 52.6% balanced accuracy; no collapsed configuration exceeds 54.3% balanced accuracy.

Note under Table 3 and Section 5.1.1: Raspberry Pi baseline and pruned rows come from separate campaigns with uncontrolled prompt templates; a template-only change reproduces 38.16 of the 38.85-point GPU-to-Pi SQuAD difference for TinyLlama.

Section 6.1 (Table 8): the fixed-activation distortion measure rank-matches SQuAD F1 drops for Qwen3.5 (Spearman 1.0 across four ratios, permutation p floor 0.083) but is explicitly a within-family diagnostic, not a cross-model predictor.

Footnote 3 / Section 4.1: experiment code and artifacts are open-sourced on GitHub; platforms (RTX 4070 laptop, Ryzen 9 7940HS, Raspberry Pi 4B 8GB) and llama.cpp GGUF serving with Q4_K_M primary target are specified.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM efficiency/deployment work: it prunes, LoRA-recovers, and GGUF-quantizes three ~1B LLMs (Qwen3.5, Gemma 3, TinyLlama) and serves them via llama.cpp on GPU, CPU, and Raspberry Pi across SQuAD/BoolQ/NQ, matching the LLM, Scaling & Efficiency, and Inference & Serving preferences while missing the other top-weight areas (Japanese LLM/NLP, reasoning, agents). Novelty is incremental: the prefill/decode split and gradient-free sensitivity distortion measures build on established work, though the GGUF k-quant super-block misalignment artifact (+21-49% deployed size after pruning) and prior-collapse reporting on BoolQ are useful practical observations. Rigor is mixed: unusually candid confound handling (prompt-template sweep quantifying a 38-point swing, separating controlled from uncontrolled campaigns, balanced accuracy for collapse detection), but only 100-item evaluation sets, near-floor NQ baselines (F1 ~8-10) that weaken NQ conclusions, a very light 100-step WikiText-2 LoRA protocol that may understate recoverability, and n=4 rank correlations with a permutation p-floor of 0.083. Evidence is extensive and quantitative (Tables 3-9, 18 matched serving-log pairs for the decode slowdown). Generalizability is bounded by three model families, one GGUF runtime, and explicitly task/model/hardware-dependent conclusions; reproducibility is aided by open-sourced code and detailed adapter hyperparameters.

primary_link.title: Large Models for Small Devices: Recent Advances and Empirical Analysis of Edge AI Deployment

papers.summary: Running large AI models on resource-constrained edge devices requires model compression to reduce model size and computation. What compresses well, however, need not deploy well. We survey dozens of recent works that report compression results on real hardware and extract practical deployment guidelines from them. Following these guidelines, we deploy compact language and image models on GPU, CPU, and Raspberry Pi platforms across question answering and image segmentation. No single technique wi
papers.summary_zh: 將大型模型部署到資源受限的邊緣裝置仰賴模型壓縮,但壓縮得好不代表部署得好。本文結合調查與實證研究:前者整理數十篇在真實硬體上量測壓縮結果的近期工作,萃取部署準則;後者在GPU、CPU與Raspberry Pi上部署約1B參數的語言模型(Gemma 3 1B、TinyLlama 1.1B、Qwen3.5 0.8B)與語意分割模型,評估結構化剪枝、GGUF量化與LoRA恢復。關鍵發現包括:(1)剪枝引發的遺忘——僅剪除1% MLP通道即大幅損失SQuAD F1,LoRA恢復只能部分補回且在任務間不一致;(2)剪枝破壞k-quant GGUF超區塊對齊,使可部署權重膨脹21–49%,加上輸出更冗長,讓Raspberry Pi延遲最高增加3.4倍,作者以prefill(計算受限)與decode(記憶體頻寬受限)兩階段分解解釋此現象;(3)BoolQ上的先驗崩塌——模型維持可解析且71%嚴格準確率,卻將97/100預測送往單一類別,平衡準確率僅52.6%;(4)分割模型上預設量化幾乎不產生壓縮,剪枝則可減少近80%模型大小。作者據此提供依任務、模型與硬體選擇技術的部署建議,並主張部署應分階段重新選模。限制包括部分Raspberry Pi比較存在提示詞未受控的干擾,涵蓋領域亦有限。此研究對AIoT實務極具參考價值。

links.title: Spectral Saliency for Machine Unlearning

evidence: Abstract & Sec 1: proposes Spectral Saliency Unlearning (SSU), thresholding weak singular components of the unlearning gradient inspired by Muon, evaluated on image classifiers, diffusion models, and LLMs.

Sec 5.3 & Tab 4: TOFU benchmark with Llama2-7B; SSU on ME+GD raises forget01 avg 0.8201->0.8538 and forget10 0.8409->0.8519, but forget05 untargeted MU drops 0.7521->0.7277 and avg slightly declines 0.8391->0.8342.
Sec 5.1 & Tab 1: CIFAR-10 ResNet-18 10% random unlearning; SSU lowers average gap vs retrain from SalUn's 1.11 to 0.77 with comparable time (2.62 vs 2.61).

Sec 4.3 (Limitations): theory is 'a characterization of the forgetting-retention trade-off rather than a complete quantitative prediction of end-to-end unlearning performance'; alignment-aware thresholding not implemented due to overhead.
Sec 5.4, Tabs 5-6: ablations over keep ratio (0.30 best avg-gap setting) and SVD-applied weight selection (cross-attention only achieves best FID 1.24 on Stable Diffusion).

Appx B: 'The code will be open-sourced upon the acceptance of this paper'; hyperparameters (e.g., gamma=0.30, gamma=0.50, alpha_qkv=0.20) chosen by grid search; no seeds or variance reported for main tables.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A general optimizer-level contribution (Muon/SignSGD-inspired singular value thresholding of the unlearning gradient) with theory and experiments across image classification, diffusion models, and LLM unlearning. It is not out-of-scope (not pure CV/diffusion: Sec 5.3 runs real LLM unlearning on TOFU with Llama2-7B), but the LLM content is one of three experiment sections and the core identity is machine unlearning, an optimization/privacy topic only moderately aligned with the LLM/agent-centered preference profile. Novelty is moderate: SVD-based unlearning and subspace projection methods exist (Sec 6 cites SEMU, GRU, etc.); the fresh elements are the spectral-saliency framing and first theory for SalUn-style masking (Props 4.2-4.4, Appx A). Rigor is decent: stated assumptions, proofs in Appx A, multiple baselines, and ablations (Tabs 5-6), though the theory is explicitly only directional (Sec 4.3 admits no end-to-end guarantees), keep ratios are grid-searched heuristics, and no seeds/variance are reported. Evidence is consistent but modest and mixed in places (Tab 4: forget05 untargeted MU drops 0.7521->0.7277; TOFU avg gains ~0.01-0.03), with no released code (Appx B: code 'will be open-sourced upon acceptance').

primary_link.title: Spectral Saliency for Machine Unlearning

papers.summary: Machine unlearning (MU) aims to remove the influence of specific training data while preserving model utility. As the name suggests, MU can be viewed as the inverse of learning, using gradient-based updates to reduce the influence of a forget-set by counteracting the previously learned behavior. Recently, Muon, a gradient descent variant, has been introduced. Muon applies spectral magnitude normalization to encourage exploration of rare directions and demonstrates promising performance. Inspired
papers.summary_zh: 機器遺忘旨在移除特定訓練資料對模型的影響,同時保留模型效用。受最佳化器Muon的頻譜正規化啟發,本文提出頻譜顯著性遺忘法SSU:對遺忘梯度做SVD,以保留比例γ對較弱的奇異值成分做門檻篩選,僅沿具信心訊號的主奇異方向更新,可直接套用於一般梯度式遺忘方法。理論上,作者由遺忘—保留權衡切入,證明弱奇異方向常對應遺忘與保留梯度的負對齊衝突,沿其更新必然顧此失彼,壓抑這些方向可減輕效用退化;此分析亦延伸解釋了SalUn座標遮罩為何有效。實驗橫跨三類任務:CIFAR-10上ResNet-18隨機遺忘,SSU將SalUn的平均差距由1.11降至0.77;DDPM類別遺忘在完全遺忘的同時將FID降至15.19–16.32;Stable Diffusion於Imagenette平均FID達1.24,優於SalUn(1.55)與ESD(1.71);LLM方面在TOFU基準以Llama2-7B搭配ME+GD與IDK+AP皆穩定提升效用與遺忘效率。消融顯示分類任務保留比例0.3最佳,Stable Diffusion以僅對cross-attention層做SVD的取捨最佳。限制是理論刻畫權衡而非端到端效能保證,更細粒度的對齊式準則亦有額外運算成本。SSU為遺忘方法提供了具原則性的頻譜視角與廣泛增益。

links.title: Who Leads Now? Token-Level Modality Arbitration for Chart-to-Code Generation

evidence: Abstract and Introduction: proposes MoCA/CAB with 'a lightweight arbiter that arbitrates their relative contributions at every layer and generated token', contrasting with static parameter-space merging.
Methodology, Branch Initialization: visual branch initialized from Qwen2.5-VL-7B FFN parameters, code branch from Qwen2.5-Coder-7B FFN parameters.

Methodology, Multi-Dimensional Rewards Optimization: GRPO with five rewards (format, consistency, structural/AST, execution, visual); 'detailed configuration is provided in the supplementary material'.

Overall Performance, Table 1: MoCA scores ChartMimic Exec 88.83 / Low-Level 75.13 / High-Level 73.48, Plot2Code Code Pass 87.88 / Text Match 41.07 / GPT-4o Score 4.45, ChartX GPT Score 2.44; Text Match trails Qwen2.5-VL-72B (41.90) and ChartX trails GLM-4.6V (2.47).

Ablation Study, Table 3: Visual+Visual SFT+RL variant reaches 85.26/37.48/3.94 vs MoCA 87.88/41.07/4.45; static merging (VisCodex) 70.45/31.86/3.15; fixed branch weights 86.74/39.82/4.26 — supporting claims that gains come from complementary initialization plus arbitration.

Visualization of Arbitration Behavior, Instance-Level: authors concede the visualization 'contains only one pair of samples... an illustrative case rather than a comprehensive measure of input adaptivity'.

Experimental Settings, Efficient Training: SFT 1 epoch on 8 H200 GPUs (lr 1e-5, batch 64); RL 3 epochs on 32 H200 GPUs (lr 1e-6, 8 responses per prompt); custom QKV sharding/SwiGLU kernels with vLLM — but no code or data release is stated.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A multimodal LLM + code-generation paper (Qwen2.5-VL/Coder backbone, GRPO RL, self-distilled reasoning trajectories) that fits multiple high-weight preferences (LLMs, code generation, reasoning/CoT, multimodal AI, RL, training), though the chart-to-code task itself is a fairly narrow application niche. Novelty is moderate: token-level input-conditioned arbitration between two branch FFNs is a sensible advance over static model merging (VisCodex), but dynamic/input-dependent merging and dual-expert routing are well-explored ideas, and the SoT + multi-reward RL recipe closely follows ChartCoder/ChartMaster-style precedents. Rigor is decent: three benchmarks, general-domain and chart-specialized baselines, and parameter-matched ablations (Visual+Visual, static merging, fixed weights) isolate the contribution of arbitration. Evidence is solid but weakened by single-benchmark ablations, no variance/significance reporting, an admitted 'illustrative' two-sample arbitration visualization, a small self-distillation comparison (80.30→83.33), a mediocre ChartX GPT score (2.44/5), and a minor miscount of 'best on four of seven' metrics (Table 1 shows five). Generalizability is untested beyond chart-to-code, and the method doubles FFN capacity; no code release is claimed and reward details are deferred to supplementary material, limiting reproducibility despite clear hyperparameters.

primary_link.title: Who Leads Now? Token-Level Modality Arbitration for Chart-to-Code Generation

papers.summary: Chart-to-code generation requires a model to read the fine-grained visual details of a chart and write executable code that reproduces it. Existing chart-to-code methods either train visual and coding abilities separately, or fine-tune on chart-to-code data with the two abilities entangled. Neither strategy accounts for the distinct nature of the two abilities or the interference that arises when they are optimized together. We propose MoCA (Mixture of Cross-modal Arbitration), which separates t
papers.summary_zh: 圖表轉程式碼生成要求模型讀懂圖表的細粒度視覺細節,並寫出可重現該圖的執行程式。不同輸入對視覺定位與程式生成的需求並不均等,但既有方法不是分開訓練兩種能力,就是在微調時將兩者糾纏在一起。本文提出MoCA,以跨模態仲裁區塊CAB維持視覺分支(初始化自Qwen2.5-VL-7B的FFN)與程式分支(初始化自Qwen2.5-Coder-7B),並由輕量仲裁器在每一層、每個生成token依隱藏表示動態預測兩分支權重。訓練採兩階段:先以自我蒸餾的SoT推理軌跡進行SFT,再以GRPO進行強化學習,獎勵涵蓋格式、推理一致性、結構、執行有效性與視覺相似五個維度。在ChartMimic、Plot2Code與ChartX三項基準上,MoCA執行率達88.83,多項指標領先通用與圖表專精模型;分析顯示仲裁器學到結構化的分配模式,權重隨token、層與實例系統性變化,而非任意或固定。消融證實增益並非僅來自參數量增加:互補的分支初始化與輸入條件化仲裁皆不可或缺,靜態合併(VisCodex式)與固定權重均明顯較差。限制包括實例級視覺化僅呈現一對樣本,且雙分支架構增加參數。本工作凸顯跨模態能力協調對多模態生成任務的重要性。

links.title: SchurQuant: Groupwise Discrete Optimization for Layer-Wise LLM Quantization

evidence: Abstract/Sec 1: 'SchurOpt improves mean zero-shot accuracy on 2-bit Qwen3-4B by 11.88 percentage points (pp)' with GPTQ objective fixed; Table 4 confirms PPL 258.96 -> 81.95 and accuracy 36.77 -> 48.65 under the identical objective.

Sec 4.4 Table 3: controlled ablation on Qwen3-4B at 2 bits shows Schur conditioning (vs Raw) reduces controlled layer loss 0.872% -> 0.550% and PPL 152.95 -> 86.64 with refitting applied to both curvatures, supporting the claim that gains are not from coordinate descent or grid refit alone.

Sec 4.5 Table 4: at 3 and 4 bits the SchurOpt optimizer with the GPTQ objective worsens PPL (15.79 -> 21.26 at 3 bits; 14.16 -> 15.52 at 4 bits) while changing accuracy by -0.12/+0.08 pp; the paper explicitly frames this as layer-wise surrogate looseness.

Appendix C Table 6: SchurQuant takes 253.7 min on Qwen3-4B (2-bit) vs GPTQ 5.5 min and QEP 55.6 min on one H100 — a disclosed 45.8x/4.6x offline cost; Sec 6 Limitations admits this limits scalability and that evaluation is restricted to asymmetric quantization.

Sec 4.1-4.3 Tables 1-2: eight Llama/Qwen models, 2/3/4 bits, six zero-shot tasks, with GPTQ/FOEM/QEP evaluated in the same codebase and calibration protocol; SchurQuant best mean accuracy at 2 bits on all eight models (50.83% vs QEP 41.18%) but no comparison to QuIP#/AQLM/OmniQuant-class methods.

Reproducibility statement + Appendix D: rho=8 mismatch multiplier, lambda=1 anchor, R=16 refinements, g=128 groups, 128 C4 windows of length 2048, and full derivations (Appendix B) are provided, but no code or artifact release is claimed; several cited works carry future dates (e.g., 'Chen et al., 2026', 'Kimi Team et al., 2026'), limiting external verifiability.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A weight-only PTQ paper for LLMs (Llama/Qwen) that matches the LLM (2.5x) and quantization/efficiency (1.3x) preferences, though it does not touch the highest-weight clusters (agents, reasoning, Japanese LLM, RAG). The core contribution — conditioning each group's discrete decision on the Schur complement of the optimal continuous-suffix response (Proposition 1) plus an exact closed-form scale/zero-point refit (Proposition 2) — is a genuine but incremental refinement over GPTQ/QuantEase/CDQuant-style optimizers, and the final SchurQuant objective largely recombines existing ingredients (QEP teacher reconstruction, LoaQ residual-add targets, reference anchoring). Rigor is above average: controlled ablations (Table 3 isolates Schur conditioning from coordinate descent/refitting; Table 4 separates optimizer from objective), convergence sweep (Table 5), full proofs in Appendix B, and honest reporting that the optimizer worsens 3/4-bit PPL and that the local surrogate can be over-optimized. Evidence strength is solid but bounded: eight models and three bit widths, yet baselines are only GPTQ/FOEM/QEP inside one codebase, with no comparison to stronger 2-bit methods (QuIP#, AQLM, OmniQuant/EfficientQAT), no variance over seeds in the main tables, and 2-bit accuracy still degrades sharply (mean 50.83% vs 68.40% FP16). Generalizability is limited by the paper's own admission to asymmetric, g=128 weight-only quantization and by 4.6-5.8x QEP / 45.8x GPTQ quantization-time cost (Appendix C Table 6). Reproducibility is supported by detailed hyperparameters (rho=8, lambda=1, R=16, 128 C4 windows of length 2048, software stack in Sec 4.1/Appendix D) but no code release is stated. Overall a competent, carefully ablated efficiency contribution of moderate interest to the stated preference profile.

primary_link.title: SchurQuant: Groupwise Discrete Optimization for Layer-Wise LLM Quantization

papers.summary: Weight-only post-training quantization (PTQ) enables the deployment of large language models under tight memory budgets, but accuracy often collapses at 2-3 bits. Existing backpropagation-free PTQ optimizers have two limitations: group decisions ignore the correction that the remaining continuous suffix can absorb, and discrete refinements typically keep the affine quantization grid fixed. We introduce SCHUROPT, which analytically eliminates the suffix's optimal continuous response, yielding an
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型在記憶體受限的部署場景中，weight-only 後訓練量化（PTQ）雖能壓低權重位元寬度，但在 2–3 位元時準確率往往劇烈崩壞。本文指出既有免反向傳播的 PTQ 最佳化器有兩項缺陷：群組決策忽略了剩餘連續後綴可吸收的誤差修正，且離散精煉通常固守既定的仿射量化網格。作者提出 SchurOpt，透過 Schur 補（Schur complement）解析消去後綴的最佳連續反應，導出精確的群組二次目標，並交替執行封閉形式的逐列 scale 與 zero-point 重擬合，以及對整數碼的座標下降法。在固定 GPTQ 目標的對照實驗下，2 位元 Qwen3-4B 的 WikiText-2 困惑度由 258.96 降至 81.95，平均零樣本準確率提升 11.88 個百分點。完整版 SchurQuant 再結合量化前綴教師重建、參考權重正則化、殘差加總目標與教師決策 token 加權，於八個 Llama 與 Qwen 模型上取得免反向傳播 PTQ 基線中最佳的平均零樣本準確率，2 位元時領先最強基線 9.65 個百分點。但實驗也顯示 3–4 位元下更緊的層級重建未必轉化為端對端指標的改善。限制包括離線量化成本明顯偏高（可達 GPTQ 的數十倍）、層級代理目標與最終語言模型損失之間存在落差，且評估僅涵蓋非對稱量化。本文的價值在於透過控制實驗清楚分離最佳化器與目標函數各自的貢獻，對低位元量化的實務部署具參考價值。

links.title: The Limits of Binding in Dual Encoders

evidence: Abstract & §4: throttle theorems state the objective's binding reward is confined to (pi+pi_impl)log2 and reversed binding costs pi·E[M], 'both verified to within 0.006 in simulation'
Appendix K.3 (Figure 15): Monte-Carlo recovery of matched constants to three decimals (0.476 vs predicted 0.477; 1.943 vs 1.949)
Appendix L.4: depth law measured across b in {2,3}, N from 256 to 65,536, 24 seeds/config; m·b^D within 0.014/0.006 at N=65,536; measured D* staircase exactly 1,2,3,4,5 for b=2
Appendix L.6 / Lemma L.7: the high-probability l4 concentration step is 'Outlined... the single unproved step in this section' behind Theorem L.8 — explicitly flagged, expectation form proved
§5 / Table 1 & Appendix H: frontier diagnostic measured on 18 deployed text encoders over 675 quartets; all models at usage 0.248–0.349, far below the 2sqrt(2delta) ceiling

Appendix I: per-item ceiling |M(s)|<=d(s) validated on SugarCrepe, 14 models x 4,757 items (66,598 decisions), subset-level r=0.990, CLIP B/32 sanity anchor reproduces published 0.775 overall accuracy

§8 Limitations: depth theorem rests on one flagged concentration estimate; frontier probe limited to two-object color binding; NegCLIP comparison carries a three-way confound (fine-tune depth, corpus, negatives)
Reproducibility section: 'measurement scripts and raw results are available from the author on request' — no public code/artifact link
Appendix C (Prop. C.3): dimension dichotomy is credited to two published independent sources; possibility result establishes that all impossibility claims must be conditional
llm_evaluation.rationale: A theory paper on why CLIP-class dual encoders fail at compositional binding. Preference relevance is moderate: it squarely serves the multimodal AI (weight 1.8) and partially the evaluation/benchmark and contrastive-training interests, but touches none of the top-weighted LLM/agent/reasoning preferences and is not an LLM methodology paper (though also not pure CV — the analysis is centered on text encoders, parses, and compositional semantics, so no out-of-scope cap applies). Novelty is strong: three new conditional obstructions (an exact depth law m(D)=2b^-D for recursive role-binding beyond prior VSA crosstalk accounting; architecture-free throttle theorems quantifying the contrastive objective's binding reward as a (pi+pi_impl)log2 sliver, extending Chen et al.'s mere existence result; a tight smoothness-binding frontier M(s)<=2sqrt(2delta) formalizing the SugarCrepe++ dissociation) plus a refuted connectivity conjecture. Rigor is high and unusually honest: axioms are first shown satisfiable so every impossibility is conditional, and the single unproved concentration step (Lemma L.7) is explicitly flagged; however, several secondary results (add-margin, Theorem E.10 (i)/(iii)) are only outlined and the depth theorem's finite-N form rests on that flagged gap. Evidence is strong: simulations confirm the depth law (m·b^D within 0.014/0.006 at N=65,536, exact D* staircase), throttle constants verified to ~0.006, and a real-model zoo study (18 text encoders, 675 quartets; r=0.990 on SugarCrepe subset difficulty across 66,598 decisions with a published-accuracy sanity anchor). Key measurements depend partly on an under-review companion paper [6], and the frontier probe is synthetic 2-object color binding with an acknowledged NegCLIP three-way confound. Generalizability of the theorems is broad (architecture-free, any dimension) but empirical validation is narrow (text-side only). Reproducibility is middling: detailed protocols, seeds, and raw numbers are given, but scripts are only 'available from the author on request' with no public repository.

primary_link.title: The Limits of Binding in Dual Encoders

papers.summary: Dual-encoder models such as CLIP score an image-caption pair by a single inner product of two independently computed unit vectors, and fail at binding, often scoring near chance when asked to distinguish "a red car and a blue dog" from "a blue car and a red dog". We give a mathematical account of when this failure is necessary and when it is contingent. Working within the ideal-encoder framework proposed by Kang et al., we first show the relevant axioms are satisfiable, so every impossibility mu
papers.summary_zh: CLIP 等雙編碼器模型以兩個獨立向量的內積為圖文配對評分，卻常在「綁定」任務上近乎隨機地失敗：無法區分「紅色的車與藍色的狗」與「藍色的車與紅色的狗」。本文在理想編碼器框架下提供數學分析，先證明基準能力公理在維度低至 N=2k 時即可滿足，因此任何不可能結果都必須依賴額外且可檢驗的假設。作者據此證明三項條件式障礙：其一為深度，對遞迴角色綁定碼，交換邊際服從精確律 m(D)=2b^{-D}，可解析深度為 D*=log N/(2log b)+O(1)，在 CLIP 規模僅為個位數，恰落在自然語言的巢狀深度；其二為目標，與架構無關的節流定理顯示對比式目標對綁定的全部獎勵僅限於寬度 (π+π_impl)log 2 的薄層，且完全反轉的綁定只需多付出 π·E[M] 的損失，兩者皆在模擬中獲得 0.006 以內的驗證；其三為幾何，平滑性—綁定前緣 M(s)≤2√(2δ) 為緊上界。作者據此設計純文字診斷，量測 18 個部署模型的文字編碼器：所有模型僅使用上限的約 25–35%，其中 14 個模型的誘導上限與 SugarCrepe 子集難度的相關達 r=0.99。結論是當前綁定失敗並非維度或平滑性限制，而是誘因與碼結構問題，但深度上限在這些因素修復後依然存在。限制包括不可能結果皆為類別相對、深度定理的有限維形式依賴一個明確標記的集中性估計，且實測僅涵蓋雙物體顏色綁定情境。

links.title: Bit-Flip Attacks on Vision-Language-Action Models: Action-Decoding Architecture Shapes the Vulnerability

evidence: Abstract: 'a few gradient-selected flips reduce closed-loop success to 0%, while hundreds of random flips are harmless' and budgets span '1-5 flips' (direct/token) vs '~100-300' (flow heads).
§6.2 Table 1: LIBERO-Spatial clean 88.0% (n=50), min K=3 with 95% upper ≤7.1%, random-300 control 80.0% (5-seed 90.0%±5.4%).

§6.2 Real-robot study: task-calibrated emulated K=100 patch yields 0/20 successes vs 14/20 clean and 16/20 global-random, two-sided Fisher p<10^-5; App. A.2 Table 9 gives exact CIs and p=0.716 clean-vs-random.
§6.3 Table 5: L1 protection (3.1% of weights) preserves SR 60% at K=100 with adaptive re-attack (24/30 vs 0/30 unprotected, Fisher p=3.3e-11); §6.3 admits protection 'does not transfer to π0'.

§6.5 Table 7 + text: matched five-direction sweep at K=100, +1 and random directions significant after Bonferroni (adjusted p≤2.6e-3) while −1 is not (adjusted p=.154), rejecting an all-positive-direction artifact.
§6.2 'Trigger-conditioned stealthiness (negative result)': clean SR still falls to 0% at K=10-30 despite gradient separation (cosine ≈0.24).

§6.1 Reproducibility: seeds 20260722 and 20260730-39, PyTorch 2.5/Transformers 4.53/LeRobot 0.4.4, ancillary code provided, but 'checkpoints, benchmark assets, calibration observations, robot videos, and experiment outputs are not redistributed'.

§4 Threat Model: white-box attacker with small calibration set disjoint from evaluation, ≤K persistent flips, no control of inputs/activations/scales; §4 'Physical-delivery boundary' states the ~100-300 flow-head regime 'is not a deliverability claim'.

Appendix A.3: coherence difference mean 0.031 with wide 95% CI [-0.019, 0.081]; paper explicitly frames the 10× budget gap as 'an empirical objective comparison rather than an identified causal mechanism'.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Security paper (AI Safety/Red Teaming weighted preferences) attacking quantized VLA policies, not pure robotics method-building; the LLM connection is real (OpenVLA's LLM decoder/token head, L1 localization) but LLMs are the substrate, not the subject, and top-weight preferences (LLMs, reasoning, agentic tool use) are only peripheral. Novelty is a genuine gap (first weight-fault attack on continuous closed-loop policies) built on inherited BFA/PBS machinery plus a new fixed-direction objective for flow heads; the defense is simple selective protection. Rigor is unusually strong: random/magnitude/objective baselines, Clopper-Pearson CIs, Fisher and Wilcoxon tests with Bonferroni correction, adaptive (re-built) defense evaluation, and reported negative results (trigger-conditioned backdoor fails, §6.2). Evidence is quantitative and honestly hedged (logical faults only, wide CI on coherence diagnostic in App. A.3), though rollouts are small (n=24-50), the real-robot study covers one task with emulated flips, and physical delivery is explicitly out of scope. Generalizability is moderate: four variants across three decoder families support the architecture-dependence claim, but the defense fails to transfer to flow heads and white-box/INT8 assumptions bind. Reproducibility is decent (ancillary code, fixed seeds, full environment versions) but checkpoints, calibration data, and assets are not redistributed.

papers.summary: Quantized Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models expose a weight-fault surface: Rowhammer-style faults can corrupt deployed INT8 bits. We present the first bit-flip attack on a VLA: a few gradient-selected flips reduce closed-loop success to $0\%$, while hundreds of random flips are harmless. Across four model variants spanning three action-head families, damaging bits concentrate in a few action-generating layers, but the empirical budget depends sharply on the head: direct regression and token po
papers.summary_zh: 本文研究部署於邊緣裝置的量化視覺-語言-動作(VLA)模型之權重完整性安全,提出首個針對VLA的位元翻轉攻擊:模擬Rowhammer式故障破壞INT8權重,並以梯度排序搜尋最具破壞力的位元。方法核心為固定方向流形逃逸損失,將最終執行動作對固定方向的投影最佳化,透過完整解碼器反向傳播並以量化感知增益為每個位元評分,因此攻擊在迭代解碼下依然有效。實驗涵蓋三種動作頭家族:直接迴歸與離散詞元策略僅需1至5個翻轉,即把LIBERO閉迴路成功率從約90%壓至0%,而300個隨機翻轉幾乎無害;流匹配策略π0與π0.5則需約100至300個翻轉,呈現兩個數量級的脆弱性光譜。固定方向目標將π0預算由約1000降至約100,五方向掃描證實結果並非全正方向特異。真實機械手臂上,任務校準的K=100等效擾動使成功率從14/20降為0/20。防禦方面,保護L1層(3.1%權重)即可在K=100維持60%成功率,加上動作頭(5.3%)將開迴路崩潰門檻從3提升至100。限制為僅評估邏輯性INT8破壞,未涵蓋端對端實體故障遞送與ECC,且流模型需要更廣的保護覆蓋。本文確立權重完整性是具身基礎模型的安全邊界。

evidence: Abstract: 'GLaQ-7B gains 5.99-9.66% over its base model and leads all compared visual latent methods' across five benchmarks
Section 3.2: LQFormer is a two-layer Q-Former-style module with cross-attention to visual tokens, self-attention across K=16 slots, and FFN refinement

Section 4.1: implementation uses Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct backbone, 80K Visual-CoT Stage 1, 30K Zebra-CoT Stage 2, 10K RL samples; 'All reported benchmark results are obtained from our reproductions using the same VLMEvalKit evaluation settings'
Table 2 / Section 4.3: component ablations (w/o EMA teacher, w/o LQFormer, text-only SFT, text-only GRPO vs DePO) show DePO adds 0.52-1.37% over text-only GRPO on every benchmark
Section 4.4: non-monotonic sensitivity to lambda_latent (best at 0.3) and K (best at 16), with the caveat that K is 'not a test-time scaling effect'

llm_evaluation.rationale: A multimodal latent-reasoning method (MLLM/visual CoT space) that matches the Reasoning & Chain-of-Thought and Multimodal AI preferences strongly, and LLM/RL moderately, but does not engage the highest-weight agent, alignment, or Japanese-LLM preferences; it is not pure computer vision, so the 0.20 cap does not apply. The core idea - replacing autoregressive latent rollout with a fixed block of queries grounded in source visual tokens via a Q-Former-style adapter (Section 3.2) - is a sensible but incremental combination of known components (BLIP-2 Q-Former, BYOL EMA teacher, GRPO/DePO from HyLaR). Rigor is above average: five benchmarks, four baseline groups, component ablations (Table 2), hyperparameter sensitivity (Tables 3-4), and an efficiency analysis (Section 4.5, Figure 3), with limitations honestly stated (Section 5: single 7B backbone, fixed K, reliance on localized-view supervision). Evidence is quantitative and internally consistent, but all baselines are self-reproduced, no variance/significance reporting exists, the key latent-redundancy motivation rests on qualitative heatmaps (Figure 1), and no code or data release is claimed. Generalizability is limited by one backbone and fixed query capacity.

papers.summary_zh: 多模態大型語言模型依賴思維鏈推理,但將中間步驟以文字敘述時,細粒度視覺證據常被壓縮或流失;連續視覺潛在推理雖把中間運算保留於隱藏狀態,其自迴歸式建構卻使後續潛在狀態彼此相似、重複既有資訊而非補充視覺細節。本文提出GLaQ,以一組固定且依上下文條件化的查詢區塊取代自迴歸潛在序列:查詢先由多模態前綴情境化,再由輕量LQFormer直接錨定於原始視覺詞元,最後以軟性視覺提示重新注入以生成答案,形成情境化-錨定-再注入流程。訓練結合ROI局部視圖之EMA教師自我蒸餾,將局部證據監督轉移至全影像推論路徑,並以DePO在任務層級獎勵下同時最佳化文字與連續查詢動作。在V*、HRBench-4K/8K、MME-RealWorld-Lite與MMVP五項基準上,GLaQ-7B較Qwen2.5-VL-7B基礎模型提升5.99至9.66個百分點,並在所有視覺潛在方法中排名第一;消融實驗顯示LQFormer與EMA教師為關鍵,移除後效能甚至低於純文字微調,且吞吐量同時提升。限制包括僅採用單一7B骨幹、查詢容量固定,且監督依賴局部輔助視圖。本研究證明直接查詢對影像的錨定,可在不借助外部視覺工具下有效取回局部證據。

llm_evaluation.rationale: An evaluation-methodology benchmark of quantum vs classical models for power-system attack detection. Zero overlap with the dominant preference categories (LLMs, Japanese NLP, reasoning, agents); relevance comes only through AI-Safety-adjacent adversarial robustness and benchmark/evaluation keywords, plus a data-leakage angle. Research quality is exceptionally high: eight evaluator choices are each shown to reverse or move conclusions at fixed models (split leakage 0.905 vs 0.594 macro-F1, Sec. IV-A), with matched controls, positive controls, equal-budget tuning, seed replication, and honest reporting of failed mechanism hypotheses (Discussion). Novel quantum-kernel-specific findings (HSJ artifact refuted by random-perturbation control, surrogate imbalance manufacturing a 10.2x asymmetry, KTA-predicts/geometric-difference-confounded) are well supported but instantiated on a single dataset with simulator-only quantum results, which the Limitations section explicitly scopes. primary_link.title: Benchmarking Quantum Machine Learning for Power-System Attack Detection: Evaluation Choices Decide the Outcome Before the Models Do

papers.summary: Machine-learning detectors for power-system cyberattacks are themselves attack surfaces, and quantum machine learning has been proposed for them. We benchmark fidelity-kernel SVMs and variational classifiers against six tuned classical models on public power-system attack data (Mississippi State/ORNL), across white-box, transfer, decision-based black-box, and poisoning attacks. Our headline finding is methodological: the benchmark's answers are set by the evaluator's choices before the models. E
papers.summary_zh: 本篇針對電力系統網路攻擊偵測,將量子核SVM與變分量子分類器和六個調校過的傳統模型,在公開的Mississippi State/ORNL資料集上進行跨家族基準比較,涵蓋白盒、遷移、決策式黑盒與投毒攻擊。核心發現是方法學性的:基準測試的結論在模型運行前就已被評估者的選擇決定——八項選擇(六項評估協定、兩項調校協定)各自逆轉或大幅改動結論。影響最大的是資料切分:列級切分得0.905 macro-F1,改為整檔保留則僅0.594;在匹配維度下,量子模型落在雜訊範圍內、貼近隨機水準。忠實度核在未受直接攻擊時看似最穩健(保留率0.886),一旦被直接白盒攻擊即崩至0.064;代理模型規格錯誤會製造10倍的遷移不對稱;未設種子的黑盒攻擊結果在重啟間變動75%。正面對照顯示準確率平盤源自標籤與核的對齊不足,而非管線本身。作者提供能捕捉每項選擇的控制檢查表,並釋出QuantumGridBench重現性套件。限制在於單一資料集、以模擬器近似量子執行、且模型皆未加防禦。此研究的價值在於為對抗性量子機器學習評估樹立可檢驗的實證紀律,並揭露廣泛沿用的評估慣例如何悄悄左右科學結論。

evidence: Sec. 4.1: ChainSpace-Bench contains '326 real-world videos and 1,304 3-rounds QA pairs' with two-stage rule-based plus human QC (Sec. 4.2); enlarged to 800 videos / 3,200 chains in Table 4.

Table 2: paired bootstrap vs untuned Qwen3-VL-8B gives Full-chain Exact Match +0.0153 [0.0054, 0.0261] (p=0.0044) and Chain-Aware +0.0165 (p<0.0001), while SenseNova-SI shows no significant chain-level gain.

Table 5: matched Independent-QA control (same videos, questions, answers, training config) scores 0.3236 acc / 0.1482 Chain-Aware, below the untuned baseline (0.3344/0.1522), isolating cross-round dependency as the active factor.

Sec. 6.1 Implementation Details: full fine-tuning of Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct with frozen ViT on 8x H20 GPUs, lr 1e-7, 1 epoch, 32768 max sequence length; no code or data release commitment appears anywhere in the paper.

Table 7 and Table 8: external transfer is mixed — Ours-50K SITE-Bench overall 43.94 vs baseline 43.54 (below SenseNova-SI-150K at 45.35), and Qwen3-VL 3DSRBench vanilla 0.564 vs baseline 0.566, though Move/Nav and Flip/Circ settings improve.

Sec. 6.5(4): authors explicitly state sim-to-real domain gap means gains 'should not be interpreted as the upper bound of chained supervision'; only two 8B backbones (Qwen3-VL-8B, InternVL3-8B) and four task types are tested.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A multimodal spatial-reasoning benchmark+training paper for VLMs (Qwen3-VL, InternVL3), not pure CV or robotics, so it stays in scope, but its core contribution targets vision-grounded spatial state rather than the highest-weight LLM/agent/language preferences; it matches reasoning (chained multi-round, planning), multimodal, evaluation, and training-data topics at mid weight. The chained state-preserving formulation with a Chain-Aware Metric is a genuinely fresh angle versus independent-QA spatial benchmarks, though the formal setup (Eq. 1-2) is simple. Rigor is above average: a matched Independent-QA control (Table 5), oracle-history intervention (Table 3), paired-bootstrap significance (Tables 2, 12), metric-weight robustness (Table 11), an enlarged-benchmark stability check (Table 4), and an honest limitations discussion (Sec. 6.5). Evidence is solid for the central claim but effect sizes are small (FEM +0.0153) and external-transfer results are mixed (SITE-Bench overall 43.94 vs 43.54 baseline and below SenseNova-SI; 3DSRBench vanilla slightly below baseline), with an acknowledged simulator-to-real gap. Generalizability is limited to two 8B backbones and four 3-round task types. Reproducibility is hampered by no stated code/data release despite detailed hyperparameters and public simulators.

primary_link.title: ChainSpace: A Chained-Reasoning Paradigm for Spatial Intelligence

radar.summary: Spatial intelligence requires foundation models to maintain coherent spatial state across interactions with the physical world. However, existing data-centric approaches typically treat spatial reasoning as independent question-answer instances, enabling shortcut-based answering and providing limited supervision for persistent spatial understanding. To address this, we introduce ChainSpace, a chained-reasoning paradigm that structures spatial reasoning as a state-preserving multi-round process.
radar.summary_zh: 空間智慧要求多模態模型在與實體世界互動時維持連貫的空間狀態,但現有資料中心方法多將空間推理視為獨立的問答實例,讓模型可仰賴捷徑作答,難以評估真正的持續性空間理解。本文提出ChainSpace鏈式推理典範,將空間問題組織成邏輯受限、聯合一致的鏈:後續問題依賴先前輪次建立的空間約束。具體包含兩項成果:其一是人工標註的ChainSpace-Bench,含326則真實影片與1,304條三輪問答鏈,涵蓋物件計數、出現順序、相對方向與路徑規劃四項任務,並設計Chain-Aware Metric衡量鏈級一致性;其二是ChainSpace-Pipeline,以ProcTHOR與AI2-THOR模擬器產生鏈狀監督資料。實驗顯示,僅用約5萬筆模擬器生成的鏈式樣本訓練Qwen3-VL-8B,即取得開源模型在ChainSpace-Bench上的最佳表現,超越以數十萬至千萬級真實資料訓練的SenseNova-SI與RoboBrain,並能遷移至VSI-Bench等多項外部基準;對照實驗證明移除跨輪依賴後成效反而低於未微調的基準。限制包括模擬器與真實世界的領域差距,以及任務型別限於四類。本研究的意義在於以更少資料實現更忠實的空間智慧評估與更有效的監督學習。
radar.title: ChainSpace: A Chained-Reasoning Paradigm for Spatial Intelligence

evidence: Abstract: 'An open-source reference implementation for invoice processing demonstrates that the framework is fully operational and ready for adoption' — the only viability claim; no accuracy, cost, or user-study numbers are given in the paper.

Section 7 (Limitations): 'the bootstrap process is currently a manual workflow', 'quantifying the cost reduction across large-scale deployments remains future work', and 'our reference implementation validates the framework in a single domain; multi-domain validation is needed'.

Section 6.5: 'a comprehensive test suite covering condition operators, action executors, schema validation, conflict detection, and impact assessment is publicly available' (github.com/google/adk-samples invoice-processing) — code availability without reported test or accuracy outcomes.
Section 3.4.3: ALF detection uses '21 operators' with 'no LLM involvement in detection' and a three-tier action model (Table 3); design claims only, no empirical validation of correction quality.

Section 3.4.2: three-layer investigation with SHA-256 rule caching, batching, and triple-check verification; compliance thresholds (Fully_Compliant >= 80%) are asserted design constants, not validated empirically.

Section 3.6: Evaluation Engine (deterministic field comparison plus optional LLM-as-judge) is described, but the paper presents no results from running it, and no comparison against ReAct/LangChain/AutoGen or Self-Refine/Reflexion baselines discussed in Section 2 (Table 1 comparison is qualitative checkmarks).
Section 5.4: Spec-to-Note Gap remains at the level of 'Open Questions' (auditor faithfulness, regeneration cadence, whether the gap can become an optimization signal).
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly aligned with top-weighted agent preferences: a production LLM-agent lifecycle framework covering post-deployment correction, human-in-the-loop rule learning, and LLM-as-judge evaluation (Sections 3, 3.5, 3.6). However, it is a pure system-description paper: no quantitative experiments, baselines, ablations, or case-study metrics are reported anywhere; Section 6.5 substantiates 'fully operational' claims only by existence of an open-source invoice-processing implementation and a test suite, and Section 7 concedes single-domain validation, manual bootstrap, and unquantified cost behavior. Novelty is moderate — hybrid deterministic-LLM correction (Section 3.4.3) and cached triple-check investigation (Section 3.4.2) are sensible engineering, largely recombining BRMS, HITL learning, and constitutional-style governance; the Spec-to-Note autoencoder analogy (Section 5) is a conceptual framing left as open questions in 5.4. Reproducibility benefits from a public GitHub reference implementation, but with no results to reproduce and Gemini-dependence.

primary_link.title: Agent Gym: A Framework for Continuous Evaluation and Evolution of LLM Agents Through Human-in-the-Loop Feedback

Existing approaches address agent construction and one-time evaluation but provide no structured mechanism for continuous post-deployment behavioral correction without modifying the agent's source code. Most of the approaches offered in the market, require intense collection
radar.summary_zh: 大型語言模型(LLM)代理人上線後行為即凍結,而業務規則與邊界案例持續演變,形成「靜態代理人困境」;且生產環境常缺乏真值標籤,傳統評估框架難以應對。本文提出Agent Gym,一個領域無關的模組化框架,可將任何既有LLM代理人視為黑盒包覆,在不修改原始程式碼的前提下建立持續評估與演化迴圈。框架分三區:憲法層以宣告式設定產物(主資料YAML與規則書)承載領域知識;執行期推論管線串接行動代理人、調查代理人與ALF修正引擎——後者以21種條件運算子進行確定性錯誤偵測,並以三層級動作模型執行修正,調查代理人則以三層架構在無真值下驗證合規性;學習迴圈讓領域專家以自然語言對話發現新規則,並由程式化安全迴圈保證規則正確性後再經人工核准。文中另提出Spec-to-Note Gap概念,將代理人系統的透明度視為自編碼器式重構問題。作者以發票處理為例釋出開源參考實作,驗證框架可完整運作。限制在於僅單一領域驗證、引導流程仍仰賴人工,以及LLM驗證成本隨案例數增長。對企業而言,此框架讓領域專家直接治理代理人行為,修正即時、可審計且可回溯,填補了現有建造與一次性評估工具的缺口。

evidence: Sec. 4.1: delta-rotation that breaks only residual-centroid correlations raises class-averaged accuracy from 85.5% to 100% while preserving centroid-centroid correlations, radii, and example-example relations

Sec. 5.2/Fig. 4e: the fitted global radius renormalization lambda correlates with inverse Student-t tail exponent 1/nu at r=0.90 across 36 backbones (15 vision, 18 language, 3 audio), supporting its interpretation as heavy-tail compensation
Appendix H, Table 12: per-class Pearson r between predicted and empirical accuracy exceeds 0.93 on all 36 backbones, with mean RMSE 0.047 (vision) to 0.076 (audio/autoregressive LM)

Sec. 6: Qwen3 family mean radius grows 1.98 to 2.20 from 0.6B to 32B while accuracy rises 41% to 57%, ruling out variability reduction as the scaling mechanism; sigma_k/sigma_mu* and centroid decorrelation track scale

Appendix A.1: prototype classifier tracks a trained linear readout closely in vision (mean gap 0.047) and autoregressive LMs (0.063), but substantially less for masked LMs (gap 0.121, per-class r=0.58)

Appendix B.1: language experiments use only the TinyStories validation set restricted to 320 content-word lemma classes with >=1000 examples, limiting generalization of the universality claim for language
No code or artifact availability statement appears anywhere in the paper; reproducibility rests on the detailed setup in Appendices B and G
llm_evaluation.rationale: A representational-geometry theory paper, not a core LLM-methodology paper, but it directly analyzes frozen representations of 18 language models (Qwen2.5/Qwen3 0.5B-32B, Llama-3.1-8B, OLMo-2-13B, BERT/RoBERTa/ModernBERT/NomicBERT) alongside vision and audio backbones, and explicitly frames the sparse centroid-aligned basis as a grounded analog of sparse-autoencoder interpretability (Sec. 1, Sec. 7), giving moderate-to-good fit to the LLM and interpretability preferences. Novelty is high: it derives a mean-field theory for multiclass prototype accuracy in the finite-radius regime left uncovered by manifold-capacity and neural-collapse theories, and identifies a causally testable centroid-aligned structure. Rigor and evidence are strong: formal assumptions with proofs (App. C), synthetic-data validation of both models (App. D), surgical rotation controls isolating residual-centroid correlations (Sec. 4.1), and per-class prediction across 36 backbones (App. H, Table 12, r>0.93, RMSE 0.047-0.076). Limitations pull the score down: the language evaluation is confined to TinyStories with 320 content-word classes (App. B.1), the linear-readout proxy degrades for masked LMs (App. A.1, r=0.58), the fitted global lambda is a per-model calibration factor (Sec. 5.2), and no code release is stated. Not out-of-scope since the study is cross-modal with substantial language-model methodology.

radar.summary_zh: 理解深度神經網路表徵的內部機制,長期缺乏將幾何結構與多類分類準確率連結的預測性理論。本文以原型分類(以類別質心作為讀出向量)為分析框架,發現視覺、語音與語言等最先進模型共享一種普遍的表徵幾何:類內變異沿著真實類質心與少數競爭類質心方向,呈現強烈且結構化的相關性。透過旋轉操作外科手術式移除這些「質心對齊」相關性、同時保留類半徑與質心間距離,各類準確率幾乎升至100%,證明這些相關性正是分類錯誤的幾何來源。作者據此建構可解析的平均場理論:僅需真實類與稀疏對手類質心座標上的變異量,加上補償重尾統計的全域半徑重整化因子λ,即可預測各類準確率。理論在36個骨幹模型(橫跨ImageNet視覺、VGGSound語音、TinyStories語言)上與實測高度吻合(每類Pearson相關超過0.93),λ與尾指數的相關達0.90。跨規模分析顯示,較大模型的優勢並非來自變異縮減,而是變異向真實質心集中、對手相關減弱等幾何重組。此稀疏且語義豐富的原型碼連結稀疏自編碼器等可解釋性研究,亦為模型選擇與蒸餾提供可操作的幾何診斷。
