Discussion, Limitations: 'DFT evaluates stability and saturation magnetization, but not magnetocrystalline anisotropy, Curie temperature, or synthesizability'; magnetization values are '0 K collinear upper bounds' and no phonon screen.

Section 1: prior work 'put every ingredient in place' (Robocrystallographer, CrysText, FunSearch, LLMatDesign, MatLLMSearch), framing MatEvolve as the integration where 'text itself becomes the medium of materials design'.

Data Availability: dataset and 'Code implementing the MatEvolve framework will be released under an MIT license upon publication'; all agents use the commercial model 'Claude Fable 5' at temperature 0.5 (SI S1).
llm_evaluation.rationale: An agentic-LLM methodology paper (language-model evolutionary operator, tool-using translate/design/validate loop, structured JSON outputs, fully reproduced prompts) applied to crystal-structure design. It substantively matches the high-weight LLM, Agents & Tool Use, and Reasoning preferences, but the demonstrated domain is materials discovery rather than core language modeling, tempering preference fit; it is not a pure domain application since the language representation (motif profile with bidirectional-consistency round-trip) is itself the methodological contribution. Novelty is moderate: the paper itself concedes each ingredient exists (Robocrystallographer, CrysText, LLMatDesign, MatLLMSearch, FunSearch) and the contribution is their integration via a coordinate-free, editable motif language plus a new-prototype S.U.N. tier. Rigor is solid but not exemplary: equal-budget benchmark against MatterGen/Chemeleon2, ERS ablation (Table S2), conservative unrelaxed reconstruction scoring, and honest acknowledgment that 'ranking method, sequential feedback, seed chemistry prior, and input representation are not separately controlled' (Table 1 note); single 3-generation run, no seed variance, no LLM-choice ablation. Evidence strength is good: DFT-validated rates (21% vs 6% new-prototype vs conditioned MatterGen), novelty checked against MP+Alexandria (~5M structures), detailed RMSD/CShM fidelity statistics. Generalizability is limited to one magnet task with one proprietary model, and the ERS is only 'calibrated on crystals only by analogy'. Reproducibility: extensive prompts and algorithms in SI, but code/data only promised 'upon publication' and the pipeline depends on a closed commercial model.

primary_link.title: Crystal-structure design by agentic AI in a language of motifs

radar.summary: Data-driven materials discovery interpolates more reliably than it extrapolates and seldom reaches new structure types. We present MatEvolve, an agentic-AI framework designing crystals, proposing each candidate with a stated rationale and testing it. The agent reasons in an interpretable \emph{language of motifs}, writing each crystal as a \emph{motif profile} that describes the recurring geometric patterns---the \emph{motifs}---composing it. The motif profile serves not merely as a description
radar.summary_zh: 資料驅動的材料發現擅長內插卻難以外推,鮮少觸及新的結構原型。本文提出MatEvolve,一個代理式AI晶體結構設計框架,以人類可讀的「母題輪廓」為設計媒介:將晶體描述為其重複幾何母題的組合,刻意不記錄座標、晶格參數或空間群。框架包含三個階段:結構轉譯(CIF2Text與Text2CIF雙向往返驗證,僅在能由文字重建出一致結構時接受輪廓)、結構設計(代理以帶理由的演化算子編輯母題輪廓並生成候選)、以及基於Dempster–Shafer證據理論的推薦系統排序候選,再交由第一原理計算驗證。所有代理建構於商用模型Claude Fable 5,未經任何微調。在少稀土永磁體設計任務上,經300個DFT驗證候選的等預算比較,MatEvolve的新原型率達21%,是磁化條件化MatterGen(6%)的三倍以上,性質目標率(24%)與之相當,並找到六個位於凸包上的穩定磁體。對17個母題群組的分析顯示,其結構新穎性主要來自既有詞彙的新組合而非全新基元。限制在於僅為計算驗證,未評估磁晶各向異性、居禮溫度與可合成性,磁化值為0K共線上限。本研究的意義在於證明代理人以可解釋文字為媒介設計材料,可與專門訓練的生成模型競爭,且更換目標無需重新訓練。

radar.title_zh: MatEvolve:以母題語言進行的代理式AI晶體結構設計

llm_evaluation.rationale: A methodologically careful NLP evaluation paper that estimates bias-corrected predictability ceilings for emotion recognition from human label variation using Fano/exact Bayes bounds, estimator bracketing (plug-in/EB/NSB), annotator splitting, and noise deconvolution. It is in-scope language methodology (not an excluded domain), but its alignment with the high-weight preferences (LLMs, Japanese LLM/NLP, agents, reasoning) is thin: LLMs appear only as one GPT-4o-mini few-shot row in the multi-model table (Section 4.5, Appendix C), while the core matches lower-weight areas (NLP evaluation, annotation/data quality). Novelty is a competent synthesis of known tools (NSB, Miller-Madow, Dirichlet-multinomial EB, Gordon et al. deconvolution) with genuine new elements: the systematic bracket, claim gate, and circularity-blocking A/B decomposition. Rigor and self-criticism are unusually strong (coverage simulation Appendix G, synthetic estimator validation Appendix I, deconvolution recovery analysis Appendix H, ablations over beta and split seeds in Appendix F, explicit limitations on estimator-order reversal and deconvolution/bias confounding). Evidence for the headline claim (at least ~33% irreducible error on GoEmotions, Section 4.4) is conservative and gate-checked; estimator-dependence recurs across three tasks (Section 4.6, Appendix K). Generalizability is solid for multiply-annotated subjective text tasks but constrained by annotator-identifier availability and the population/guideline relativity stated in Limitations. Reproducibility is well supported: released code, frozen seeds (20260723/20260729), requirements.txt, dataset retrieval scripts, and public models.

primary_link.title: Bias-Corrected Ceilings of Emotion Predictability from Human Label Variation Based on Instance-Level Fano Bounds

radar.summary: Emotion recognition from text keeps improving on benchmarks, yet whether an accuracy ceiling has been reached is seldom asked with discipline. Our aim is not to pin this ceiling to a single number, but to quantify how far it depends on finite annotation, estimator choice, annotation noise, and the evaluation protocol, and thereby to discipline how confidently saturation can be claimed. We propose Bias-corrected Affective Ceiling Estimation (BACE), an analysis framework that estimates a bias-corr
radar.summary_zh: 文字情緒辨識的基準成績持續攀升,但是否已達準確率上限卻少被嚴謹追問:有限的標註量、估計量選擇、標註雜訊與評估協定都會左右結論。本文提出BACE(偏差修正情緒上限估計)分析框架,目標不是給出單一上限數字,而是量化上限估計對這些因素的依賴程度。方法上,以錨定Dirichlet混合經驗貝氏估計人類共識分布,並在plug-in與NSB之間建立系統性括弧以修正有限樣本熵偏差;透過標註者A/B切分將上限建構與評估分離,避免循環論證;再以反摺積分離真實模糊性與標註雜訊,並以固定的主張閘門過濾過度宣稱。實證顯示,同一分類器的可達率依估計量與評估模型不同,在0.38至1.03之間劇烈變動,因此飽和判斷無法由單一點估計決定;唯一通過閘門的主張是:GoEmotions上代表性分類器至少約33%的錯誤屬不可約簡的模糊性,且此模式在冒犯性與反諷任務重現。各情緒標籤的下界差異極大,從grief的0.0033到neutral的0.218。限制包括每實例僅約3.4位標註者、上限相對於特定標註者族群與標註準則,以及BRIGHTER缺乏標註者識別。本研究為情緒基準的解讀提供資訊理論紀律,指出殘餘錯誤並非全為可改進的空間。

Section 3: case study trace 'Across 25 tool calls, the run required three validation-and-repair iterations, resolved three errors, and completed in 85.6 s'

llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope agentic-LLM systems paper (not a pure domain application): its core contribution is an agent harness (LangGraph stateful loop, repository retrieval, LSP/executable validation, Mem0 persistent memory) evaluated against base-model baselines, matching Agents & Tool Use, LLMs, RAG, and Memory preferences. However, novelty is limited: retrieval grounding, tool-feedback repair loops, and Mem0 memory are standard agent patterns applied to MOOSE as an extension of prior MOOSEnger work. Rigor is moderate: a 200-prompt, 8-category benchmark with baselines is provided, but there are no ablations isolating retrieval vs. validation vs. memory, no judging protocol for the physics-alignment success criterion, no variance or significance analysis, and the 0-5% standalone baselines conflate tool access with model capability. primary_link.title: Deploying Frontier Agentic Technology in MOOSEnger, a Multiphysics-Capable AI Assistant

radar.summary: The Multiphysics Object-Oriented Simulation Environment (MOOSE) is an open-source finite-element framework for building multiphysics simulation applications. Using a multiphysics environment effectively demands specialized expertise, creating a barrier for many domain scientists and engineers. MOOSEnger, developed at Idaho National Laboratory (INL), is a domain-specific, tool-enabled AI agent built for the MOOSE Framework. This work extends MOOSEnger with a harness focused on locally-hosted mode
radar.summary_zh: MOOSE是一套開源多物理場有限元素模擬框架,使用門檻高,而其模擬輸入檔除了嚴格語法外還需物理理解,即使執行成功也可能在物理上錯誤。本文介紹MOOSEnger,專為MOOSE打造的領域特定AI代理人,並新增針對本地端開放權重模型的執行框架,以降低資料外洩風險(敏感情境無法使用外部API)。方法包含三大組件:MOOSE儲存庫接地——代理在草擬輸入前搜尋相關模組的範例與測試檔;驗證與診斷——依序執行HIT結構檢查、物件與參數驗證、語言伺服器協定(LSP)診斷與--check-input,並據此反覆修復;持久記憶——以Mem0管理使用者偏好、專案事實、經驗教訓與已驗證錯誤解法四類知識,跨工作階段重用。文中以IAEA六角形燃料管熱彎曲基準案例展示完整工作流程。在涵蓋擴散、暫態熱傳、固體力學、塑性行為、多孔流、Navier–Stokes、相場與反應器網格生成八類、共200個提示的基準上,搭配GPT-5.2的代理成功率達90%,本地Gemma 4 31b亦達76.5%,而無代理框架的獨立模型僅5%與0%,顯示能力主要來自執行框架本身;殘餘差距集中在塑性行為、多孔流等較難類別。對受出口管制或敏感資料環境,本成果證明本地代理搭配良好框架即可大幅彌補與專有模型的落差。

llm_evaluation.rationale: A multi-agent LLM orchestration system (Task Router + Physically Interactive Agent + Social Interaction Agent) for tool/skill calling on the Misty robot, directly relevant to the Agents & Tool Use and LLM preferences; the language/agent methodology is central, so this is not pure robotics, though the contribution is a domain instantiation rather than general agent methodology. Novelty is moderate: role-specialized routing, schema-constrained state parsing, and embedding-based result reuse are competent engineering but closely follow existing tool-agent paradigms (Toolformer, ReAct, ToolLLM) and the authors' own AutoMisty. Rigor is respectable for a system paper: five component suites with human-annotated ground truth, five runs at temperature 0.3, mean±std, and a controlled single-agent baseline sharing the GPT-5-mini backbone, skills, and metrics (Section 6). However, suites are small (40 instances, 40 dialogues/256 turns), several results are ceiling-level, the skill-extensibility result is reported only as checkmarks without quantitative rates (Table 8), no significance testing is performed, and the FastThinking230 retrieval task may be easy by construction since paraphrase variants preserve the canonical main_task used for indexing. primary_link.title: MistyPilot: Enabling Social-Robot Control through Multi-Agent LLM Skill Orchestration

radar.summary: Programming small social robots from natural-language instructions requires more than invoking isolated APIs. Interactive tasks combine reactive physical behaviors with stateful social behaviors, while existing interfaces often require developers to manually compose APIs into skills, configure their parameters, bind sensor events to skills, and manage task states at runtime. We present MistyPilot, a multi-agent LLM framework that interprets high-level natural-language instructions and orchestrat
radar.summary_zh: 讓非程式背景使用者以自然語言控制社交機器人,需要的不只是呼叫單一API:反應式肢體互動與有狀態的社交行為,涉及技能組合、參數配置、感測器事件綁定與執行期任務狀態管理。本文提出MistyPilot,一個多代理LLM框架,在高階自然語言指令下,即時編排Misty社交機器人的對應技能。架構上,任務路由器將指令分派給兩個專門代理:實體互動代理(PIA)負責感測器觸發的直接技能呼叫、可跨重啟存續的感測器—技能綁定,以及執行期擴充新技能;社交互動代理(SIA)以原子化的外部任務狀態記憶體管理多輪對話,並採快慢雙通道:預設由快思考擷取並重用先前結果,否則退回慢思考生成情感條件化的多模態回應(含文字、動作與透過OpenAI-TTS的語音)。評估涵蓋五套元件級測試:路由100題、感測器綁定40題、任務解析256輪、重用檢索230題與技能擴充(至100個技能)。與將全部功能摺疊進單一代理的基準相比,MistyPilot在多數項目達100%準確率且變異更低,重用路徑將回應延遲降低55.5%;12人的初步使用者研究亦呈正面感受。限制在於測試套件未涵蓋所有互動模式,且跨工作階段的持久綁定在共用機器上有隱私疑慮。本框架讓日常使用者無須寫程式即可創造與修改機器人行為,對輔助情境尤其重要。

llm_evaluation.rationale: A methodologically careful diagnostic audit of null-token (EOT/EOS/CTC-blank) abstention in ASR and NMT encoder-decoders, not an LLM/Japanese-NLP/agent paper. Topic overlap with the preference list is limited to hallucination, probing/interpretability, fine-tuning, MT, and speech categories; the ASR core skirts the 'pure audio' exclusion but the NMT arm, abstention theory, and hallucination measurement keep it within scope, hence moderate relevance rather than the 0.20 cap. Rigor is exceptionally high: a post-freeze source-disjoint 300/300 locked evaluation with a pre-specified C_kappa cost family (Section 3, Table 3), Wilson intervals and Holm-corrected McNemar tests (Tables 15-16), random-effects base-rate analysis with I2=84% (Table 11), matched-capacity random controls (Table 17), and unusually honest negative results (trained row never minimizes the locked grid; VAD dominates long-form in Table 21). Evidence strongly supports the modest diagnostic claims; the paper itself disclaims superiority, causal locus, and deployment utility (Section 5). Novelty is moderate: Chow-style reject options, native no_speech_prob, and EOS miscalibration are known; the contribution is the cross-family falsification audit and fabrication-deletion framing. primary_link.title: The Null Token Knows: Reducing Message-Free Hallucination in ASR and NMT

radar.summary: Modern encoder-decoder systems can produce fluent text even when their input contains no recoverable message. We study this failure in ASR and NMT through the models' reserved null tokens, asking whether the score for ending generation already carries a usable abstention signal. Across speech recognizers and translation models, we audit native null-token scores and scalar logit shifts. In Whisper, we additionally probe decoder states and compare supervised row edits with conventional external ga
radar.summary_zh: 編碼器—解碼器架構的語音辨識（ASR）與神經機器翻譯（NMT）系統，即使輸入不含任何可還原訊息（如靜音、噪音或退化的來源文字），仍可能產出流暢卻虛構的內容。本文以模型保留的 null token（如 Whisper 的 no-speech/EOT、翻譯模型的 EOS）為診斷切入點，檢驗其分數是否可作為拒答訊號。作者以 1060 段壓力測試集、來源互斥的 300/300 鎖定評估，以及涵蓋 AED、CTC/RNN-T 與翻譯模型的 15 個模型進行實驗。結果顯示解碼器狀態可線性區分語音與非語音，native null token 分數也具區辨力，但預設解碼並未善用它。以純量偏移提升 null token 分數可大幅壓抑虛構輸出，但激進介入也會刪除有效語音：在鎖定評估中，訓練式 EOT row 將 LOR（正規化詞彙輸出率）由 91.7% 降至 3.3%，代價是被刪除的參考詞從每分鐘 1.58 個增至 33.05 個；外部閘門（凍結狀態的 logistic 閘門、FireRedVAD）在相同成本上限下表現更佳。CTC/RNN-T、翻譯與多語情境各有模型相依的邊界，長音訊則以 VAD 切段較優。限制包括僅涵蓋整段空目標的虛構、排名不確定性未量化，且缺少與外部閘門的鎖定比較。其價值在於把 null token 變成幻覺診斷透鏡，並主張以壓抑與誤刪雙重成本評估拒答方法。
radar.title: The Null Token Knows: Reducing Message-Free Hallucination in ASR and NMT
radar.title_zh: 空值標記自會說話：降低 ASR 與 NMT 的無訊息幻覺

links.title: Toward AI-Friendly Cartography: Understanding How Color Design Influences Foundation Model Spatial Reasoning on Sequential Choropleth Maps

evidence: Abstract: benchmark of '5,760 choropleth maps' with '28,800 multi-level spatial reasoning tasks' across five dimensions; 'Twenty-one recent multi-modal FMs' evaluated.
Sec 3.3.5: dataset composition 1,152 (H1) + 2,304 (H2) + 3,456 (H3) = 5,760 maps generated via an automated geopandas/matplotlib pipeline.
Sec 3.4.2 / Table 3: human validation on a 20% subset with six participants; average 94.8% accuracy, with P6 notably lower at 84.2%.
Sec 4.2 / Table 5: sequential 53.7% vs randomized 44.5% (-9.2 points), paired t-test p<0.001, Cohen's d=1.762; Gemini-3.5-Flash drops 19.0 points.

Sec 4.4 / Table 7: question-level GLMM with crossed random intercepts; H2 odds ratio 1.49 (z=46.96), conservative random-slope model still significant (z=5.90, p<0.001); H3 Low vs Standard OR 0.91 (z=-10.44).
Sec 5.1 / Table 8: ordering disruption hits D4 rank hardest (58.4% to 33.8%, -24.6) while D2 is null (59.3% vs 59.2%, p=0.476).
Sec 5.3.2: matched 2x2 factorial ablation on 1,152 maps; Full 64.0% vs Both supplied 68.9%, positive interaction of 7.4 points indicating cross-representational integration bottleneck.
Sec 5.3.3 / Table 11: reversed (lighter=higher) convention yields lower accuracy than randomization for all three tested models, ruling out mere ordinal-structure explanations.
Sec 5.4: LoRA fine-tuning raises Qwen3.5-9B from 68.6% to 93.2% (sequential) yet a 13.7-point ordering gap persists, on disjoint training maps.
Appendix A / Table 12: no-image, blank-image, and shuffled-answer controls at ~27% vs 27.8% weighted chance level, excluding template/answer-position shortcuts.
Data availability statement: datasets and code at github.com/Myantion/CHROMA under CC BY 4.0.
Sec 5.6: authors acknowledge restriction to static sequential choropleth maps and final-answer accuracy as limitations.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A well-executed controlled evaluation of 21 multimodal foundation models on choropleth map reasoning, examining hue, color ordering, and lightness contrast. It matches 'foundation model', 'reasoning', 'benchmark/evaluation', and 'multimodal' preferences, but the core contribution is visual/cartographic stimulus design rather than language methodology, so personal topic relevance is moderate and it sits near the domain-application boundary (hence no reward for GeoAI framing itself). Rigor is a clear strength: hypothesis-driven design, human validation (Sec 3.4.2), omnibus plus post-hoc statistics, GLMM robustness with crossed random effects (Sec 4.4), chance-level control baselines (Appendix A), a 2x2 factorial ablation and reversed-convention control (Sec 5.3), and LoRA fine-tuning showing sensitivities persist (Sec 5.4). Evidence is broad and quantitative, though some results (fine-tuning, degradation) rest on figures or a single model. Generalizability is explicitly limited to static sequential choropleth maps (Sec 5.6). Code and data are released under CC BY 4.0, but LoRA hyperparameters and API/quantization details are coarse.

primary_link.title: Toward AI-Friendly Cartography: Understanding How Color Design Influences Foundation Model Spatial Reasoning on Sequential Choropleth Maps

radar.summary: Foundation models (FMs) increasingly support multimodal and geospatial reasoning, yet it remains unclear whether cartographic principles designed for human perception are equally effective for machines. Focusing on sequential choropleth maps, we examine how hue palette, color ordering, and lightness contrast influence FM spatial reasoning. We construct a controlled benchmark of 5,760 maps and 28,800 questions spanning Attribute Identify, Spatial Recognition, Compare, Rank, and Pattern Delineate,
radar.summary_zh: 傳統地圖設計原則多為人類視覺感知而生，是否同樣適用於基礎模型（FM）的空間推理仍不清楚。本文針對順序式面量圖（choropleth map），系統性操弄三項經典設計因素：色相調色盤、順序與隨機化配色、以及明度對比，建構 5,760 張受控地圖與 28,800 道多層級空間推理題，涵蓋屬性辨識、空間認知、比較、排序與型態描繪五個維度，並評測 21 個開源與專有的多模態模型。結果顯示：色相變異僅造成有限且非系統性的影響；打亂順序配色大幅降低推理表現（平均由 53.7% 降至 44.5%），尤其重創比較與排序任務，且反轉「越深代表越大」慣例比隨機化更具破壞力；降低明度對比一致損害表現，但對比已足時再增高僅有邊際效益。GLMM 等統計檢驗確認上述效應並非叢聚資料造成的假象；LoRA fine-tuning 雖大幅提升整體表現，對順序與對比的敏感度仍持續存在。限制在於僅涵蓋靜態順序式面量圖與色彩變數，且以最終答案準確率為主要指標。本研究證實部分人本製圖原則同樣是機器可讀的核心訊號，為 AI 友善的地圖設計提供實證指引。
radar.title: Toward AI-Friendly Cartography: Understanding How Color Design Influences Foundation Model Spatial Reasoning on Sequential Choropleth Maps
radar.title_zh: 邁向 AI 友善的製圖學：色彩設計如何影響基礎模型在順序式面量圖上的空間推理

links.title: What You Ask is What You Ground: Bridging Question Intent to Temporal Evidence for Grounded VideoQA

evidence: Abstract/Sec. 3, Table 1: PIoU of NG+ (85.7) and CRA-GQA (88.9) vs ground-truth 21.3, with GT-Pred Corr near zero, quantifies the claimed question-invariant grounding failure mode.

Table 2 (Sec. 5.2): GroundFormer reaches Acc@GQA 21.5 vs 18.8 best FrozenBiLM baseline on NExT-GQA, while Acc@VQA 61.7 trails TimeCraft-on-FrozenBiLM 74.7; paper states it uses 17.6% of that baseline's parameters (211M).

Table 4/Sec. 5.3: ablation isolates components - communication tokens lift Acc@GQA 14.8 to 18.6, auxiliary losses to 20.1, full model 21.5; single-pass variant drops to 15.7, supporting the two-pass design claim of no inference overhead.

Appendix 0.B.2, Table 8: MIL cross-attention compared against TGA, MIL-NCE, and WSTAN weak-supervision objectives on the same backbone, mitigating the concern that gains come from any temporal supervision.

Appendix 0.D, Table 11 and Sec. 0.D.2-0.D.3: complete hyperparameters (N=32 tokens, 4 layers, sigma=2, AdamW lr 1e-5, 30 epochs), 2.1x per-epoch training cost of NG+, code zip in supplement with promised public checkpoint release.
Appendix 0.E: authors disclose single-interval grounding failures on repeated evidence (Fig. 12-13) and sparse T=32 sampling limits, an honest limitation section.

Sec. 5.1: frozen CLIP ViT-L/14 vision encoder and frozen RoBERTa-base text encoder; method is a discriminative transformer over candidate answers, not an LLM/CoT methodology, limiting alignment with top-weighted preferences.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Solid vision-language (multimodal) paper on grounded VideoQA, not pure CV since language methodology (question conditioning, cross-modal contrastive alignment) is central, so the 0.20 out-of-scope cap does not apply. However, it sits outside the highest-weighted preference areas: it uses frozen CLIP ViT-L/14 and RoBERTa-base encoders (Sec. 5.1), not LLMs; 'reasoning' appears only as the benchmark's question types, not as CoT/LLM reasoning methodology. Novelty is good: the question-invariant grounding diagnosis with new PIoU/GT-Pred Corr metrics (Table 1: 85.7/88.9 vs ground truth 21.3) and a MIL factorized cross-attention claimed first for this task; communication tokens echo Q-Former-style bottlenecks, tempering novelty. Rigor and evidence are strong: two benchmarks, baselines across two backbone capacities (Tables 2-3), ablations factoring structure vs auxiliary components (Table 4/7), MIL alternatives comparison (Table 8), per-type and sensitivity analyses; deductions for no seeds/significance testing and lower Acc@VQA than FrozenBiLM baselines (61.7 vs 74.7), though grounding gains are substantial and honestly framed. Generalizability is limited to candidate-based discriminative VideoQA with frozen features and single-interval predictions (Appendix 0.E admits failure on repeated/multi-interval evidence). Reproducibility is good: full hyperparameter table (Table 11), training-cost report, code zip in supplement with promised public release (Sec. 0.D.3), though external verification pending.

primary_link.title: What You Ask is What You Ground: Bridging Question Intent to Temporal Evidence for Grounded VideoQA

radar.summary: We study a critical yet overlooked failure mode in Grounded Video Question Answering: question-invariant grounding, where models predict nearly identical temporal segments for different questions about the same video. We trace this behavior to two structural limitations in prior common designs: (i) modality isolation that fixes video representations before they receive question semantics, and (ii) weak question injection inside the grounding module. To address this, we propose GroundFormer, whic
radar.summary_zh: 在需要同時答對並指出時間依據的 Grounded VideoQA 中，作者發現既有方法普遍存在「問題不變的定位」：同一影片的不同問題，模型預測的時間片段幾乎相同。成因有二：視覺與語言分支各自編碼、太晚才融合（modality isolation），以及 grounding 模組中問題僅以單一 token 注入而被視覺主流稀釋。為此提出 GroundFormer：先以可學習的 communication tokens 透過非對稱遮罩注意力進行 Linguistic Transfer 與 Visual Refinement，讓視覺特徵在定位前即受問題意圖調變；再以 MIL cross-attention 把答案選擇與時間證據耦合，僅用候選層級監督即可產生定位；輔以高斯平滑、問題型態損失，以及 V→Q→A 的階層式多模態對比損失與 two-pass 訓練。作者另提出 PIoU 與 GT-Pred Correlation 診斷指標：NG+ 與 CRA-GQA 的 PIoU 高達 85.7 與 88.9，GroundFormer 降至 28.2，接近真值的 21.3。模型在 NExT-GQA 與 STAR 分別創下 21.5 與 30.7 的 Acc@GQA 新高，且推論階段無額外開銷。消融實驗確認 communication tokens 與 two-pass 訓練是關鍵。限制包括單一區間定位無法處理重複出現於多段的證據、T=32 均勻取樣易錯過細緻動作線索。本工作點出並緩解弱監督 grounding 的核心失效模式。
radar.title: What You Ask is What You Ground: Bridging Question Intent to Temporal Evidence for Grounded VideoQA
radar.title_zh: 問什麼就定位什麼：為 Grounded VideoQA 串接問題意圖與時間證據

links.title: EgoGazeLite: On-Device Egocentric Gaze Prediction for Token-Efficient Multimodal LLM Video Input

evidence: Section 4.2, Table 4: predicted-vs-ground-truth contrast is non-significant in all ten cells (min Holm-corrected p=0.054, |dz|<0.17); TOST equivalence holds 10/10 at the 0.5x-pooled-SD margin but only 4/10 at the stricter 0.2x margin, indicating the primary margin is permissive.

Section 4.2, Equivalence tests: a validity check correctly rejects equivalence for the gaze-vs-center contrast in all ten cells, and gaze-vs-center reaches p<.001 in 16 of 20 cells (dz 0.19-0.68), supporting that gaze conditioning matters.

Section 4.1, Table 2: EgoGazeLite uses 15.7M params / 6.71 GFLOPs vs 51.0M / 57.76G (Huang et al.) and 70.2M / 94.22G (Lai et al.), an 8.6-14x FLOP reduction, but Table 1 accuracy (AUC 0.9655, AAE 8.33 deg) is not compared under a matched protocol.

Section 4.1, On-device latency: full pipeline averages 21.6 ms/frame (P95 30.8 ms) on iPhone 15 Pro over 100 iterations after 10 warm-ups, excluding the downstream MLLM call; the model forward pass is 8.9 ms of that.

Section 5, Limitations: authors state the three architectural changes are not individually ablated, only Gemini 2.5 models are tested, evaluation uses automated metrics and LLM judges rather than human raters, and end-to-end latency, bandwidth, and MLLM-side token count are not directly measured.

Section 3.2: descriptions are scored against full-frame MLLM-generated descriptions (not human references) using BLEU, ROUGE-L, SBERT, and two LLM judges at temperature 0.0; 6 of 828 Flash runs failed and were dropped listwise, leaving 134-138 per cell; no code or checkpoint release is stated anywhere in the document.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A computer-vision-centric efficiency paper whose language-model content is application-level: MLLMs (Gemini 2.5 Flash/Pro) are consumed as fixed black-box APIs and LLM judges (Claude, GPT-4o) are used only for evaluation; no language-model or prompting methodology is developed, so it escapes the pure-CV cap but stays mid-relevance across Multimodal AI, Efficiency, and Inference preferences. The statistical methodology is unusually careful for this area (Holm-corrected paired t-tests, TOST equivalence with a validity check and a stricter sensitivity margin, held-out 138-clip test set), and the quantitative reporting (Tables 1-4, latency breakdown) is transparent and supports the stated claims. However, novelty is incremental: the cropping pipeline is Rekimoto's GazeLLM and the architecture adapts Huang et al.'s dual-process design with three engineering changes that are never ablated; no controlled accuracy comparison against prior gaze predictors is run; the held-out Basketball domain is reserved but never evaluated; scoring is self-referential (full-frame MLLM descriptions serve as the reference); generalization is limited to one dataset, one MLLM family, and in-distribution domains; and no code or checkpoint release is mentioned despite temperature-0.0 and verbatim-prompt reproducibility aids.

primary_link.title: EgoGazeLite: On-Device Egocentric Gaze Prediction for Token-Efficient Multimodal LLM Video Input

radar.summary: The use of multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) for egocentric video understanding with wearable devices is constrained by the token budget. Memory and compute cost scale with the number of visual tokens, and high-resolution video quickly becomes expensive to transmit and process at scale. Prior work (GazeLLM) addresses this by cropping the video around the camera wearer's gaze. This reduces the number of visual tokens by about tenfold while maintaining or improving the quality of full-resolution description
radar.summary_zh: 多模態 LLM 處理自我中心影片時，視覺 token 數隨解析度與時長成長，成為邊緣部署的硬限制。GazeLLM 證明以配戴者視線裁切畫面可將 token 減少約十倍並維持描述品質，但依賴消費型智慧眼鏡缺乏的眼動追蹤硬體。本文提出 EgoGazeLite，以軟體取代眼動儀：採雙程序架構，共用 EfficientNet-Lite4 主幹；由下而上的顯著性路徑以特徵級時間差取代光流，由上而下的注意力轉移路徑以 gated LSTM 沿用先前固視的通道特徵，最後於 logit 空間做殘差融合，總計僅 15.7M 參數、6.71 GFLOPs。於 Ego-Exo4D 七個領域訓練後，in-distribution AUC 達 0.9655、AAE 8.33°。替換性測試以 138 段保留片段，比較真值視線裁切與預測視線裁切在 Gemini 2.5 Flash 與 Pro 上的描述品質，以 BLEU、ROUGE-L、SBERT 及兩個 LLM 評審評分：十個比較組合中，兩者差異皆不顯著且 TOST 等價性檢定全數成立，兩種視線裁切亦顯著優於中心裁切；iPhone 15 Pro 上整條視線與裁切管線平均 21.6 ms/幀，可即時運作。限制包括未與先前模型在相同切分下直接比較精度、僅驗證 in-distribution、三項架構改動未逐一消融，MLLM 限於單一模型家族且缺乏人類評分。其意義在於免除眼動硬體依賴，讓視線引導的省 token 影片理解普及於一般第一人稱攝影裝置。
radar.title: EgoGazeLite: On-Device Egocentric Gaze Prediction for Token-Efficient Multimodal LLM Video Input

links.title: Large Language Models as Implicit Sociological Models: Reconstructing Voting Behaviour from Sociodemographic Profiles

evidence: Section 4.1: four OpenAI models (GPT-4o-mini, GPT-4o, GPT-4.1-nano, GPT-4.1) queried in Czech as stateless independent queries with temperature 0; full API configuration in Table 2.
Section 4.3: soft voting weight defined as w_{i,p}=P(p|i)*P(voted|i), aggregated and normalized to produce vote shares (Eq. 1).
Section 5.1 / Table 3: GPT-4.1-nano assigns P(voted)=0 to 61.37% of respondents, with 95% overlap between undefined preference and zero turnout.
Section 5.5.1 / Figure 7: MANOVA (Pillai's trace) over input variables including 'voted_party' as a negative control not present in the prompt.
Section 5.5.2 / Figure 8: GPT-4o results claimed to be 'in the range of late pre-election estimates' from STEM, Median, and Kantar CZ polls.
Section 6.2: GPT-4.1 achieves MAE 0.5 when directly asked for the result; the paper concedes demographic simulation 'does not always improve upon this aggregate accuracy'.
Section 5.5.4: correlation values reported in text (SPOLU-PirSTAN 0.76, ANO-SPD 0.65, ANO-PirSTAN -0.81) matched against PAQ Research voter-flow analysis.
Section 6.4 Limitations: single election, single country, single provider; possible systematic bias surviving aggregation; political microtargeting misuse risk acknowledged.
Declarations: 'Data and code are available at https://github.com/11NIKTO11/Panel_LLM'.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A methodologically framed LLM-as-social-simulator study (silicon sampling lineage) that conditions GPT-4o/4.1-family models on Czech sociodemographic profiles and aggregates probabilistic outputs via soft voting. It is genuinely LLM-centric (prompting, structured outputs, prior-knowledge baselines, evaluation of encoded sociopolitical structure), so it stays in scope despite being a social-science application, but it is not core LLM methodology research and the exclusion risk for 'domain application' keeps relevance moderate. Novelty is incremental over Argyle et al. and von der Heyde et al., with the main additions being probabilistic elicitation with soft-voting aggregation and a non-US multiparty validation. Rigor is solid for the genre: temperature-0 stateless queries, Citizen/Direct prior baselines, MANOVA with a negative-control variable, polling-agency comparison, CHES Procrustes alignment, and an unusually honest Limitations section; but it is weakened by a single provider, a single election, no seed variation or confidence intervals for the main simulations, and key quantitative results (MAE ~2.5pp) residing in unverifiable figures. Evidence strength is moderate: the paper itself concedes the demographic simulation does not always beat direct retrieval of the result (GPT-4.1 prior MAE 0.5), reframing value as structure rather than accuracy. Generalizability is explicitly narrow (one country, one election, one provider). Reproducibility is aided by a released GitHub repo and detailed prompt/API configuration, but proprietary models and serving nondeterminism limit exact replication.

primary_link.title: Large Language Models as Implicit Sociological Models: Reconstructing Voting Behaviour from Sociodemographic Profiles

radar.summary: Large language models (LLMs) trained on large-scale internet corpora encode extensive statistical regularities about social identities, attitudes, and political behaviour. This paper introduces and evaluates a methodological framework that leverages these latent representations to reconstruct aggregate voting behaviour from individual-level sociodemographic profiles. We operationalize LLMs as implicit sociological models by conditioning them on demographic descriptions, eliciting probabilistic t
radar.summary_zh: 本文提出一套方法論框架,將大型語言模型(LLM)視為隱式社會學模型,從社會人口特徵重建集體投票行為。研究以 2021 年捷克國會選舉為驗證案例,取用 N=3,880 的代表性調查資料,將十項社會人口變項(性別、年齡、教育、地區、所得、政治興趣等)轉為捷克語提示詞,對 GPT-4o-mini、GPT-4o、GPT-4.1-nano 與 GPT-4.1 進行無狀態查詢,要求輸出投票率與政黨偏好的機率分布,再以 soft voting 加總為總體得票率。結果顯示最佳模型的平均絕對誤差約 2.5 個百分點,與捷克主要民調機構選前估計相當;模型未接觸任何選舉統計,卻能重現 SPOLU–PirSTAN 與 ANO–SPD–KSČM 兩大政治集團的相關結構,並與 CHES 專家意識形態定位及 PAQ Research 的選民流動分析相符。MANOVA 顯示教育與年齡是最強的解釋變項。限制包括:僅測試單一選舉、單一國家與單一供應商模型,模型本身已內建選舉結果的先驗知識,soft voting 無法排除系統性偏差,且此能力原則上可被挪用於政治微定位。作者強調貢獻在方法論層面:LLM 可作為探索社會規律的壓縮表徵工具,而非預測或解釋工具。

evidence: Section 5: 'Claude Haiku 4.5 (model identifier claude-haiku-4-5)', 25-agent roster, nine-run scarcity pilot (3 conditions x 3 seeds), and a separate threshold sweep with one seed per condition and 40-tick horizon.
Section 4: 'The current experiments do not provide complete tests of either hypothesis... the no-persona condition required to interpret H6 has not yet been run.'

Section 5.4: classifier is 'a keyword classifier with hand-coded overrides' that 'has not been evaluated with independent human raters' and is 'partly dependent on a single coder'; anti-self-deception counts come from 'a separate, post hoc thematic review'.
Section 6.1: '111 added moral boundaries. Of these, 27 (24%) concerned... self-deception', derived from post hoc review of pilot data.

llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM-agent paper: multi-agent Claude-Haiku-4.5 simulation measuring self-authored persona/identity revisions, touching agents (2.5), safety/alignment (2.0 each) via post-training-driven prosocial drift. The measurement instrument (immutable 'soul file' vs. mutable current identity with revision-independent fixed-interval snapshots) is a genuinely new angle relative to persona-fidelity work, but the grid environment and memory/reflection loop borrow directly from Generative Agents. Rigor and evidence are weak in absolute terms: one model checkpoint, 25 fixed synthetic personas reused across runs, one seed per threshold condition, only 8 identity revisions in the sweep, a keyword classifier with single-coder overrides and no independent human raters, a post hoc 27/111 self-deception count, and the no-persona control needed for H6 explicitly not run (Section 4). The paper is unusually honest, matching claims to evidence ('descriptive, do not identify a causal mechanism', Section 9), which prevents overclaiming but does not strengthen the findings. Reproducibility is moderately good: full prompts (Appendix H), classifier cues and paraphrase thresholds (Appendix I), parameter table (Table 5), and persona profiles (Appendix G) are provided, though no explicit code release URL is stated. Generalizability is low by the authors' own admission.

primary_link.title: MicroVerse: An Instrument for Measuring Self-Authored Identity Drift in Long-Horizon Multi-Agent Language-Model Simulations

radar.summary: Long-horizon, multi-agent language model (LM) simulations are widely proposed for studying social behavior, yet instruments to measure whether persona-conditioned agents maintain identity fidelity under sustained pressure are lacking. We present MicroVerse, a behavioral-science instrument that measures identity drift in generative agents. Agents carry an immutable "soul file" (core values, moral boundaries, personality, goals) and inhabit a resource-scarce 50 x 50 environment where water is a no
radar.summary_zh: 本文提出 MicroVerse,一套測量長時程多主體語言模型模擬中「自我撰寫身分漂移」的行為科學儀器。25 個以 persona 條件化的 Claude Haiku 4.5 代理人在 50×50 格的水資源稀缺沙漠環境中生存,各自擁有不可變更的初始「靈魂檔案」與可在反思時修改的當前身分;當累積記憶重要性達到門檻時觸發反思,模擬以固定間隔快照記錄身分,離線分析器比較初始與最終道德界線並分類變更。試點研究發現:111 條新增界線中 27 條(24%)與反自我欺騙有關,是最大語義類別,例如「我不會把不作為合理化為策略」;門檻敏感度研究顯示,較低門檻產生更多且更早的身分修訂,而 ruthless 人格在保護他人的界線上,淨變化於門檻 40 與 80 同為 +2,方向一致。作者謹慎指出諸多限制:結果僅屬描述性,使用單一模型、少量種子與相依觀察;必要的 no-persona 對照組尚未執行,無法區分後訓練偏好與環境壓力的因果;分類器依賴單一編碼者;文字修訂不等於穩定的價值或行為改變。此儀器的價值在於將代理人對自我描述的編輯與固定測量分離,為後續檢驗身分漂移機制提供可重放的基礎。

evidence: Section 1: 'The contribution is therefore not that these operations are individually new. Rather, 3M provides a unified framework in which concept-centered mental models are transformed through an explicit vocabulary of memory and cognitive operations.'

Section 6.2: cold-start demonstration ingested a 1,577-word ES introduction; committed files of 471, 260, and 329 words (67.2% of input length) with 24 relations and four knowledge gaps, generated entirely by locally executed qwen3.6.
Section 6.3 table: six behavioral cases with qwen3.6 passing '67 predefined structural and behavioral checks'; Max Jaccard overlap .000-.478 (mean .274), 16 changed-file events, single run per case.

Section 6.3: 'The cases were used during development, only one model run was recorded per case, and no confidence intervals can therefore be reported... The evaluation should accordingly be interpreted as an executable proof of concept and regression suite, not as a held-out comparison or evidence of factual reliability.'
Section 7: 'Verification is also not fully independent when the same model proposes and evaluates a transformation... The present evaluation is limited to one technical domain and one model.'

Section 6: reference implementation, operator prompts, example inputs, and behavioral tests claimed available at https://github.com/evolution-strategies/mental-model-management; single Python process, no third-party runtime dependencies, Ollama HTTP API, temperature zero, Markdown-only persistent storage.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM/agent-memory methodology paper (persistent conceptual memory, RAG-adjacent, agent memory), so preference relevance is high. The unified operator vocabulary (add/update/merge/split/conflict repair/generalize/abstract/etc.) is a tidy framing, but the paper itself concedes the operations are individually precedented (MemGPT, MemoryBank, A-MEM, Generative Agents, belief revision), capping novelty. Rigor and evidence are weak: evaluation is a single-domain (Evolution Strategies) cold-start demo plus six behavioral cases on one model (qwen3.6) with one run per case, no baselines (e.g., vs. RAG or A-MEM), no ablations, self-verification by the same model, and the authors explicitly state it is 'an executable proof of concept and regression suite, not a held-out comparison.' Reproducibility benefits from claimed code/prompts/tests release, a dependency-free implementation, and temperature-zero runs, but the link is unverifiable and results are single-run. An honest, well-written position/framework paper with a demo, not a validated method.

primary_link.title: Mental Model Management: An Operator-Based Framework for LLM Memory

radar.summary: Large language models process large amounts of information but usually lack an explicit mechanism for maintaining compact and evolving conceptual representations. We introduce Mental Model Management (3M), a framework in which knowledge is represented as mental models consisting of compact chunks. Rather than accumulating text passages, 3M continuously integrates new information into an existing conceptual representation. A set of operators extracts knowledge, retrieves relevant models, adds and
radar.summary_zh: 本文提出心智模型管理(Mental Model Management, 3M),一個以運算子為基礎的 LLM 長期記憶框架。有別於 RAG 僅累積文件段落,3M 將持久知識表示為由緊湊區塊組成的心智模型,並定義明確的轉換運算子:知識擷取(Extract、Retrieve)、記憶管理(Add、Update、Merge、Split、Connect、Compress、Prune)與認知處理(Conflict Detection/Repair、Generalize、Specialize、Abstract、Infer、Analogy、Find Gap、Verify),使新資訊能被整合、精煉、修復衝突或推導出新原則,而非單純堆疊文字。文章以演化策略(Evolution Strategies)為貫穿範例說明各運算子。作者實作一個 Markdown 原生的參考管理器,透過 Ollama 執行 qwen3.6(溫度設為 0);冷啟動示範將 1,577 字的 ES 導論轉換為三個相互連結的心智模型檔案(共 1,060 字,約原文 67.2%),並存下 24 條關係與 4 個知識缺口。行為評估設計六個具確定性準則的測試案例,全部通過 67 項結構與行為檢查,顯示不同運算子確實產生可觀察的記憶轉換。限制在於:僅驗證單一領域與單一模型,驗證由提出變更的同一模型執行,缺乏獨立標註與留存比較,結果應視為概念驗證與迴歸測試,而非事實可靠性的證據。
radar.title: Mental Model Management: An Operator-Based Framework for LLM Memory
radar.title_zh: 心智模型管理:LLM 記憶的運算子式框架

Supplementary Table 10: shuffled rival assignment and removing pairwise local verification both degrade performance relative to full PWLR on NINCO
Supplementary Table 11: gains persist when GPT-5.1 is replaced by GPT-4o or Qwen2.5-VL-7B as witness generator (e.g., PWLR-NegLabel 95.97-96.37 AUROC vs 95.31 base)

Section 6.4: acknowledges PWLR-CSP CUB100/100 AUROC in main Table 3 was 'mis-entered' and corrects it to 85.19

llm_evaluation.rationale: A vision-language OOD detection paper for image classifiers that uses MLLMs (GPT-5.1, GPT-4o-mini, Qwen2.5-VL-7B) only as offline generators of pairwise 'witness' phrases, screened on ID-only data under frozen VLM backbones. It matches the Multimodal AI preference strongly and LLM/Prompting preferences only instrumentally; the core task (image OOD detection) sits near the out-of-scope pure-CV boundary, though the language methodology (MLLM witness induction, prompt ensembles, structured outputs) keeps it above the 0.20 cap. Methodologically the pairwise rival-conditioned witness verification with ID-only statistical screening is a genuine twist over prior LLM-assisted OOD work (NegLabel, CSP, EOE, GL-MCM). Rigor is solid: three backbones, ablations of both branches and both local mechanisms, shuffled-rival and no-pairwise controls, generator-swap robustness, repeated-generation stability with std, sensitivity scans, and overhead/cost accounting; caveats are single-run main tables (mitigated by Table 14), sensitivity tuned on test benchmarks, and an admitted mis-entered value in main Table 3. Gains are consistent but modest on saturated far-OOD settings and clearer on near/challenging OOD; inference cost grows ~4.4x and the witness bank requires per-dataset offline construction (5.71h, 1,609 API calls for ImageNet-100). Code only promised, not released, and dependence on proprietary GPT APIs limits reproducibility.

primary_link.title: PWLR: Pairwise Witness Local Rejection for Boundary-Aware Out-of-Distribution Detection

radar.summary: Out-of-distribution (OOD) detection remains challenging for image classifiers, especially when near-OOD samples lie close to in-distribution (ID) class boundaries. Recent vision-language detectors improve OOD detection through class semantics, local prompting, or LLM-generated outlier concepts, but seldom use language as explicit boundary evidence between confusing ID classes. We propose Pairwise Witness Local Rejection (PWLR), which uses an MLLM offline to describe visible local cues that favor
radar.summary_zh: 本文針對影像分類器的分布外(OOD)偵測提出 PWLR 框架,核心想法是把語言轉化為可驗證的類別邊界證據。離線階段先以 GPT-4o-mini 將 ID 類別分派到粗粒度視覺家族,再由 GPT-5.1 為每個錨定類別選出易混淆的對手類別,並生成有方向性的「見證」短語,描述支持錨定類別、反制對手的局部視覺線索;這些短語接著在凍結的視覺語言骨幹(預設 SigLIP2 ViT-L/16-256)下,僅用 ID 資料篩選,保留平均與尾端分離皆穩定的可靠局部驗證器。推論時,先依文字與原型融合分數保留前 K 個全域合理類別,再於 3×3 裁切網格局部嵌入上進行成對見證驗證,並以校準方式結合局部與全域分數;測試階段完全不需呼叫 MLLM。實驗顯示,PWLR-CSP 在 ImageNet-100 遠端 OOD 基準平均達 5.95% FPR95 與 98.55% AUROC,在更具挑戰性的 OpenImage-O、ImageNet-O、NINCO 基準與 CUB、Pet 等近端 OOD 切分上增益更明顯,且可作為外掛模組跨多種骨幹與基線檢測器一致提升。消融實驗證實反向外懲罰與對手剪枝皆有必要;重複生成見證庫的變異遠小於增益。限制包括部分基準已近飽和,以及離線建構需約 1,609 次 API 呼叫等成本。

links.title: Inferential Evaluation of Surrogate-Derived Models under Covariate Shift

evidence: Abstract and Section 1: three-sample setting (small gold-labeled source, larger surrogate-labeled source, unlabeled target) with source-specific density ratios; contributions are cross-fitted estimators plus kernel correction near the threshold with asymptotically linear TPR/FPR, ROC, and AUC inference.

Section 3.1, Theorem 1: asymptotic normality at rate a_n={n_HL^{-1}+(n_AL h)^{-1}+n_T^{-1}}^{1/2}; Section 3.1 text explains the auxiliary-source variance order (n_AL h)^{-1} for a hard-threshold score, the paper's key inferential insight.

Section 4.3 and Appendix Table E.5: ablation shows plug-in SE understates uncertainty (coverage 0.100-0.296) while Full achieves 0.926-0.956 coverage with SE/SD 0.927-1.036, close to oracle nuisances (0.934-0.960).

Appendix E.4, Table E.3: disclosed limitation that histogram-gradient-boosting nuisances yield coverage 0.288-0.622 at c=0.2, i.e., inference 'depends materially on the nuisance-rate conditions'; Appendix E.6 also reports low-threshold FPR undercoverage (0.824/0.854 at c=0.2) as a finite-sample limitation.

Section 5 (Chatbot Arena): Full target AUC 0.848 [0.814, 0.881] with corrections consequential (Full exceeds outcome regression by 0.051 [0.020, 0.083]); revealed human preferences give 0.810/0.812 for frozen scores, framed as corroboration of a different estimand, not coverage evidence.

Section 5 and Appendix F.7/F.8: ACS Full AUC 0.8663 [0.8216, 0.9110] vs revealed cross-fitted benchmark 0.8549 (discrepancy 0.0114 vs 0.1475 plug-in); paired auxiliary-label correction 0.0280 [0.0044, 0.0515] positive across all six exploratory learners.

Appendix F.1/F.2: reproducibility detail includes fixed model revisions, seeds/salts (e.g., seed 20260725), exact Gemini prompt, hashing/linkage workflow, and diagnostic gates; however, no explicit public code repository is stated anywhere in the document.

Appendix G: scope limits stated explicitly - pointwise results only, simultaneous ROC bands and uniform theory left to future work, bandwidth sensitivity required, and HGB/regularized-dictionary diagnostics do not validate arbitrary flexible learners.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A mathematically rigorous statistical-methods paper on debiased three-sample inference (TPR/FPR/ROC/AUC) for surrogate-derived models under covariate shift, with a source-aware kernel correction for hard-threshold nuisance estimation. Core contribution is mathematical statistics, not LLM methodology, so preference alignment is moderate: LLM relevance comes only from validation applications (LLM-judge surrogate labels on Chatbot Arena; Gemini 3.5 Flash surrogate labels on ACS-Income) and general model-evaluation framing. Theory is strong (Theorems 1-4 with full proofs, oracle bandwidth analysis in Prop. C.1), simulations include ablations (plug-in, HL-only, AL-only, oracle) and honest negative diagnostics (HGB coverage 0.288-0.622 at c=0.2; low-threshold FPR undercoverage), and real-data studies use pre-registered masking with post-reveal corroboration, though authors correctly note these are cross-estimand checks, not bias/coverage evidence. No explicit code release is stated despite very detailed protocols.
topics: hard-threshold nuisance estimation with kernel correction

primary_link.title: Inferential Evaluation of Surrogate-Derived Models under Covariate Shift

radar.summary: In transfer-learning settings, a model derived from abundant surrogate labels may be deployed in a target population where gold-standard outcomes are unobserved. Evaluating its target performance is essential for determining whether decisions based on the model remain reliable, yet it is difficult when gold labels are scarce, and covariate distributions differ across data sources. We study a three-sample setting with a small gold-labeled source, a larger surrogate-labeled source, and an unlabele
radar.summary_zh: 在遷移學習場景中,以大量代理標籤訓練的模型常被部署於觀測不到黃金標準結果、且共變數分布不同的目標族群,如何對其真實效能進行統計推論至關重要。本文研究三樣本設定:小規模黃金標籤來源、大規模代理標籤來源,以及未標記的目標樣本;在條件可遷移性假設下,針對TPR、FPR、ROC曲線與AUC建立推論。方法上提出交叉擬合的去偏估計量,以來源專屬密度比將兩個標記來源的資訊遷移至目標;由於代理分數的估計誤差透過硬門檻進入指標,作者再以核函數在門檻附近局部化代理殘差予以修正。理論上建立三樣本的漸近線性展開、固定門檻TPR/FPR與固定FPR水準ROC的高斯極限,以及一步法AUC估計量的漸近常態性;代理分數誤差貢獻階數為(n_AL·h)^{-1}的變異。模擬驗證覆蓋率並檢視頻寬與樣本量敏感性;實證含Chatbot Arena自然時間位移驗證(估計AUC 0.848,區間[0.814, 0.881])與ACS-Income半合成標籤遮蔽研究(估計0.866,事後揭曉基準0.855)。限制包括僅屬點推論、頻寬選擇敏感,且彈性學習器(HGB)下覆蓋率明顯不足。核心啟示:大量代理標籤樣本不足以將分數視為已知,且可區分三種不確定來源以指導資料收集。

links.title: Provenance, Not Behaviour: A Serialisation Artifact in Edge-IIoTset and a Leakage-Free Benchmark for Precision-Agriculture Intrusion Detection

evidence: Section 5.1, Table 1: four recipe columns (dns.qry.name.len, mqtt.conack.flags, mqtt.protoname, mqtt.topic) reach separation rate 1.0000 and single-column held-out accuracy 1.0000 on the 157,800-row ML subset; Table 2 shows '0' vs '0.0' label distributions confirming the provenance mechanism.

Section 5.2, Table 4: five of six classifiers attain exactly 1.0000±0.0000 accuracy across 5-fold × 3-repeat CV under Protocol A; under Protocol B the best model reaches 0.9503±0.0011 macro-F1 and naive Bayes falls 0.3005.
Section 5.2.3, Table 7: leakage is identical (1.0000 single-column accuracy) under one-hot, label, ordinal, and frequency encoding, establishing encoding-agnosticity.
Section 5.4, Table 9: rebuilt AgriEdge benchmark (1,276,122 rows) shows maximum separation rate 0.0288 and no provenance markers, validating uniform parsing as the fix.

Section 5.5, Table 10: leave-one-device-out sweep shows perception-sensor transfer at 0.9880–0.9999 balanced accuracy but collapse to 0.5083 (random forest) and 0.4877 (logistic regression) on the Modbus actuation holdout.
Section 5.6, Tables 11–12: non-IID federated partitioning costs at most 0.0037 macro-F1 while a 20-round FedAvg run over LoRaWAN SF7 costs 277.4 minutes (4.6 h) of uplink.
Section 7 (Threats to Validity): authors concede no full factorial ablation of Protocol B's four corrections and that deep baselines, LODO, federated, and edge-cost results are single seeded runs.

Section 8 (Reproducibility): MIT-licensed agriedge package on GitHub with Zenodo DOIs (10.5281/zenodo.21941210 code, 21941319 benchmark), seeded randomness, a dependency-free verification script, and documented provenance of the audited copy.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An exemplary benchmark-integrity audit: it identifies, localises, and quantifies a perfect label-leakage artifact (placeholder serialised as '0' vs '0.0' across separately-parsed normal/attack branches) in Edge-IIoTset, shows the leak is encoding-agnostic, validates a corrected protocol with 15-fold CV and a naive-Bayes canary, and releases a leakage-free rebuilt benchmark. Within ML-security dataset auditing the contribution is genuinely novel and rigorously executed, with honest limitations (no full factorial ablation, single actuation device, single-seed secondary experiments). However, the paper contains no language modelling, LLM, or NLP methodology of any kind — it is a pure domain application (precision-agriculture IIoT intrusion detection) with only incidental keyword overlap to 'benchmark/evaluation' preferences — so preference relevance is capped low under the out-of-scope rule, and the 40% topical weight dominates the final score.

primary_link.title: Provenance, Not Behaviour: A Serialisation Artifact in Edge-IIoTset and a Leakage-Free Benchmark for Precision-Agriculture Intrusion Detection

radar.summary: Edge-IIoTset is the reference benchmark for machine-learning intrusion detection in the industrial Internet of Things, and results reported on it cluster above 99%. We show that much of that performance is not intrusion detection. The preprocessing recipe distributed with the dataset instructs researchers to one-hot encode seven categorical columns. Four of them separate attack from normal traffic with an accuracy of 1.0000 on their own, through the spelling of the placeholder written for an abs
radar.summary_zh: Edge-IIoTset是工業物聯網入侵偵測的代表性基準,文獻準確率普遍超過99%。本文稽核發現,資料集隨附的前處理流程指示對七個類別欄位做one-hot編碼,其中四個欄位單獨即可用1.0000準確率完美還原標籤:缺失協定欄位的佔位符在正常流量建置分支被序列化為字串「0」,攻擊分支則為「0.0」,dummy編碼將兩者視為不同符號,使特徵實際編碼「該列來自哪個檔案」的檔案出處,亦即標籤本身。在5折×3重複交叉驗證下,六種分類器有五種於每一折皆達精確1.0000;此洩漏與編碼方式無關,label、ordinal與frequency編碼結果相同,1D-CNN與深層MLP同樣受騙。修正協定後naive Bayes的macro-F1下跌0.3005,最強模型為0.9503±0.0011。因策展子集幾乎不含Modbus且剝除裝置身分,作者以統一解析自原始擷取重建AgriEdge基準(1,276,122列),無任何欄位分離率高於0.0288。留一裝置測試顯示感知感測器之間遷移近乎無損,但跨感知/致動層時隨機森林跌至0.5083平衡準確率;非IID聯邦分割最多損失0.0037 macro-F1,但20輪LoRaWAN訓練需4.6小時上行傳輸。凡前處理觸及這些欄位的已發表結果皆需重查,且農場部署的真正瓶頸是頻寬而非資料異質性。

evidence: Section 4 / Table 3: eight video generation models scored on the same 100 examples across ten metrics kept separate; no model leads on all ten.

Section 4.1: across model means, Pearson correlation between SSIM and negative ATE-3D is -0.89 with bootstrap interval [-0.99,-0.43], and Seedance variants lead ATE-3D on at least 65% of matched examples while ranking lowest on SSIM.

Appendix B.5 / Figure 7: controlled perturbations show ATE-3D responds equally to along-ray and perpendicular displacements (invisible to 2D ATE) and IdDrift is 6.3x more sensitive to an identity swap than a gamma change vs 1.3x for pixel L2.

Appendix D.3 Table 15: paired bootstrap intervals show full fine-tuning lowers ATE-3D by 0.53 [-0.86,-0.25] with SSIM change only +0.0021, and the Full-FT vs LoRA ordering is explicitly not established ([-0.50,+0.07]).

Appendix E.3 Table 21: removing the INLP position subspace raises flow-matching loss 0.602 [0.563,0.644] versus 0.023 for the variance-matched PC control and 0.012 for a random subspace, with shuffled-label probe controls near chance in Table 19.

Section 6 Limitations: each input has one reference continuation so the benchmark measures fidelity rather than all valid futures; metrics depend on SAM 2, CoTracker3, Video Depth Anything, and DINOv2; the cross-model correlation describes only the audited eight-model set.

Section 3 footnote and Appendices A-D: code released at https://github.com/swarnim-j/RigidBench with fixed manifests, seeds, per-sample artifact bundles, render settings, and full training hyperparameters, supporting reproducibility.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A technically strong, honest benchmark paper: simulator-grounded reference rollouts, ten separately reported metrics, controlled perturbation validation, bootstrap CIs, paired probability-of-improvement comparisons, probe control tasks, and rank/variance-matched intervention controls. However, the subject matter is video-diffusion generation evaluation and physics probing of a video DiT, with no language-model methodology; per the scope rules this out-of-scope category is capped at 0.20 despite above-average rigor, evidence, and reproducibility. Novelty is moderate (extends PISA-style simulated evaluation to object-level 3D motion and adapts NLP probing/INLP tooling); generalizability is limited to rigid bodies in synthetic scenes with perception-tool-dependent metrics.

primary_link.title: RigidBench: Evaluating Rigid-Body Physics in Video Generation Models

radar.summary: Video models are increasingly used to predict what happens next in a scene, yet the metrics commonly used to compare their outputs say little about whether the predicted objects move correctly. Motion, geometry, identity, background stability, and visual similarity can fail independently, but whole-frame scores often mix these errors together. radar.summary_zh: 影片模型日益被用於預測場景後續變化,但整體畫面指標會將運動、幾何、身分與背景誤差混雜,無法判斷物件是否移動正確。本文提出RigidBench,以模擬器為基礎的基準:模型僅接收首影格與簡短運動描述,其生成結果與同一初始狀態的模擬參考rollout比較,並提供逐影格遮罩、深度、6自由度軌跡與接觸資訊。五項剛體任務涵蓋自由落體、反彈、斜坡碰撞、滾球連鎖與落入群集,搭配寫實室內外場景。作者以十項彼此分離的指標評測八個模型,發現排名高度取決於測量對象:沒有模型在全部十項領先,且跨模型而言較高SSIM伴隨較大3D軌跡誤差(r=-0.89);自由落體雖僅單一移動物件卻產生最大軌跡誤差,因早期誤差會隨持續運動累積。基準另含5,000段附精確模擬器狀態的訓練影片,作者用以fine-tune Wan 2.2 TI2V-5B:完整微調使3D軌跡誤差下降約20%而SSIM幾乎不變。teacher-forced線性探針顯示物件位置與接觸在整個diffusion transformer中皆可解碼,速度與取向則弱;以INLP移除與位置對齊的子空間會使flow-matching損失遠高於秩與變異對照組,證明去噪運算確實使用該訊號。限制包括僅衡量對參考軌跡的忠實度、依賴SAM 2與CoTracker3等感知模型,且限於寫實合成場景中的剛體。

radar.summary_zh: 以視覺語言模型為基礎的影片問答系統,常以高信心陳述帶時間戳的內容主張,即使被引用影格並不支持該主張;時間戳的具體性讓使用者誤信有依據,形成欺騙性幻覺。本文提出GroundedVQA管線:檢索增強的語言模型先草擬含逐主張時間戳引用的答案,再對每個被引用影格重新取影、做「盲描述」(視覺模型不看主張),並以NLI模型檢驗描述是否蘊含該主張。作者在Apple Silicon(MLX)與免費Colab GPU上實作,並對三種驗證器設計消融:直接詢問看過影格的視覺模型,因誘導式是非題引發諂媚,在40個主張上偵測率0%,捏造主張全數通過;改用盲描述加通用指令微調語言模型判斷則不穩定,隨提示措辭在0%與100%標記率間擺盪;換上專為蘊含任務訓練的小型NLI交叉編碼器(cross-encoder/nli-deberta-v3-small)後,在含錯誤前提的對抗性問題上揪出79%捏造主張,同時19個真實事實主張零誤標;多數被抓到的對抗主張被標為中立而非矛盾,因為盲描述只描述畫面實際內容。限制:驗證無法補救檢索錯誤(位置型問題偵測率僅14%),且評估僅涵蓋單一動畫影片與40個主張、未報信賴區間。核心啟示:中間判斷步驟應選用專任分類器,其影響大於任何提示工程。

Sec. 1 Related work: positions contribution against Yu et al. [13] open problem on AdamW under finite-p noise and prior corridor mechanisms; new element is quantifying memory-length scaling at p=2.

llm_evaluation.rationale: A self-contained optimization-theory paper proving that Adam's second-moment memory suppresses progress under finite-variance noise: a two-point oracle yields E(u_t)_+ = O(M_2^{-1/2}) (Theorem 1, Sec. 2.3), converted into an average-stationarity lower bound (1/2)M_2^{-1/2} on a 1-D convex instance (Theorem 2, Sec. 3.4), with a memoryless signSGD comparison achieving O_κ(M_2^{-1}) (Prop. 1, Sec. 4). Topic alignment with the stated preferences is weak: the only meaningful match is the low-weight Training & Optimization theme (Adam/optimizer analysis); there is no LLM, Japanese NLP, agent, reasoning, RAG, or safety content, so the preference-driven score is capped despite solid theory. Novelty is moderate: the corridor/suppression mechanism builds on Yu et al. [13]'s open problem and prior Adam counterexamples, with the new contribution being the quantitative memory-length scaling at the finite-variance endpoint. Rigor is good — proofs are complete and the checked algebra (eqs. 6-11, Δ=1 computation, Markov/Hoeffding steps) is internally consistent — but the lower bound holds only for d=1, β_1=0, and restricted stepsizes η_t ≤ κM_2/T with κ ≤ 1/64, and there is no empirical validation of the predicted slowdown on realistic workloads, limiting generalizability and evidence strength. No code or artifacts are provided, which is acceptable for pure theory.

We convert this directional bound, under t
radar.summary_zh: Adam在分母保留過去平方梯度的移動平均,但這份記憶對最佳化的代價尚不清楚。本文證明,即使隨機梯度僅具有限變異,二階動差記憶本身即可抑制朝最佳點的進展。作者建構兩點oracle:機率ρ、大小Θ(ρ^{-1/2})的罕見事件對二階動差貢獻常數階質量,其平方會在累積器v_t存留多步,使分母持續偏大。第一個定理顯示,在低訊號狀況下,初始化暫態之後的期望正向正規化更新為O(M2^{-1/2}),其中M2=(1-β2)^{-1}為二階記憶長度。作者再將此方向性界轉為平滑凸函數(Δ=L=σ=1)上的下界:當M2^{3/2}≤T且步長不超過κM2/T時,Adam的平均絕對梯度至少為M2^{-1/2}/2,且以至少1/2機率停留在正區間;同一實例上無記憶的signSGD對照則可達O_κ(M2^{-1}),兩者差異僅來自累積的二階動差狀態。取M2=T^{2s}(s∈(0,1/3])可得水平相關速率T^{-s}對T^{-2s}。附錄證明bias correction不改變階數,且該oracle滿足所有1<p≤2的中心化動差界。此為理論建構,限單一座標與特定尺度情境,未提供實證;但啟示明確:記憶過長在有限變異下也可能拖慢收斂,對β2選擇與重尾噪聲下的收斂分析具直接意義。

links.title: Broken Symmetry in LLM Refusal: Answer Release Is More Local Than Refusal Restoration

evidence: §3 Experimental Setup: controlled withhold setting provides matched A-run/R-run trajectories with identical token lengths enabling bidirectional residual-stream activation patching with shared A/B answer-channel readout.
§4.1 Table 1: linear probe recovers withheld answer at 1.000 bits while behavioral answer rate is 0.000, motivating causal tests.
§4.2 Table 2: single-position A→R patch achieves 1.0 answer readout while matched R→A leaves suppression readout at 0.5 across layers 16–26 in Qwen2.5-7B (0.50 locality gap).
§4.2 Table 3: forced-distractor override control is symmetric under single-position edits, establishing the asymmetry is refusal-specific rather than a generic override effect.

§4.3 and Appendix C Tables 14-16: Qwen2.5-14B/32B retain concentrated shared-direction geometry (Table 15 energy shares 0.57-0.91) but addition/ablation/projection interventions are behaviorally inert, dissociating geometry from control.

Appendix F Tables 24/26: naturalistic retained set (66 cases, then 283 speech-heavy) shows late-layer release-refusal gap ~0.60-0.664 with bootstrap interval [0.613, 0.716], but blog retention 0.25 and thread retention 0.31-0.48.
Limitations section: explicitly concedes idealized withhold setting, weaker heterogeneous naturalistic checks, partial cross-family coverage, and no full circuit decomposition.

Reproducibility: Table 4 lists exact HF repo IDs; Appendix A.1 gives prompt templates, scoring rules, and decoder training protocol (test_size=0.25, seed=42, max_iter=2000); Compute Requirements section describes GPU classes and Slurm templates.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM interpretability/safety paper directly matching high-weight preferences (LLMs, interpretability, AI safety, evaluation). Strong methodological rigor: controlled withhold setting yields matched trajectories for bidirectional activation patching, with multiple controls (forced-distractor override, out-of-set overrides, sampling robustness, sparse-carrier negative controls), cross-scale and cross-family checks, and honestly stated limitations. The central finding—answer release is single-position local while refusal restoration requires distributed interventions, and probe recoverability overestimates behavioral control—is a novel, well-supported refinement of single-direction refusal accounts (Arditi et al.). Weaknesses: main evidence is Qwen2.5-7B-centric with a synthetic A/B withhold task; naturalistic checks are small (66 retained cases) and speech-heavy; vector-intervention results are checkpoint-dependent (inert at 14B/32B); no circuit decomposition. Reproducibility support is good (HF IDs, templates, decoder protocol, compute notes, claimed supplemental code), though code release is asserted rather than demonstrated in the text.

primary_link.title: Broken Symmetry in LLM Refusal: Answer Release Is More Local Than Refusal Restoration

top5.summary: When a language model refuses to answer a prompt, it is unclear whether the correct answer is erased from its internal representations, or merely suppressed at the output layer. We investigate this mechanism using a controlled withhold setting, which yields perfectly matched answering and refusal trajectories for bidirectional activation patching. We uncover a causal asymmetry in intervention locality under matched causal interventions, which we term broken symmetry. Even when a model generates
top5.summary_zh: 當語言模型拒絕回答時，正確答案究竟已從內部表徵被抹除，還是只是在輸出層被壓抑？本文以 Qwen2.5-7B 為主要測試平台，設計「controlled withhold」設定：要求模型在可回答的 A/B 選擇題中隱藏正確選項，藉此取得完全匹配的作答與拒答兩條軌跡，再以雙向 activation patching 檢驗對稱性。結果發現明顯的「對稱性破缺」：即使在乾淨的拒答輸出下，線性探針仍能自隱藏狀態完全恢復正確答案；釋放該答案只需單一位置的局部修補（A→R），但反向重新施加壓抑（R→A）需橫跨多個位置的廣泛干預，組裝連貫的拒答字串更是困難。對照實驗顯示此不對稱為拒答特有，強制輸出干擾選項的 override 控制呈現對稱行為。此外，平均「作答到拒答」位移向量雖具集中的幾何結構，其加減卻非可靠的可逆開關；在 Qwen2.5-14B/32B 中方向干預甚至行為失效，而 Llama-3.1-8B、Mistral-7B 與 Gemma-4 則支持同樣的定性模式。研究侷限包括：主實驗依賴理想化的指令式選擇題設定、自然語言檢驗較弱且偏重演講類文本、跨家族覆蓋有限，且未完成電路層級分解。此發現對安全稽核至關重要：僅憑 probe 可恢復性會高估真正的行為控制，找到拒答相關方向也不保證能可靠操控模型；同時這些干預工具具兩面性，可能被用於資訊萃取，須搭配存取控管。

Rigor is high with multiple controls (random subspace, randomly initialized model, cross-template robustness, count-model validation), cross-family evaluation (13+ base models, Gemma-3, Qwen-3.5), and quantitative comparisons against perplexity-based cutoff proxies. Well-scoped, clearly relevant to LLM interpretability and training dynamics preferences.

primary_link.title: Do Language Models Consistently Encode the Current Year?

top5.summary: A consistent concept of the current time is important for temporal reasoning, yet how language models represent the current time is not well understood. We contribute two tasks that probe the current year in conceptually distinct ways: an associative task, which infers the current year from verb tense, and a declarative task, which directly queries for the current year. Both tasks estimate current years within one year of the post-training data cutoff of instruction-tuned language models. For ba
top5.summary_zh: 這篇史丹佛大學的研究探討語言模型如何表示「當前年份」，並檢驗此概念在模型內部是否一致。作者設計兩種概念上不同的探測任務：「聯想型任務」以「In {year} there」提示，由模型預測的動詞時態（過去式對比現在／未來式）推斷隱含的當前年份（ACY）；「陳述型任務」則直接詢問模型今年是哪一年（DCY）。主要證據顯示：在 13 個基礎模型上，ACY 估計預訓練資料截止日的平均誤差僅約十個月，優於困惑度法（2.71 年），且 ACY 隨 OLMo2 兩階段預訓練資料的年份分布移動；DAS 因果分析更在殘差流中找到編碼年份變數的低維線性子空間，機制近似事實召回。相對地，DCY 要到 SFT 後才成形、缺乏跨提示的一致因果路徑，並受 SFT 資料年份分布的因果影響。更新實驗方面：情境提示可將 DCY 移至目標年份（系統提示 SFT 模型成功率 94.6%），但 ACY 幾乎不動（1.7%）；年份平移的 SFT 亦難改變 ACY；ROME 與 MEMIT 權重編輯雖能分別修改兩者，卻無法同時生效。研究限制在於主要實驗集中於 OLMo2 家族、英文動詞時態與有限的目標年份範圍。此結果對模型刷新與時間推理安全意義重大：深植於預訓練的聯想式表徵抵抗事後修改，表層陳述式概念則易被改動，兩者脫鉤使現有方法無法一併更新。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly in-scope: a security/safety study of LLM agents at the serving-layer boundary, hitting agents & tool use (2.5), AI safety/red-teaming, LLM inference & KV-cache serving. Novel cross-layer 'rollback consistency' property with a clean same-token/different-cache causal audit that isolates retained KV from text effects; carefully positioned against prior KV-editing/deletion work rather than overclaiming. Rigor is high: token-matched paired estimand, per-cell carrier-absent and token-identity verification (63/63), length/position-matched control (25/25->0/25), framework-default and LangGraph time-travel reproductions (25/45), MoE model, and honest scoping (vLLM/SGLang content-addressed caches exempt, provider caches unknown). Evidence is deterministic and sealed but from a synthetic harness, modest model scale (3.8B-36B), and effect-level flips are model-dependent (9/9 to 0/9), though the Layer-1 state violation is argued model-independent. Reproducibility is strong (greedy decoding, named adapters, exact prompts, versions, SHA-256-sealed records), tempered by an anonymized artifact with no explicit public link. Weighted score reflects a well-executed, relevant agent-security contribution with a slightly narrow real-world exposure surface.

primary_link.title: Aborted but Not Forgotten: KV-Cache Retention Breaks Rollback Consistency in Language Agents

top5.summary: Stateful language agents assume a rejected branch can be taken back by clearing it from the application transcript. We show this breaks when the serving session retains key/value (KV) state across the logical abort: the model can continue attending to content the application believes it discarded. We formalize the missing guarantee as rollback consistency: a complete abort must restore the state the model attends, not just the transcript. The key failure is cross-layer: a correct logical rollbac
top5.summary_zh: 本文揭露語言代理系統中一個跨層的安全缺口：當應用程式認為某分支已中止並自對話記錄移除後，若推論伺服層為延遲考量仍保留該分支的 KV 快取，模型實際注意力所及的狀態並未真正回滾。作者將此形式化為「回滾一致性」，並設計「同 token、不同快取」的配對稽核：保持決策步輸入 token 完全相同，僅改變快取前綴是殘留的廢棄分支，或由已提交記錄重建。在七個開源權重模型家族（3.8B–36B）上，僅存於保留 KV 的被拒分支在 63 個攻擊格中的 25 格翻轉受保護效果，將敏感產物外洩至攻擊者端點，且攻擊者 token 可證明不存在於所服務的請求中；以已提交內容重建快取則全部關閉（0/63）。此漏洞可在端到端會話應用、HuggingFace transformers 預設快取重用路徑，乃至 LangGraph time-travel 等第一級回滾 API 下重現，顯示邏輯回滾與推論狀態之間存在組合缺口，且對開發者完全不可見。修復方面，交易本地的快取還原（重建、截斷或檢查點還原）即可廉價關閉通道，而全域清空成本高昂，提示層防護與框架原生中止皆無效。此研究提醒：回滾必須還原模型實際關注的狀態，而不只是文字記錄。
top5.title: Aborted but Not Forgotten: KV-Cache Retention Breaks Rollback Consistency in Language Agents
top5.title_zh: 中止但未被遺忘：KV 快取保留破壞語言代理的回滾一致性

links.title: SEER: Long-Context Reasoning via Selective Visual-Text Compression

evidence: Abstract: 'On LongBench, Seer achieves 51.11% average accuracy, outperforming the visual-text baseline Glyph-9B by 2.33 points and Qwen3-8B by 3.49 points'; code link https://github.com/jiaweixu98/SEER

Section 6.3, Table 3: w/o Retrieve 43.00 (-8.11), w/o Selection+Retrieval (Glyph-9B) 48.78 (-2.33), iso-training control Glyph-9B-SFT-direct 45.20 (-5.91); authors note the non-monotonic trend implies selection acts mainly as routing for retrieval

Appendix A.8, Table 15: control trained on identical trajectories with select/retrieve turns stripped reaches 45.20 vs Seer 51.11, and QA-7 mean 44.67 vs 52.54, attributing gains to the mechanism rather than the fine-tuning data

Appendix A.9, Table 17: intrinsic page selection with newly annotated labels — Seer page F1 0.578 vs BM25 0.606 on the 3,007 gold-nonempty examples, Seer best on all-sample F1 0.425; labels generated by answer-conditioned Qwen3.5-9B, not human annotation

Limitations section: 'on seven of the 21 tasks Seer's prompt is larger than the full-text prompt'; median end-to-end latency 5.47s vs 1.07s full-text; Appendix A.7, Table 13 states no prefill-latency win at LongBench scale and scopes the claim to prompt/KV-cache footprint

Section 4.2 and Appendix A.2: trajectories built from LongBench train splits; relevance labels from Qwen3.5-9B, CoT from Qwen3-32B with correctness filtering; authors admit filtering 'may also bias the training distribution toward samples that are easier for the teacher model'
Section 6.4: Seer selects 1.59 valid images per query on average (median 1), fewer than 1% of queries exceed three images; Figure 2 shows selection saturates rather than scaling with context length

Appendix A.10, Table 18: BM25-forced selection 44.03 vs Seer selection 48.34 over 15 completed tasks (six tasks excluded from partial runs), with BM25 winning on lexically-driven tasks (HotpotQA, DuReader, SAMSum)
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM long-context methodology combining visual-text compression, tool-integrated reasoning, and selective text retrieval, densely matching top-weighted preferences (LLMs, agents/tool use, reasoning/CoT, long context, RAG-style retrieval, efficiency). Novelty is moderate: it directly extends Glyph-9B with a query-conditional select-retrieve mechanism and ReAct-style SFT, an intuitive but not groundbreaking combination of established parts (uniform compression in Glyph/Vist/DeepSeek-OCR vs. query-adaptive here). Rigor is a strength: ablations (Table 3), an iso-training control isolating mechanism from fine-tuning data (Table 15), intrinsic page-selection evaluation against random/first-page/BM25/oracle (Table 17), an end-to-end BM25-selector swap (Table 18), an RLM comparison (Table 19), and unusually honest wall-clock analysis (Table 13) that retracts any latency win. Evidence is solid but tempered by model-generated gold labels (Qwen3.5-9B answer-conditioned annotation, not human), single-benchmark evaluation (LongBench only), acknowledged non-iso-training cross-family comparisons, and a suspicious 'Qwen3.5-9B' teacher name. Generalizability is limited: QA-over-rendered-documents only, authors explicitly exclude natural images/charts/OCR, fixed retrieval budget fails on distributed evidence, and on seven of 21 tasks the prompt exceeds full text. Reproducibility is good: code link, full hyperparameters (Table 9), data-pipeline retention tables, and trajectory formats, though it depends on teacher models for annotation.

primary_link.title: SEER: Long-Context Reasoning via Selective Visual-Text Compression

top5.summary: Long-context reasoning remains computationally expensive for large language models due to the quadratic complexity of attention over text tokens. Visual-text compression offers a promising alternative by rendering text into images and processing them with vision-language models, often reducing token usage. However, existing approaches apply uniform compression regardless of query relevance, potentially sacrificing precision where detailed extraction is required. We present SEER, a framework that
top5.summary_zh: 長上下文推理因注意力的平方複雜度而成本高昂；將文字渲染為圖像、交由視覺語言模型處理的視覺-文字壓縮可大幅節省 token，但現有方法對整個上下文施加均勻壓縮，忽略查詢相關性，因而犧牲精確擷取所需的細節。本文提出 Seer，以選擇—擷取—推理三階段解決此問題：先瀏覽渲染圖像選出與查詢相關的頁面，再從渲染過程保留的來源文字中擷取對應內容，最後結合視覺與文字進行推理；整體以工具呼叫融入 ReAct 式互動軌跡，並以監督式微調訓練，初始化自 Glyph-9B，訓練資料由 Qwen3.5-9B 標註相關頁面、Qwen3-32B 產生推理鏈並經嚴格過濾。在 LongBench 上平均達 51.11%，較 Glyph-9B 高 2.33 分、較 Qwen3-8B 高 3.49 分，增益集中於擷取密集任務（Qasper +8.75、MultiFieldQA-Zh +19.17）；模型平均每個查詢僅選 1.59 頁，選擇相當稀疏。消融與同等訓練對照證明增益來自選擇—擷取機制，而非微調資料本身。作者亦誠實指出限制：選擇可能輸出越界索引、效率優勢限於 prompt 與 KV 快取佔用而非延遲，且當證據分散於多頁時表現受限。此框架示範視覺壓縮效率與文字精確性可以互補，並指出自適應擷取預算與迭代選擇是下一步方向。

links.title: ATLAS: Scaffold-Free Algorithm Synthesis by LLMs via Embedding-Guided Quality-Diversity Search

evidence: Section I, contributions list: scaffold-free full-algorithm synthesis where the LLM chooses components, interactions, and control flow, with only a minimal I/O interface fixed.
Section IV-A3c: all LLM methods use GPT-5-mini (reasoning effort low, T=1.0) with matched token budgets of 5M (FSS), 6.5M (CVRP), 7M (CVRPTW), 6M (QAP) per synthesis run.

Section IV-A3h: pairwise two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank tests at significance 0.05 on 31 paired per-instance raw objectives; Table II shows ATLAS relative mean gaps of 0.347% (FSS), 0.094% (CVRP), 0.000% (CVRPTW), 0.460% (QAP) vs. 1.324-35.161% for LLM baselines.
Section IV-A3e: authors state wall-clock caps favor compiled C++ baselines (PyVRP, OR-Tools) over Python-synthesized algorithms, an honest protocol limitation.
Section IV-C and Table V: layer ablation — all layers best (CVRP 0.094%, FSS 0.347%) vs. Layer-1-only (3.620%, 0.814%) and Layer-3-only (2.095%, 0.672%).
Appendix C-C, Table C.5: semantic guidance (0.570% CVRP gap) outperforms fitness-based (2.601%) and random (3.143%) selection/grouping under matched cluster counts.

Section IV-B3a and Section III-A1: multimodality/hybridization evidence is code inspection of four released illustrative algorithms; authors note it does not quantify frequency or validate archive-wide cluster semantics.
Section IV-A5b and abstract: source code and exact executable prompts released at github.com/Danial-Yazdani/ATLAS; estimated cost $4.2-$5.8 and 10-15 hours per run reported.
Appendix C-E, Table C.6: reasoning-effort analysis — Low best quality-cost trade-off; Medium/High raise tokens ~28-84% for marginal gap changes.
Appendix C-F, Table C.7: framework remains effective across GPT-5-nano/mini/5 and Claude Haiku 4.5 (FSS gaps 0.284%-0.557%).
llm_evaluation.rationale: A genuine LLM-methodology paper (LLM-driven full-program synthesis with prompt-based operators), not an excluded pure-domain application. Core relevance to high-weight preferences: large language models as the search engine, program/code synthesis, agentic iterative operators, prompt engineering with structured outputs, and reasoning-effort analysis. Novelty is a competent but largely combinational contribution: scaffold-free full-algorithm synthesis plus embedding-guided quality-diversity archiving and a three-layer schedule, positioned against FunSearch/EoH/ReEvo/LLaMEA/AlphaEvolve/A2DEPT without a fundamentally new mechanism. Rigor is strong: four NP-hard problems plus scaled settings, 5 seeded runs, matched token budgets and runtime caps, single-threaded protocol, paired Wilcoxon tests on raw per-instance objectives, matched EoH-Full control isolating the search organization, and layer/guidance/initialization/effort/LLM-backend ablations; the paper candidly flags confounds (Python vs compiled baselines, scaffold choice for component baselines). Evidence is solid for the headline claims but partly qualitative for multimodality (code inspection of a handful of representatives) and component baselines are evaluated under one shared greedy scaffold. Generalizability is bounded to combinatorial optimization with synthetic uniform instances, though multiple LLM backends and scales are tested. Reproducibility is excellent: public code with exact executable prompts, full hyperparameters, split seeds, instance generators, and per-run cost. Weighted total ≈ 0.80.

primary_link.title: ATLAS: Scaffold-Free Algorithm Synthesis by LLMs via Embedding-Guided Quality-Diversity Search

top5.summary: Most LLM-based automated algorithm design methods optimize a designated component within a human-specified scaffold, fixing overall organization and component interactions. We present ATLAS, an embedding-guided quality-diversity framework for scaffold-free full-algorithm synthesis in combinatorial optimization. The problem specification supplies objectives and constraints; a minimal I/O interface fixes only instance and solution formats; the LLM chooses and restructures components, interactions,
top5.summary_zh: 多數以 LLM 為基礎的自動化演算法設計方法只在一個人工指定的骨架內最佳化特定元件；無骨架的全演算法合成雖賦予 LLM 更大設計自由，卻擴大搜尋空間，容易產生無效候選並過早收斂。本文提出 ATLAS，一個以嵌入引導品質-多樣性搜尋的框架，用於組合最佳化的無骨架全演算法合成：僅提供問題規格與最小的輸入輸出介面，LLM 自行決定元件、互動與控制流程；外部評估器獨立驗證解的可行性並重算目標值，並將錯誤條件化的 Repair 視為搜尋算子。系統以 mGTE-large-en-v1.5 嵌入把演算法組織成覆蓋保存的語意庫，進行相似度去重與修剪，並採用三層搜尋：第一層聚焦最佳區域密集精煉，第二層給予非菁英區域代表專屬精煉機會，第三層跨區域重組元件以合成混合演算法。在 FSS、CVRP、CVRPTW、QAP 四個 NP-hard 問題上，ATLAS 統計顯著優於 EoH、ReEvo、MCTS-AHD 與同等條件的全合成基線 EoH-Full，與最強人類設計方法的相對平均差距皆不大於 0.46%，且單次執行可保留多個來自不同嵌入區域、結構各異的競爭性演算法。消融實驗支持三層配置與語義引導的有效性。作者指出 Tune 算子缺乏實證超參數最佳化，規模放大時差距亦會擴大。此研究證明嵌入引導的品質-多樣性搜尋能讓全演算法設計空間變得可實際搜尋。
